drinks.name: Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime juice. Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice. Pour the rum and top with soda water. Garnish and serve with straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷叶与糖和青柠汁一起捣碎。加入少许苏打水，用碎冰填满杯子。倒入朗姆酒，再加满苏打水。加装饰，配吸管上桌。

drinks.name: Old Fashioned
drinks.instructions_en: Place sugar cube in old fashioned glass and saturate with bitters, add a dash of plain water. Muddle until dissolved. Fill the glass with ice cubes and add whiskey. Garnish with orange twist, and a cocktail cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将方糖放入古典杯中，用苦精浸透，加入少许清水。捣碎至溶解。用冰块填满杯子，加入威士忌。用橙皮卷和一颗鸡尾酒樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Long Island Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients (except cola) and pour over ice in a highball glass. Add the splash of cola for color. Decorate with a slice of lemon and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（可乐除外）混合，倒入装有冰块的海波杯中。加入少许可乐调色。用一片柠檬装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Negroni
drinks.instructions_en: Stir into glass over ice, garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在加冰的杯中搅拌，加装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Whiskey Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake with ice. Strain into chilled glass, garnish and serve. If served 'On the rocks', strain ingredients into old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀。滤入冰镇过的杯中，加装饰后上桌。若以“加冰”方式饮用，则将配料滤入装满冰块的古典杯中。

drinks.name: Dry Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.
drinks.instructions_zh: 纯饮：将所有配料倒入加有冰块的调酒杯中。充分搅拌。滤入冰镇的马天尼鸡尾酒杯中。将柠檬皮中的精油挤在酒面上，或用橄榄装饰。

drinks.name: Daiquiri
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入加有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Rub the rim of the glass with the lime slice to make the salt stick to it. Take care to moisten only the outer rim and sprinkle the salt on it. The salt should present to the lips of the imbiber and never mix into the cocktail. Shake the other ingredients with ice, then carefully pour into the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用青柠片擦拭杯口，使盐能粘附其上。注意只润湿杯外沿并撒上盐。盐应接触饮用者的嘴唇，而绝不能混入鸡尾酒中。将其他配料加冰摇匀，然后小心地倒入杯中。

drinks.name: Manhattan
drinks.instructions_en: Stirred over ice, strained into a chilled glass, garnished, and served up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰搅拌，滤入冰镇杯中，加装饰，净饮上桌。

drinks.name: Moscow Mule
drinks.instructions_en: Combine vodka and ginger beer in a highball glass filled with ice. Add lime juice. Stir gently. Garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有冰块的海波杯中混合伏特加和姜汁啤酒。加入青柠汁。轻轻搅拌。加装饰。

drinks.name: After Dinner Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except lime wedge) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the wedge of lime and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（青柠角除外）加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。放入青柠角后上桌。

drinks.name: After Supper Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 晚餐后鸡尾酒（After Supper Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Alabama Slammer
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients (except for lemon juice) over ice in a highball glass. Stir, add a dash of lemon juice, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（柠檬汁除外）倒入装有冰块的海波杯中。搅拌，加入少许柠檬汁，上桌。

drinks.name: Alaska Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass. Drop in a twist of lemon and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。放入一片柠檬皮卷，上桌。

drinks.name: Alexander
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。在表面撒上肉豆蔻粉，上桌。

drinks.name: Brandy Alexander
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（肉豆蔻除外）加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。在表面撒上肉豆蔻粉，上桌。

drinks.name: Alfie Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Combine and shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合所有配料后加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Algonquin
drinks.instructions_en: Combine and shake all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料混合并加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Allegheny
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the twist of lemon peel and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（柠檬皮除外）加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。在表面放上柠檬皮卷，上桌。

drinks.name: Allies Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Almeria
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中混合所有配料。充分摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Almond Joy
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Amaretto And Cream
drinks.name_display: 阿玛雷托奶油（Amaretto And Cream）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake well with cracked ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用碎冰充分摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Amaretto Mist
drinks.instructions_en: Pour amaretto in an old-fashioned glass over crushed ice. Add the wedge of lime and serve. (A wedge of lemon may be substituted for lime, if preferred.)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将杏仁利口酒倒入装有碎冰的古典杯中。放入青柠角后上桌。（如喜欢，可用柠檬角代替青柠。）

drinks.name: Amaretto Rose
drinks.instructions_en: Pour amaretto and lime juice over ice in a collins glass. Fill with club soda and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将杏仁利口酒和青柠汁倒入装有冰块的柯林杯中。加满苏打水，上桌。

drinks.name: Amaretto Stinger
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用碎冰将所有配料充分摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Amaretto Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Pour hot tea into a pousse-cafe glass, using a spoon in glass to prevent cracking. Add amaretto, but do not stir. Top with chilled whipped cream and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将热茶倒入分层酒杯中，杯中放一把勺子以防杯子破裂。加入杏仁利口酒，但不要搅拌。在表面加上冰镇的打发奶油，上桌。

drinks.name: Angel Face
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Applecar
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Apricot Lady
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, apricot brandy, triple sec, lemon juice, and egg white. Shake well. Strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with the orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合朗姆酒、杏子白兰地、橙皮利口酒、柠檬汁和蛋清。充分摇匀。滤入几乎装满冰块的古典杯中。用橙片装饰。

drinks.name: Archbishop
drinks.instructions_en: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在几乎装满冰块的古典杯中混合所有配料。充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Arise My Love
drinks.name_display: 醒来吧我的爱人（Arise My Love）
drinks.instructions_en: Put creme de menthe into a champagne flute. Fill with chilled champagne and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷利口酒倒入香槟笛形杯中。加满冰镇香槟，上桌。

drinks.name: Arthur Tompkins
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, Grand Marnier, and lemon juice. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合金酒、金万利和柠檬汁。充分摇匀。滤入酸酒杯中，用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Artillery
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Balmoral
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中混合所有配料。充分搅拌。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Banana Daiquiri
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入加有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Bermuda Highball
drinks.instructions_en: Pour brandy, gin, and dry vermouth into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Add the twist of lemon and serve. (Ginger ale may be substituted for carbonated water, if preferred.)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将白兰地、金酒和干味美思倒入装有冰块的海波杯中。加满苏打水并搅拌。放入柠檬皮卷，上桌。（如喜欢，可用姜汁汽水代替苏打水。）

drinks.name: Black Russian
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the ingredients into an old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入装满冰块的古典杯中。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Blackthorn
drinks.instructions_en: Stir sloe gin and vermouth with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黑刺李金酒和味美思加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。放入柠檬皮卷，上桌。

drinks.name: Bloody Maria
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except lemon slice) with cracked ice and strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes. Add the slice of lemon and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（柠檬片除外）用碎冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的古典杯中。放入柠檬片，上桌。

drinks.name: Bloody Mary
drinks.instructions_en: Stirring gently, pour all ingredients into highball glass. Garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 一边轻轻搅拌，一边将所有配料倒入海波杯中。加装饰。

drinks.name: Blue Lagoon
drinks.instructions_en: Pour vodka and curacao over ice in a highball glass. Fill with lemonade, top with the cherry, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和库拉索酒倒入装有冰块的海波杯中。加满柠檬水，在顶部放上樱桃，上桌。

drinks.name: Blue Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Rub rim of cocktail glass with lime juice. Dip rim in coarse salt. Shake tequila, blue curacao, and lime juice with ice, strain into the salt-rimmed glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用青柠汁擦拭鸡尾酒杯的杯口。将杯口蘸上粗盐。将龙舌兰、蓝库拉索酒和青柠汁加冰摇匀，滤入沾盐的杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Blue Mountain
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中混合所有配料。充分摇匀。滤入几乎装满冰块的古典杯中。

drinks.name: Bluebird
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with crushed ice, combine the gin, triple sec, Curacao, and bitters. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the lemon twist and the cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯碎冰的调酒杯中，混合金酒、橙皮利口酒、库拉索酒和苦精。充分搅拌。滤入鸡尾酒杯中，用柠檬皮卷和樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Bobby Burns Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 鲍比伯恩斯鸡尾酒（Bobby Burns Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（柠檬皮除外）加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。放入柠檬皮卷，上桌。

drinks.name: Boomerang
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1/2 tsp）
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, vermouth, bitters, and maraschino liqueur. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中，混合金酒、味美思、苦精和黑樱桃利口酒。充分搅拌。滤入鸡尾酒杯中，用樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Boston Sidecar
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Boston Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake juice of lemon, powdered sugar, blended whiskey, and egg white with cracked ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Add the slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬汁、糖粉、调和威士忌和蛋清加碎冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯中。放入柠檬片，在顶部放上樱桃，上桌。

drinks.name: Classic Old-Fashioned
drinks.instructions_en: In an old-fashioned glass, muddle the bitters and water into the sugar cube, using the back of a teaspoon. Almost fill the glass with ice cubes and add the bourbon. Garnish with the orange slice and the cherry. Serve with a swizzle stick.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中，用茶匙背面将苦精和水捣入方糖中。用冰块装至近满，加入波本威士忌。用橙片和樱桃装饰。配一根搅拌棒上桌。

drinks.name: Bourbon Sling
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the sugar, water, lemon juice, and bourbon. Shake well. Strain well. Strain into a highball glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合糖、水、柠檬汁和波本威士忌。充分摇匀。充分过滤。滤入海波杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Bourbon Sour
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the bourbon, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a whiskey sour glass, garnish with the orange slice and cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合波本威士忌、柠檬汁和糖。充分摇匀。滤入威士忌酸酒杯中，用橙片和樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Boxcar
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中混合所有配料。充分摇匀。滤入酸酒杯中。

drinks.name: Brandy Cobbler
drinks.instructions_en: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full. Add the brandy. Stir well. Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中，将糖溶于苏打水中。加入碎冰至杯子近满。加入白兰地。充分搅拌。用樱桃以及橙片和柠檬片装饰。

drinks.name: Brandy Flip
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the brandy, egg, sugar, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the nutmeg.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合白兰地、鸡蛋、糖和奶油。充分摇匀。滤入酸酒杯中，用肉豆蔻粉装饰。

drinks.name: Brandy Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake brandy, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with the lemon slice, top with the cherry, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将白兰地、柠檬汁和糖粉加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯中。用柠檬片装饰，在顶部放上樱桃，上桌。

drinks.name: Caipirinha
drinks.instructions_en: Place lime and sugar into old fashioned glass and muddle (mash the two ingredients together using a muddler or a wooden spoon). Fill the glass with ice and add the Cachaça.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠和糖放入古典杯中并捣碎（用捣棒或木勺将这两种配料一起捣压）。用冰块填满杯子，加入卡莎萨酒。

drinks.name: California Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a collins glass over shaved ice. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Decorate with slices of orange and lemon. Add the cherry and serve with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（苏打水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入装有刨冰的柯林杯中。加满苏打水并搅拌。用橙片和柠檬片装饰。放入樱桃，配吸管上桌。

drinks.name: Casa Blanca
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1 1/2 tsp）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Casino Royale
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1 tsp）
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中混合所有配料。充分摇匀。滤入酸酒杯中。

drinks.name: Champagne Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Add dash of Angostura bitter onto sugar cube and drop it into champagne flute. Add cognac followed by gently pouring chilled champagne. Garnish with orange slice and maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在方糖上滴上几滴安高天娜苦精，将其放入香槟笛形杯中。加入干邑，然后缓缓倒入冰镇香槟。用橙片和黑樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Cherry Rum
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Chicago Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（苏打水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入放有两块冰块的海波杯中。加满苏打水，搅拌，上桌。

drinks.name: Chocolate Black Russian
drinks.name_display: 巧克力黑俄罗斯（Chocolate Black Russian）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into a chilled champagne flute and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入电动搅拌机中，低速搅拌片刻。倒入冰镇的香槟笛形杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: City Slicker
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中混合所有配料。充分摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Clove Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Cuba Libre
drinks.instructions_en: Build all ingredients in a Collins glass filled with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料依次倒入装有冰块的柯林杯中。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Dragonfly
drinks.instructions_en: In a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and ginger ale. Stir well. Garnish with the lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在几乎装满冰块的海波杯中，混合金酒和姜汁汽水。充分搅拌。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Dry Rob Roy
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中，混合苏格兰威士忌和味美思。充分搅拌。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Dubonnet Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（柠檬皮除外）加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。放入柠檬皮卷，上桌。

drinks.name: English Highball
drinks.instructions_en: Pour brandy, gin, and sweet vermouth into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water. Add the twist of lemon peel, stir, and serve. (Ginger ale may be substituted for carbonated water, if preferred.)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将白兰地、金酒和甜味美思倒入装有冰块的海波杯中。加满苏打水。放入柠檬皮卷，搅拌，上桌。（如喜欢，可用姜汁汽水代替苏打水。）

drinks.name: English Rose Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 英式玫瑰鸡尾酒（English Rose Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Rub rim of cocktail glass with lemon juice and dip rim of glass in powdered sugar. Shake all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into sugar-rimmed glass. Top with the cherry and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用柠檬汁擦拭鸡尾酒杯的杯口，将杯口蘸上糖粉。将所有配料（樱桃除外）加冰摇匀，滤入沾糖的杯中。在顶部放上樱桃，上桌。

drinks.name: Flying Dutchman
drinks.instructions_en: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and triple sec. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在几乎装满冰块的古典杯中，混合金酒和橙皮利口酒。充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Flying Scotchman
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Foxy Lady
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Frisco Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except slices of lemon and lime) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with the slices of lemon and lime and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（柠檬片和青柠片除外）加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯中。用柠檬片和青柠片装饰，上桌。

drinks.name: Frozen Daiquiri
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients (except for the cherry) in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for five seconds, then blend at a high speed until firm. Pour contents into a champagne flute, top with the cherry, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（樱桃除外）放入电动搅拌机中，低速搅拌五秒钟，然后高速搅拌至浓稠。将内容物倒入香槟笛形杯中，在顶部放上樱桃，上桌。

drinks.name: Frozen Mint Daiquiri
drinks.name_display: 冰沙薄荷大吉利（Frozen Mint Daiquiri）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将1杯碎冰和所有配料放入电动搅拌机中混合。低速搅拌片刻。倒入古典杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Frozen Pineapple Daiquiri
drinks.name_display: 冰沙菠萝大吉利（Frozen Pineapple Daiquiri）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into a cocktail glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将1杯碎冰和所有配料放入电动搅拌机中混合。低速搅拌片刻。倒入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Gentleman's Club
drinks.instructions_en: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在几乎装满冰块的古典杯中混合所有配料。充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Gin And Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the gin and the tonic water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Garnish with the lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒和汤力水倒入几乎装满冰块的海波杯中。充分搅拌。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Gin Cooler
drinks.instructions_en: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice and add gin. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Add the lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end of the orange spiral dangles over rim of glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在柯林杯中搅拌糖粉和2盎司苏打水。用冰块填满杯子，加入金酒。加满苏打水并搅拌。放入柠檬皮和螺旋状橙皮，使橙皮末端垂挂在杯口外。

drinks.name: Gin Daisy
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, sugar, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合金酒、柠檬汁、糖和红石榴糖浆。充分摇匀。倒入古典杯中，用樱桃和橙片装饰。

drinks.name: Gin Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice cubes, except soda water. Pour into glass. Top with soda water.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除苏打水外的所有配料加冰块摇匀。倒入杯中。在顶部加满苏打水。

drinks.name: Gin Sling
drinks.instructions_en: Dissolve powdered sugar in mixture of water and juice of lemon. Add gin. Pour into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes and stir. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖粉溶于水和柠檬汁的混合液中。加入金酒。倒入装有冰块的古典杯中并搅拌。放入橙皮卷，上桌。

drinks.name: Gin Smash
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle sugar with carbonated water and mint sprigs in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and 1 ice cube. Stir, add the orange slice and the cherry, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中，将糖与苏打水和薄荷枝一起捣碎。加入金酒和1块冰块。搅拌，放入橙片和樱桃，上桌。

drinks.name: Gin Sour
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合金酒、柠檬汁和糖。充分摇匀。滤入酸酒杯中，用橙片和樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Gin Squirt
drinks.instructions_en: Stir gin, grenadine, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Decorate with the pineapple chunks and the strawberries and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、红石榴糖浆和糖粉加冰搅拌，滤入装有冰块的海波杯中。加满苏打水并搅拌。用菠萝块和草莓装饰，上桌。

drinks.name: Gin Swizzle
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the lime juice, sugar, gin, and bitters. Shake well. Almost fill a colling glass with ice cubes. Stir until the glass is frosted. Strain the mixture in the shaker into the glass and add the club soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合青柠汁、糖、金酒和苦精。充分摇匀。在柯林杯中装入近满冰块。搅拌至杯壁结霜。将摇酒壶中的混合液滤入杯中，加入苏打水。

drinks.name: Gin Toddy
drinks.instructions_en: Mix powdered sugar and water in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and one ice cube. Stir, add the twist of lemon peel, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中混合糖粉和水。加入金酒和一块冰块。搅拌，放入柠檬皮卷，上桌。

drinks.name: Godchild
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a champagne flute, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料用碎冰充分摇匀，滤入香槟笛形杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Godfather
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料直接倒入装满冰块的古典杯中。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Godmother
drinks.instructions_en: Pour vodka and amaretto into an old-fashioned glass over ice and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和杏仁利口酒倒入装有冰块的古典杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Grass Skirt
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, triple sec, pineapple juice, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the pineapple slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合金酒、橙皮利口酒、菠萝汁和红石榴糖浆。充分摇匀。倒入古典杯中，用菠萝片装饰。

drinks.name: Harvey Wallbanger
drinks.instructions_en: Stir the vodka and orange juice with ice in the glass, then float the Galliano on top. Garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加冰搅拌伏特加和橙汁，然后在顶部漂浮一层加利亚诺。加装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Havana Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中混合所有配料。充分摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Hawaiian Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，上桌。

drinks.name: Highland Fling Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 高地弗林鸡尾酒（Highland Fling Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients (except olive) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the olive and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（橄榄除外）加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。放入橄榄，上桌。

drinks.name: Imperial Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（苏打水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入放有两块冰块的海波杯中。加满苏打水，搅拌，上桌。

drinks.name: Irish Spring
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients (except orange slice and cherry) into a collins glass over ice cubes. Garnish with the slice of orange, add the cherry on top, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料（橙片和樱桃除外）倒入装有冰块的柯林杯中。用橙片装饰，在顶部放上樱桃，上桌。

drinks.name: Jack Rose Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 杰克玫瑰鸡尾酒（Jack Rose Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Japanese Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（苏打水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入放有两块冰块的海波杯中。加苏打水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Jewel Of The Nile
drinks.name_display: 尼罗河之珠（Jewel Of The Nile）
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中倒入所有材料，充分搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: John Collins
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients directly into highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently. Garnish. Add a dash of Angostura bitters.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料直接倒入加满冰的海波杯中，轻轻搅拌，加以装饰，再滴入少许安高天娜苦精。

drinks.name: Kamikaze
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients together with ice. Strain into glass, garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与冰一起摇匀，滤入杯中，装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Kentucky B And B
drinks.name_display: 肯塔基本笃白兰地（Kentucky B And B）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the bourbon and Benedictine into a brandy snifter.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将波本威士忌和廊酒倒入白兰地杯中。

drinks.name: Kentucky Colonel
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes combine the courbon and Benedictine. Shake and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的雪克杯中倒入波本威士忌和廊酒，摇匀后滤入鸡尾酒杯，用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Lady Love Fizz
drinks.name_display: 淑女之爱菲士（Lady Love Fizz）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（苏打水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入放有两块冰块的鸡尾酒杯中。加苏打水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Loch Lomond
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch, Drambuie, and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中倒入苏格兰威士忌、德兰布依和味美思，充分搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯，用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: London Town
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中倒入所有材料，充分搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Lone Tree Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Lone Tree Cooler
drinks.instructions_en: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice, add gin and vermouth, and stir. Fill with carbonated water and stir again. Add the twist of lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end dangles over rim of glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在柯林杯中搅拌糖粉和2盎司苏打水。加冰至满，倒入金酒和味美思，搅拌。加苏打水至满，再次搅拌。加入柠檬皮卷和橙皮螺旋条，使末端垂在杯沿之外。

drinks.name: Lord And Lady
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the rum and Tia Maria into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒和提亚玛丽亚咖啡利口酒倒入几乎装满冰块的古典杯中，充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Mai Tai
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain into glass. Garnish and serve with straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入杯中，装饰后配吸管享用。

drinks.name: Martinez Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the cherry and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（樱桃除外）加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯，放上樱桃即可享用。

drinks.name: Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.
drinks.instructions_zh: 纯饮：将所有材料倒入加有冰块的调酒杯中，充分搅拌，滤入冰镇的马天尼鸡尾酒杯。将柠檬皮中的精油挤在酒液上，或用橄榄装饰。

drinks.name: Midnight Cowboy
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的雪克杯中倒入所有材料，充分摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Mississippi Planters Punch
drinks.name_display: 密西西比种植者潘趣（Mississippi Planters Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（苏打水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的柯林杯中。加苏打水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Monkey Wrench
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all of the ingredients into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入几乎装满冰块的古典杯中，充分搅拌。

drinks.name: New York Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake blended whiskey, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Float claret on top. Decorate with the half-slice of lemon and the cherry and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将调和威士忌、柠檬汁和糖粉加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯。在表面浮上一层波尔多红酒。用半片柠檬和樱桃装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Orange Oasis
drinks.instructions_en: Shake brandy, gin, and orange juice with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将白兰地、金酒和橙汁加冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的海波杯中。加干姜水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Orgasm
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Pink Gin
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the bitters into a wine glass. Swirl the glass to coat the inside with the bitters, shake out the excess. Pour the gin into the glass. Do not add ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苦精倒入葡萄酒杯中，转动酒杯使苦精均匀覆盖杯壁，甩掉多余的苦精。将金酒倒入杯中。不要加冰。

drinks.name: Pink Lady
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Poppy Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Port And Starboard
drinks.instructions_en: Pour carefully into a pousse-cafe glass, so that creme de menthe floats on grenadine. Serve without mixing.
drinks.instructions_zh: 小心地倒入普施咖啡杯中，使薄荷利口酒浮在红石榴糖浆之上。不要搅拌，直接享用。

drinks.name: Port Wine Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 波特酒鸡尾酒（Port Wine Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Port Wine Flip
drinks.name_display: 波特酒菲利普（Port Wine Flip）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（肉豆蔻除外）加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯。在表面撒上肉豆蔻即可享用。

drinks.name: Quaker's Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Quarter Deck Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 后甲板鸡尾酒（Quarter Deck Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Queen Bee
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Queen Charlotte
drinks.instructions_en: Pour red wine and grenadine into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with lemon-lime soda, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将红酒和红石榴糖浆倒在柯林杯中的冰块上。加柠檬-青柠汽水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Queen Elizabeth
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Quentin
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, Kahlua, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the nutmeg.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的雪克杯中倒入朗姆酒、甘露咖啡利口酒和奶油，充分摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，用肉豆蔻装饰。

drinks.name: Royal Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except cola) with ice and strain into a chilled collins glass. Fill with cola and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（可乐除外）加冰摇匀，滤入冰镇的柯林杯中。加可乐至满即可享用。

drinks.name: Royal Gin Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（苏打水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入放有两块冰块的海波杯中。加苏打水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Rum Cobbler
drinks.instructions_en: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full. Add the rum. Stir well. Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中用苏打水将糖化开。加入碎冰至杯将满，倒入朗姆酒，充分搅拌。用樱桃以及橙片和柠檬片装饰。

drinks.name: Rum Cooler
ingredients_zh: 朗姆酒（2 oz light or dark）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the rum and soda into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well and garnish with the lemon wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒和苏打水倒入几乎装满冰块的柯林杯中，充分搅拌，用柠檬角装饰。

drinks.name: Rum Milk Punch
drinks.name_display: 朗姆牛奶潘趣（Rum Milk Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a collins glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（肉豆蔻除外）加冰摇匀，滤入柯林杯。在表面撒上肉豆蔻即可享用。

drinks.name: Rum Old-fashioned
drinks.instructions_en: Stir powdered sugar, water, and bitters in an old-fashioned glass. When sugar has dissolved add ice cubes and light rum. Add the twist of lime peel, float 151 proof rum on top, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中搅拌糖粉、水和苦精。待糖溶化后加入冰块和淡朗姆酒。加入青柠皮卷，在表面浮上151度朗姆酒，即可享用。

drinks.name: Rum Screwdriver
drinks.instructions_en: Pour rum into a highball glass over ice cubes. Add orange juice, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒倒在装有冰块的海波杯中。加入橙汁，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Rum Sour
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的雪克杯中倒入朗姆酒、柠檬汁和糖，充分摇匀，滤入酸酒杯，用橙片和樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Rum Toddy
ingredients_zh: 朗姆酒（2 oz light or dark）
drinks.instructions_en: Dissolve powdered sugar in water in an old-fashioned glass. Add rum and one ice cube and stir. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中用水将糖粉化开。加入朗姆酒和一块冰块，搅拌。加入柠檬皮卷即可享用。

drinks.name: Rusty Nail
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Scotch and Drambuie into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苏格兰威士忌和德兰布依倒入几乎装满冰块的古典杯中，充分搅拌，用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Salty Dog
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients over ice cubes in a highball glass. Stir well and serve. (Vodka may be substituted for gin, if preferred.)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒在装有冰块的海波杯中，充分搅拌后即可享用。（若喜欢，可用伏特加代替金酒。）

drinks.name: Sazerac
drinks.instructions_en: Rinse a chilled old-fashioned glass with the absinthe, add crushed ice, and set it aside. Stir the remaining ingredients over ice and set it aside. Discard the ice and any excess absinthe from the prepared glass, and strain the drink into the glass. Add the lemon peel for garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用苦艾酒涮洗冰镇的古典杯，使其挂壁，加入碎冰后放置一旁。将剩余材料加冰搅拌，放置一旁。倒掉备用杯中的冰和多余的苦艾酒，把调好的酒滤入杯中，加入柠檬皮装饰。

drinks.name: Scooter
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与碎冰充分摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Scotch Cobbler
drinks.instructions_en: Pour scotch, brandy, and curacao over ice in an old-fashioned glass. Add the orange slice, top with the mint sprig, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苏格兰威士忌、白兰地和库拉索酒倒在古典杯中的冰块上。加入橙片，放上薄荷枝，即可享用。

drinks.name: Scotch Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake scotch, juice of lime, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with 1/2 slice lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苏格兰威士忌、青柠汁和糖粉加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯。用半片柠檬装饰，放上樱桃，即可享用。

drinks.name: Screwdriver
drinks.instructions_en: Mix in a highball glass with ice. Garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在海波杯中加冰混合。装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Sherry Eggnog
drinks.instructions_en: Shake sherry, powdered sugar, and egg with ice and strain into a collins glass. Fill with milk and stir. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将雪莉酒、糖粉和鸡蛋加冰摇匀，滤入柯林杯。加牛奶至满并搅拌，在表面撒上肉豆蔻即可享用。

drinks.name: Sherry Flip
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（肉豆蔻除外）加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯。在表面撒上肉豆蔻即可享用。

drinks.name: Sidecar
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入装有冰块的雪克杯中，充分摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Singapore Sling
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into highball glass. Garnish with pineapple and cocktail cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入装有冰块的雪克杯中，充分摇匀，滤入海波杯，用菠萝和酒渍樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Sol Y Sombra
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a brandy snifter, and serve. (The English translation of the name of this drink is "Sun and Shade", and after sampling this drink, you'll understand why. Thanks, Kirby.)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料加冰摇匀，滤入白兰地杯，即可享用。（这款酒名的英文译名是“Sun and Shade”（日与影），品尝之后你就会明白为什么了。谢谢 Kirby。）

drinks.name: Stone Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled whiskey sour glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入冰镇的威士忌酸酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Tequila Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except ginger ale) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（干姜水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的柯林杯中。加干姜水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Tequila Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake tequila, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Add the half-slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将龙舌兰、柠檬汁和糖粉加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯。加入半片柠檬，放上樱桃，即可享用。

drinks.name: Thriller
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的雪克杯中倒入所有材料，充分摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Tom Collins
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a collins glass alomst filled with ice cubes. Add the club soda. Stir and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有半杯冰块的雪克杯中倒入金酒、柠檬汁和糖，充分摇匀，滤入几乎装满冰块的柯林杯。加入苏打水，搅拌后用樱桃和橙片装饰。

drinks.name: Turf Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients (except orange peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（橙皮除外）加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯。加入橙皮卷即可享用。

drinks.name: Tuxedo Cocktail
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1/4 tsp）
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry and a twist of lemon zest.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯。用一颗樱桃和一条柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Valencia Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Van Vleet
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的古典杯中，即可享用。

drinks.name: Vermouth Cassis
drinks.instructions_en: Stir vermouth and creme de cassis in a highball glass with ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir again, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在海波杯中将味美思和黑加仑利口酒与冰块一起搅拌。加苏打水至满，再次搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Vesuvio
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的古典杯中，即可享用。

drinks.name: Veteran
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the rum and cherry brandy into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒和樱桃白兰地倒入几乎装满冰块的古典杯中，充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Victor
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Victory Collins
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except orange slice) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Add the slice of orange and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（橙片除外）加冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的柯林杯中。加入橙片即可享用。

drinks.name: Vodka And Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with tonic water, stir, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加倒在装有冰块的海波杯中。加汤力水至满，稍加搅拌后即可享用。

drinks.name: Waikiki Beachcomber
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，即可享用。

drinks.name: Whisky Mac
drinks.instructions_en: Pour both of the ingredients into a wine goblet with no ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种材料倒入不加冰的葡萄酒杯中。

drinks.name: White Russian
drinks.instructions_en: Pour vodka and coffee liqueur over ice cubes in an old-fashioned glass. Fill with light cream and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和咖啡利口酒倒在古典杯中的冰块上。加淡奶油至满即可享用。

drinks.name: Afterglow
drinks.instructions_en: Mix. Serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合均匀，加冰享用。

drinks.name: Alice Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake well, strain into a large cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 充分摇匀，滤入大号鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Apple Karate
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机杯中，盖好盖子，以中速搅打至充分混合。倒入一个大杯、两个中杯或三个小杯中，一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Bora Bora
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare in a blender or shaker, serve in a highball glass on the rocks. Garnish with 1 slice of pineapple and one cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用搅拌机或雪克杯调制，加冰倒入海波杯中。用一片菠萝和一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Orangeade
drinks.instructions_en: Place some ice cubes in a large tumbler or highball glass, add lemon juice, orange juice, sugar syrup, and stir well. Top up with cold soda water, serve with a drinking straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大号平底杯或海波杯中放入几块冰块，加入柠檬汁、橙汁和糖浆，充分搅拌。加冰镇苏打水至满，配吸管享用。

drinks.name: Rail Splitter
drinks.instructions_en: Mix sugar syrup with lemon juice in a tall glass. Fill up with ginger ale.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中把糖浆和柠檬汁混合。加干姜水至满。

drinks.name: Banana Milk Shake
drinks.instructions_en: Blend very well, preferably in a household mixer. Serve in a wine glass, garnish with whipped cream and a piece of banana.
drinks.instructions_zh: 充分搅打混合，最好使用家用搅拌机。倒入葡萄酒杯，用打发的奶油和一片香蕉装饰。

drinks.name: Banana Strawberry Shake
drinks.name_display: 香蕉草莓奶昔（Banana Strawberry Shake）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all together in a blender until smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。

drinks.name: Banana Strawberry Shake Daiquiri
drinks.name_display: 香蕉草莓奶昔大吉利（Banana Strawberry Shake Daiquiri）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all together in a blender until smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。

drinks.name: Egg Cream
drinks.instructions_en: Mix syrup and milk in a fountain glass. Add soda water, serve with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在冷饮杯中混合糖浆和牛奶。加入苏打水，配吸管享用。

drinks.name: Fruit Cooler
drinks.instructions_en: Toss strawberries with sugar, and let sit overnight in refrigerator. Cut lemon, reserve two slices. Juice the rest. Mix together the lemon juice, strawberries, apple juice, and soda water. Add slices of lemon (decor, really). In glasses, put ice cubes, and a slice of apple. Pour drink in, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将草莓与糖拌匀，放入冰箱静置一夜。切开柠檬，留出两片，其余榨汁。将柠檬汁、草莓、苹果汁和苏打水混合在一起。加入柠檬片（其实只是装饰）。在杯中放入冰块和一片苹果，倒入调好的饮品即可享用。

drinks.name: Fruit Flip-Flop
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机杯中，盖好盖子，以中速搅打至充分混合。倒入一个大杯、两个中杯或三个小杯中，一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Fruit Shake
drinks.instructions_en: Blend til smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 搅打至顺滑。

drinks.name: Just a Moonmint
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机杯中，盖好盖子，以中速搅打至充分混合。倒入一个大杯、两个中杯或三个小杯中，一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Lassi - A South Indian Drink
drinks.name_display: 南印度拉西（Lassi - A South Indian Drink）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend in a blender for 3 seconds. Lassi is one of the easiest things to make, and there are many ways of making it. Basically, it is buttermilk (yoghurt whisked with water), and you can choose almost any consistency that you like, from the thinnest to the thickest. Serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 放入搅拌机中搅打3秒钟。拉西是最容易制作的饮品之一，做法也有很多种。基本上它就是酪乳（酸奶加水搅打而成），浓稠度几乎可以随你喜欢，从最稀到最稠都可以。冷饮风味更佳。

drinks.name: Lassi Khara
drinks.instructions_en: Blend (frappe) in blender until frothy. Add torn curry leaves and serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 放入搅拌机中搅打（冰沙模式）至起泡。加入撕碎的咖喱叶，冷饮风味更佳。

drinks.name: Lassi Raita
drinks.instructions_en: Blend the yoghurt and ice cubes together, until the yoghurt becomes more liquid. Add sugar to taste. The lemon/lime is optional but it gives it a slightly tart taste. Dash of salt. Raita is also good for the summer. Instead of having a traditional salad you can make raita instead.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将酸奶和冰块一起搅打，直至酸奶变得更稀。按口味加糖。柠檬/青柠可以不放，但加了会带一点微酸的风味。加少许盐。莱塔也很适合夏天，可以代替传统的沙拉。

drinks.name: Lassi - Sweet
drinks.instructions_en: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until nice and frothy. Serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中搅打至细腻起泡。冷藏后享用。

drinks.name: Lassi - Mango
drinks.instructions_en: Put it all in a blender and pour over crushed ice. You can also use other fruits like strawberries and bananas.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中搅打，倒在碎冰上。也可以用草莓、香蕉等其他水果。

drinks.name: Lemouroudji
drinks.instructions_en: Juice the lemons. Peel and grate the ginger. Place the grated ginger and a liberal dash of the cayenne pepper into a piece of cheesecloth, and tie it into a knot. Let soak in the water. After 15 minutes or so, add the sugar, and the lemon juice. Chill, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬榨汁。将生姜去皮并磨成末。把姜末和足量的卡宴辣椒粉放入一块纱布中，扎成结。放在水中浸泡。约15分钟后，加入糖和柠檬汁。冷藏后享用。

drinks.name: Limeade
drinks.instructions_en: In a large glass, put the lime juice and sugar, and stir well. Add cold seltzer water to fill. Put the lime peels in the glass. Drink. Repeat until limes or soda run out.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大号杯中放入青柠汁和糖，充分搅拌。加冰镇苏打水至满。把青柠皮放入杯中。饮用。重复以上步骤，直到青柠或苏打水用完。

drinks.name: Imperial Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Banana Cantaloupe Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 香蕉哈密瓜冰沙（Banana Cantaloupe Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Juice cantaloupe, pour juice into blender, add banana, and liquify.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将哈密瓜榨汁，把果汁倒入搅拌机，加入香蕉，搅打成液体。

drinks.name: Apple Berry Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 苹果浆果冰沙（Apple Berry Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.
drinks.instructions_zh: 把所有材料倒入搅拌机，搅打成液体。

drinks.name: Grape lemon pineapple Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 葡萄柠檬菠萝冰沙（Grape lemon pineapple Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.
drinks.instructions_zh: 把所有材料倒入搅拌机，搅打成液体。

drinks.name: Kiwi Papaya Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 奇异果木瓜冰沙（Kiwi Papaya Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.
drinks.instructions_zh: 把所有材料倒入搅拌机，搅打成液体。

drinks.name: Mango Orange Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 芒果橙子冰沙（Mango Orange Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.
drinks.instructions_zh: 把所有材料倒入搅拌机，搅打成液体。

drinks.name: Pineapple Gingerale Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 菠萝干姜水冰沙（Pineapple Gingerale Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.
drinks.instructions_zh: 把所有材料放入搅拌机，搅打至液化。

drinks.name: Kill the cold Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 驱寒冰沙（Kill the cold Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Juice ginger and lemon and add it to hot water. You may add cardomom.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将生姜和柠檬榨汁，倒入热水中。可加入小豆蔻。

drinks.name: Strawberry Shivers
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机杯中，盖上盖子，以中速搅打至充分混合。倒入一个大杯、两个中杯或三个小杯中，一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Sweet Bananas
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机杯中，盖上盖子，以中速搅打至充分混合。倒入一个大杯、两个中杯或三个小杯中，一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Tomato Tang
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机杯中，盖上盖子，以中速搅打至充分混合。倒入一个大杯、两个中杯或三个小杯中，一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Yoghurt Cooler
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up. Note: Use lots of ice in this one - great on hot days! To add ice: Remove the center of the cover while the blender is on - drop 3 or 4 ice cubs and blend until they're completely crushed.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机杯中，盖上盖子，以中速搅打至充分混合。倒入一个大杯、两个中杯或三个小杯中，一饮而尽。注意：这份要多放冰块，在炎热的日子里非常棒！加冰方法：搅拌机运转时取下盖子中央的部件，投入3到4块冰块，搅打至完全碎冰。

drinks.name: Castillian Hot Chocolate
drinks.name_display: 卡斯蒂利亚热巧克力（Castillian Hot Chocolate）
drinks.instructions_en: Shift the cocoa and sugar together into a medium-sized saucepan. Dissolve the cornstarch in the water, and stir into the cocoa and sugar until it is a smooth paste. Begin heating the mixture, stirring it with a whisk, and gradually pour in the milk. Continue stirring with the whisk as you bring the liquid to a simmer. Allow the chocolate to simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring often, until it is thick, glossy and completely smooth. Serve steaming hot in coffee mug. Serves six.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将可可粉和糖一起筛入一个中等大小的平底锅中。把玉米淀粉溶于水中，再搅入可可粉和糖里，搅成顺滑的糊状。开始加热混合物，用打蛋器搅拌，并逐渐倒入牛奶。继续用打蛋器搅拌，将液体加热至微沸。让巧克力液微沸约10分钟，其间经常搅拌，直到变得浓稠、有光泽且完全顺滑。趁热冒气倒入咖啡杯中饮用。可做六份。

drinks.name: Chocolate Beverage
drinks.instructions_en: Boil milk in the top of a deep double boiler five minutes. Remove from fire and add chocolate, mixed with the cinnamon, a little at a time, beating with molinillo or egg beater after each addition. When the chocolate is thoroughly blended, heat to the boiling point. Place over bottom of double boiler and add eggs, whipping constantly, until they are thoroughly blended and the mixture is frothing. Serve in coffee mug. Serves eight.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在深口双层蒸锅的上层将牛奶煮沸五分钟。离火，加入与肉桂混合好的巧克力，一次加一点，每加一次就用打泡棒或打蛋器搅打。待巧克力完全融合后，加热至沸点。将锅放回双层蒸锅下层之上，加入鸡蛋，不停搅打，直到鸡蛋完全融合、混合物起泡。倒入咖啡杯中饮用。可做八份。

drinks.name: Chocolate Drink
drinks.instructions_en: Melt the bar in a small amount of boiling water. Add milk. Cook over low heat, whipping gently (with a whisk, i would assume) until heated well. Don't let it boil! Serve in coffee mug.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将巧克力块放入少量沸水中融化。加入牛奶。用小火加热，轻轻搅打（我想是用打蛋器）至充分热透。不要让它煮沸！倒入咖啡杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Drinking Chocolate
ingredients_zh: 巧克力（2 oz finely chopped dark）
drinks.instructions_en: Heat the cream and milk with the cinnamon and vanilla bean very slowly for 15-20 minutes. (If you don't have any beans add 1-2 tsp of vanilla after heating). Remove the bean and cinnamon. Add the chocolate. Mix until fully melted. Serve topped with some very dense fresh whipped cream. Serves 1-2 depending upon how much of a glutton you are. For a richer chocolate, use 4 oz of milk, 4 oz of cream, 4 oz of chocolate. Serve in coffee mug.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将奶油、牛奶与肉桂和香草荚一起用极小的火加热15-20分钟。（如果没有香草荚，可在加热后加入1-2茶匙香草精）。取出香草荚和肉桂。加入巧克力，搅拌至完全融化。盛出后淋上一些非常浓稠的新鲜打发的奶油。可做1-2份，取决于你有多贪吃。想要更浓郁的巧克力味，可用4盎司牛奶、4盎司奶油、4盎司巧克力。倒入咖啡杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Hot Chocolate to Die for
drinks.name_display: 极致热巧克力（Hot Chocolate to Die for）
drinks.instructions_en: Melt the chocolate, butter and vanilla in a double boiler. When just smooth stir in the cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用双层蒸锅将巧克力、黄油和香草精融化。待刚刚变得顺滑时搅入奶油。

drinks.name: Microwave Hot Cocoa
drinks.instructions_en: Combine sugar, cocoa, salt and hot water in 1-quart micro-proof measuring cup (or coffee mug). Microwave at HIGH (100%) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until boiling. Add milk, sitr and microwave an additonal 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until hot. Stir in vanilla, blend well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个1夸脱的微波炉适用量杯（或咖啡杯）中混合糖、可可粉、盐和热水。用高火（100%）微波加热1至1分半钟，或至沸腾。加入牛奶，搅拌后再微波加热1分半至2分钟，或至热透。搅入香草精，拌匀。

drinks.name: Nuked Hot Chocolate
drinks.name_display: 微波热巧克力（Nuked Hot Chocolate）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix with a bit of milk (1 oz or so) in coffee mug. Nuke mug for about 30-50 seconds. Stir until the heated cocoa dissolves. Fill mug with milk. Nuke for 1-2 minutes, depending on wattage and preferences as to burnt mouth parts.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在咖啡杯中与少量牛奶（约1盎司）混合。将杯子微波加热约30-50秒。搅拌至加热后的可可溶化。将杯中加满牛奶。微波加热1-2分钟，具体时间取决于微波炉功率，以及你对烫到嘴的耐受程度。

drinks.name: Orange Scented Hot Chocolate
drinks.name_display: 香橙热巧克力（Orange Scented Hot Chocolate）
ingredients_en: Chocolate (4 oz chopped bittersweet or semi-sweet)
ingredients_zh: 巧克力（4 oz chopped bittersweet or semi-sweet）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in heavy medium saucepan. Stir over low heat until chocolate melts. Increase heat and bring just to a boil, stirring often. Remove from heat and whisk untily frothy. Return to heat and bring to boil again. Remove from heat, whisk until frothy. Repeat heating and whisking once again. Discard orange peel. (Can be prepared 2 hours ahead. Let stand at room temperature. Before serving, bring just to boil, remove from heat and whisk until frothy.) Pour hot chocolate into coffee mugs. Makes 2 servings.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入厚底中等平底锅中。用小火搅拌至巧克力融化。调高火力，煮至刚沸腾，其间经常搅拌。离火，搅打至起泡沫。重新加热，再次煮沸。离火，搅打至起泡沫。再重复一次加热和搅打。弃去橙皮。（可提前2小时准备。置于室温下静置。上桌前煮至刚沸腾，离火搅打至起泡沫。）将热巧克力倒入咖啡杯中。可做2份。

drinks.name: Spanish chocolate
drinks.instructions_en: Stir the milk with the chocolate and the cinnamon over low heat until the chocolate dissolves. Add the eggs and beat the mixture until it becomes thick, taking care not to boil. Serve in coffee mug.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用小火将牛奶与巧克力、肉桂搅拌，直到巧克力融化。加入鸡蛋搅打混合物至变稠，注意不要煮沸。倒入咖啡杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Lemon Shot
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加柠檬味（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix Galliano and Absolut Citron in a shot glass, lay lemon wedge sprinkled with sugar over glass and pour a rum over wedge and glass. light rum with a lighter and let burn for a second. Do shot quickly and suck on lemon. If it is done correctly, this will taste like a shot of sweet lemonade.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在子弹杯中混合加利安奴和绝对伏特加柠檬味，将一个撒了糖的柠檬角盖在杯口上，把朗姆酒浇在柠檬角和杯子上。用打火机点燃朗姆酒，让它燃烧一会儿。迅速饮尽这杯，然后吮吸柠檬角。如果做法正确，尝起来会像一杯甜甜的柠檬水。

drinks.name: Autodafé
drinks.instructions_en: Mix and fill up with soda water. Drunk by finns on a sunny day any time of the year and day.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合后加满苏打水。芬兰人在一年中任何一天、只要天气晴朗就会喝。

drinks.name: Gagliardo
drinks.instructions_en: Shake well and serve in a cocktail glass. This is a home cocktail of American/Internet Bar del Pozzo, Pavia, Italy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 充分摇匀，倒入鸡尾酒杯中饮用。这是意大利帕维亚的American/Internet Bar del Pozzo酒吧的一款自制鸡尾酒。

drinks.name: Grizzly Bear
drinks.instructions_en: Served over ice. Sounds nasty, but tastes great.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰饮用。听起来不怎么样，但味道很棒。

drinks.name: Karsk
drinks.instructions_en: Put a copper coin in a coffe-cup and fill up with coffee until you no longer see the coin, then add alcohol until you see the coin. Norwegian speciality.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在咖啡杯中放一枚铜币，倒入咖啡至看不见铜币为止，然后加入烈酒至能重新看见铜币。挪威特色饮品。

drinks.name: Happy Skipper
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Captain Morgan's Spiced Rum over ice, fill glass to top with Ginger Ale. Garnish with lime. Tastes like a cream soda. Named for the Gilligan's Island reference ("The Captain" *in* "Ginger" is a Happy Skipper!)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将摩根船长香料朗姆酒倒在冰块上，用姜汁汽水将杯子添满。用青柠装饰。尝起来像奶油苏打水。名字源自《吉利根岛》的梗（“船长”泡在“姜汁”里，就是个快乐的水手！）

drinks.name: Frappé
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together. Blend at highest blender speed for about 1 minute. Pour into a glass and drink with a straw. Notes: This works best if everything is cold (if you make fresh coffee, mix it with the milk and let it sit in the fridge for 1/2 hour. If it is not frothy, add more milk, or even just some more milk powder. The froth gradually turns to liquid at the bottom of the glass, so you will find that you can sit and drink this for about 1/2 hour, with more iced coffee continually appearing at the bottom. Very refreshing.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合在一起。用搅拌机最高转速搅打约1分钟。倒入杯中，用吸管饮用。注意：所有材料都冰凉时效果最佳（如果煮了新鲜咖啡，把它和牛奶混合后放入冰箱静置半小时。如果泡沫不够，就多加些牛奶，甚至只加些奶粉也行。泡沫会在杯底逐渐化为液体，所以你会发现可以坐着慢慢喝上大约半小时，杯底会不断有更多冰咖啡出现。非常清爽。

drinks.name: Iced Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together until coffee and sugar is dissolved. Add milk. Shake well. Using a blender or milk shake maker produces a very foamy drink. Serve in coffee mug.
drinks.instructions_zh: 搅拌至咖啡和糖溶解。加入牛奶。充分摇匀。用搅拌机或奶昔机可做出泡沫非常丰富的饮品。倒入咖啡杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Iced Coffee Fillip
drinks.name_display: 冰咖啡菲利普（Iced Coffee Fillip）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together in a coffee mug and chill before serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在咖啡杯中混合，冷藏后饮用。

drinks.name: Masala Chai
drinks.instructions_en: Bring 2 cups of water to boil. Add all the ingredients and boil again for about 15 seconds. Let stand for a minute. Warm milk in a pot. Filter tea into cups. Add milk and sugar. That's IT.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将2杯水煮沸。加入所有材料，再次煮沸约15秒。静置一分钟。在锅中将牛奶温热。将茶滤入杯中。加入牛奶和糖。就这么简单。

drinks.name: Melya
drinks.instructions_en: Brew espresso. In a coffee mug, place 1 teaspoon of unsweetened powdered cocoa, then cover a teaspoon with honey and drizzle it into the cup. Stir while the coffee brews, this is the fun part. The cocoa seems to coat the honey without mixing, so you get a dusty, sticky mass that looks as though it will never mix. Then all at once, presto! It looks like dark chocolate sauce. Pour hot espresso over the honey, stirring to dissolve. Serve with cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 冲泡浓缩咖啡。在咖啡杯中放入1茶匙无糖可可粉，然后用1茶匙蜂蜜盖住它并淋入杯中。趁咖啡冲泡时搅拌，这是有趣的部分。可可粉似乎只包裹住蜂蜜而不与之混合，于是你得到一团带粉、黏稠、看起来永远混不匀的东西。然后忽然之间，变！它就像黑巧克力酱了。将热浓缩咖啡倒在蜂蜜上，边倒边搅拌至溶解。搭配奶油饮用。

drinks.name: Spiking coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Incidentally, a pinch of cinnamon is indeed a nice addition to coffee but true heaven is a cardamom seed. Of course, you serve it in a coffee mug.
drinks.instructions_zh: 顺便说一句，一撮肉桂确实是咖啡的绝佳搭配，但真正的极乐是一颗小豆蔻籽。当然，要把它盛在咖啡杯里端上。

drinks.name: Thai Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Place the coffee and spices in the filter cone of your coffee maker. Brew coffee as usual, let it cool. In a tall glass, dissolve 1 or 2 teaspoons of sugar in an ounce of the coffee (it's easier to dissolve than if you put it right over ice). Add 5-6 ice cubes and pour coffee to within about 1 inch of the top of the glass. Rest a spoon on top of the coffee and slowly pour whipping cream into the spoon. This will make the cream float on top of the coffee rather than dispersing into it right away.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡和香料放入咖啡机的滤斗中。照常冲泡咖啡，放凉。在高杯中，用1盎司咖啡溶解1或2茶匙糖（这样比直接加在冰上更容易溶解）。加入5-6块冰块，再倒入咖啡至距杯口约1英寸处。将一把勺子架在咖啡上方，慢慢将打发用奶油倒入勺中。这样奶油会浮在咖啡表面，而不会立刻散入咖啡里。

drinks.name: Thai Iced Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare a pot of coffee at a good European strength. In the ground coffee, add 2 or 3 freshly ground cardamom pods. Sweeten while hot, then cool quickly. Serve in highball glass over ice, with cream. To get the layered effect, place a spoon atop the coffee and pour the milk carefully into the spoon so that it floats on the top of the coffee.
drinks.instructions_zh: 煮一壶浓度适当的欧式咖啡。在咖啡粉中加入2到3个现磨的小豆蔻荚。趁热加糖，然后迅速冷却。倒入海波杯中加冰饮用，配奶油。要做出分层效果，把一把勺子架在咖啡上方，小心地将牛奶倒入勺中，让它浮在咖啡表面。

drinks.name: Thai Iced Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Combine Thai tea (i.e., the powder), boiling water, and sweetened condensed milk, stir until blended. Pour into 2 tall glasses filled with ice cubes. Garnish with mint leaves. Makes 2 servings.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将泰式茶（即粉末）、沸水和加糖炼乳混合，搅拌至融合。倒入两个装满冰块的杯中。用薄荷叶装饰。可做2份。

drinks.name: Absinthe #2
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together and let sit a few days. Strain through a coffee filter. To serve mix 1 part absinthe to 4 parts water, add ice, enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合后静置几天。用咖啡滤纸过滤。饮用时按1份苦艾酒兑4份水的比例调好，加冰，尽情享用。

drinks.name: Amaretto Liqueur
drinks.instructions_en: Combine sugar and 3/4 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer until all sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat and cool. In an aging container, combine apricot halves, almond extract, grain alcohol with 1/2 cup water, and brandy. Stir in cooled sugar syrup mixture. Cap and let age for 2 days. Remove apricot halves. (Save apricot halves, can be used for cooking). Add food coloring and glycerine. Stir, recap and continue aging for 1 to 2 months. Re-bottle as desired. Liqueur is ready to serve but will continue to improve with additional aging.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小锅中将糖和3/4杯水混合。煮沸，其间不停搅拌。调低火力，微沸至糖完全溶解。离火放凉。在陈化容器中，将杏子半、杏仁香精、食用谷物酒精加1/2杯水，以及白兰地混合。搅入放凉的糖浆混合物。盖好盖子，陈化2天。取出杏子半。（保留杏子半，可用于烹饪。）加入食用色素和甘油。搅拌，重新盖好盖子，继续陈化1到2个月。根据需要重新装瓶。利口酒即可饮用，但继续陈化会愈发醇美。

drinks.name: Angelica Liqueur
ingredients_zh: 马郁兰叶（1 tblsp fresh chopped）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all herbs, nuts and spices with vodka in a 1 quart or larger aging container. Cap tightly and shake daily for 2 weeks. Strain through a fine muslin cloth or coffee filter, discarding solids. Clean out aging container. Place liquid back in container. Place sugar and water in saucepan and stir to combine over medium heat. When sugar is completely dissolved, set aside and let cool. When cool combine with food coloring and add to liqueur liquid. Cap and allow to age and mellow in a cool, dark place for one month.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有香草、坚果和香料与伏特加一起放入1夸脱或更大的陈化容器中。盖紧盖子，每天摇晃一次，持续2周。用细纱布或咖啡滤纸过滤，弃去固体。清洗陈化容器。将液体倒回容器中。把糖和水放入锅中，用中火搅拌混合。待糖完全溶解后，放置一旁放凉。放凉后与食用色素混合，加入利口酒液中。盖好盖子，在阴凉避光处陈化醇熟一个月。

drinks.name: Caribbean Orange Liqueur
drinks.name_display: 加勒比橙味利口酒（Caribbean Orange Liqueur）
drinks.instructions_en: Pare very thinly the bright-colored rind from the oranges (no white). Blot the peel on paper towels to remove any excess oil. Put peel in a 4 cup screw-top jar. Add 2 cups vodka. Close jar. Store in a cool, dark place for 2 days or until the vodka has absorbed the flavor. Remove peel and add remaining vodka. Close jar and add remaining cup of vodka. Close the jar and store in a cool dark place at least 1 month to age.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙子鲜亮的外皮削得很薄（不要白色部分）。用厨房纸巾吸去橙皮上多余的油脂。将橙皮放入一个4杯容量的螺旋盖广口瓶中。加入2杯伏特加。盖紧瓶子。在阴凉避光处存放2天，或直到伏特加吸收了风味。取出橙皮，加入剩余的伏特加。盖紧瓶子，再加入剩余的1杯伏特加。盖紧瓶子，在阴凉避光处至少存放1个月进行陈化。

drinks.name: Coffee Liqueur
drinks.instructions_en: Combine coffee, sugar and water. Simmer 1 hour and let cool. Add vanilla and vodka. Age in sealed jar 2 to 3 weeks.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡、糖和水混合。微沸1小时，放凉。加入香草精和伏特加。在密封罐中陈化2到3周。

drinks.name: Coffee-Vodka
drinks.instructions_en: Boil water and sugar until dissolved. Turn off heat. Slowly add dry instant coffee and continue stirring. Add a chopped vanilla bean to the vodka, then combine the cooled sugar syrup and coffee solution with the vodka. Cover tightly and shake vigorously each day for 3 weeks. Strain and filter. Its also best to let the sugar mixture cool completely so the vodka won't evaporate when its added. If you like a smoother feel to the liqueur you can add about 1 teaspoon of glycerine to the finished product.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水和糖煮沸至糖溶解。关火。慢慢加入速溶咖啡粉，并继续搅拌。将一根切碎的香草荚加入伏特加中，然后把放凉的糖浆和咖啡液与伏特加混合。盖紧盖子，每天用力摇晃一次，持续3周。过滤并滤清。最好让糖浆混合物完全冷却后再加入，这样伏特加就不会挥发。如果想让利口酒口感更顺滑，可在成品中加入约1茶匙甘油。

drinks.name: Cranberry Cordial
drinks.instructions_en: Place the chopped cranberries in a 2 liter jar that has a tight-fitting lid. Add the sugar and rum. Adjust the lid securely and place the jar in a cool, dark place. Invert the jar and shake it every day for six weeks. Strain the cordial into bottles and seal with corks.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将切碎的蔓越莓放入一个2升、带密封盖的罐子中。加入糖和朗姆酒。将盖子盖紧，把罐子放在阴凉避光处。每天将罐子倒置并摇晃，持续六周。将果酒滤入瓶中，用软木塞封好。

drinks.name: Creme de Menthe
drinks.instructions_en: Bring sugar and water to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Cool. Add the remaining ingredients and stir. Cover and let ripen for 1 month.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖和水煮沸，微沸10分钟。放凉。加入剩余材料并搅拌。盖好盖子，熟成1个月。

drinks.name: Irish Cream
drinks.instructions_en: Mix scotch and milk. Add half-and-half. Add rest.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苏格兰威士忌和牛奶混合。加入半对半奶油。加入其余材料。

drinks.name: Scottish Highland Liqueur
drinks.name_display: 苏格兰高地利口酒（Scottish Highland Liqueur）
ingredients_en: Angelica root (2 tsp dried and chopped)
ingredients_zh: 当归根（2 tsp dried and chopped）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingreds in aging container. Cover tightly and shake gently several times during the first 24 hrs. After 24 hrs, remove the lemon zest. Cover again and let stand in a cool, dark place for 2 weeks, shaking gently every other day. Strain through a wire sieve to remove the angelica root and fennel. Return to aging container, cover and let stand undisturbed in a cool dark place for 6 months. Siphon or pour clear liqueur into a sterile bottle. The cloudy dregs may be saved for cooking.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入陈化容器中混合。盖紧盖子，在最初的24小时内轻轻摇晃几次。24小时后，取出柠檬皮。再次盖好，在阴凉避光处静置2周，每隔一天轻轻摇晃一次。用金属网筛过滤，去除当归根和茴香。倒回陈化容器中，盖好，在阴凉避光处静置6个月不搅动。用虹吸法或直接倒出清亮的利口酒到消过毒的瓶中。浑浊的沉淀物可留作烹饪用。

drinks.name: Tia-Maria
drinks.instructions_en: Boil water, sugar and coffe for 10 mins and let cool. Add rum and vanilla. Put in clean bottle(s) and leave for 1 week before using.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水、糖和咖啡煮沸10分钟，放凉。加入朗姆酒和香草精。装入干净的瓶中，放置1周后即可使用。

drinks.name: Aloha Fruit punch
drinks.name_display: 阿罗哈水果宾治（Aloha Fruit punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Add 1/4 cup water to ginger root. Boil 3 minutes. Strain. Add the liquid to the guava, lemon and pineapple juices. Make a syrup of sugar and remaining water. Cool. Combine with juices and pineapple. Chill throroughly.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在姜根中加入1/4杯水。煮沸3分钟。过滤。将滤出的液体加入番石榴汁、柠檬汁和菠萝汁中。用糖和剩余的水熬成糖浆。放凉。与果汁和菠萝混合。彻底冷藏。

drinks.name: Apple Cider Punch
drinks.name_display: 苹果西打宾治（Apple Cider Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: If you use the whole all spice and cloves, tie them in cheesecloth. Heat the mixture. Stir occasionally. If you want an alcoholic drink, rum would be nice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 如果使用整颗多香果和丁香，请用纱布将它们包好扎紧。加热混合物。偶尔搅拌。如果想做成含酒精的饮品，加朗姆酒会很不错。

drinks.name: Artillery Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients in a large punch bowl with a block of ice. If found too dry, sugar syrup may be added. Decorate with twists of lemon peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与一大块冰一起放入大潘趣碗中混合。如果觉得太干，可加入糖浆。用柠檬皮扭条装饰。

drinks.name: Berry Deadly
ingredients_zh: 葡萄酒（1 bottle Boone Strawberry Hill）
酷爱饮料（1 gal Tropical Berry）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients to large bowl. Stir gently. Serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入大碗中。轻轻搅拌。冷藏后饮用。

drinks.name: Cranberry Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Combine first four ingredients. Stir until sugar is dissolved, chill. Then add ginger ale just before serving. Add ice ring to keep punch cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合前四种材料。搅拌至糖溶解，冷藏。上桌前方才加入姜汁汽水。加入冰环以保持潘趣酒冰凉。

drinks.name: Egg Nog #4
drinks.instructions_en: In a small mixer bowl beat egg yolks till blended. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating at high speed till thick and lemon colored. Stir in milk, stir in rum, bourbon, vanilla, and salt. Chill thoroughly. Whip cream. Wash beaters well. In a large mixer bowl beat egg whites till soft peaks form. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar, beating to stiff peaks. Fold yolk mixture and whipped cream into egg whites. Serve immediately. Sprinkle nutmeg over each serving. Serve in a punch bowl or another big bowl. NOTE: For a nonalcoholic eggnog, prepare Eggnog as above, except omit the bourbon and rum and increase the milk to 3 cups.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小搅拌盆中搅打蛋黄至混合均匀。逐渐加入1/4杯糖，用高速搅打至浓稠并呈柠檬色。搅入牛奶，再搅入朗姆酒、波本威士忌、香草精和盐。彻底冷藏。打发奶油。将打蛋器清洗干净。在大搅拌盆中搅打蛋清至出现软性尖峰。逐渐加入剩余的1/4杯糖，搅打至硬性发泡。将蛋黄混合物和打发的奶油翻拌入蛋清中。立即饮用。在每一份上撒上肉豆蔻粉。盛在潘趣碗或其它大碗中。注意：要做不含酒精的蛋奶酒，按上述方法制作，但省略波本威士忌和朗姆酒，并将牛奶增加到3杯。

drinks.name: Egg-Nog - Classic Cooked
drinks.name_display: 经典煮制蛋奶酒（Egg-Nog - Classic Cooked）
drinks.instructions_en: In large saucepan, beat together eggs, sugar and salt, if desired. Stir in 2 cups of the milk. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough to coat a metal spoon and reaches 160 degrees F. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining 2 cups milk and vanilla. Cover and regfigerate until thoroughly chilled, several hours or overnight. Just before serving, pour into bowl or pitcher. Garnish or add stir-ins, if desired. Choose 1 or several of: Chocolate curls, cinnamon sticks, extracts of flavorings, flavored brandy or liqueur, fruit juice or nectar, ground nutmeg, maraschino cherries, orange slices, peppermint sticks or candy canes, plain brandy, run or whiskey, sherbet or ice-cream, whipping cream, whipped. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大平底锅中，将鸡蛋、糖和盐（如需要）搅打混合。搅入2杯牛奶。用小火加热，不停搅拌，直到混合物浓稠到能挂住金属勺，并达到160华氏度。离火。搅入剩余的2杯牛奶和香草精。盖好，冷藏至彻底冰凉，需数小时或过夜。上桌前，倒入碗或壶中。如需要，可加装饰或搅拌添加物。从以下选择一种或几种：巧克力卷、肉桂棒、调味香精、调味白兰地或利口酒、果汁或果露、肉豆蔻粉、马拉斯奇诺樱桃、橙片、薄荷棒或拐杖糖、纯白兰地、朗姆酒或威士忌、雪芭或冰淇淋、打发用奶油、已打发的奶油。立即饮用。

drinks.name: Egg Nog - Healthy
drinks.instructions_en: Whip egg substitute and sugar together, combine with the two kinds of milk, vanilla, and rum. Mix well. Chill over night. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Makes 6 servings.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将蛋替代品和糖一起搅打，与两种牛奶、香草精和朗姆酒混合。搅拌均匀。冷藏过夜。撒上肉豆蔻粉。可做6份。

drinks.name: Gluehwein
drinks.instructions_en: Boil sugar and spices in water, leave in the water for 30 minutes. Strain the spiced water and mix with the wine. Heat slowly until short of boiling temperature. (To remove alcohol, let it boil for a while.) You may add lemon or orange juice to taste. Serve in irish coffee cup.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖和香料在水中煮沸，在水中浸泡30分钟。过滤香料水，与葡萄酒混合。慢慢加热至接近沸点但未沸。（想要去除酒精，可让它煮一会儿。）可按口味加入柠檬汁或橙汁。盛在爱尔兰咖啡杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Holloween Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Take a bunch of grape juice and a bunch of fizzy stuff (club soda, ginger ale, lemonlime, whatever). Mix them in a punch bowl. Take orange sherbet and lime sherbet. Scoop out scoops and float them in the punch, let them melt a little so that a nasty film spreads all over the top of the punch but there are still "bubbles" in it in the form of sherbet scoops. Looks horrible, tastes just fine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一些葡萄汁和一些带气泡的饮料（苏打水、姜汁汽水、柠檬青柠汽水，随便什么都行）。在潘趣碗中混合。取橙子雪芭和青柠雪芭。挖出球状，让它们漂浮在潘趣酒中，稍微融化一点，让一层腻腻的膜蔓延在潘趣酒表面，但其中仍以雪芭球的形式保留着“气泡”。看起来可怕，喝起来还不错。

drinks.name: Mulled Wine
drinks.instructions_en: Simmer 3 cups water with, sugar, cloves, cinnamon sticks, and lemon peel in a stainless steel pot for 10 minutes. Add wine heat to a "coffee temperature" (DO NOT BOIL) then add the brandy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在不锈钢锅中将3杯水与糖、丁香、肉桂棒和柠檬皮微沸10分钟。加入葡萄酒，加热到“咖啡的温度”（不要煮沸），然后加入白兰地。

drinks.name: Sangria
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all together in a pitcher and refrigerate. Add cloves and cinnamon sticks to taste. Serve in wine glasses.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料在壶中混合并冷藏。按口味加入丁香和肉桂棒。倒入葡萄酒杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Sweet Sangria
drinks.instructions_en: Dissolve the sugar in hot water and cool. Peel the citrus fruits and break into wedges. Mix the wine, sugar syrup, fruit, and Fresca in a pitcher and put in the fridge for a few hours. Serve in tall glasses with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖溶于热水中，放凉。将柑橘类水果去皮，掰成瓣。在壶中混合葡萄酒、糖浆、水果和Fresca（柑橘味汽水），放入冰箱冷藏几个小时。倒入高杯中，配吸管饮用。

drinks.name: Sangria The  Best
drinks.name_display: 最佳桑格利亚（Sangria The  Best）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix wine, sugar and fruit, and let sit in the fridge for 18-24 hours. The mixture will have a somewhat syrupy consistency. Before serving stir in brandy and cut the mixture with soda water until it have a thinner, more wine like consistency. Serve from a pitcher in wine glasses.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将葡萄酒、糖和水果混合，放入冰箱静置18-24小时。混合物会呈现略带糖浆般的浓稠感。上桌前搅入白兰地，并用苏打水稀释，直到变得较稀、更像葡萄酒的浓度。用壶倒出，盛在葡萄酒杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Spiced Peach Punch
drinks.name_display: 香料蜜桃潘趣（Spiced Peach Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine peach nectar, orange juice and brown sugar in a large saucepan. Tie cinnamon and cloves in a small cheesecloth bag. Drop into saucepan. Heat slowly, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in lime juice. Serve in hot mugs.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大平底锅中混合桃子果露、橙汁和红糖。将肉桂和丁香装入小纱布袋中扎好。放入锅中。慢慢加热，不停搅拌，直到糖溶解。微沸10分钟。搅入青柠汁。盛入热杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Strawberry Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Throw everything into a blender and mix until fairly smooth. Serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机，搅打至相当顺滑。加冰饮用。

drinks.name: Sunny Holiday Punch
drinks.name_display: 阳光假日潘趣（Sunny Holiday Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入潘趣碗中混合。

drinks.name: Wine Cooler
ingredients_zh: 红葡萄酒（2 oz white or）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix wine and soft drink. Pour into glass. Add ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将葡萄酒和软饮料混合。倒入杯中。加冰。

drinks.name: Wine Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all of the ingredients and pour over a block of ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料混合，浇在一大块冰上。

drinks.name: Bruce's Puce
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: In a regular-sized shot glass, layer, with a spoon or cherry, the grenadine , the Kahlua , then the Bailey's Irish cream in equal portions. It goes down really smooth ,and you don't even need a chaser. It tastes just like chocolate milk.(Really!)
drinks.instructions_zh: 在普通大小的子弹杯中，用勺子或樱桃，依次将红石榴糖浆、甘露咖啡利口酒、百利甜酒分层倒入，各等量。入口极为顺滑，甚至不需要再喝别的来压味。尝起来就像巧克力牛奶。（真的！）

drinks.name: Brave Bull Shooter
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Tabasco into bottom of shot glass and fill with tequila.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将塔巴斯哥辣酱倒入子弹杯底部，用龙舌兰酒加满。

drinks.name: Fahrenheit 5000
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加胡椒味（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Cover bottom of shot glass with Tabasco Sauce and then fill with half Firewater and half Absolut Peppar.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用塔巴斯哥辣酱铺满子弹杯底部，然后用一半Firewater、一半绝对伏特加辣椒味加满。

drinks.name: Popped cherry
drinks.instructions_en: Served over ice in a tall glass with a popped cherry (can add more popped cherries if in the mood)!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中加冰饮用，配一颗酒渍樱桃（如果兴致来了可以多放几颗）！

drinks.name: Atomic Lokade
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker, place lemonade, vodka, blue Curacao, and triple sec together. Shake with ice and strain into glass. Add sugar to taste
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中放入柠檬水、伏特加、蓝橙力娇酒和橙皮甜酒。加冰摇匀，滤入杯中。按口味加糖。

drinks.name: Diesel
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the lager first then add the blackcurrant cordial. Top up with the cider. The colour sholud be very dark approaching the colour of Guiness.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先倒入拉格啤酒，然后加入黑加仑糖浆。用苹果酒加满。颜色应该非常深，接近健力士的颜色。

drinks.name: Afternoon
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 cl）
drinks.instructions_en: Build into a suiting glass, with no ice. Cream on top if wanted. Served directly.
drinks.instructions_zh: 直接在合适的杯中调制，不加冰。如需要可在顶部加奶油。直接饮用。

drinks.name: Kool-Aid Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Pour into a large glass with ice and stir. Add a little cranberry juice to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入加冰的大杯中搅拌。按口味加入少许蔓越莓汁。

drinks.name: National Aquarium
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a shaker of ice. Shake well. Serve on the rocks.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入装有冰的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。加冰饮用。

drinks.name: Damned if you do
drinks.name_display: 咎由自取（Damned if you do）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour into shot glass. Put in mouth. Repeat as deemed necessary.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入子弹杯。倒进嘴里。视需要重复。

drinks.name: Long vodka
drinks.instructions_en: Shake a tall glass with ice cubes and Angostura, coating the inside of the glass. Por the vodka onto this, add 1 slice of lime and squeeze juice out of remainder, mix with tonic, stir and voila you have a Long Vodka
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中放入冰块和安高天娜苦精，摇晃使杯内壁挂上苦精。倒入伏特加，加入1片青柠，并把剩下的青柠汁挤进去，与汤力水混合，搅拌，瞧，你就得到一杯长伏特加。

drinks.name: Quick F**K
ingredients_zh: 蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（1 part）
百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 part）
drinks.instructions_en: In a shot glass add 1/3 Kahlua first. Then 1/3 Miduri, topping it off with a 1/3 bailey's irish cream
drinks.instructions_zh: 在子弹杯中先倒入1/3的甘露咖啡利口酒。然后倒入1/3的蜜多丽。最后用1/3的百利甜酒加满。

drinks.name: Owen's Grandmother's Revenge
drinks.name_display: 欧文祖母的复仇（Owen's Grandmother's Revenge）
drinks.instructions_en: Add ingredients and mix in blender.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入材料，在搅拌机中混合。

drinks.name: Flaming Dr. Pepper
drinks.name_display: 燃烧的胡椒博士（Flaming Dr. Pepper）
drinks.instructions_en: Add Amaretto, Bacardi, and vodka. Mix in the Dr. Pepper and beer
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入杏仁利口酒、百加得朗姆酒和伏特加。拌入Dr. Pepper（胡椒博士汽水）和啤酒。

drinks.name: New York Lemonade
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加柠檬味（2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Serve in a chilled cocktail glass. Lemon and sugar the rim. Stir and Strain.
drinks.instructions_zh: 盛在冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯中。用柠檬和糖沾杯口。搅拌并过滤。

drinks.name: Caipirissima
drinks.instructions_en: Same as Caipirinha but instead of cachaca you add WHITE RUM. It's great!!!!!!!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 与凯匹林纳相同，但把卡莎萨换成白朗姆酒。太棒了！！！！

drinks.name: Pisco Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Vigorously shake and strain contents in a cocktail shaker with ice cubes, then pour into glass and garnish with bitters.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒摇酒壶中加入冰块，用力摇匀并过滤，然后倒入杯中，用苦精装饰。

drinks.name: Big Red
ingredients_zh: 爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into 1 ounce shot glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料倒入1盎司的子弹杯中。

drinks.name: Black & Tan
ingredients_zh: 艾尔啤酒（1 part Bass pale）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill pint glass half full with Bass. Next pour Guiness over a spoon slowly until glass is full. If done correctly the Guiness will stay on top and the Bass on bottom hence the name Black & Tan.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将品脱杯倒至半满的巴斯啤酒。接着将健力士沿着一把勺子慢慢倒入，直到杯子加满。如果做得正确，健力士会留在上层，巴斯在下层，因此得名“黑与棕”。

drinks.name: Chocolate Milk
