drinks.instructions_en: Put the milk in the bottom, pour the Liquer on top and add the dash of amaretto. Do not mix. SLAM IT!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将牛奶放在底部，把利口酒倒在上面，再加入少许杏仁利口酒。不要搅拌。一口干了！

drinks.name: B-53
drinks.instructions_en: Layer the Kahlua, Sambucca and Grand Marnier into a shot glas in that order. Better than B-52
drinks.instructions_zh: 按此顺序将甘露咖啡利口酒、萨姆布卡茴香酒和柑曼怡橙味力娇酒分层倒入子弹杯中。比B-52还好喝。

drinks.name: Sea breeze
drinks.instructions_en: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装满冰块的海波杯中直接调制所有材料。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Snake Bite (UK)
ingredients_zh: 苹果酒（1/2 pint sweet or dry）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into a pint glass. Drink. Fall over.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料倒入品脱杯中。喝掉。醉倒。

drinks.name: Bob Marley
ingredients_zh: 蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Layer in a 2 oz shot glass or pony glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 在2盎司子弹杯或小酒杯中分层倒入。

drinks.name: Brainteaser
ingredients_zh: 爱尔兰奶油利口酒（30 ml）
drinks.instructions_en: layered erin first, then sambuca and then avocart(should sit in middle of other two. To drink: use a straw to suck up avocart then shot the rest and then suck fumes up through straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先分层倒入Erin，然后萨姆布卡，最后是avocart（应位于另外两者之间）。饮用方法：用吸管吸上avocart，然后把剩下的干掉，再通过吸管吸入酒气。

drinks.name: Atlantic Sun
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all the ingredients, top the drink with soda. Garnish with a slice of orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料摇匀，用苏打水为饮品加满。用一片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Green Goblin
drinks.instructions_en: Cider First, Lager then Curacao
drinks.instructions_zh: 先倒苹果酒，再倒拉格啤酒，最后倒橙皮力娇酒。

drinks.name: Oreo Mudslide
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend Vodka, Kahlua, Bailey's, ice-cream and the Oreo well in a blender. Pour into a large frosted glass. Garnish with whipped cream and a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中将伏特加、甘露咖啡利口酒、百利甜酒、冰淇淋和奥利奥饼干充分搅打。倒入大号霜冻玻璃杯中。用打发的奶油和一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: ABC
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1/3）
drinks.instructions_en: Layered in a shot glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在子弹杯中分层调制。

drinks.name: Pink Panty Pulldowns
drinks.instructions_en: Shake well
drinks.instructions_zh: 充分摇匀。

drinks.name: Ice Pick
drinks.instructions_en: Put Vodka in glass fill with iced tea. Stir in lemon to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加倒入杯中，用冰茶加满。按口味搅入柠檬。

drinks.name: 410 Gone
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合均匀，尽情享用！

drinks.name: Tequila Sunrise
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the tequila and orange juice into glass over ice. Add the grenadine, which will sink to the bottom. Stir gently to create the sunrise effect. Garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将龙舌兰酒和橙汁倒在冰块上倒入杯中。加入红石榴糖浆，它会沉到杯底。轻轻搅拌，营造出日出的效果。装饰后饮用。

drinks.name: Flander's Flake-Out
drinks.instructions_en: Bang 'em both in.
drinks.instructions_zh: 把两样都一股脑倒进去。

drinks.name: Apple Slammer
drinks.instructions_en: pour into a shot glass and present to consumer, they are expected to cover the top of the shotglass with thier palm, raise the glass, slam it on the bar and the swallow quickly.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入子弹杯中端给客人，客人需用手掌盖住杯口，举起杯子，往吧台上猛地一磕，然后迅速咽下。

drinks.name: Amaretto Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake and strain. Garnish with a cherry and an orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀并过滤。用一颗樱桃和一片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Cuba Libra
drinks.instructions_en: Fill tall glass with ice cubes. Add rum. Rub cut edge of lime on rim of glass then squeeze juice into glass. Fill with Coca-Cola. Garnish with lime slice. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中装满冰块。加入朗姆酒。用青柠的切面摩擦杯口，然后把汁挤入杯中。用可口可乐加满。用青柠片装饰。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Jelly Bean
drinks.instructions_en: mix equal parts in pony glass-tastes just like a jelly bean!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小酒杯中等量混合——尝起来就像一颗果冻豆！

drinks.name: After Five
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: 1. Pour Kahlua into shot glass to about 1/2 full. 2. Using a spoon(inverted), slowly pour in the Peppermint Schnapps until glass is about 3/4 full. Done correctly, the Schnapps will flow under the Kahlua for a clear layer. 3. Again using a spoon, but this time right side up, slowly top off the glass with a layer of Bailey's. Be careful to place the spoon right at the top of the Kahlua layer and to raise it as the glass fills up. Done correctly, this will provide a layer of Bailey's floating over the Kahlua. 4. Toss it down all at once for something like a Peppermint Pattie, WITH A BANG!!! NOTE: Best if all ingredients are chilled
drinks.instructions_zh: 1. 将甘露咖啡利口酒倒入子弹杯中至约半满。2. 用一把（倒置的）勺子，慢慢倒入薄荷味荷兰酒，直到杯子约3/4满。做法正确的话，荷兰酒会流到甘露咖啡利口酒下方，形成清晰的分层。3. 再次用勺子，但这次勺口朝上，慢慢用一层百利甜酒将杯子加满。注意把勺子正好放在甘露咖啡利口酒层的顶部，并随着杯子加满而抬高。做法正确的话，这会形成一层百利甜酒浮在甘露咖啡利口酒之上。4. 一口气把它干掉，味道有点像薄荷帕蒂，砰！注意：所有材料冰镇后效果最佳。

drinks.name: Midnight Manx
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a mixer with ice and add Baileys, Kahlua, Goldshlager, and cream. Shake for 5 seconds and Strain into a double rocks glass filled with ice. Add chilled coffee Stir and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在调酒杯中装满冰，加入百利甜酒、甘露咖啡利口酒、金禾（Goldschläger）和奶油。摇晃5秒，过滤到装满冰的双份古典杯中。加入冰镇咖啡，搅拌后尽情享用！

drinks.name: Kir Royale
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Creme de cassis in glass, gently pour champagne on top
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黑加仑利口酒倒入杯中，在其上方缓缓倒入香槟。

drinks.name: Jackhammer
drinks.instructions_en: Serve over ice- Warning,Deadly!
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰饮用——警告，烈性致命！

drinks.name: Nutty Irishman
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 part）
drinks.instructions_en: Serve over ice
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰饮用。

drinks.name: 3 Wise Men
drinks.instructions_en: put them them in a glass... and slam it to tha head.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将它们倒入杯中……然后一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Miami Vice
drinks.instructions_en: First: Mix pina colada with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice(set aside). Second: Mix daiquiri with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice. Third: While frozen, add pina colda mix then daiquiri mix in glass (Making sure they do not get mixed together).
drinks.instructions_zh: 第一步：将椰林飘香与 2.5 盎司朗姆酒加冰混合（放置一旁备用）。第二步：将代基里与 2.5 盎司朗姆酒加冰混合。第三步：在冰冻状态下，先将椰林飘香混合液倒入杯中，再倒入代基里混合液（注意不要让两者混合在一起）。

drinks.name: AT&T
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Vodka and Gin over ice, add Tonic and Stir
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和金酒倒在冰上，加入汤力水并搅拌。

drinks.name: 69 Special
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 2 oz. gin. Add 4 oz. 7-up. Add Lemon Juice for flavor. If you are weak, top up glass with more 7-Up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入 2 盎司金酒。加入 4 盎司七喜。加入柠檬汁调味。如果你酒量浅，可用更多七喜将杯中续满。

drinks.name: Irish Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Heat the coffee, whiskey and sugar; do not boil. Pour into glass and top with cream; serve hot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加热咖啡、威士忌和糖，但不要煮沸。倒入杯中，在其上方挤上奶油；趁热饮用。

drinks.name: 57 Chevy with a White License Plate
drinks.name_display: 白色车牌的57雪佛兰（57 Chevy with a White License Plate）
drinks.instructions_en: 1. Fill a rocks glass with ice 2.add white creme de cacao and vodka 3.stir
drinks.instructions_zh: 1. 在古典杯中加满冰块 2. 加入白色可可利口酒和伏特加 3. 搅拌

drinks.name: Mother's Milk
drinks.instructions_en: Shake over ice, strain. Serves two.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀，滤入杯中。可供两人饮用。

drinks.name: Zippy's Revenge
drinks.instructions_en: Mix Kool-Aid to taste then add Rum and ammaretto. shake well to disolve the sugar in the Kool-Aid... serve cold
drinks.instructions_zh: 按口味调好酷爱饮料（Kool-Aid），然后加入朗姆酒和阿玛雷托。充分摇匀，以溶解酷爱饮料中的糖……冷藏后饮用。

drinks.name: Belgian Blue
drinks.instructions_en: Just pour all ingredients in the glass and stir...
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料直接倒入杯中并搅拌……

drinks.name: Red Snapper
drinks.instructions_en: One shot each, shake n shoot
drinks.instructions_zh: 各取一份，摇匀后一口喝掉。

drinks.name: Jamaica Kiss
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a tumbler with ice cubes. Add a shot of Tia Maria and a shot of Jamaican light rum. Fill the tumbler with milk. Blend until smooth and serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在平底杯中加满冰块。加入一份提亚玛丽亚咖啡利口酒和一份牙买加淡朗姆酒。用牛奶将杯中续满。搅打至顺滑后立即饮用。

drinks.name: Absolut Summertime
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加柠檬味（1 1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients except lemon to shaker filled with ice. Cover and shake vigorously. Strain contents into ice filled collins glass. Garnish with lemon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 除柠檬外，将所有配料加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。盖上盖子用力摇匀。将酒液滤入加满冰块的柯林杯中。用柠檬装饰。

drinks.name: Cosmopolitan Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients in mixing glass half filled with ice, shake and strain into chilled Martini glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入装有一半冰块的调酒杯中，摇匀后滤入冰镇过的马天尼杯。

drinks.name: Ziemes Martini Apfelsaft
drinks.name_display: 齐梅斯马天尼苹果汁（Ziemes Martini Apfelsaft）
drinks.instructions_en: Serve without ice. At least the juice shold have room temperature.
drinks.instructions_zh: 不加冰饮用。至少果汁应达到室温。

drinks.name: Vodka Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Shake the vodka and vermouth together with a number of ice cubes, strain into a cocktail glass, add the olive and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和味美思与数块冰块一起摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯，放入橄榄后饮用。

drinks.name: Cafe Savoy
drinks.instructions_en: Fill mug almost to top with coffee.Add milk, triple sec and brandy. Stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡倒入马克杯至几乎满杯。加入牛奶、三重橙利口酒和白兰地。搅拌。

drinks.name: Snowball
drinks.instructions_en: Place one ice cube in the glass and add 1 1/2 oz of Advocaat. Fill up the glass with lemonade and decorate with a slice of lemon. Serve at once.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中放入一块冰块，加入 1.5 盎司蛋黄利口酒（Advocaat）。用柠檬汽水将杯中续满，并用一片柠檬装饰。立即饮用。

drinks.name: Mocha-Berry
ingredients_zh: 香波覆盆子利口酒（2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: pour 6 oz. of coffee in a mug or Irish coffee cup. add coca mix and chambord, mix well and top off with whipped cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 6 盎司咖啡倒入马克杯或爱尔兰咖啡杯中。加入可可混合粉和香波利口酒，搅拌均匀，在其上方挤上打发的奶油。

ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1/3 part）
drinks.instructions_en: pour kaluha, then Baileys, then Frangelico not chilled and not layered -- SERVE!!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 依次倒入甘露咖啡利口酒、百利甜酒，再倒入榛子利口酒（Frangelico），不必冰镇也无需分层——上桌！

drinks.name: Addison Special
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in the order listed into a shaker. Fill half full with ice and shake well. Strain into glass with ice and garnish with a cherry and orange wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 按所列顺序将配料加入摇酒壶中。加入冰块至半满并充分摇匀。滤入装有冰块的杯中，用一颗樱桃和一块橙角装饰。

drinks.name: California Root Beer
drinks.instructions_en: Put Kahlua and Galliano in highball glass fill with soda
drinks.instructions_zh: 将甘露咖啡利口酒和加利安奴利口酒倒入高球杯中，用苏打水续满。

drinks.name: Amaretto Stone Sour
drinks.name_display: 阿玛雷托石酸酒（Amaretto Stone Sour）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake and Serve over ice
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀后加冰饮用。

drinks.name: Blind Russian
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（3/4 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice. Add all liquers. Add milk. shake.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加满冰块。加入所有利口酒。加入牛奶。摇匀。

drinks.name: Absolut Sex
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加黑加仑味（3/4 oz）
蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（3/4 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake Absolut Kurant, Midori, and Cranberry juice in shaker with ice: Strain into rocks glass: Splash of seven on top.Absolut Sex.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将绝对伏特加黑加仑味、蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒和蔓越莓汁加冰在摇酒壶中摇匀：滤入古典杯中：在上方淋入少许七喜。Absolut Sex。

drinks.name: Aztec Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients in a pitcher. Mix thoroughly and pour into whatever is available, the bigger the better! This drink packs a big punch, so don't over do it.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料在一壶中混合。充分搅匀后倒入手边任何可用的容器中，越大越好！这款酒劲道十足，所以不要贪杯。

drinks.name: Lemon Drop
drinks.instructions_en: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass rimmed with sugar.
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀后滤入杯口沾糖的冰镇鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Absolut limousine
drinks.instructions_en: Fill Absolut into a glass. Add Lime juice. Add Ice and lime wedges.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将绝对伏特加倒入杯中。加入青柠汁。加入冰块和青柠角。

drinks.name: Absolut Evergreen
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加柠檬味（2/3 part）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix, pour over ice and top up with Bitter Lemon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合后倒在冰上，再用苦柠檬汽水续满。

drinks.name: Lunch Box
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a pint glass almost full with beer. Then fill the rest with orange juice (careful not to fill it to the top). Then take the shot of Amaretto and drop it in.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一品脱杯中倒入啤酒至几乎满杯。然后用橙汁填满剩余空间（注意不要倒到杯口）。然后取一份阿玛雷托，将其坠入杯中。

drinks.name: Kool-Aid Slammer
drinks.instructions_en: Fill half the shot glass with the kool-aid first. Then put a paper towel over the top of the glass and slowly pour in the vodka. If you do it right, you should be able to see that the two liquids are separated, with the vodka on top. Now slam it! The last thing you'll taste is the kool-aid.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先倒入酷爱饮料（Kool-Aid）至子弹杯的一半。然后在杯口盖上一张纸巾，缓缓倒入伏特加。如果操作得当，你应该能看到两种液体彼此分层，伏特加位于上层。现在一口干掉！你最后尝到的会是酷爱饮料。

drinks.name: Kurant Tea
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加黑加仑味（4 cl）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Absolut Kurant into a comfortably big tea-cup. Add the not too hot(!) apple tea and, if you like, some sugar. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将绝对伏特加黑加仑味倒入一只够大的茶杯中。加入不太烫（！）的苹果茶，如果喜欢还可以加些糖。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Dirty Nipple
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: This is a layered shot - the Bailey's must be on top
drinks.instructions_zh: 这是一款分层子弹酒——百利甜酒必须位于上层。

drinks.name: Darkwood Sling
drinks.instructions_en: There are many good cherry liqueurs you can use, but I prefere Heering. Add one share of the liqueur. Then you add one share of Soda. For a sour sling use Tonic (most people prefer the drink without Tonic). Afterwards you fill the glass with Orange Juice and ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 有许多不错的樱桃利口酒可供选择，但我更偏爱希林（Heering）。加入一份该利口酒。然后加入一份苏打水。若想做成酸味司令，则改用汤力水（大多数人更喜欢不加汤力水的版本）。之后用橙汁和冰块将杯中续满。

drinks.name: Bailey's Dream Shake
drinks.name_display: 百利梦幻奶昔（Bailey's Dream Shake）
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend ingredients for 30 seconds. Definitely refreshing for a hot summer's day !
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料搅打 30 秒。绝对是炎热夏日里的清爽之选！

drinks.name: Bumble Bee
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1/3 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: This is a layered shot. First pour the Bailey's into the shot glass. Then take an upside down spoon and touch it to the inside wall of the glass. Carefully add the Kahlua. Repeat this process for the Sambuca. If done properly, the alcohol will stay separated and resemble a bumble bee. Enjoy!!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 这是一款分层子弹酒。先将百利甜酒倒入子弹杯中。然后取一把倒置的勺子，将其抵住杯内壁。小心地加入甘露咖啡利口酒。对珊布卡茴香酒重复此步骤。如果操作得当，各层酒液会保持分层，形似一只大黄蜂。尽情享用！！！

drinks.name: A.D.M. (After Dinner Mint)
drinks.instructions_en: shake vigorously
drinks.instructions_zh: 用力摇匀。

drinks.name: A Splash of Nash
drinks.name_display: 纳什一滴（A Splash of Nash）
ingredients_zh: 蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（0.5 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Drop shot glass with banana & melon liquers into a 9 oz hi- ball glass containing soda water and cranberry juice. Drink in one shot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将装有香蕉利口酒和蜜瓜利口酒的子弹杯投入盛有苏打水和蔓越莓汁的 9 盎司高球杯中。一口饮尽。

drinks.name: Amaretto Sunrise
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together the amaretto and orange juice. Pour into glass and then add the grenadine untill you see the sunrise.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将阿玛雷托和橙汁混合。倒入杯中，然后加入红石榴糖浆，直到呈现出日出般的色彩。

drinks.name: Arizona Stingers
drinks.instructions_en: Place ice cubes in the hurricane glass . Add the 2 HEAPING shots of Absolute Vodka (Note: You can add as many shots of Absolute as you want!) Fill the rest of glass with the Arizona Icetea with lemon. Stir to mix using a spoon. Drink up and enjoy!!!!!!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在飓风杯中加入冰块。加入 2 份满满的绝对伏特加（注：你可以随意多加几份绝对伏特加！）。用柠檬味的亚利桑那冰茶将杯中剩余空间续满。用勺子搅拌混合。喝光并尽情享用！！！！！

drinks.name: Orange Push-up
drinks.instructions_en: Combine liquors in a blender. Add a half scoop of ice and blend. Garnish with an orange and cherry flag. So good it will melt in your mouth!!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各种酒在搅拌机中混合。加入半勺冰块搅打。用橙子和樱桃串成的装饰旗点缀。好喝到入口即化！！！

drinks.name: 151 Florida Bushwacker
drinks.name_display: 151佛罗里达布什瓦克（151 Florida Bushwacker）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients. Blend until smooth. Garnish with chocolate shavings if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料混合。搅打至顺滑。如需要可用巧克力碎屑装饰。

drinks.name: Zizi Coin-coin
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 5cl of Cointreau on ice, add 2cl of fresh lemon (or lime) juice, stir gently, and finally add slices of lemon/lime in glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 5 厘升君度橙酒倒在冰上，加入 2 厘升新鲜柠檬（或青柠）汁，轻轻搅拌，最后在杯中放入柠檬片或青柠片。

drinks.instructions_en: fill glass with crushed ice. Add vodka. Add a splash of grand-marnier. Fill with o.j.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加满碎冰。加入伏特加。淋入少许金万利橙酒。用橙汁续满。

drinks.name: Tequila Surprise
drinks.instructions_en: Fill shot glass with Tequila. Add drops of Tobasco sauce.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将子弹杯倒满龙舌兰酒。滴入几滴塔巴斯科辣椒酱。

drinks.name: Cream Soda
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 1oz of Spiced Rum into a highball glass with ice. Fill with Ginger Ale.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 1 盎司香料朗姆酒倒入装有冰块的高球杯中。用姜汁汽水续满。

drinks.name: ACID
drinks.instructions_en: Poor in the 151 first followed by the 101 served with a Coke or Dr Pepper chaser.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先倒入 151 朗姆酒，再倒入 101 朗姆酒，搭配可乐或胡椒博士汽水作为伴饮。

drinks.name: Arctic Fish
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice and fish, add vodka, grape soda and orange juice. DO NOT STIR!!!!! Serve well chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加满冰块和鱼形软糖，加入伏特加、葡萄汽水和橙汁。切勿搅拌！！！！！冰镇后饮用。

drinks.name: Grim Reaper
drinks.instructions_en: Mix Kahlua and 151 in glass. Quickly add ice and pour grenadine over ice to give ice red tint.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将甘露咖啡利口酒和 151 朗姆酒在杯中混合。迅速加入冰块，并将红石榴糖浆浇在冰上，使冰块染上红色。

drinks.name: Freddy Kruger
drinks.instructions_en: make it an ample size shot!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 做成一份大份量的子弹酒！！

drinks.name: Bubble Gum
drinks.instructions_en: Layer in order into a shot glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 按顺序在子弹杯中依次分层。

drinks.name: Kiwi Lemon
drinks.instructions_en: Mix in highball glass. Stirr. Garnish with slice of kiwi.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中混合。搅拌。用一片猕猴桃装饰。

drinks.name: Hot Creamy Bush
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（3/4 shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料在杯中混合。

drinks.name: Midnight Mint
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: If available, rim cocktail (Martini) glass with sugar syrup then dip into chocolate flakes or powder. Add ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake well then strain into cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 如果有条件，先用糖浆涂抹鸡尾酒（马天尼）杯的杯口，再蘸上巧克力碎或巧克力粉。将配料加冰放入摇酒壶中。充分摇匀后滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Talos Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Add your GM and then add your coffee.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先加入金万利橙酒，然后加入咖啡。

drinks.name: Zinger
drinks.instructions_en: Get a shot glass and pour in three shots of the schnapps. Do the same with the Surge Cola. Then down it like Scheetz would.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个子弹杯，倒入三份果味蒸馏酒。对 Surge 可乐也做同样处理。然后像 Scheetz 那样一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Jello shots
drinks.instructions_en: Boil 3 cups of water then add jello. Mix jello and water until jello is completely disolved. Add the two cups of vodka and mix together. Pour mixture into plastic shot glasses and chill until firm. Then, eat away...
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 3 杯水煮沸，然后加入果冻粉。搅拌果冻粉和水，直至果冻粉完全溶解。加入 2 杯伏特加并混合均匀。将混合液倒入塑料子弹（果冻）杯中，冷藏至凝固。然后，就可以开吃了……

drinks.name: Rum Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料在潘趣酒碗中混合后饮用。

drinks.name: Turkeyball
drinks.instructions_en: Shake with ice and strain into a shot glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀后滤入子弹杯。

drinks.name: Absolutely Cranberry Smash
drinks.name_display: 绝对蔓越莓碎石（Absolutely Cranberry Smash）
drinks.instructions_en: Stir ingredients together. Serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料搅拌在一起。加冰饮用。

drinks.name: Kiss me Quick
ingredients_zh: 舒味思粉红汤力水（7 cl）
drinks.instructions_en: mix in the glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中混合。

drinks.name: Royal Flush
ingredients_zh: 香波覆盆子利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all the ingredients into tumbler over ice. Strain into glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒在冰上倒入平底杯中。滤入杯中。

drinks.name: Limona Corona
ingredients_zh: 百加得柠檬朗姆酒（1 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Open the Corona. Fill the empty space in the neck in the bottle with the rum. The bottle should be filled to the top. Plug the bottle with your thumb or the palm of your hand. Turn the bottle upside-down so the rum and beer mix. Turn the bottle rightside-up, unplug, and drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 打开科罗娜啤酒。用朗姆酒填满瓶中瓶颈处的空隙。瓶子应被填至满口。用拇指或手掌堵住瓶口。将瓶子倒转，使朗姆酒与啤酒混合。将瓶子转正，松开手，然后饮用。

drinks.name: Pysch Vitamin Light
drinks.name_display: 赛克维他命轻饮（Pysch Vitamin Light）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀。

drinks.name: Apello
drinks.instructions_en: Stirr. Grnish with maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 搅拌。用马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Texas Rattlesnake
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients and Shake well. Sweet at first, with a BITE at the end...
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料混合并充分摇匀。入口先是甘甜，收尾则带有一记猛烈的后劲……

drinks.name: After sex
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the vodka and creme over some ice cubes in a tall glass and fill up with juice. to make it beuty full make the top of the glass with a grenadine and sugar
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和奶油利口酒倒在长杯中的几块冰块上，再用果汁续满。为了使其更加美观，用红石榴糖浆和糖在杯口做装饰。

drinks.name: San Francisco
drinks.instructions_en: Take a tall glass and put in a few ice cubes, fill the vodka over it and fill with juice then the "creme", to end fill in the grenadine but very carefully at the side of the glass so it will lay down in the bottom. garnish with orange and strawberry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一长杯，放入几块冰块，倒入伏特加没过冰块，用果汁续满，然后加入“奶油利口酒”，最后沿杯壁非常小心地加入红石榴糖浆，使其沉在杯底。用橙子和草莓装饰。

drinks.name: Amaretto Shake
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend at high speed until smooth. Serve in chilled glass garnished with bittersweet chocolate shavings.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料在搅拌机中混合，高速搅打至顺滑。盛入冰镇过的玻璃杯中，用苦甜巧克力碎屑装饰后饮用。

drinks.name: A Day at the Beach
drinks.name_display: 海滩一日（A Day at the Beach）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake Rum, Amaretto, and Orange Juice in a shaker filled with ice. Strain over ice into a highball glass. Add Grenadine and garnish with a Pineapple Wedge and a Strawberry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、阿玛雷托和橙汁在装有冰块的摇酒壶中摇匀。滤入装有冰块的高球杯中。加入红石榴糖浆，并用一块菠萝角和一颗草莓装饰。

drinks.name: Malibu Twister
drinks.instructions_en: Add rum & trister then, add cranberry jucie,stir
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入朗姆酒和三重橙利口酒（Triple Sec），然后加入蔓越莓汁，搅拌。

drinks.name: Space Odyssey
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice and add shots of Bacardi and Malibu. Add splash of pineapple juice and top with orange juice. Add grenadine for color and garnish with cherries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加满冰块，加入几份百加得朗姆酒和马力宝椰香朗姆酒。淋入少许菠萝汁，再用橙汁续满。加入红石榴糖浆调色，并用樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Zenmeister
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together and enjoy
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合在一起后尽情享用。

drinks.name: Avalon
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a tall glass with ice. Layer the Finlandia Vodka, lemon and apple juices, Pisang Ambon, and top up with lemonade. Stir slightly and garnish with a spiralled cucumber skin and a red cherry. The cucumber provides zest and looks attractive. This drink, created by Timo Haimi, took first prize in the 1991 Finlandia Vodka Long Drink Competition.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在长杯中加入冰块。依次分层倒入芬兰伏特加、柠檬汁和苹果汁、皮桑安邦香蕉利口酒，再用柠檬汽水续满。轻轻搅拌，用螺旋状的黄瓜皮和一颗红樱桃装饰。黄瓜带来清爽风味，外观也十分诱人。这款由 Timo Haimi 创作的鸡尾酒曾在 1991 年芬兰伏特加长饮鸡尾酒大赛中荣获第一名。

drinks.instructions_en: Add both ingredients to shot glass, shoot, and get drunk quick
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种配料加入子弹杯中，一口干掉，快速进入微醺。

drinks.name: 3-Mile Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.name_display: 三英里长岛冰茶（3-Mile Long Island Iced Tea）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill 14oz glass with ice and alcohol. Fill 2/3 glass with cola and remainder with sweet & sour. Top with dash of bitters and lemon wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在 14 盎司的杯中加入冰块和酒。倒入可乐至杯子的 2/3，剩余部分用甜酸汁填满。最后加入少许苦精和一块柠檬角。

drinks.name: Zorro
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（2 cl）
drinks.instructions_en: add all and pour black coffee and add whipped cream on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入所有配料，倒入黑咖啡，并在上方挤上打发的奶油。

drinks.name: Orange Crush
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients to tumbler-Pour as shot
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加入平底杯中——作为子弹酒一口饮下。

drinks.name: 155 Belmont
drinks.instructions_en: Blend with ice. Serve in a wine glass. Garnish with carrot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰搅打。盛入葡萄酒杯中饮用。用胡萝卜装饰。

drinks.name: Vodka Russian
drinks.instructions_en: Mix it as a ordinary drink .
drinks.instructions_zh: 像调制普通饮品那样混合即可。

drinks.name: Danbooka
drinks.instructions_en: pour it in and mix it.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入并混合。

drinks.name: 110 in the shade
drinks.instructions_en: Drop shooter in glass. Fill with beer
drinks.instructions_zh: 将子弹杯中的酒液坠入杯中。用啤酒续满。

drinks.name: Grand Blue
drinks.instructions_en: Serve in an old fashioned glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 盛入古典杯中饮用。

drinks.name: Baby Eskimo
drinks.instructions_en: Leave ice-cream out for about 10 minutes. Add ingredients in order, stir with chopstick (butter knife or spoon works too). Consume immediately and often. Nice and light, great for following a heavy drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰淇淋取出放置约 10 分钟。按顺序加入配料，用筷子搅拌（黄油刀或勺子也可以）。立即饮用，且可常饮。口感清新轻盈，非常适合在喝完烈酒之后享用。

drinks.name: Tennesee Mud
drinks.instructions_en: Mix Coffee, Jack Daniels and Amaretto. Add Cream on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡、杰克丹尼威士忌和阿玛雷托混合。在上方加入奶油。

drinks.name: Swedish Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the coffee in an ordinary coffee cup. Add the aquavit. Add sugar by taste. Stir and have a nice evening (morning)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡倒入普通咖啡杯中。加入阿夸维特酒（aquavit）。按口味加糖。搅拌后享受一个美好的夜晚（或清晨）。

drinks.name: Adam Sunrise
drinks.instructions_en: Fill blender up with ice. Fill half with Bartons Vodka. Put 10 tsp of sugar, add 1/2 can lemonade concentrate, fill to top with water. Blend for 60 seconds.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中装满冰块。加入巴顿伏特加至一半。放入 10 茶匙糖，加入半罐浓缩柠檬水，再用水加至满口。搅打 60 秒。

drinks.name: Absolut Stress #2
drinks.instructions_en: Mix well. Garnish with Orange and Cherry. Enjoy
drinks.instructions_zh: 充分混合。用橙子和樱桃装饰。尽情享用。

drinks.name: Chocolate Monkey
drinks.instructions_en: blend liqeuors with ice-cream, milk and syrup. pour into parfait glass, top with whipped cream and garnish with banana and cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各种利口酒与冰淇淋、牛奶和糖浆一起搅打。倒入帕菲高杯中，在其上方挤上打发的奶油，并用香蕉和樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Texas Sling
ingredients_zh: 爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend with Ice until smooth. Serve in a tulip glass, top with whip cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰搅打至顺滑。盛入郁金香杯中饮用，在其上方挤上打发的奶油。

drinks.name: A midsummernight dream
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the strawberrys in a blender Pour it together with the vodka,kirch and strawberry liquer over ice in a shaker. Shake well and pour in a highballglass. Fill up with the Russchian water
drinks.instructions_zh: 将草莓放入搅拌机中打碎。将其与伏特加、樱桃酒（kirsch）和草莓利口酒一起倒在摇酒壶中的冰上。充分摇匀后倒入高球杯中。用 Russchian 水续满。

drinks.name: Zoksel
drinks.instructions_en: No specific mixing instructions, just poor every ingredient in one glass. The lemon goes with it.
drinks.instructions_zh: 没有特别的调制说明，只需将所有配料倒入一个杯子中即可。柠檬一并放入。

drinks.name: Fuzzy Asshole
drinks.instructions_en: fill coffe mug half full of coffee. Fill the other half full of Peach Schnapps. Stir and drink while hot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡杯倒至一半满的咖啡。另一半倒满蜜桃味烈酒（Peach Schnapps）。搅拌后趁热饮用。

drinks.name: Quick-sand
drinks.instructions_en: Simply add the orange juice, quite a quick pour in order to mix the sambucca with the orange juice. The juice MUST have fruit pulp!
drinks.instructions_zh: 直接加入橙汁，倒入时要稍快一些，以便让珊布卡茴香酒与橙汁混合。果汁必须含有果肉！

drinks.name: Snakebite and Black
ingredients_zh: 黑加仑浓缩果汁（A little bit of）
drinks.instructions_en: Put blackcurrant squash in first up to about 1cm in glass. Then add the lager and cider one after another.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先在杯中加入约 1 厘米高的黑加仑浓缩饮料。然后依次加入拉格啤酒和苹果酒。

drinks.name: Zimadori Zinger
ingredients_zh: 蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（1.5 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Zima in a collins glass over ice and then pour the shot of Midori. Don't stir. Garnish with a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 Zima 汽酒倒在柯林杯中的冰上，然后倒入一份蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒。不要搅拌。用一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Herbal flame
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Hot Damn 100 in bottom of a jar or regular glass. Fill the rest of the glass with sweet tea. Stir with spoon, straw, or better yet a cinnamon stick and leave it in.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 Hot Damn 100 肉桂利口酒倒入罐子或普通杯子的底部。用甜茶将杯中剩余空间续满。用勺子、吸管，或者更好的选择——一根肉桂棒搅拌，并将肉桂棒留在杯中。

drinks.name: Jamaican Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Stir the rum, coffee and water together. Top with the whipped cream. Sprinkle with a pinch of well ground coffee and drink with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、咖啡和水搅拌在一起。在其上方挤上打发的奶油。撒上一小撮研磨细腻的咖啡粉，用吸管饮用。

drinks.name: Mojito Extra
drinks.instructions_en: Put mint with lemon juice in a glas, mash the mint with a spoon, ice, rum & fill up with club soda. Top it with Angostura.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷与柠檬汁放入杯中，用勺子捣碎薄荷，加入冰块、朗姆酒，再加满苏打水。最后在表面淋上安哥斯图拉苦精。

drinks.name: Apricot punch
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingrediants into a large punch bowl. Add ice and 4 oranges that are peeled and divided.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入大号潘趣酒碗中。加入冰块和4个去皮切瓣的橙子。

drinks.name: B-52
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1/3）
drinks.instructions_en: Layer ingredients into a shot glass. Serve with a stirrer.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各配料依次分层倒入子弹杯中。配搅拌棒一同上桌。

drinks.name: Zambeer
drinks.instructions_en: Mix sambuca with rootbeer and stir. Add ice
drinks.instructions_zh: 将萨姆布卡与根汁汽水混合并搅拌。加入冰块。

drinks.name: Americano
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Campari and vermouth over ice into glass, add a splash of soda water and garnish with half orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金巴利和味美思倒在冰上倒入杯中，加入少许苏打水，用半片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Black Forest Shake
drinks.instructions_en: In a blender put ice cubes, chocolate syrup, cherry brandy, vodka, and milk. Blend very well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中放入冰块、巧克力糖浆、樱桃白兰地、伏特加和牛奶。充分搅打均匀。

drinks.name: GG
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Galliano liqueur over ice. Fill the remainder of the glass with ginger ale and thats all there is to it. You now have a your very own GG.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将加利安奴利口酒倒在冰上。用姜汁汽水加满杯中剩余空间，就这么简单。这样你就拥有了一杯属于自己的GG。

drinks.name: Radler
drinks.instructions_en: Pour beer into large mug, slowly add the 7-up (or Sprite).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将啤酒倒入大号马克杯，缓慢加入七喜（或雪碧）。

drinks.name: Mudslinger
drinks.instructions_en: Add all contents to a large jug or punch bowl. Stir well!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入大壶或潘趣酒碗中。充分搅拌！

drinks.name: Campari Beer
drinks.instructions_en: Use a 15 oz glass. Add Campari first. Fill with beer.
drinks.instructions_zh: 使用15盎司的杯子。先加入金巴利。再用啤酒加满。

drinks.name: Almond Chocolate Coffee
drinks.name_display: 杏仁巧克力咖啡（Almond Chocolate Coffee）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour in order into coffee cup. Top with whipped creme and chocolate shcvings.
drinks.instructions_zh: 按顺序倒入咖啡杯中。顶部挤上打发的奶油并撒上巧克力碎。

drinks.name: Amaretto Stone Sour Alternative
drinks.name_zh: 阿玛雷托石酸酒替代版
drinks.name_display: 阿玛雷托石酸酒替代版（Amaretto Stone Sour Alternative）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake sour mix, tequila and amaretto with ice. Strain into highball glass. Add a splash of OJ. Garnish with orange slice and a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将酸甜汁、龙舌兰和杏仁利口酒加冰摇匀。滤入高球杯。加入少许橙汁。用橙片和一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: 9 1/2 Weeks
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加柠檬味（2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in glass mixer. Chill and strain into Cocktail glass. Garnish with sliced strawberry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入玻璃调酒器中混合。冰镇后滤入鸡尾酒杯。用草莓片装饰。

drinks.name: Absolutly Screwed Up
ingredients_zh: 绝对伏特加柠檬味（1 shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake it up it tasts better that way, but you can stir it if you want. 6 of those and you will be wasted for the rest of the night.
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀后味道更佳，不过你也可以按喜好搅拌。喝下6杯这个，接下来一整晚你都会醉得不省人事。

drinks.name: Whitecap Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. This makes one drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机，搅打至顺滑。此配方可做一杯。

drinks.name: Bellini Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice cubes to shaker. Add vodka. Add peach schnapps. Add peach nectar. Shake. Strain into glass. Add lemon twist peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块加入摇酒器。加入伏特加。加入蜜桃利口酒。加入蜜桃果浆。摇匀。滤入杯中。加入柠檬皮卷。

drinks.name: Jitterbug
drinks.instructions_en: Wet glass, dip rim in sugar. Then add Ice. Then add everything else. It's that simple!
drinks.instructions_zh: 沾湿杯口，将杯沿蘸上糖。然后加入冰块。再倒入其余所有材料。就这么简单！

drinks.name: Moranguito
drinks.instructions_en: first you put rhe absinthe, then put tequila, then put the Granadine syrup.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先倒入苦艾酒，再倒入龙舌兰，然后倒入红石榴糖浆。

drinks.name: Amaretto Sweet & Sour
drinks.name_display: 阿玛雷托酸甜（Amaretto Sweet & Sour）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill the blender with 3/4 ice. Add sweet & sour mix to the top of the ice. Add about 1" of pineapple juice, 1/2" of melon liqeur, and 1/2 to 1/4" of amaretto. Then blend the mix until it is of margaritta consistency or thinner.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将搅拌机装入四分之三的冰。加入酸甜汁至冰面高度。加入约1英寸高的菠萝汁、1/2英寸高的蜜瓜利口酒，以及1/2至1/4英寸高的杏仁利口酒。然后搅打混合，直至达到玛格丽特的浓稠度或更稀。

drinks.name: Rum Runner
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients in glass & add ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料在杯中混合并加入冰块。

drinks.name: H.D.
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（8 cl）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the whisky and Baileys Cream in a beer-glass (at least 50 cl). Fill the rest of the glass with coffee.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌和百利甜奶油在啤酒杯（至少50厘升）中混合。用咖啡加满杯中剩余空间。

drinks.name: The Evil Blue Thing
drinks.name_display: 邪恶蓝色之物（The Evil Blue Thing）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into glass, and drop in a blue whale! The blue whale isn't really necessary, but it makes the drink more "fun".
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料倒入杯中，然后丢入一头蓝鲸！蓝鲸并非真有必要，但它能让这杯酒更有“趣味”。

drinks.name: Shark Attack
drinks.instructions_en: Mix lemonade and water according to instructions on back of can. If the instructions say to add 4 1/3 cans of water do so. Mix into pitcher. Add 1 1/2 cup of Vodka (Absolut). Mix well. Pour into glass of crushed ice. Excellent!
drinks.instructions_zh: 按照罐子背面的说明将柠檬水和清水混合。若说明要求加4 1/3罐水就照做。倒入水壶中混合。加入1 1/2杯伏特加（绝对牌）。充分搅匀。倒入装满碎冰的杯中。棒极了！

drinks.name: Jack's Vanilla Coke
drinks.name_display: 杰克的香草可乐（Jack's Vanilla Coke）
drinks.instructions_en: After pouring in your ingredients, and adding 3-5 ice cubes, according to taste. Stir the drink with a stirrer to get the Vanilla off the bottom.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入配料后，根据口味加入3至5块冰块。用搅拌棒搅拌这杯酒，把底部的香草味搅匀上来。

drinks.name: Apple Grande
drinks.instructions_en: Chill both ingredients!! Mix in a tumbler and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 把两种配料都冰镇！在平底杯中混合，尽情享用！

drinks.name: Bleeding Surgeon
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Shot of Rum over slice of orange. Fill the remaining space in glass half way full of surge or similar drink. Finish off glass with cranberry juice. Be carefull, warm surge may foam over the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一份朗姆酒倒在橙片上。用Surge或类似饮料将杯中剩余空间加至一半满。最后用蔓越莓汁加满。小心，温热的Surge可能会起泡溢出杯外。

drinks.name: Applejack
ingredients_zh: 蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into mixing glass, chill and strain into cocktail glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加入调酒杯，冰镇后滤入鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Adam Bomb
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to blender (or to glass if prefer on the rocks) then fruit, and fruite juice depending on personal prefference then add the Rum, Vodka, Tequila, and triple sec. blend till smooth, rim glass with sugar or salt and pour mixture in. garnish with lemon or lime slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰加入搅拌机（若偏好加冰饮用则加入杯中），然后根据个人喜好加入水果和果汁，接着加入朗姆酒、伏特加、龙舌兰和橙皮利口酒。搅打至顺滑，用糖或盐蘸杯沿，倒入混合液。用柠檬片或青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Arizona Antifreeze
ingredients_zh: 蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（1/3 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into shot glass and slam !!!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入子弹杯，一饮而尽！！！！

drinks.name: Black and Brown
drinks.instructions_en: CAREFULLY to avoid explosive head formation: Pour Beer glass half full of favorite rootbeer and top off with Guinness.
drinks.instructions_zh: 小心操作以避免产生喷涌的泡沫头：将啤酒杯倒入半杯你最爱的根汁汽水，再用吉尼斯加满。

drinks.name: A Piece of Ass
drinks.name_display: 一口风情（A Piece of Ass）
drinks.instructions_en: Put ice in glass. Pour in shots. Fill with Sour Mix.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中放入冰块。倒入数份shot。用酸甜汁加满。

drinks.name: Avalanche
drinks.instructions_en: Mix in highball glass over ice, shake well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中加冰混合，充分摇匀。

drinks.name: Brandon and Will's Coke Float
drinks.name_zh: 布兰登与威尔的可乐浮冰
drinks.name_display: 布兰登与威尔的可乐浮冰（Brandon and Will's Coke Float）
drinks.instructions_en: Scoop two large scoops of vanilla ice-cream into frosted beer mug. Next, add 2 ounces Maker's Mark. Then, pour in coke. Gently stir and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 挖两大球香草冰淇淋放入冰镇啤酒杯中。接着加入2盎司美格威士忌。然后倒入可乐。轻轻搅拌后享用。

drinks.name: Flaming Lamborghini
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Sambuca and Kahlua into the Cocktail Glass and give the drinker a straw. Pour the Baileys and Blue Curacao into two sepsrate shot glasses either side of the cocktail glass. Set light the concotion in the cocktail glass and start to drink through the straw (this drink should be drunk in one) , as the bottom of the glass is reached put out the fire by pouring the Baileys and Blue Curacao into the cocktail glass and keep drinking till it's all gone!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将萨姆布卡和甘露咖啡利口酒倒入鸡尾酒杯，给饮用者一根吸管。将百利甜和蓝橙利口酒分别倒入鸡尾酒杯两侧的两个子弹杯中。点燃鸡尾酒杯中的混合物，开始通过吸管饮用（这杯酒应一饮而尽），当喝到杯底时，将百利甜和蓝橙利口酒倒入鸡尾酒杯中灭火，并继续喝完！！

drinks.name: Zipperhead
ingredients_zh: 香波覆盆子利口酒（1 shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with rocks, add straw before putting in liquor. Then add the ingredients in order, trying to keep layered as much as possible (i.e. Chambord on bottom, then Vodka, Then soda on top).
drinks.instructions_zh: 用冰块装满杯子，在倒入酒液之前先放入吸管。然后按顺序加入各配料，尽量保持分层（即香波在底部，然后是伏特加，最后苏打水在顶部）。

drinks.name: A Gilligan's Island
drinks.instructions_en: Shaken, not stirred!
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀，不要搅拌！

drinks.name: Kioki Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Stir. Add whipped cream to the top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 搅拌。在顶部加上打发的奶油。

drinks.name: Apple Pie with A Crust
drinks.name_display: 带酥皮的苹果派（Apple Pie with A Crust）
drinks.instructions_en: Just mix the two liquids and sprinkle in the cinnamon. Serve either cold or heated.
drinks.instructions_zh: 只需将两种液体混合并撒入肉桂粉。可冷饮也可热饮。

drinks.name: Zorbatini
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare like a Martini. Garnish with a green olive.
drinks.instructions_zh: 像制作马天尼一样调制。用一颗绿橄榄装饰。

drinks.name: Vodka Fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all ingredients, save nutmeg. Pour into large white wine glass and sprinkle nutmeg on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料混合搅打，肉豆蔻除外。倒入大号白葡萄酒杯，在顶部撒上肉豆蔻。

drinks.name: Radioactive Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.name_display: 放射性长岛冰茶（Radioactive Long Island Iced Tea）
ingredients_zh: 香波覆盆子利口酒（1 oz）
蜜多丽蜜瓜利口酒（1 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients over ice in a very tall glass. Sip cautiously.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有制冰倒入一个很高的杯子中。小心地小口饮用。

drinks.name: Shot-gun
drinks.instructions_en: Pour one part Jack Daneils and one part Jim Beam into shot glass then float Wild Turkey on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一份杰克丹尼和一份占边倒入子弹杯，然后在顶部漂浮一层威凤凰。

drinks.name: Bible Belt
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients, and pour over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料混合，倒在冰上。

drinks.name: Irish Curdling Cow
drinks.name_display: 爱尔兰结块奶牛（Irish Curdling Cow）
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（3/4 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Irish Cream, Vodka, and Bourbon in a glass. Add some ice and mix in the orange juice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将爱尔兰奶油、伏特加和波本威士忌倒入杯中。加入一些冰块，并拌入橙汁。

drinks.name: Sweet Tooth
drinks.instructions_en: Put 2 shots Godiva Liquour into a glass, add as much or as little milk as you would like.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将2份歌帝梵利口酒倒入杯中，按喜好加入适量牛奶（多少随意）。

drinks.name: Downshift
drinks.instructions_en: Start with the Sprite. Next comes the tequila. After that, add the Minute Maid Fruit Punch, then float the 151. Rocks optional.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先倒入雪碧。接着加入龙舌兰。之后加入美汁源果汁宾治，然后在顶部漂浮一层151朗姆酒。冰块可选。

drinks.name: Pink Penocha
drinks.instructions_en: mix all ingredients into bowl keep iced stir frequently
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入碗中混合，保持冰镇，经常搅拌。

drinks.name: Orange Whip
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients over ice and stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料倒在冰上并搅拌。

drinks.name: Bruised Heart
ingredients_zh: 香波覆盆子利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients in a mixing tin over ice, stir, and strain into shot glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入加冰的调酒锡壶中，搅拌后滤入子弹杯。

drinks.name: Gideon's Green Dinosaur
drinks.name_display: 基甸的绿恐龙（Gideon's Green Dinosaur）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients in collins glass with ice and stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加入放有冰块的柯林斯杯中并搅拌。

drinks.name: A True Amaretto Sour
drinks.name_display: 正宗阿玛雷托酸酒（A True Amaretto Sour）
drinks.instructions_en: Rub the rim of an old fashioned glass with lemon, and dip repeatedly into granulated sugar until it has a good "frosted" rim. Shake a jigger of Amaretto with the juice of 1/2 a lemon. Strain into glass and add ice. Garnish with a Marachino Cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用柠檬擦拭古典杯的杯沿，反复蘸取砂糖，直到杯沿形成漂亮的“糖霜”。将一份杏仁利口酒与半个柠檬的汁一起摇匀。滤入杯中并加入冰块。用一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Kool First Aid
drinks.instructions_en: Add Kool Aid to a double shot glass, and top with rum. Slam and shoot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将酷爱（Kool-Aid）饮料倒入双份子弹杯中，顶部加上朗姆酒。一饮而尽。

drinks.name: Irish Russian
drinks.instructions_en: Add the ingredients in the order listed in the recipe. Care must be taken when adding the Guinness to prevent an excess of foam. Do Not add ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 按配方中列出的顺序加入各配料。加入吉尼斯时务必小心，以防泡沫过多。不要加冰。

drinks.name: Auburn Headbanger
drinks.instructions_en: Mix in spread glass over ice. Strain and pour in shot glass. Sit down before shotting. ENJOY!!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在广口杯中加冰混合。滤出后倒入子弹杯。喝之前先坐下。尽情享用！！

drinks.name: Zima Blaster
ingredients_zh: 香波覆盆子利口酒（3 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice. Pour in Chambord, then fill with Zima. Mix and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰块。倒入香波，然后用齐马加满。混合后享用。

drinks.name: Buccaneer
ingredients_zh: 百加得柠檬朗姆酒（1 shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the corona into an 18oz beer glass pour the bacardi limon into the beer stir very gently
drinks.instructions_zh: 将科罗娜倒入18盎司啤酒杯，把百加得柠檬朗姆酒倒入啤酒中，非常轻柔地搅拌。

drinks.name: Homemade Kahlua
drinks.instructions_en: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups of boiling water and add corn syrup. Dissolve the instant coffee in the remaining water. Pour syrup and coffee in a gallon jug. Let it cool. Add vodka and vanilla when cold. For the best result, let the mixture "mature" for 4-5 weeks.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖溶于2杯沸水中，加入玉米糖浆。将速溶咖啡溶于剩余的水中。把糖浆和咖啡倒入1加仑的罐中。让其冷却。冷却后加入伏特加和香草。为达到最佳效果，让混合物“陈化”4至5周。

drinks.name: 24k nightmare
drinks.instructions_en: Add over ice,shake and pour.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰，摇匀后倒入杯中。

drinks.name: Caribbean Boilermaker
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Corona into an 18oz beer glass pour the rum into the beer.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将科罗娜倒入18盎司啤酒杯，把朗姆酒倒入啤酒中。

drinks.name: Army special
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Vodka, Gin and lime cordial into glass, and top up with crushed ice. Wait for ice to melt slightly and sip without a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加、金酒和青柠糖浆倒入杯中，用碎冰加满。等待冰稍微融化后，不用吸管小口饮用。

drinks.name: Arizona Twister
drinks.instructions_en: Just mix in the shots of rum, vodka, and tequila. Add splashes of the three juices, heavy on the pineapple. Top off with grenadine. Crushed ice should already be in glass. Top off the glass with a pineapple wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 只需拌入数份朗姆酒、伏特加和龙舌兰。加入三种果汁各少许，菠萝汁多放一些。用红石榴糖浆加满。杯中应已放有碎冰。最后在杯口放上一块菠萝角。

drinks.name: Baby Guinness
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1/2 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Kahlua, almost filling shot glass. Then, carefully pour Baileys, using wall of shot glass. This will give the "Guinness" its "head".
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入甘露咖啡利口酒，几乎加满子弹杯。然后借助子弹杯的杯壁小心地倒入百利甜。这样就能让这杯“吉尼斯”形成“泡沫头”。

drinks.name: Alice in Wonderland
drinks.name_display: 爱丽丝梦游仙境（Alice in Wonderland）
drinks.instructions_en: Just mix the three ingredients one to one to one
drinks.instructions_zh: 只需将三种配料按一比一比一的比例混合。

drinks.name: 501 Blue
drinks.instructions_en: Mix equal amounts into a glass with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将等量的各配料在加冰的杯中混合。

drinks.name: Coke and Drops
drinks.instructions_en: Take a glass, pour the Coke in the glass, then you take 7 drops of lemon juice. Granish with a lemon slice on the rim of the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一只杯子，将可乐倒入杯中，然后滴入7滴柠檬汁。在杯沿放一片柠檬作装饰。

drinks.name: Ruby Tuesday
drinks.instructions_en: Pour gin and cranberry into a highball filled with ice cubes. Add grenadine and stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒和蔓越莓汁倒入装满冰块的高球杯中。加入红石榴糖浆并搅拌。

drinks.name: Arctic Mouthwash
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all ingredients in a blender on high until ice is finely crushed. It should be of a slushy consistency. Pour immediately and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机高速搅打，直至冰被充分打碎。成品应呈冰沙状浓稠度。立即倒出并上桌。

drinks.name: Brain Fart
ingredients_zh: 伏特加（1 fifth Smirnoff red label）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients together. Slowly and gently. Works best if ice is added to punch bowl and soda's are very cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料混合在一起。缓慢而轻柔。若在潘趣酒碗中加入冰块且汽水非常冰凉，效果最佳。

drinks.name: Royal Bitch
drinks.instructions_en: Into a shot glass layer the Crown Royal on top of the Frangelico.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在子弹杯中将皇冠威士忌分层漂浮在榛子利口酒之上。

drinks.name: Citrus Coke
ingredients_zh: 百加得柠檬朗姆酒（1 part）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour half of coke in a glass. Then add Bacardi and top it off with the remaining coke. Stir and drink up!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一半可乐倒入杯中。然后加入百加得，再用剩余的可乐加满。搅拌后一饮而尽！

drinks.name: Smut
drinks.instructions_en: Throw it all together and serve real cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料混合在一起，冰镇上桌。

drinks.name: Raspberry Cooler
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the raspberry vodka and soda into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将覆盆子伏特加和苏打水倒入几乎装满冰块的高球杯中。充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Amaretto Sunset
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients in bartender's mixer quickly, just 5 shakes. Strain out ice, serve in glass immediately with a slice of orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各配料放入调酒器中快速摇匀，只需摇5下。滤去冰块，立即连同一片橙子一起装入杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Cherry Electric Lemonade
drinks.name_display: 樱桃电击柠檬水（Cherry Electric Lemonade）
drinks.instructions_en: Now stir vigorously and then pour over a large cup of ice. Now drink it with a straw and stir occasionally.
drinks.instructions_zh: 现在用力搅拌，然后倒在一大杯冰上。用吸管饮用，并不时搅拌。

drinks.name: Girl From Ipanema
drinks.name_display: 伊帕内玛女孩（Girl From Ipanema）
drinks.instructions_en: Add the cachaca, lemon juice and syrup to your boston glass. Add ice and shake until ice cold. Pour into a chilled flute and top-up with Champagne
drinks.instructions_zh: 将卡莎萨、柠檬汁和糖浆加入波士顿摇酒器中。加入冰块摇匀至冰冷。倒入冰镇笛形杯中，用香槟加满。

drinks.name: Ipamena
drinks.instructions_en: Cut half a lime into pieces, place in a shaker, add the sugar and crush. Measure the passion fruit juice, add it to the shaker and fill up with ice cubes. Close the shaker and shake vigorously. Pour the liquid into a glass, top up with ginger ale, stir with a teaspoon and then garnish the rim of the glass with a slice of lime
drinks.instructions_zh: 将半个青柠切成块，放入摇酒器，加入糖并捣碎。量取百香果汁，加入摇酒器并用冰块加满。盖紧摇酒器用力摇匀。将液体倒入杯中，用姜汁汽水加满，用茶匙搅拌，然后在杯沿放一片青柠作装饰。

drinks.name: Dark Caipirinha
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the sugar into the lime wedges in an old-fashioned glass. Fill the glass with ice cubes. Pour the cachaca into the glass. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中将糖与青柠角一起捣碎。用冰块装满杯子。将卡莎萨倒入杯中。充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Jam Donut
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（2/3 oz）
香波覆盆子利口酒（1/3 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Coat the rim of a shot glass with sugar using sugar syrup to stick. Add the Chambord raspberry liqueur to the shot glass, and carefully layer the Baileys Irish Cream on top. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用糖浆作粘合剂，在子弹杯的杯沿蘸上一层糖。将香波覆盆子利口酒倒入子弹杯，然后小心地将百利甜爱尔兰奶油分层漂浮在其上。上桌。

drinks.name: Aviation
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1.5 cl）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加入装满冰块的鸡尾酒摇酒器。充分摇匀后滤入鸡尾酒杯。用一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Dirty Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the vodka, dry vermouth and olive brine into a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice and shake well. Rub the rim of a martini glass with the wedge of lemon. Strain the contents of the cocktail shaker into the glass and add the olive. A dirty Martini contains a splash of olive brine or olive juice and is typically garnished with an olive.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加、干味美思和橄榄盐水倒入放有一把冰的鸡尾酒摇酒器中，充分摇匀。用柠檬角擦拭马天尼杯的杯沿。将摇酒器中的内容物滤入杯中并放入橄榄。脏马天尼含有少许橄榄盐水或橄榄汁，通常用一颗橄榄装饰。

drinks.name: Duchamp's Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients. Double strain in a chilled double old fashioned glass with abig ice cube. Garnish with a couple of lavender sprigs
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料摇匀。双重过滤到放有一大块冰的冰镇双份古典杯中。用几枝薰衣草装饰。

drinks.name: Bacardi Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake together with ice. Strain into glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰一起摇匀。滤入杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Between The Sheets
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes, shake, strain into chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入装有冰块的摇酒器，摇匀后滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Casino
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1/4 tsp）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist and a maraschino cherry. Serve without a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入装有冰块的摇酒器。充分摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。用柠檬皮卷和一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。不配吸管上桌。

drinks.name: Clover Club
drinks.instructions_en: Dry shake ingredients to emulsify, add ice, shake and served straight up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先将各配料干摇以乳化，加入冰块再摇匀，然后不加冰直接倒入杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Derby
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice. Stir. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a sprig of fresh mint in the drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入加冰的调酒杯中。搅拌。滤入鸡尾酒杯。在酒中放一枝新鲜薄荷作装饰。

drinks.name: Mary Pickford
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1/2 tsp）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake and strain into a chilled large cocktail glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀后滤入冰镇的大号鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Monkey Gland
drinks.instructions_en: Shake well over ice cubes in a shaker, strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒器中加冰块充分摇匀，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Paradise
drinks.instructions_en: Shake together over ice. Strain into cocktail glass and serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰一起摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯，冰镇上桌。

drinks.name: Planter's Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients, except the bitters, into shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Pour into large glass, filled with ice. Add Angostura bitters, "on top". Garnish with cocktail cherry and pineapple.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除苦精外的所有配料倒入装有冰的摇酒器。充分摇匀。倒入装满冰的大号杯中。在顶部“漂浮”加入安哥斯图拉苦精。用鸡尾酒樱桃和菠萝装饰。

drinks.name: Porto flip
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients together in a mixer with ice. Strain into glass, garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各配料在调酒器中加冰摇匀。滤入杯中，装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Stinger
drinks.instructions_en: Pour in a mixing glass with ice, stir and strain into a cocktail glass. May also be served on rocks in a rocks glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入加冰的调酒杯中，搅拌后滤入鸡尾酒杯。也可以加冰在古典杯中上桌。

drinks.name: White Lady
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into large cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加入装满冰块的鸡尾酒摇酒器。充分摇匀后滤入大号鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Bellini
drinks.instructions_en: Pour peach purée into chilled flute, add sparkling wine. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将蜜桃果泥倒入冰镇的笛形杯，加入起泡酒。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Cosmopolitan
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and double strain into large cocktail glass. Garnish with lime wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加入装满冰块的鸡尾酒摇酒器。充分摇匀后双重过滤到大号鸡尾酒杯中。用青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: French 75
drinks.instructions_en: Combine gin, sugar, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake vigorously and strain into a chilled champagne glass. Top up with Champagne. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、糖和柠檬汁放入装满冰的鸡尾酒摇酒器中混合。用力摇匀后滤入冰镇的香槟杯。用香槟加满。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: French Connection
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料直接倒入装满冰块的古典杯中。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Golden dream
drinks.instructions_en: Shake with cracked ice. Strain into glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加碎冰摇匀。滤入杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Grasshopper
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake briskly and then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料倒入加冰的鸡尾酒摇酒器。快速摇匀后滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Hemingway Special
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（3 parts）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入加冰的摇酒器。摇匀。

drinks.name: Horse's Neck
drinks.instructions_en: Pour brandy and ginger ale directly into highball glass with ice cubes. Stir gently. Garnish with lemon zest. If desired, add dashes of Angostura Bitter.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将白兰地和姜汁汽水直接倒入装有冰块的海波杯中。轻轻搅拌。用柠檬皮装饰。如需要，可加入几滴安格仕苦精。

drinks.name: Kir
drinks.instructions_en: Add the crème de cassis to the bottom of the glass, then top up with wine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黑醋栗利口酒倒入杯底，再注入葡萄酒至满。

drinks.name: Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.name_display: 长岛冰茶（Long Island Iced Tea）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all contents in a highball glass and sitr gently. Add dash of Coca-Cola for the coloring and garnish with lemon or lime twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将全部材料倒入海波杯中轻轻搅拌。加入少量可口可乐调色，并用柠檬皮或青柠皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Mimosa
drinks.instructions_en: Ensure both ingredients are well chilled, then mix into the glass. Serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 确保两种材料充分冰镇，然后倒入杯中混合。冷饮。

drinks.name: Mint Julep
drinks.instructions_en: In a highball glass gently muddle the mint, sugar and water. Fill the glass with cracked ice, add Bourbon and stir well until the glass is well frosted. Garnish with a mint sprig.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在海波杯中轻轻捣压薄荷、糖和水。将杯子装满碎冰，加入波本威士忌充分搅拌，直至杯身结满霜。用一枝薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Pina Colada
drinks.instructions_en: Mix with crushed ice in blender until smooth. Pour into chilled glass, garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 与碎冰一起在搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。倒入冰镇过的杯中，装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Rose
drinks.instructions_en: Shake together in a cocktail shaker, then strain into chilled glass. Garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在雪克壶中摇匀，然后滤入冰镇过的杯中。装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Barracuda
drinks.instructions_en: Shake pour ingredients with ice. Strain into glass, top with Sparkling wine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料加冰摇匀。滤入杯中，注入起泡酒至满。

drinks.name: Bramble
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with crushed ice. Build gin, lemon juice and simple syrup over. Stir, and then pour blackberry liqueur over in a circular fashion to create marbling effect. Garnish with two blackberries and lemon slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将杯子装满碎冰。依次倒入金酒、柠檬汁和糖浆。搅拌，然后以画圈方式倒入黑莓利口酒，营造大理石纹效果。用两颗黑莓和一片柠檬装饰。

drinks.name: Dark and Stormy
drinks.instructions_en: In a highball glass filled with ice add 6cl dark rum and top with ginger beer. Garnish with lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装满冰块的海波杯中加入 6 厘升黑朗姆酒，注入姜汁啤酒至满。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Espresso Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into shaker filled with ice, shake vigorously, and strain into chilled martini glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料倒入装有冰块的雪克壶中，用力摇匀，滤入冰镇过的马天尼杯中。

drinks.name: French Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入加冰块的雪克壶中。充分摇匀后滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯中。挤压柠檬皮，将柠檬油喷于酒面。

drinks.name: Russian Spring Punch
drinks.name_display: 俄罗斯春天潘趣（Russian Spring Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the ingredients into an highball glass, top with Sparkling wine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料倒入海波杯中，注入起泡酒至满。

drinks.name: Spritz
drinks.instructions_en: Build into glass over ice, garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加冰依次调制，装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Tommy's Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀后滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Vampiro
drinks.instructions_en: Vampiros may be made in a tall glass or an old fashioned glass. Bartenders may first "rim" the glass with Kosher Salt, which is done by placing a layer of Kosher Salt on a chopping board, moistening the glass' rim with lime juice or water, and then placing the upside down glass rim onto the Kosher Salt, so that the salt sticks to the moistened rim. The second step is to fill half the glass with ice and add one or two shooter glasses full of high quality Tequila. The next stage is to add the flavouring elements. This is done by squeezing a fresh lime into the glass, adding a few grains of salt, adding citrus-flavoured soda pop, until the glass is 4/5 full, and then adding spicy Viuda de Sanchez (or orange juice, lime juice and pico de gallo). The final step is to stir the ingredients so that the flavours are properly blended.
drinks.instructions_zh: 吸血鬼（Vampiros）可用高杯或古典杯调制。调酒师可能会先用犹太盐为杯口做盐边，做法是在砧板上铺一层犹太盐，用青柠汁或水润湿杯口，然后将杯子倒扣、使杯口沾上犹太盐，让盐粘附在湿润的杯口上。第二步是将杯子装半杯冰，加入一到两小杯（shooter）优质龙舌兰酒。接下来是加入调味元素：将一颗新鲜青柠挤汁入杯，加入少许盐粒，倒入柑橘味汽水至杯子 4/5 满，然后加入辛辣的 Viuda de Sanchez（或橙汁、青柠汁和皮科德加洛）。最后一步是搅拌材料，使各种风味充分融合。

drinks.name: Vesper
drinks.instructions_en: Shake over ice until well chilled, then strain into a deep goblet and garnish with a thin slice of lemon peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀至充分冷却，然后滤入深口高脚杯中，用一片薄柠檬皮装饰。

drinks.name: Yellow Bird
drinks.instructions_en: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀后滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Butter Baby
drinks.instructions_en: Blend together in a blender. Serve in a chilled Beer mug with Fresh Blueberries and caramel for topping.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中搅打混合。倒入冰镇过的啤酒杯中，顶部以新鲜蓝莓和焦糖点缀。

drinks.name: Boozy Snickers Milkshake
drinks.name_display: 微醺士力架奶昔（Boozy Snickers Milkshake）
drinks.instructions_en: Place the snickers bars in a plastic bag and roll over them with a rolling pin until crushed. Add crushed snickers pieces, ice cream, milk, caramel sauce, chocolate sauce, and chocolate liquor to a blender. Blend until shake is thick and frothy. Pour into glasses and top with chocolate liquor and whip cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将士力架放入塑料袋中，用擀面杖碾压至碎。将碎士力架、冰淇淋、牛奶、焦糖酱、巧克力酱和巧克力利口酒放入搅拌机中。搅打至奶昔浓稠起泡。倒入杯中，顶部淋上巧克力利口酒并挤上打发的奶油。

drinks.name: A1
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, mix and serve over ice into a chilled glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入雪克壶中混合，加冰倒入冰镇过的杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Abbey Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Put all ingredients into a shaker and mix, then strain contents into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入雪克壶中混合，然后滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Absolutely Fabulous
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the Vodka and Cranberry juice together in a shaker and strain into a glass. Top up with Champagne.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和蔓越莓汁在雪克壶中混合，滤入杯中。注入香槟至满。

drinks.name: Ace
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and ice then strain in a cold glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与冰在雪克壶中摇匀，然后滤入冰镇过的杯中。

drinks.name: Adam & Eve
drinks.instructions_en: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料一起摇匀，滤入冰镇过的杯中。

drinks.name: Addington
drinks.instructions_en: Mix both the vermouth's in a shaker and strain into a cold glass. Top up with a squirt of Soda Water.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种味美思在雪克壶中混合，滤入冰镇过的杯中。挤入少许苏打水至满。

drinks.name: Addison
drinks.instructions_en: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料一起摇匀，滤入冰镇过的杯中。

drinks.name: Adios Amigos Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 再见朋友鸡尾酒（Adios Amigos Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料一起摇匀，滤入冰镇过的杯中。

drinks.name: Gin Rickey
drinks.instructions_en: Half-fill a tall glass with ice. Mix the gin and Grenadine together and pour over the ice. Add the lime or lemon juice and top off with soda water. Decorate the glass with lime and/or lemon slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中装半杯冰。将金酒和红石榴糖浆混合，倒在冰上。加入青柠汁或柠檬汁，注入苏打水至满。用青柠片和/或柠檬片装饰杯身。

drinks.name: Hunter's Moon
drinks.instructions_en: Put the Bombay Sapphire, Martini Bianco, sugar syrup & blackberries in a cocktail shaker with lots of ice and shake vigorously before pouring into a balloon glass, topping up with lemonade and garnishing with a wedge of orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将孟买蓝宝石金酒、马天尼白味美思、糖浆和黑莓放入装有大量冰块的雪克壶中用力摇匀，然后倒入球形杯中，注入柠檬汽水至满，并用一角橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Zombie
drinks.instructions_en: Blend at high speed for no more than 5 seconds. Pour into a glass, add ice cubes to fill, then add the garnish. *Donn’s mix: Bring 3 crushed cinnamon sticks, 1 cup of sugar and 1 cup of water to a boil, stirring until the sugar is dissolved. Simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from the heat and let sit for at least 2 hours before straining into a clean glass bottle. Then add 1 part of the syrup and 2 parts of fresh grapefruit juice together.
drinks.instructions_zh: 高速搅打不超过 5 秒。倒入杯中，加入冰块至满，然后装饰。*唐氏混合液（Donn's mix）：将 3 根压碎的肉桂棒、1 杯糖和 1 杯水煮沸，搅拌至糖溶解。小火煮 2 分钟，然后离火静置至少 2 小时，再滤入干净的玻璃瓶中。然后将 1 份该糖浆与 2 份新鲜西柚汁混合。

drinks.name: Bombay Cassis
drinks.instructions_en: Add the Bombay Sapphire, Crème de Cassis and lime juice to a balloon glass and swirl well to mix. Fill the glass with good quality cubed ice. Top up with chilled and freshly opened Fever-Tree Ginger Beer. Gently stir to combine, top with a gently squeezed lime wedge and finish with a fresh ginger slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将孟买蓝宝石金酒、黑醋栗利口酒和青柠汁倒入球形杯中充分旋摇混合。用优质方冰将杯子填满。注入冰镇且刚开瓶的 Fever-Tree 姜汁啤酒至满。轻轻搅拌使其混合，顶部放一角轻挤过的青柠，最后放一片新鲜生姜。

drinks.name: Rosemary Blue
drinks.instructions_en: 1) Add the Bombay Sapphire, Blue Curacao, rosemary sprig and gently squeezed lemon wedge to a balloon glass. Swirl well to combine. 2) Fill with cubed ice and top with the Fever-Tree Light Tonic Water. 3) Gently fold with a bar spoon to mix.
drinks.instructions_zh: 1）将孟买蓝宝石金酒、蓝橙利口酒、一枝迷迭香和轻挤过的柠檬角放入球形杯中。充分旋摇混合。2）加入方冰至满，注入 Fever-Tree 淡味汤力水至满。3）用吧勺轻轻翻拌混合。

drinks.name: Empellón Cocina's Fat-Washed Mezcal
drinks.name_zh: 恩佩隆厨房脂洗梅斯卡尔
drinks.name_display: 恩佩隆厨房脂洗梅斯卡尔（Empellón Cocina's Fat-Washed Mezcal）
drinks.instructions_en: To ensure that your pork fat is just as delicious as theirs, here’s their adobo marinade and what to do with it (you’ll also need a rack of ribs): 4 ancho chiles, 8 guajillo chiles and 4 chipotle chiles, plus 4 cloves roasted garlic, half a cup of cider vinegar, a quarter teaspoon of Mexican oregano, 1 teaspoon of ground black pepper, a whole clove, a quarter teaspoon of ground cinnamon and a half teaspoon of ground cumin. Toast the dried chiles and soak in water for at least an hour until they are rehydrated. Drain and discard the soaking liquid. Combine the soaked chiles with the remaining ingredients and purée until smooth. Cold smoke a rack of baby back pork ribs by taking a large hotel pan with woodchips on one side and charcoal on the other. Place another, smaller, pan with pork ribs, above the charcoal/woodchip pan. Ignite the charcoal, being careful to not ignite the woodchips. Cover both pans with foil and allow to smoke for 10-15 minutes, until desired level of smoke is achieved, then coat with adobo marinade and wrap in tin foil prior to placing ribs in a 300 degree oven for 7 hours. When the ribs have cooled, strain off the fat and use for the infusion. If you’re having a hard time coming up to the same kind of volume of fat, make up the balance with pork lard from a butcher. To get the same depth of flavor without the ribs, heat up the fat in a pot with a few spoons of the marinade. Once you’ve got your tub of seasoned pork fat in cooled liquid form, pour equal amounts of Ilegal Joven mezcal and fat into a sealable container. Seal the container and give it a really good shake, then put it in the freezer overnight. When the whole thing is separated and congealed, pour it through a fine mesh chinoise. If you don’t have a chinoise, try a fine mesh strainer, or if you don’t have one of those, try spooning off most of the fat. There will be some beads of orange fat left in the strained mezcal: run that through a few layers of cheesecloth (or coffee filters in a pinch) to get rid of the last of it. The mezcal is now ready for drinking, straight-up or in a cocktail. Habanero tincture Slice habaneros and add 2 ounces Ilegal Joven mezcal. Allow to sit overnight or until desired level of heat is achieved. Cocktail Combine mezcal and chocolate liqueur in a mixing glass with ice and stir for 45 seconds. Strain into chilled coupe. Carefully "sink" the coffee liqueur down the inside of the coupe over a spoon. Garnish with 5 drops habanero tincture.
drinks.instructions_zh: 为确保你的猪油和他们的一样美味，以下是他们的阿多波（adobo）腌料及其用法（你还需要一整扇排骨）：4 个安乔辣椒、8 个瓜希柳辣椒和 4 个烟熏墨西哥辣椒，另加 4 瓣烤蒜、半杯苹果醋、四分之一茶匙墨西哥牛至、1 茶匙黑胡椒粉、1 整粒丁香、四分之一茶匙肉桂粉和半茶匙孜然粉。将干辣椒烘烤后浸泡在水中至少一小时，直至泡软回软。沥干并丢弃浸泡液。将泡好的辣椒与其余材料混合，打成顺滑的泥。用冷熏法熏制一整扇猪小排：取一个大的酒店烤盘，一侧放木屑，另一侧放木炭。在木炭/木屑盘上方再放一个较小的、装有猪排的烤盘。点燃木炭，注意不要点燃木屑。用锡纸盖住两个烤盘，熏制 10-15 分钟，直至达到理想的烟熏程度，然后涂上阿多波腌料，用锡纸包好，将排骨放入 300 度（约 150℃）的烤箱中烤 7 小时。排骨冷却后，滗出油脂，用于浸渍。如果你难以获得同样分量的油脂，可用肉店的猪板油补足。若想不用排骨也获得同样浓郁的风味，可将油脂与几勺腌料一起在锅中加热。当你得到一盆冷却成液态的调味猪油后，将等量的 Ilegal Joven 梅斯卡尔酒与油脂倒入可密封容器中。密封容器并用力摇晃，然后放入冷冻室冷藏过夜。待整体分离并凝结后，用细网滤勺（chinoise）过滤。如果没有细网滤勺，可试用细网筛；若也没有，可尝试撇去大部分油脂。过滤后的梅斯卡尔酒中会残留一些橙色油脂珠：用几层纱布（应急时可用咖啡滤纸）过滤掉最后残留的部分。此时梅斯卡尔酒即可饮用，可纯饮或调制成鸡尾酒。哈瓦那辣椒酊剂：将哈瓦那辣椒切片，加入 2 盎司 Ilegal Joven 梅斯卡尔酒。静置过夜，或直至达到理想的辣度。鸡尾酒：将梅斯卡尔酒和巧克力利口酒加冰在调酒杯中搅拌 45 秒。滤入冰镇过的碟形香槟杯中。用勺背贴着杯内壁，小心地将咖啡利口酒“沉”入杯底。用 5 滴哈瓦那辣椒酊剂装饰。

drinks.name: The Last Word
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: French Negroni
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to a shaker and pour in all ingredients. Using a bar spoon, stir 40 to 45 revolutions or until thoroughly chilled. Strain into a martini glass or over ice into a rocks glass. Garnish with orange twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在雪克壶中加冰，倒入所有材料。用吧勺搅拌 40 至 45 圈，或直至彻底冷却。滤入马天尼杯中，或加冰滤入古典杯中。用橙皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Pegu Club
drinks.instructions_en: Shake, strain, up, cocktail glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀、过滤、不加冰，盛于鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Corpse Reviver
drinks.instructions_en: Shake, strain, straight up, cocktail glass rinsed with absinthe
drinks.instructions_zh: 摇匀、过滤、不加冰，盛于用苦艾酒涮洗过的鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: Boulevardier
drinks.instructions_en: Stir with ice, strain, garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰搅拌，过滤，装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Greyhound
drinks.instructions_en: Add the vodka to a Collins glass filled with ice. Top with grapefruit juice and stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加倒入装有冰块的柯林杯中。注入西柚汁至满并搅拌。

drinks.name: Paloma
drinks.instructions_en: Stir together and serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 一起搅拌，加冰享用。

drinks.name: Bijou
drinks.instructions_en: Stir in mixing glass with ice and strain
drinks.instructions_zh: 在调酒杯中加冰搅拌并过滤。

drinks.name: Gimlet
drinks.instructions_en: Add all the ingredients to a shaker and fill with ice. Shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass or an Old Fashioned glass filled with fresh ice. Garnish with a lime wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入雪克壶中并加满冰。摇匀后滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯，或滤入装有新鲜冰块的古典杯中。用一片青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Martinez 2
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1 tsp）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass and fill with ice. Stir until chilled, and strain into a chilled coupe glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入调酒杯中并加满冰。搅拌至冷却，滤入冰镇过的碟形香槟杯中。

drinks.name: Oatmeal Cookie
ingredients_zh: 百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒（2 parts）
drinks.instructions_en: Just mix it all together. It's meant to be a shot, but it works just fine as a proper adult-sized drink over lots of ice. Tastes like an oatmeal cookie.
drinks.instructions_zh: 把所有材料混合在一起即可。它本意是一款子弹杯（shot），但加大量冰块做成一杯成人分量的饮品也完全没问题。味道像燕麦饼干。

drinks.name: Bahama Mama
drinks.instructions_en: Add 2 parts club soda or more or less to taste. Mix it all together and pour over a bunch of ice. Drink with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入 2 份苏打水，可按口味增减。将所有材料混合，倒在大量冰块上。用吸管饮用。

drinks.name: Blue Hurricane
drinks.instructions_en: If each part is 1/2 oz then use about 2.5 cups of ice. Blend it all together. Drink it with a big straw if you have one.
drinks.instructions_zh: 若每份为 1/2 盎司，则使用约 2.5 杯冰。将所有材料一起搅打。如果有大吸管，就用大吸管饮用。

drinks.name: The Laverstoke
drinks.instructions_en: 1) Squeeze two lime wedges into a balloon glass then add the cordial, Bombay Sapphire and MARTINI Rosso Vermouth, swirl to mix. 2) Fully fill the glass with cubed ice and stir to chill. 3) Top with Fever-Tree Ginger Ale and gently stir again to combine. 4) Garnish with a snapped ginger slice and an awoken mint sprig.
drinks.instructions_zh: 1）将两角青柠挤汁入球形杯中，然后加入果浆（cordial）、孟买蓝宝石金酒和马天尼红味美思，旋摇混合。2）用方冰将杯子完全填满并搅拌冷却。3）注入 Fever-Tree 姜汁汽水至满，再次轻轻搅拌使其混合。4）用一片掰开的生姜和一枚拍醒的薄荷枝装饰。

drinks.name: Brigadier
drinks.instructions_en: Mix ingredients in a warmed mug and stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料放入温热的马克杯中混合并搅拌。

drinks.name: The Jimmy Conway
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice Pour in The Irishman and Disaronno Fill to the top with Cranberry Juice Garnish with a slice of lemon…Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰，倒入 The Irishman 威士忌和 Disaronno 杏仁利口酒，注入蔓越莓汁至满，用一片柠檬装饰……尽情享用！

drinks.name: Old Pal
drinks.instructions_en: Chill cocktail glass. Add ingredients to a mixing glass, and fill 2/3 full with ice. Stir about 20 seconds. Empty cocktail glass and strain into the glass. Garnish with a twist of lemon peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 冰镇鸡尾酒杯。将材料放入调酒杯中，装冰至 2/3 满。搅拌约 20 秒。倒空鸡尾酒杯中的冰水，将酒液滤入杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Tipperary
drinks.instructions_en: Stir over ice. Strain into chilled glass. Cut a wide swath of orange peel, and express the orange oils over the drink. Discard orange twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰搅拌。滤入冰镇过的杯中。切一片宽大的橙皮，将橙油喷于酒面。丢弃橙皮卷。

drinks.name: Penicillin
ingredients_zh: 调和苏格兰威士忌（2 oz）
艾雷岛单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌（1/4 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake blended Scotch, lemon juice, honey syrup and ginger syrup with ice. Strain over large ice in chilled rocks glass. Float smoky Scotch on top (be sure to use a smoky Scotch such as an Islay single malt). Garnish with candied ginger.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将调和苏格兰威士忌、柠檬汁、蜂蜜糖浆和姜汁糖浆加冰摇匀。滤入装有冰糖块的冰镇古典杯中。在表面漂浮一层烟熏苏格兰威士忌（务必使用如艾雷岛单一麦芽这类烟熏威士忌）。用糖姜装饰。

drinks.name: Corn n Oil
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the half lime in half again. Add the lime, falernum, and bitters to a rocks glass. Muddle. Add the rum. (Aged Barbados rum such as Plantation 5 Year is recommended). Add ice and stir. Float the blackstrap rum on top. Serve with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将半个青柠再切成两半。将青柠、法勒南糖浆和苦精放入古典杯中。捣压。加入朗姆酒。（推荐使用陈年巴巴多斯朗姆酒，如 Plantation 5 Year）。加冰搅拌。在表面漂浮一层黑糖蜜朗姆酒。配吸管上桌。

drinks.name: Slippery Nipple
ingredients_zh: 爱尔兰奶油利口酒（1 part）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Sambuca into a shot glass, then pour the Irish Cream on top so that the two liquids do not mix.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将珊布卡茴香酒倒入子弹杯中，然后在其上缓慢倒入爱尔兰奶油利口酒，使两种液体不相混合。

drinks.name: Tequila Slammer
drinks.instructions_en: Mix carefully to avoid releasing the dissolved CO2.
drinks.instructions_zh: 小心搅拌，以免释放出溶解的二氧化碳。

drinks.name: Spritz Veneziano
drinks.instructions_en: Build into glass over ice, garnish and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加冰依次调制，装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Espresso Rumtini
drinks.name_display: 浓缩咖啡朗姆天尼（Espresso Rumtini）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together in a cocktail glass. Garnish with some choclate powder and coffee beans
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒杯中混合在一起。用少许巧克力粉和咖啡豆装饰。

drinks.name: A Furlong Too Late
drinks.name_display: 迟了一浪（A Furlong Too Late）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the rum and ginger beer into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒和姜汁啤酒倒入几乎装满冰块的海波杯中。充分搅拌。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Brooklyn
ingredients_zh: 马拉斯奇诺利口酒（1/4 oz）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients with ice and stir until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料与冰混合搅拌至充分冷却。滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Broadside
drinks.instructions_en: Half fill the glass with ice cubes. Crush the wormwood and add to ice. Pour rum, scotch and butters, then serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装半杯冰块。将苦艾捣碎加入冰中。倒入朗姆酒、苏格兰威士忌和 butters（黄油利口酒），然后上桌！

drinks.name: Bloody Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Place the thawed strawberries in a large bowl. Mash them with a fork to ensure no large chunks. In a punch bowl or pitcher, combine mashed strawberries, lime pulp and soda. Mix well. Add blueberries and raisins. They will float and look like bugs in the punch.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将解冻的草莓放入大碗中。用叉子捣碎，确保没有大块。在潘趣盆或水壶中，将捣碎的草莓、青柠果肉和苏打水混合。充分拌匀。加入蓝莓和葡萄干。它们会浮在表面，看起来像潘趣酒里的虫子。

drinks.name: Halloween Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Tip the cherry juice, orange peel, chilli, cinnamon sticks, cloves and ginger into a large saucepan. Simmer for 5 mins, then turn off the heat. Leave to cool, then chill for at least 4 hrs, or up to 2 days – the longer you leave it the more intense the flavours. If serving to young children, take the chilli out after a few hours. When you’re ready to serve, pour the juice into a jug. Serve in glass bottles or glasses and pop a straw in each. If you're adding vodka, do so at this stage. Dangle a fangs sweet from each glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将樱桃汁、橙皮、辣椒、肉桂棒、丁香和生姜倒入一个大平底锅中。小火煮 5 分钟，然后关火。放凉后冷藏至少 4 小时，最多可放 2 天——放得越久，风味越浓郁。如果给幼儿饮用，几小时后取出辣椒。准备上桌时，将汁液倒入壶中。盛入玻璃瓶或玻璃杯中，每个杯子里插一根吸管。如果要加伏特加，就在这一步加入。每个杯子上挂一颗“尖牙”糖果。

drinks.name: Gin Basil Smash
drinks.name_display: 金酒罗勒斯玛什（Gin Basil Smash）
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle Basil leaves (~ 10) with Suggar Syrup in a shaker. Add Gin an Lemon Juice. Filter and serve in a tumbler with ice
drinks.instructions_zh: 在雪克壶中将罗勒叶（约 10 片）与糖浆一起捣压。加入金酒和柠檬汁。过滤后倒入加冰的平底杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Munich Mule
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice Pour Gin and Lime Juice Fill glass with Ginger Beer Garnish with Cucumer and Lime slice
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰，倒入金酒和青柠汁，注入姜汁啤酒至满，用黄瓜片和青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Honey Bee
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients with crushed ice
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料与碎冰摇匀。

drinks.name: Bee's Knees
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients with crushed ice Garnish with orange peel
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料与碎冰摇匀，用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: 747 Drink
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a Collins glass with ice. Pour in vodka, lime cordial, and cranberry juice. Fill up with Sprite. Garnish with a Lime wheel or some cranberries
drinks.instructions_zh: 在柯林杯中装满冰。倒入伏特加、青柠果浆和蔓越莓汁。注入雪碧至满。用一片青柠片或一些蔓越莓装饰。

drinks.name: Aquamarine
drinks.instructions_en: Shake well in a shaker with ice. Strain in a martini glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有冰的雪克壶中充分摇匀。滤入马天尼杯中。

drinks.name: A Night In Old Mandalay
drinks.name_display: 曼德勒旧城之夜（A Night In Old Mandalay）
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the light rum, añejo rum, orange juice, and lemon juice. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Top with the ginger ale. Garnish with the lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装半杯冰块的雪克壶中，将白朗姆酒、陈酿朗姆酒、橙汁和柠檬汁混合。充分摇匀。滤入几乎装满冰块的海波杯中。注入姜汁汽水至满。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Banana Cream Pi
drinks.instructions_en: Serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰上桌。

drinks.name: Amaretto fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Mix Amaretto, orange juice and sparkling wine in a jug. Add a strip orange zest to each glass, if you like.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在壶中将杏仁利口酒、橙汁和起泡酒混合。如喜欢，可在每个杯中加入一条橙皮。

drinks.name: Spice 75
drinks.instructions_en: Gently warm 60g golden caster sugar in a pan with 30ml water and 1 tbsp allspice. Cook gently until the sugar has dissolved, then leave the mixture to cool. Strain through a sieve lined with a coffee filter (or a double layer of kitchen paper). Pour 60ml of the spiced syrup into a cocktail shaker along with 200ml rum and 90ml lime juice. Shake with ice and strain between six flute glasses. Top up with 600ml champagne and garnish each with an orange twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在锅中将 60 克金黄细砂糖与 30 毫升水和 1 汤匙多香果轻轻加热。小火煮至糖溶解，然后让混合物冷却。用铺有咖啡滤纸（或双层厨房纸巾）的滤网过滤。将 60 毫升香料糖浆与 200 毫升朗姆酒和 90 毫升青柠汁一起倒入雪克壶中。加冰摇匀，分滤入六个笛形香槟杯中。注入 600 毫升香槟至满，每杯用橙皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Passion Fruit Martini
drinks.name_display: 百香果马天尼（Passion Fruit Martini）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a glass and stir. Garnish with half a passion fruit piece.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入杯中搅拌。用半颗百香果装饰。

drinks.name: Aperol Spritz
drinks.instructions_en: Put a couple of cubes of ice into 2 glasses and add a 50 ml measure of Aperol to each. Divide the prosecco between the glasses and then top up with soda, if you like.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在两个杯子中各放入几块冰，每杯加入 50 毫升的阿佩罗。将普罗塞克起泡酒分倒入两个杯中，如喜欢可再注入苏打水至满。

drinks.name: White Wine Sangria
drinks.name_display: 白葡萄酒桑格利亚（White Wine Sangria）
drinks.instructions_en: Chop the Lemon, Lime and other fruits into large chunks. Fill the Pitcher with the white wine and mix in the Apple Brandy. Top to taste with soda water.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬、青柠和其他水果切成大块。在壶中倒入白葡萄酒，并拌入苹果白兰地。按口味注入苏打水至满。

drinks.name: Pineapple Paloma
drinks.instructions_en: Rub the rim of each glass with lime slice and dip into salt. Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda. Give it a quick stir. Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用青柠片擦拭每个杯口，然后蘸上盐。加入冰、龙舌兰酒、西柚汁、青柠汁，注入菠萝汽水至满。快速搅拌一下。用新鲜菠萝或青柠装饰。

drinks.name: Funk and Soul
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients together and strain into a Collins glass. Use Jamaican rum where possible for a more authentic taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料混合在一起，滤入柯林杯中。尽可能使用牙买加朗姆酒，以获得更地道的风味。

drinks.name: Captain Kidd's Punch
drinks.name_display: 基德船长潘趣（Captain Kidd's Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients together in a shaker and strain into a collins glass. Use Caribbean dark Rum for a sweeter taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料在雪克壶中混合，滤入柯林杯中。使用加勒比黑朗姆酒可获得更甜的风味。

drinks.name: A. J.
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中上桌。

drinks.name: The Philosopher
drinks.instructions_en: Add all the spirits in a shaker (best to use Hendricks gin) as well as the orange bitters and lemon juice. Strain into a Margarita glass, top with Prosecco.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有烈酒（最好使用亨利爵士金酒）、橙味苦精和柠檬汁放入雪克壶中。滤入玛格丽特杯中，注入普罗塞克起泡酒至满。

drinks.name: Bounty Hunter
drinks.instructions_en: Add the spirits into a shaker as well as the pineapple juice, strain into a Margarita glass. Top with Prosecco and garnish with Blueberries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将烈酒和菠萝汁放入雪克壶中，滤入玛格丽特杯中。注入普罗塞克起泡酒至满，并用蓝莓装饰。

drinks.name: Smashed Watermelon Margarita
drinks.name_display: 捣碎西瓜玛格丽特（Smashed Watermelon Margarita）
drinks.instructions_en: In a mason jar muddle the watermelon and 5 mint leaves together into a puree and strain. Next add the grapefruit juice, juice of half a lime and the tequila as well as some ice. Put a lid on the jar and shake. Pour into a glass and add more ice. Garnish with fresh mint and a small slice of watermelon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在梅森罐中将西瓜和 5 片薄荷叶一起捣压成泥并过滤。接着加入西柚汁、半个青柠的汁、龙舌兰酒以及一些冰。盖上罐盖摇匀。倒入杯中并再加些冰。用新鲜薄荷和一小片西瓜装饰。

drinks.name: Raspberry Julep
drinks.instructions_en: Softly muddle the mint leaves and raspberry syrup in the bottom of the cup. Add crushed ice and Bourbon to the cup and then stir. Top with more ice, garnish with a mint sprig.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯底轻轻捣压薄荷叶和覆盆子糖浆。向杯中加入碎冰和波本威士忌，然后搅拌。再加些冰至满，用一枝薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Death in the Afternoon
drinks.name_display: 午后之死（Death in the Afternoon）
drinks.instructions_en: Easy as you like, pour the absinthe into a chilled glass, top with champagne. Must be drunk mid afternoon for the optimum effect.
drinks.instructions_zh: 简单得很，将苦艾酒倒入冰镇过的杯中，注入香槟至满。需在午后饮用方可达到最佳效果。

drinks.name: Lazy Coconut Paloma
drinks.name_display: 慵懒椰子帕洛玛（Lazy Coconut Paloma）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the coconut liqueur (preferably tequila) with the grapefruit juice and top with soda water. Garnish with a large grapefruit slice against the inside of the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将椰子利口酒（最好用龙舌兰酒）与西柚汁混合，注入苏打水至满。将一大片西柚贴靠杯内壁作装饰。

drinks.name: Blueberry Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the blueberries with the other ingredients and serve in a highball glass. Garnish with mint and a half slice of lime.
