drinks.instructions_zh: 将蓝莓与其他材料一起捣压，盛入海波杯中。用薄荷和半片青柠装饰。

drinks.name: Autumn Garibaldi
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a glass over ice and stir with a bar spoon. Garnish with some orange slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰倒入杯中，用吧勺搅拌。用几片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Pure Passion
drinks.instructions_en: Mix up all ingredients with a cocktail stirrer and serve with crushed ice with mint and edible flour if available.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用鸡尾酒搅拌棒将所有材料混合，配碎冰上桌，如有可用薄荷和食用花装饰。

drinks.name: The Strange Weaver
drinks.instructions_en: Mix ingredients slowly in a glass with ice, garnish with orange slice
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加冰，将材料缓缓混合，用橙片装饰。

drinks.name: Abbey Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients (except for the cherry) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the cherry and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除樱桃外的所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。放上樱桃装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Garibaldi Negroni
drinks.name_display: 加里波第内格罗尼（Garibaldi Negroni）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together in a shaker and garnish with a simple orange slice. Fill your vitamin C and cocktail fix at the same time!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在雪克壶中混合在一起，用一片简单的橙子装饰。同时满足你对维生素 C 和鸡尾酒的需求！

drinks.name: Orange Rosemary Collins
drinks.name_display: 橙子迷迭香柯林斯（Orange Rosemary Collins）
drinks.instructions_en: Add the spirits to the bottom of the glass and top equally with the mixer drinks. Garnish with orange slices inside the glass as well as some rosemary on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将烈酒倒入杯底，等量注入混合饮料至满。用橙片放入杯中装饰，顶部再放些迷迭香。

drinks.name: Gin and Soda
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Gin and Soda water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Garnish with the lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒和苏打水倒入几乎装满冰块的海波杯中。充分搅拌。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Michelada
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the beer with tomato juice, freshly squeezed lime juice, and Worcestershire sauce, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, or hot sauce. Served In a chilled, salt-rimmed glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 将啤酒与番茄汁、鲜榨青柠汁，以及伍斯特酱、照烧酱、酱油或辣酱混合。盛于冰镇过的盐边杯中。

drinks.name: Figgy Thyme
drinks.instructions_en: In a lewis bag, crush up some ice like a baller/maniac (@glacioice). Pour your precious ice into a collins glass. In a cocktail shaker, muddle the figs and thyme together. Add honey vodka, lemon juice, and a large ice cube (@glacioice). Shake until well chilled, and strain into glass. Add tonic water and finally 2 dashes of angostura bitters. Garnish with sliced figs and thyme.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在刘易斯冰袋中，像行家／疯子一样把冰砸碎（@glacioice）。将你珍贵的冰倒入柯林杯中。在雪克壶中，将无花果和百里香一起捣压。加入蜂蜜伏特加、柠檬汁和一大块冰（@glacioice）。摇匀至充分冷却，滤入杯中。加入汤力水，最后加 2 滴安格仕苦精。用无花果片和百里香装饰。

drinks.name: Hot Toddy
drinks.instructions_en: STEP 1 Whisk the whisky and honey together and split between 2 heatproof glasses. Add half of the cinnamon stick to each, then top up with 200ml boiling water. STEP 2 Add a splash of lemon juice to each, then taste and add more to your preference. Finish each with a slice of lemon, studded with a clove, and serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 步骤 1：将威士忌和蜂蜜搅打均匀，分装入两个耐热杯中。每杯加入半根肉桂棒，然后注入 200 毫升沸水至满。步骤 2：每杯加入少许柠檬汁，然后品尝并按个人喜好再添加。每杯最后放一片插着丁香的柠檬，立即上桌。

drinks.name: Elderflower Caipirinha
drinks.name_display: 接骨木花卡琵莉亚（Elderflower Caipirinha）
drinks.instructions_en: Take the glass and muddle the lime in it. Fill the glass with crushed ice and add the Cachaca. Stir well and top with some more crushed ice. Garnish with lime and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 取杯，在其中捣压青柠。将杯子装满碎冰并加入卡莎萨甘蔗酒。充分搅拌，再加些碎冰至满。用青柠装饰，尽情享用！

drinks.name: Winter Rita
drinks.instructions_en: Salt rim. Combine all ingredients, shake with ice, and strain over fresh ice.⠀
drinks.instructions_zh: 做盐边。将所有材料混合，加冰摇匀，滤在新鲜冰块上。

drinks.name: Winter Paloma
drinks.instructions_en: Everyone’s favourite Paloma gets a delicious Indian makeover. Tequila reposado infused with “Timur Pepper” which has citrusy & grapefruit notes and is grown at the foothills of Himalaya. It also produces a slightly numbing and tingling sensation on your lip when consumed. We have also spiced up the fresh grapefruit juice with the warming spice blend from Himalaya. The combination of all these interesting elements has allowed us to elevate your Paloma sipping experience.
drinks.instructions_zh: 人人都爱的帕洛玛（Paloma）经过一番美味的印度风情改造。陈酿龙舌兰酒（Tequila reposado）中浸入了“提穆尔花椒”（Timur Pepper），它带有柑橘与西柚的香气，生长于喜马拉雅山麓。饮用时还会在嘴唇上带来微微发麻、刺刺的感觉。我们还用来自喜马拉雅的暖香香料混合物为新鲜西柚汁增添了风味。所有这些有趣元素的结合，让我们的帕洛玛品饮体验得到了提升。

drinks.name: Snowday
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled rocks glass over fresh ice. Express orange peel over drink and garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰搅拌。滤入预先冰镇的古典杯中，杯中加新冰块。在酒液上方挤压橙皮喷香并装饰。

drinks.name: Abilene
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all of the ingredients into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入几乎装满冰块的高球杯中。充分搅拌。

drinks.name: The Galah
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together the alcoholic portions and top with Pineapple and Lime juice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各含酒精的材料混合，然后倒入菠萝汁和青柠汁补满。

drinks.name: Frosé
drinks.instructions_en: Step 1 Pour rosé into a 13x9" pan and freeze until almost solid (it won't completely solidify due to the alcohol), at least 6 hours. Step 2 Meanwhile, bring sugar and ½ cup water to a boil in a medium saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes. Add strawberries, remove from heat, and let sit 30 minutes to infuse syrup with strawberry flavor. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a small bowl (do not press on solids); cover and chill until cold, about 30 minutes. Step 3 Scrape rosé into a blender. Add lemon juice, 3½ ounces strawberry syrup, and 1 cup crushed ice and purée until smooth. Transfer blender jar to freezer and freeze until frosé is thickened (aim for milkshake consistency), 25–35 minutes. Step 4 Blend again until frosé is slushy. Divide among glasses. Step 5 Do Ahead: Rosé can be frozen 1 week ahead.
drinks.instructions_zh: 步骤1：将桃红葡萄酒倒入13x9英寸的烤盘中，冷冻至几乎凝固（因含酒精不会完全冻硬），至少6小时。步骤2：与此同时，将糖和½杯水放入中型平底锅中煮沸；不断搅拌，煮至糖溶解，约3分钟。加入草莓，离火，静置30分钟，让糖浆吸收草莓风味。用细网筛滤入小碗中（不要按压固体）；盖好并冷藏至冰凉，约30分钟。步骤3：将桃红葡萄酒刮入搅拌机中。加入柠檬汁、3½盎司草莓糖浆和1杯碎冰，搅打至顺滑。将搅拌机杯放入冷冻室，冷冻至冰沙变浓稠（以奶昔的浓稠度为目标），25–35分钟。步骤4：再次搅打至冰沙呈雪泥状。分装入各杯中。步骤5：提前准备：桃红葡萄酒可提前1周冷冻。

drinks.name: Apple Highball
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice in a highball glass. Rub a wedge of fresh lime around rim and place it in the glass. Add a shot of Apple schnapps, a shot of Courvoisier and top up with ginger ale.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中加冰。用一块新鲜青柠角擦抹杯口，再将其放入杯中。加入一份苹果味利口酒、一份拿破仑干邑，用姜汁汽水补满。

drinks.name: Pink Moon
drinks.instructions_en: Slowly shake in a shaker with ice, strain into a square whiskey glass. Top with fresh ice. Add the blackberries to garnish. Add flowers and a green leaf for a special look!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加冰缓慢摇匀，滤入方形威士忌杯中。加入新冰块。放入黑莓作装饰。再点缀花朵和一片绿叶，营造特别的效果！

drinks.name: Mountain Bramble
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the blackberries in a tumbler glass. Mix the Gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup in a shaker and strain over chopped ice. Top with Soda water and garnish with more blackberries and some mint
drinks.instructions_zh: 在平底杯中捣碎黑莓。将金酒、柠檬汁和糖浆在摇酒壶中混合，滤在碎冰上。用苏打水补满，再用更多黑莓和少许薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Butterfly Effect
drinks.instructions_en: Grab your boston tin, fill it with cubes ice and then simply chuck in all your ingredients apart from your lemonade. Now it’s time to shake what your mama gave you until all your ingredients are blended to perfection. Add some cubes of ice to your hurricane glass, give them a swill to cool the whole thing down and then strain your raspberry vodka cocktail of wonder into the glass. Top with lemonade and chuck a sprig of mint on top for garnish. You can either get drinking at this point or go and try and grab a few butterflies to finish, the choice really is yours.
drinks.instructions_zh: 拿起你的波士顿摇酒壶，装入冰块，然后把除柠檬水以外的所有材料统统倒进去。现在用力摇匀，直到所有材料完美融合。在飓风杯中放入几块冰块，晃动一下让整只杯子冷却，然后将这杯奇妙的覆盆子伏特加鸡尾酒滤入杯中。用柠檬水补满，最后放一小枝薄荷作装饰。此时你可以直接开喝，也可以再去捉几只蝴蝶来收尾，全凭你喜好。

drinks.name: Pornstar Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Cut passion fruit in half and use as garnish. Pour prosecco into a chilled shot glass and serve alongside the martini.
drinks.instructions_zh: 直饮：将所有材料倒入加有冰块的调酒杯中。充分摇匀。滤入冰镇的马天尼鸡尾酒杯中。将百香果对半切开用作装饰。将普罗塞克倒入冰镇的shot杯中，与马天尼一同上桌。

drinks.name: Mango Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze the juice from 1½ limes and blend with the mango to give a smooth purée. Cut the rest of the limes into quarters, and then cut each wedge in half again. Put 2 pieces of lime in a highball glass for each person and add 1 teaspoon of caster sugar and 5-6 mint leaves to each glass. Squish everything together with a muddler or the end of a rolling pin to release all the flavours from the lime and mint. Divide the mango purée between the glasses and add 30ml white rum and a handful of crushed ice to each one, stirring well to mix everything together. Top up with soda water to serve and garnish with extra mint, if you like.
drinks.instructions_zh: 挤出1½个青柠的汁，与芒果一起搅打成顺滑的果泥。将剩余的青柠切成四瓣，再把每一瓣对半切开。每人的高球杯中放入2块青柠，每杯加入1茶匙细砂糖和5-6片薄荷叶。用捣棒或擀面杖的末端将它们一起捣压，充分释放青柠和薄荷的风味。将芒果果泥分入各杯中，每杯加入30毫升白朗姆酒和一把碎冰，充分搅拌使所有材料融合。上桌时用苏打水补满，如喜欢可再用额外的薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Kiwi Martini
drinks.instructions_en: The kiwi martini is a very fun vodka cocktail and it is one of the best drinks that makes use of fresh fruit. Though there are a few recipes floating around, this is one of the easiest and it is an absolutely delightful green martini to drink. For this recipe, you'll simply muddle slices of kiwi with simple syrup, then shake it with vodka. It's a drink that anyone can mix up in minutes and a perfect cocktail to show off your favorite vodka.
drinks.instructions_zh: 猕猴桃马天尼是一款非常有趣的伏特加鸡尾酒，也是最能利用新鲜水果的饮品之一。虽然流传的配方不少，但这款是最简单的之一，也是一杯绝对令人愉悦的绿色马天尼。做这款配方时，你只需将猕猴桃片与单糖浆一起捣压，再与伏特加一起摇匀即可。这是一款任何人都能在几分钟内调好的饮品，也是展示你心爱伏特加的完美鸡尾酒。

drinks.name: Acapulco
drinks.instructions_en: Combine and shake all ingredients (except mint) with ice and strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes. Add the sprig of mint and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（薄荷除外）加冰混合摇匀，滤入放了冰块的古典杯中。加入一小枝薄荷即可上桌。

drinks.name: Lemon Elderflower Spritzer
drinks.name_display: 柠檬接骨木花气泡饮（Lemon Elderflower Spritzer）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients over ice, stir and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒在冰上，搅拌即可享用！

drinks.name: Vodka Slime
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice. Add vodka, 7-up then finish with the lime juice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 杯中加满冰。加入伏特加、七喜，最后以青柠汁收尾。

drinks.name: Vodka Lemon
drinks.instructions_en: The vodka lemon is prepared directly in a highball glass or in a large tumbler: put 6-7 ice cubes in the glass, pour the vodka, lemonade and mix with a bar spoon. Finally decorate with a slice of lemon and, if you prefer, add a few mint leaves. Your vodka lemon is ready to be served.
drinks.instructions_zh: 伏特加柠檬直接在高球杯或大平底杯中调制：杯中放入6-7块冰块，倒入伏特加和柠檬水，用吧勺搅拌。最后用一片柠檬装饰，如喜欢可再加几片薄荷叶。你的伏特加柠檬就可以上桌了。

drinks.name: Vodka Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Wash and cut 1 wedge and 1 slice of lime or lemon. Fill a tumbler with fresh ice. Pour the desired dose of vodka and top up with the tonic. Squeeze the lime wedge into the glass and decorate with the slice. That's all, very simple: it's just the recipe for happiness!
drinks.instructions_zh: 洗净并切出1个青柠或柠檬的角块和1片圆片。在平底杯中加满新鲜冰块。倒入所需分量的伏特加，用汤力水补满。将青柠角挤汁入杯，再放上柠檬圆片装饰。就这样，非常简单：这就是快乐的配方！

drinks.name: Gin Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a highball glass with ice, pour the gin, top with tonic water and squeeze a lemon wedge and garnish with a lemon wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将高球杯加满冰，倒入金酒，用汤力水补满，挤入一块柠檬角，再用一块柠檬角装饰。

drinks.name: Gin Lemon
drinks.instructions_en: For the preparation of the gin lemon you will not need the shaker. Fill the tumbler with ice, pour the gin and lemonade over it. Gently mix and decorate with a slice of lemon. Those who prefer can also add a few mint leaves. Your gin lemon is ready to be served.
drinks.instructions_zh: 调制金酒柠檬不需要摇酒壶。在平底杯中加满冰，倒入金酒和柠檬水。轻轻搅拌，用一片柠檬装饰。喜欢的人还可以加几片薄荷叶。你的金酒柠檬就可以上桌了。

drinks.name: Ramos Gin Fizz
drinks.name_display: 拉莫斯金菲士（Ramos Gin Fizz）
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare all the ingredients on the counter to be able to work well and quickly, especially the cream and egg white. Pour all the ingredients into a shaker. Shake vigorously for 1 minute: cream and egg white must be mixed perfectly, so don't rush. Now open the shaker and put some ice and shake for 1-2 minutes. It depends on how long you can resist! Pour into a highball glass, add a splash of soda and garnish to taste. Ramos Gin Fizz was once drunk as an invigorating drink or even as a breakfast, try it as an aperitif and after dinner and you will discover a little gem now lost.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料备在台面上以便高效快速地操作，尤其是奶油和蛋清。将所有材料倒入摇酒壶中。用力摇约1分钟：奶油和蛋清必须完全融合，所以不要着急。现在打开摇酒壶加入一些冰，再摇1-2分钟。这取决于你能坚持多久！倒入高球杯中，加少许苏打水，按口味装饰。拉莫斯金菲士当年是作为提神饮品甚至早餐来饮用的，把它当作开胃酒和餐后酒试试，你会发现一颗如今已被遗忘的小瑰宝。

drinks.name: Planter’s Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze an orange and strain the juice. Put all the ingredients in a shaker filled with ice and shake for at least 12 seconds. Strain into a highball glass and decorate with a pineapple wedge or fruit of your choice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 挤一个橙子并滤出橙汁。将所有材料放入装有冰的摇酒壶中，摇匀至少12秒。滤入高球杯中，用一块菠萝角或你喜欢的水果装饰。

drinks.name: Cocktail Horse’s Neck
drinks.instructions_en: Wash and brush an organic, untreated lemon, then cut a spiral of lemon peel, using a citrus peel. If it is too large, cut it with a sharp knife. Put some ice in a tall tumbler glass, place the lemon peel inside and pour the cognac, add the ginger beer and let 2-3 drops of Angostura fall into it. Easy to do, but once you try it you'll love it.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一颗有机、未经处理的柠檬洗净刷净，然后用削皮刀削出一条螺旋状的柠檬皮。如果太大，可用锋利的刀修剪。在高身平底杯中放入一些冰，将柠檬皮放入其中，倒入干邑，加入姜汁啤酒，再滴入2-3滴安高天娜苦精。做起来很简单，但一旦尝试你就会爱上它。

drinks.name: Adam
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装了一半冰块的摇酒壶中混合所有材料。充分摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Mauresque
drinks.instructions_en: 1 - Pour the Ricard (or pastis) 2 - Pour the orgeat syrup 3 - Finally pour the water and add ice cubes at your convenience. Add the ice cubes at the end, otherwise the syrup and pastis do not mix well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 1 - 倒入里卡尔（或帕斯蒂斯茴香酒） 2 - 倒入杏仁糖浆 3 - 最后倒入水，并视需要加入冰块。冰块要最后加，否则糖浆和茴香酒无法充分融合。

drinks.name: Old Cuban
drinks.instructions_en: Shake a handful of mint, 2oz white rum, 1oz of sugar syrup, 1oz lime juice and 2 dashes angostura bitters with ice. Double strain into a glass and top with 2oz of prosecco.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一把薄荷、2盎司白朗姆酒、1盎司糖浆、1盎司青柠汁和2滴安高天娜苦精加冰摇匀。双重过滤倒入杯中，用2盎司普罗塞克补满。

drinks.name: Boyarsky
drinks.instructions_en: Pour a layer of vodka over the grenadine, then add a few drops of Tabasco sauce.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在红石榴糖浆上铺一层伏特加，然后滴入几滴塔巴斯科辣酱。

drinks.name: Adonis Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中，即可上桌。

drinks.name: Affair
drinks.instructions_en: Pour schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice over ice in a highball glass. Top with club soda and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中加冰，倒入果味烈酒、橙汁和蔓越莓汁。用苏打水补满即可上桌。

drinks.name: Affinity
drinks.instructions_en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装了一半冰块的调酒杯中混合所有材料。充分搅拌。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: 151 Rum Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the rum into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒倒入shot杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Aam Panna
drinks.instructions_en: Choose the raw mangoes which are tart. You can keep the skin on before boiling the mangoes. It gives a very distinct flavor to the Panna. Peeling the skin before boiling makes the process very easy. If the Panna is not very tangy, you can add some lemon juice to it. Boil Mango with mild heat in 1 cup of water. You can also roast mango before boiling if needed for crispy taste. The subtly smoky flavor in this drink will take it to the next level. Strain into the prepared glass. Garnish with a parsley sprig, 2 speared green olives, and a lime wedge and a celery stalk (optional).
drinks.instructions_zh: 挑选带酸味的生芒果。煮芒果前可以保留果皮，这样会让Panna风味格外独特。煮前去皮则能让过程更简单。如果Panna酸味不足，可以加一些柠檬汁。用小火将芒果在1杯水中煮。如有需要，也可在煮之前先把芒果烤一下以获得更清脆的口感。这款饮品中淡淡的烟熏风味会让它更上一层楼。滤入准备好的杯中。用一小枝欧芹、2颗用签串起的青橄榄、一块青柠角，以及一根芹菜杆（可选）作装饰。

drinks.name: Aamras
drinks.instructions_en: Rinse the Alphonso mangoes, then peel and chop them. Add the chopped mango pieces in a blender and blend. Add cardamom powder and crushed saffron strands. Stir very well. To thin down the aamras you can add some sugar and water/milk. Pour in small bowls and chill in the refrigerator. You can also add your choice of dry fruits to the aamras.
drinks.instructions_zh: 冲洗阿方索芒果，然后去皮切块。将切好的芒果块放入搅拌机中搅打。加入小豆蔻粉和碾碎的藏红花丝。充分搅拌均匀。若想让aamras更稀一些，可以加一些糖和水/牛奶。倒入小碗中，放入冰箱冷藏。你也可以加入自己喜欢的干果。

drinks.name: ABC Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Wash all the ingredients thoroughly. Core the apples and chop all the fruits and vegetables into chunks. If using a juicer: juice apples, beetroot, carrots, and ginger in that order. If using a blender: blend everything with water until smooth and strain using a mesh or muslin cloth. Squeeze in lemon juice if desired. Add a pinch of salt, sugar, or chaat masala as per taste (optional). Serve immediately with or without ice, or store in the fridge for up to 24–48 hours.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料彻底洗净。给苹果去核，把所有水果和蔬菜切成大块。如果使用榨汁机：按苹果、甜菜根、胡萝卜、姜的顺序榨汁。如果使用搅拌机：将所有材料加水搅打至顺滑，再用滤网或纱布过滤。如喜欢可挤入柠檬汁。根据口味加入一小撮盐、糖或印度酸辣调味粉（可选）。立即上桌，可加冰或不加冰，或放入冰箱冷藏，最多可存放24–48小时。

drinks.name: Across the Pacific
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into a shaker with one ice cube. Shake until the ice melts and mixture is frothy. Pour into a rocks glass filled with crushed ice. Garnish with a lime wheel and grated nutmeg.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与一块冰放入摇酒壶中。摇至冰块融化、混合物起泡。倒入装满碎冰的古典杯中。用一片青柠片和磨碎的肉豆蔻装饰。

drinks.name: Adonis
ingredients_en: 60 ml fino sherry, lustau La Ina
ingredients_zh: 30毫升甜味美思，卡帕诺安提卡
60毫升菲诺雪莉酒，卢斯塔奥拉伊纳
drinks.instructions_en: Pour sherry, vermouth and bitters in to a mixing glass. Fill glass with ice and stir quickly. Strain into a coupe glass and garnish with orange zest
drinks.instructions_zh: 将雪莉酒、味美思和苦精倒入调酒杯中。在杯中加满冰，快速搅拌。滤入浅碟香槟杯中，用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Adult Hot Chocolate
drinks.name_display: 成人热巧克力（Adult Hot Chocolate）
ingredients_en: Garnish: chocolate sprinkles or shaved chocolate
ingredients_zh: 装饰用巧克力碎或巧克力屑
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. Pour the schnapps into a warm mug or Irish coffee glass. Fill with hot chocolate. Stir well. Optionally, top with whipped cream and chocolate sprinkles or shaved chocolate. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好材料。将果味烈酒倒入温热的马克杯或爱尔兰咖啡杯中。注入热巧克力。充分搅拌。可选：在顶部加上打发的奶油和巧克力碎屑或巧克力刨片。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Affogato
drinks.instructions_en: Place a scoop of Gelato in a chilled bowl. Pour the Espresso quickly over the Gelato Add an extra topping of choice such as whipped cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在冰镇的碗中放入一球意式冰淇淋。将浓缩咖啡快速浇在冰淇淋上。可按喜好额外添加配料，如打发的奶油。

drinks.name: Afterglow
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into a shaker Add ice into the shaker. Shake vigorously. Garnish with a slice of orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入摇酒壶中。向摇酒壶中加入冰。用力摇匀。用一片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Agua de bandindo
drinks.name_display: 阿瓜德班迪多（Agua de bandindo）
drinks.instructions_en: Put the corote in a glass and mix the powdered juice and frozen juice Be happy
drinks.instructions_zh: 将corote倒入杯中，加入冲调的果汁粉和冰冻果汁混合。开心享用。

drinks.name: Agua de valencia
drinks.name_display: 瓦伦西亚之水（Agua de valencia）
drinks.instructions_en: Start by making fresh-squeezed orange juice (if you can find Valencia oranges, all the better). It may be a bit labor intensive, but trust me, you will taste the difference! Fresh-squeezed orange juice has a much lighter, fresher taste that will make your Agua de Valencia super refreshing. In Spain, many grocery stores have orange juice machines where you can simply press a button to get a liter of Valencia’s famous orange juice. Taste your orange juice and take note of its sweetness. If its on the bitter side, you may need to add some sugar. Pour all the liquid ingredients in your pitcher. Mix together and taste. If you used a bitter cava or type of champagne, this will also affect how much sugar needs to be added. Agua de Valencia is not meant to be a super sugary drink, but it isn’t meant to be bitter either! Grab a couple of large wine glasses and pour your fresh Spanish cocktail over ice. Chop a few orange slices and add them as a garnish. Clink your glasses, say “¡Salud!” and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 先制作鲜榨橙汁（如果能买到瓦伦西亚橙就更好了）。这可能有点费功夫，但相信我，你会尝出差别！鲜榨橙汁的味道更清淡、更新鲜，能让你的瓦伦西亚之水格外清爽。在西班牙，许多杂货店都有橙汁机，只需按个按钮就能得到一升瓦伦西亚著名的橙汁。尝一下你的橙汁，留意它的甜度。如果偏苦，可能需要加一些糖。将所有液体材料倒入壶中。混合均匀并尝味。如果使用的是偏苦的卡瓦酒或某种香槟，也会影响需要添加的糖量。瓦伦西亚之水本不是一款超甜的饮品，但也不该是苦的！取两只大葡萄酒杯，将你的新鲜西班牙鸡尾酒倒在冰上。切几片橙子作为装饰放入。碰杯，说一句“¡Salud!”（干杯），尽情享用！

drinks.name: Aguapanela
drinks.instructions_en: Put the water in a small saucepan or pot and heat until it boils. When it reaches this state, lower the heat. When the water stops boiling add the panela in pieces and simmer for 30 minutes. Pour the aguapanela over ice. Add in lemon juice, to taste. Stir to combine, then serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水放入小平底锅或锅中，加热至沸腾。沸腾后调低火力。待水停止沸腾时，加入切成块的panela（粗制蔗糖块），小火慢煮30分钟。将aguapanela倒在冰上。按口味加入柠檬汁。搅拌均匀后上桌。

drinks.name: Airmail
drinks.instructions_en: Add rum, lime juice and honey syrup to a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake until chilled. Strain over ice into a Collins glass. Top with Champagne and add a straw. Garnish with a lime or orange twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、青柠汁和蜂蜜糖浆加入摇酒壶中。加冰摇至冰凉。滤在冰上倒入柯林杯中。用香槟补满，插入一根吸管。用青柠皮或橙皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Ajoblanco
drinks.instructions_en: Place the stale bread into the blender and cover with the cold water and vinegar. Add the strained almonds, diced apple, and garlic. Pulse in the blender until smooth. Taste and adjust for salt and vinegar. Add ice if serving immediately (to make sure it's fully chilled). While blending, slowly add the olive oil. Taste and adjust seasoning. Chill in the fridge if you have time. If not, add some ice cubes. To serve, top with sliced green grapes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将不新鲜的面包放入搅拌机中，倒入冷水和白醋没过。加入滤出的杏仁、切丁的苹果和大蒜。用搅拌机点动搅打至顺滑。尝味并调整盐和白醋的用量。如果马上上桌就加入冰（以确保完全冰凉）。搅打过程中慢慢加入橄榄油。尝味并调整调味。有时间的话放入冰箱冷藏。如果没时间，就加一些冰块。上桌时在顶部放上切片绿葡萄。

drinks.name: Alien Brain Hemorrhage
drinks.name_display: 外星人脑溢血（Alien Brain Hemorrhage）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shot glass with Peach Schnapps. Put Bailey’s Irish Cream carefuly on top using spoon. Slowly add a dash of of Blue Curacao. Finish with a dash of grenadine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将shot杯倒满桃子味利口酒。用勺子小心地将百利甜酒铺在上面。缓慢加入少许蓝橙力娇酒。最后以少许红石榴糖浆收尾。

drinks.name: Almond Banana Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 杏仁香蕉冰沙（Almond Banana Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: To make almond banana smoothie combine all the ingredients in a mixer and blend till smooth and frothy. Pour equal quantities of the almond banana smoothie into 4 individual glasses. Serve the almond banana smoothie immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作杏仁香蕉奶昔时，将所有材料放入搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑起泡。将杏仁香蕉奶昔等量倒入4个杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Amaretto Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake hard all ingredients with ice. Fine strain into an ice-filled glass. Garnish with a lemon twist and two skewered brandied cherries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰用力摇匀。细滤入加了冰的杯中。用一片柠檬皮卷和两颗用签串起的酒渍樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Amarula Thai Tea
drinks.name_display: 阿玛鲁拉泰式茶（Amarula Thai Tea）
drinks.instructions_en: Bring 4 cups water to a simmer a medium saucepan then turn down the heat and add the Thai tea. Steep for up to 20 minutes over low heat. Strain to remove all of the tea leaves. Pour the warm tea into 4 heatproof 12-ounce mugs. Add 2 ounces of Amarula to each cup. Top with frothed milk and garnish with star anise or a cinnamon stick.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在中型平底锅中将4杯水煮至微沸，然后调低火力并加入泰式茶。用小火浸泡最多20分钟。滤去所有茶叶。将温热的茶倒入4个耐热、12盎司的马克杯中。每杯加入2盎司非洲大象酒。在顶部加上奶泡，用八角或一根肉桂棒装饰。

drinks.name: American Trilogy
drinks.instructions_en: In a rocks glass, add sugar cube and saturate with orange bitters. Gently muddle to make a granulated paste. Add whiskey and ice (preferably an oversized cube). Garnish with a long, curly orange peel. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中放入一块方糖，用橙味苦精浸透。轻轻捣压成一团颗粒状的糊。加入威士忌和冰（最好是一块大冰块）。用一条长而卷曲的橙皮装饰。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Americano
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Campari and vermouth over ice into glass. Add a splash of soda water. Garnish with a half orange slice. Served on the rocks, poured over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金巴利和味美思倒在冰上倒入杯中。加少许苏打水。用半片橙子装饰。加冰饮用，倒在冰上调制。

drinks.name: Adios Motherfucker (AMF)
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with ice and pour in vodka, rum, gin, tequila sweet & sour, lemon-lime soda and blue curaçao. Stir to mix. Garnish with a lemon slice and a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 杯中加满冰，倒入伏特加、朗姆酒、金酒、龙舌兰、酸甜调味汁、柠檬青柠汽水和蓝橙力娇酒。搅拌混合。用一片柠檬和一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Amritulya Chai
drinks.name_display: 阿姆里图利亚奶茶（Amritulya Chai）
drinks.instructions_en: Take a utensil and put the Water and Milk inside it. Boil it for 5 minutes Now add the Assam tea Now wait for 3 minutes Now as the color of the milk changes to brown add the elaichi
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个容器，放入水和牛奶。煮沸5分钟。现在加入阿萨姆红茶。等待3分钟。当牛奶颜色变成棕色时，加入小豆蔻。

drinks.name: Angevine Soup
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the lime juice with the Cointreau and the sugar in a very large bowl. Set aside in the fridge. Add the chilled Crémant just before serving!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个非常大的碗中，将青柠汁与君度橙酒和糖混合。放入冰箱中静置。上桌前再加入冰镇的克雷芒起泡酒！

drinks.name: Aperol Spritz
ingredients_en: Sliced orange or lemon for garnish
ingredients_zh: 橙子片或柠檬片用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with ice. Add Prosecco, Aperol and soda. Stir gently to combine and garnish with a slice of orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 杯中加满冰。加入普罗塞克、阿佩罗和苏打水。轻轻搅拌混合，用一片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Apertass
drinks.instructions_en: Cool a tumbler with ice. Drain the water formed with a strainer. Pour a small bottle of Tassoni Soda cedar and add a tip of Aperol, completing with the Soda. Stir gently. Garnish with a slice of orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用冰给平底杯降温。用滤网倒掉融化的水。倒入一小瓶Tassoni雪松味苏打水，加入少许阿佩罗，再用苏打水补满。轻轻搅拌。用一片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Apple Cider Margarita
drinks.name_display: 苹果西打玛格丽特（Apple Cider Margarita）
ingredients_en: Cointreau or other orange flavored liqueur
ingredients_zh: 君度或其他橙味利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Combine sugar, cinnamon, and salt on a small, flat plate. Pour a small amount of maple syrup on another small plate. Dip the rim of the glass in a bit of maple syrup, then coat into the cinnamon sugar mixture. Fill a cocktail shaker halfway with ice. Add all ingredients to cocktail shaker and shake vigorously for about 30 seconds. Strain into glass and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个小浅盘中混合糖、肉桂和盐。在另一个小盘中倒入少量枫糖浆。将杯口蘸上少许枫糖浆，再蘸裹肉桂糖混合物。在摇酒壶中装一半的冰。将所有材料加入摇酒壶中，用力摇约30秒。滤入杯中即可享用！

drinks.name: Apple Cider Mimosa
drinks.name_display: 苹果西打含羞草（Apple Cider Mimosa）
drinks.instructions_en: Rim the glasses: Mix together cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl. Wet the exterior edges of the glasses (ideally champagne flutes) with apple cider. Then tap the wet edges in the cinnamon and sugar mixture. Pour 1 oz brandy and 2 oz apple cider into each glass. Top each glass with 4 oz of chilled champagne. Garnish with apple slices and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 给酒杯挂边：在小碗中混合肉桂和糖。用苹果酒蘸湿酒杯（最好是香槟笛形杯）的外沿。然后将湿润的杯沿蘸上肉桂糖混合物。每个杯中倒入1盎司白兰地和2盎司苹果酒。每个杯子上再倒入4盎司冰镇香槟补满。用苹果片装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Apple Cider Mules
drinks.name_display: 苹果西打骡子（Apple Cider Mules）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill two copper mugs with ice. Pour 2 oz vodka into each cup. Fill 2/3 full with sparkling cider, then top with ginger beer. Garnish with an apple slice and a cinnamon stick. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两只铜杯加满冰。每个杯中倒入2盎司伏特加。倒入起泡苹果酒至三分之二满，然后用姜汁啤酒补满。用一片苹果和一根肉桂棒装饰。上桌。

drinks.name: Apple Jack
drinks.instructions_en: 3/4 fill a highball glass with cubed ice. Pour Old No. 7 over ice. Top with apple juice. Add apple slice to garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中装入四分之三的冰块。将Old No. 7威士忌倒在冰上。用苹果汁补满。放上一片苹果作装饰。

drinks.name: Apple Liqueur
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare the syrup by melting the water and sugar over a low heat in a saucepan. Afterwards, let it cool down. Prepare the apple cores with all their seeds and peel, the pulp should be as little as possible. Combine the apple cores, the completely cooled syrup and the alcohol in an airtight jar. Leave to rest for 30 days in a dry place away from light, shaking the jar twice a week. Filter the liqueur with a cloth or gauze, bottle it and let it rest in a cool, dark place for at least a month before serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在平底锅中用小火将水和糖融化制成糖浆。之后让它冷却。准备带有全部籽和皮的苹果核，果肉应尽可能少。将苹果核、完全冷却的糖浆和酒精放入密封罐中混合。置于避光干燥处静置30天，每周摇晃罐子两次。用布或纱布过滤利口酒，装瓶后在阴凉避光处静置至少一个月再上桌。

drinks.name: Apple Orchard Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Combine apple juice, cranberry juice concentrate and orange juice in a large punch bowl. Stir until dissolved, then slowly pour in the ginger ale. Thinly slice the apple vertically, forming whole apple slices. Float apple slices on top of punch.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大潘趣碗中混合苹果汁、浓缩蔓越莓汁和橙汁。搅拌至溶解，然后慢慢倒入姜汁汽水。将苹果竖直切成薄片，形成完整的苹果片。将苹果片浮在潘趣酒表面。

drinks.name: Apple Pie Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 苹果派鸡尾酒（Apple Pie Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine vodka, whiskey, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker filled whit ice. Shake. Strain mixture into a glass and add cider and bitters; stir. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有冰的摇酒壶中混合伏特加、威士忌和柠檬汁。摇匀。将混合物滤入杯中，加入苹果酒和苦精；搅拌。上桌。

drinks.name: Appletini
drinks.instructions_en: Dip the apple slice in lemon juice to prevent it from turning yellow. Combine all the liquid ingredients in a cocktail mixing cup. Fill it with ice and shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the apple slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苹果片蘸上柠檬汁，防止其变黄。将所有液体材料放入鸡尾酒调酒杯中。加满冰并充分摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用苹果片装饰。

drinks.name: April Rain Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 四月雨鸡尾酒（April Rain Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. Pour the vodka, lime juice, and dry vermouth in a cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a lime peel. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好材料。将伏特加、青柠汁和干味美思倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。用青柠皮装饰。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Aqueduct
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice cubes. Add all ingredients. Shake and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰块。加入所有材料。摇匀后滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Argentinian Mate
drinks.instructions_en: You start by filling the container until it’s just over half full with the yerba. Then place your hand on the top of the half-filled container and turn it upside down and give it a bit of a shake bringing the more powdery leaves to the top. This helps you to not suck up the powdery leaves later on! Then turn the container on its side and give it a few more shakes meaning the yerba is on a pile on one side. Now time for the bombilla! Add a bit of cool water to help preserve some of the mate. Then put the bombilla in the empty space in the container trying hard not to disturb the leaves. Bring the bombilla to the wall of the container as far away as you can from the mixture and add cold water until it reaches the top of the powdery pile (with the top of the pile still dry) and wait for the water to be absorbed. Pour hot water into the empty space just as you did with the cold water. The water should be about 80 degrees. Drink from the bombilla until you drink the entire mate. Don’t just keep sipping. Also, try not to jiggle the straw as you will end up clogging the bombilla. The person that makes the mate drinks first and then they refill it and pass it to the next person keeping the same bombilla. Keep refilling the container until it loses its taste. It should last for about 10 refills. To signal that you don’t want anymore give it back to the ‘el cebador’ (the server) and give them “thanks”. Remember to give “thanks” only after your last mate. Once you have given a “thanks”, you will not be served anymore mate.
drinks.instructions_zh: 首先往容器里装入马黛茶，装到略高于一半。然后用手按住装了一半的容器顶部，将其倒过来轻轻摇晃，让较细的粉末状茶叶浮到上面。这样能避免你之后吸到粉末状的茶叶！接着把容器侧放，再摇晃几下，让马黛茶堆到一侧。现在该放吸管（bombilla）了！先加一点凉水，以保护一部分马黛茶。然后把吸管插入容器中的空位，尽量不要搅动茶叶。将吸管靠向容器内壁，尽可能远离茶料，加入凉水直到液面达到粉末堆的顶部（粉末堆顶部仍保持干燥），等待水被吸收。像加凉水那样往空位中倒入热水。水温应在约80度。用吸管饮用，直到喝完所有的马黛茶。不要只是不停地小口啜饮。还有，尽量不要晃动吸管，否则会把吸管堵住。负责泡茶的人先喝，然后重新续水并传给下一个人，继续使用同一根吸管。不断续水，直到茶失去味道。大约可以续水10次。若表示你不想再喝了，就把容器还给“el cebador”（负责续水的人），并说一声“谢谢”。记住，只在你喝完最后一杯马黛茶后才说“谢谢”。一旦说了“谢谢”，就不会再为你提供马黛茶了。

drinks.name: Astronaut
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice. Pour in gin, soda, and lemon juice. Carefully pour in the grenadine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 杯中加满冰。倒入金酒、苏打水和柠檬汁。小心地倒入红石榴糖浆。

drinks.name: Aviation
ingredients_zh: 15毫升马拉斯奇诺樱桃利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加入装有冰的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀后滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Ayran
drinks.instructions_en: Add yoghurt, cold water, and salt into a blender Add some fresh mint (optional). Blend and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将酸奶、冷水和盐放入搅拌机中。加入一些新鲜薄荷（可选）。搅打后上桌。

drinks.name: B-52
drinks.instructions_en: Layer the three spirits in a shot glass in the following order: Coffee liqueur, Baileys Irish cream liqueur, Grand Marnier liqueur.
drinks.instructions_zh: 按以下顺序在shot杯中依次分层三种酒：咖啡利口酒、百利甜爱尔兰奶油利口酒、柑曼怡橙味利口酒。

drinks.name: Baby Guinness
drinks.instructions_en: Get a shot glass and fill it nearly to the top with a coffee flavored liqueur (ex. Kahlúa). Fill the the rest of the shot glass with an Irish cream liqueur (ex. Baileys).
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个shot杯，用咖啡味利口酒（如甘露）几乎倒满。再用爱尔兰奶油利口酒（如百利甜）填满剩余部分。

drinks.name: Bacardi Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Chill a coupe glass with ice and set aside. Add all the ingredients into a shaker with ice and shake. Strain into the chilled coupe.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用冰给浅碟香槟杯降温，放在一旁。将所有材料加入装有冰的摇酒壶中摇匀。滤入冰镇的浅碟杯中。

drinks.name: Bael Panna (Woodapple Juice)
ingredients_en: 1 tablespoon Roasted and Powdered Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
drinks.instructions_en: Break open the fruit using a pestle or if you are adventurous, strike it against the floor or a platform till it splits open. Scoop the pulp using a spoon and place in a large bowl. Pour a glass of water and using your palms gather and squish the pulp to separate the seeds and juice the pulp. Press the juice through a soup siever to strain the fibres and seeds from the thick pulp. Scoop the remaining pulp in the sieve into a vessel and add more water. Repeat the squishing process and strain until all that remains is the fiber. Add jaggery to the strained juice and season with salt and cumin powders as per taste. Run the juice in a mixer. Pour in tall glasses and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用捣杵把果实敲开，如果你够大胆，也可以把它朝地面或台子上砸，直到裂开。用勺子舀出果肉放入大碗中。倒入一杯水，用手掌把果肉聚拢并揉捏，使籽分离并挤出果肉中的汁液。用筛子将果汁压滤，滤去浓稠果肉中的纤维和籽。把筛中剩余的果肉舀入容器中，再加更多的水。重复揉捏和过滤的过程，直到只剩下纤维为止。在滤出的果汁中加入粗糖，并按口味用盐和孜然粉调味。将果汁放入搅拌机中搅打。倒入高杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Bahama Mama
drinks.instructions_en: Combine regular rum, rum with coconut flavoring, grenadine, orange juice, pineapple juice and crushed ice in an electric blender.  Blend until the drink's consistency is slushy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将普通朗姆酒、椰子味朗姆酒、红石榴糖浆、橙汁、菠萝汁和碎冰放入电动搅拌机中。搅打至饮品呈雪泥状的浓稠度。

drinks.name: Bajigur
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare a pan and then boil coconut milk. Add brown sugar, granulated sugar and black coffee and stir well. Let the sugar and coffee dissolve, wait until it boils. Add cinnamon, salt and bay leaf, then stir again until it smells, bringing fragrance from wedang bajigur. Boil again until boiling then strain and serve while still hot. Wedang Bajigur is ready to be enjoyed and warms the body.
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备一口锅，将椰奶煮沸。加入红糖、白砂糖和黑咖啡，充分搅拌。让糖和咖啡溶解，等待再次沸腾。加入肉桂、盐和香叶，再次搅拌，直到香气散发出来，带出wedang bajigur的芬芳。再次煮沸后过滤，趁热上桌。Wedang Bajigur就可以享用了，暖心暖身。

drinks.name: Banana with cocoa powder
drinks.name_display: 可可粉香蕉（Banana with cocoa powder）
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the banana into slices Put the bananas, the milk, the Cocoa Powder in the blender, turn it on, and blend these ingredients. Put ice in the blender and beat very little
drinks.instructions_zh: 将香蕉切片。把香蕉、牛奶、可可粉放入搅拌机中，开机搅打这些材料。向搅拌机中放入冰，稍微搅打一下。

drinks.name: Banana Smoothie
drinks.instructions_en: Combine banana, milk, vanilla, egg, and sugar in a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into a tall glass and top with a pinch of cinnamon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将香蕉、牛奶、香草、鸡蛋和糖放入搅拌机中混合。搅打至顺滑。倒入高杯中，在顶部撒一小撮肉桂。

drinks.name: Bandrek
ingredients_en: 80 grams grilled ginger are then crushed
1 sheet pandan leaves (before use, clean first)
drinks.instructions_en: Boil sugar and water in a saucepan until it boils. Add pandan leaves, grilled ginger, and lemongrass stems. Then stir to taste. Add salt and stir again. If the resulting flavor is just right and the ingredients and seasonings have been mixed evenly, turn off the heat and lift this bandrek drink. Pour the bandrek drink to the glass. Add a few mililiters vanilla sweetened condensed milk if needed. Bandrek ready to serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在平底锅中将糖和水煮沸。加入香兰叶、烤姜和香茅茎。然后按口味搅拌。加入盐再搅拌。如果味道正合适，且材料和调料混合均匀，就关火，把这锅bandrek端起。将bandrek倒入杯中。如需要可加入几毫升香草甜炼乳。Bandrek即可上桌。

drinks.name: Bandung, Rose Syrup Beverage
drinks.name_display: 万隆玫瑰糖浆饮品（Bandung, Rose Syrup Beverage）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine condensed milk and roohafza in a bowl. Add water and mix well until condensed milk dissolves in the water. A combination of soda and milk can also be used. Chill and serve. OR pour in serving glasses, add some ice and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在碗中混合炼乳和roohafza糖浆。加水充分搅拌，直到炼乳溶于水中。也可以使用苏打水和牛奶的组合。冷藏后上桌。或者倒入饮用的杯中，加一些冰后上桌。

drinks.name: Bangkok Sunrise
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. Pour the tequila, Orange juice, and lemongrass syrup in a cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Top with grenadine Shake well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好材料。将龙舌兰、橙汁和香茅糖浆倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。加入红石榴糖浆。充分摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Barley Drink
ingredients_en: 6 stalks of pandan leaves - tied into a knot
drinks.instructions_en: Wash and drain the pearl barley until the water is much clearer. Place water, barley, candied wintermelon and pandan leaves into a soup pot and bring to a boil. Once the mix is boiling, lower the heat and let it simmer for about 30 minutes until the barley expands and softens. Top up with more water if necessary. Add in rock sugar 5-10 minutes before turning off the heat. Stir until the rock sugar is fully dissolved. Discard the pandan leaves. Serve hot. Or leave it to cool and chuck it into the fridge and enjoy it chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薏米洗净沥干，直到水变得清澈许多。将水、薏米、糖冬瓜和香兰叶放入汤锅中煮沸。煮沸后调低火力，小火慢煮约30分钟，直到薏米膨胀变软。如有需要可再加些水。关火前5-10分钟加入冰糖。搅拌至冰糖完全溶解。弃去香兰叶。趁热上桌。或者放凉后放进冰箱，冰镇享用。

drinks.name: Barnamint Bailey's
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all ingredients in a blender. Garnish with one Oreo cookie.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中搅打。用一块奥利奥饼干装饰。

drinks.name: Barracuda
drinks.instructions_en: Shake first 4 ingredients with ice. Fine strain into a cocktail glass. Top with Prosecco
drinks.instructions_zh: 将前4种材料加冰摇匀。细滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用普罗塞克补满。

drinks.name: Barraquito
drinks.instructions_en: Add the condensed milk to the coffee, followed by the licor. Add the espresso and optional lemon peel. Add the frothed milk and sprinkle some cinammon for some extra flavor.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将炼乳加入咖啡中，再倒入licor（茴香酒）。加入浓缩咖啡和可选的柠檬皮。加入奶泡，再撒一些肉桂增添风味。

drinks.name: Basil Kadha
drinks.instructions_en: Wash the Basil, Lemongrass and Ginger. Boil water in deep pan. Add Basil, Lemongrass and Ginger and boil for 3-4 minutes If the Panna is not very tangy, you can add some lemon juice to it. Add jaggery and mix well then turn off the gas Strain and serve hot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 洗净罗勒、香茅和姜。在深锅中烧开水。加入罗勒、香茅和姜，煮3-4分钟。如果Panna酸味不足，可以加一些柠檬汁。加入粗糖并搅拌均匀，然后关火。过滤后趁热上桌。

drinks.name: Basil Smash Pina Colada
drinks.name_display: 罗勒碎冰椰林飘香（Basil Smash Pina Colada）
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the lime juice, basil (or mint) together in a cocktail shaker or glass jar, squashing everything to release the juices. Add the white rum and dark rum. Fill with ice and shake until combined. Strain into a blender. Add the pineapple chunks and coconut cream to the blender and blend until smooth. Add three cups ice and blend until frozen. Pour into glasses and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶或玻璃罐中把青柠汁、罗勒（或薄荷）一起捣压，把所有材料压碎以释放汁液。加入白朗姆酒和黑朗姆酒。加满冰，摇匀至混合。滤入搅拌机中。向搅拌机中加入菠萝块和椰浆，搅打至顺滑。加入三杯冰，搅打至冰冻状。倒入杯中享用！

drinks.name: Basil Smash
drinks.instructions_en: Put basil, lemon juice, sugar syrup into a cocktail shaker and top up with ice. Do the strong man shake and strain it into an ice-filled glass. Garnish with basil leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将罗勒、柠檬汁、糖浆放入摇酒壶中，再加满冰。使出大力士般的力气摇匀，滤入加了冰的杯中。用罗勒叶装饰。

drinks.name: Batanga
drinks.instructions_en: Rim a highball glass with salt and fill with ice. Add lime juice and tequila. Top with cola and stir gently. Garnish with a lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用盐给高球杯挂边，然后加满冰。加入青柠汁和龙舌兰。用可乐补满并轻轻搅拌。用一块青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Bay Breeze
drinks.instructions_en: Combine cranberry juice, pineapple juice, and vodka in highball glass filled with ice. Stir and garnish with pineapple and lime wedges if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有冰的高球杯中混合蔓越莓汁、菠萝汁和伏特加。搅拌，如喜欢可用菠萝角和青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Beam me up, Scotchie
drinks.name_display: 传送我吧史考奇（Beam me up, Scotchie）
ingredients_zh: 2盎司格兰菲迪苏格兰威士忌
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle ingredients Strain out fig seeds Serve in a cocktail glass over ice Garnish with figs
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料捣压。滤出无花果籽。在鸡尾酒杯中加冰盛放。用无花果装饰。

drinks.name: Beer Pletok
drinks.instructions_en: Burn the ginger then peel and crush, set aside. Boil ginger, lemongrass, secang wood, cinnamon, salt, and sugar until boiling. Reduce the heat and continue until the boiled water is thick. Lift and strain. Chill the pletok beer. Blend with ice. Serve immediately while still cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将姜烧一下，然后去皮拍碎，放在一旁。将姜、香茅、secang木、肉桂、盐和糖一起煮至沸腾。调低火力继续煮，直到煮出的水变浓稠。捞出并过滤。将pletok啤酒放凉。与冰一起搅打。趁冷立即上桌。

drinks.name: Beergarita
ingredients_zh: 1盎司塔特索尔西柚奶油利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a glass over ice. Garnish with a lime wedge. Salt rim optional. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加冰，将所有材料混合在冰上。用一块青柠角装饰。杯口可选用盐挂边。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Bee's Kiss
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a shaker and shake with ice until chilled. Fine strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with grated nutmeg.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料放入摇酒壶中，加冰摇至冰凉。细滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用磨碎的肉豆蔻装饰。

drinks.name: Bee's Knees
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a shaker. Shake with ice until chilled. Fine strain into a cocktail class.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料放入摇酒壶中。加冰摇至冰凉。细滤入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Bellini
drinks.instructions_en: Pour peach juice into a champagne flute. Slowly pour sparkling wine over peach juice; let sit until liquids have blended for one minute. Pour raspberry juice over champagne mixture.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将桃子汁倒入香槟笛形杯中。慢慢将起泡酒倒在桃子汁上；静置一分钟，让液体融合。将覆盆子汁倒在香槟混合物上。

drinks.name: Bentley
ingredients_en: 2 dashes Peychaud's Bitters, optional (or bitter orange)
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients in a shaker, add ice and shake. Strain into an old fashioned glass. Decorate with orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料倒入摇酒壶中，加冰摇匀。滤入古典杯中。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Beras Kencur
drinks.instructions_en: Wash the rice in the water before use. Soak the rice with water for around three hours. Peal, wash and chop galangal and tumeric. Blend the tumeric, galangal, and rice with blender and wait until all the ingredients are smooth. Boil the water and pour all the ingredients into the water. Stir constantly for a few minutes. Store in  refrigerator. Serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 使用前将米用水洗净。将米用水浸泡约三小时。给高良姜和姜黄去皮、洗净并切碎。将姜黄、高良姜和米放入搅拌机中搅打，直到所有材料变得顺滑。烧开水，将所有材料倒入水中。不断搅拌几分钟。放入冰箱保存。冷饮上桌。

drinks.name: Berry and Oat Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 莓果燕麦冰沙（Berry and Oat Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Put the oats into the blender and pour in the milk. Leave to sit for five minutes. Add the honey, blueberries, blackberries and ground flaxseeds and blitz until smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将燕麦放入搅拌机中，倒入牛奶。静置五分钟。加入蜂蜜、蓝莓、黑莓和亚麻籽粉，搅打至顺滑。

drinks.name: Berry Shrub
drinks.instructions_en: Add the berries, thyme and sugar to a large bowl and refrigerate overnight. Stir in the vinegar and let sit for 3 hours, mixing or shaking occasionally, then stir until sugar is dissolved. Strain out solids and store in the refrigerator.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将浆果、百里香和糖放入大碗中，冷藏过夜。拌入醋，静置3小时，期间偶尔搅拌或摇晃，然后搅拌至糖溶解。滤去固体，放入冰箱保存。

drinks.name: Berrylicious Frozen Sangria Slush
drinks.name_zh: 美味莓果冰镇桑格利亚
drinks.name_display: 美味莓果冰镇桑格利亚（Berrylicious Frozen Sangria Slush）
ingredients_en: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or more to taste
drinks.instructions_en: Combine red wine, ice cubes, blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, orange-flavored liqueur, orange juice, and sugar in a blender. process until smooth. Serve immediately or freeze.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将红葡萄酒、冰块、蓝莓、覆盆子、草莓、橙味利口酒、橙汁和糖放入搅拌机中混合。搅打至顺滑。立即上桌或冷冻保存。

drinks.name: Beton
drinks.instructions_en: Put ice into highball glass. Add Becherovka and tonic water. Garnish with a lemon wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中放入冰。加入贝赫洛夫卡苦酒和汤力水。用一块柠檬角装饰。

drinks.name: Between the Sheets
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain and pour into a martini glass. Garnish with the lemon twists.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。过滤后倒入马天尼杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Bijou
drinks.instructions_en: Combine in a mixing glass and fill with cracked ice Stir for 20 seconds Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a twist of lemon peel over the drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在调酒杯中混合，加满碎冰，搅拌20秒，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。在酒液上方用一片柠檬皮扭条装饰。

drinks.name: Bikini Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Combine rum, vodka and pineapple juice in a drink shaker. Shake firmly until frothy. Pour in a martini glass. Add a touch of grenadine in the middle. Garnish with an orange wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、伏特加和菠萝汁倒入摇酒壶中混合。用力摇匀至起泡。倒入马天尼杯中。在中间滴入少许红石榴糖浆。用一片橙子圆片装饰。

drinks.name: Birthday Cake Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add vanilla vodka and amaretto. Shake and strain into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰。加入香草伏特加和杏仁利口酒。摇匀后滤入子弹杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Bitter but Good eh!
drinks.name_display: 苦却美味（Bitter but Good eh!）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the spirits into a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled. Strain into a rocks glass filled halfway with ice. Fill rest of Rocks Glass with White Beer. Garnish with an orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各种烈酒加冰倒入调酒杯中混合。搅拌至冰镇。滤入半满冰块的古典杯中。用白啤酒将古典杯剩余部分补满。用一片橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Black Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a shaker and shake with ice until chilled. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入摇酒壶中，加冰摇匀至冰镇。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用一片柠檬皮扭条装饰。

drinks.name: Black Russian
ingredients_en: 1 part coffee liqueur, such as Kahlua
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a rocks glass with ice. Add one part Kahlua, two parts of vodka. Mix, add a cherry on top and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中加满冰。加入1份甘露咖啡利口酒和2份伏特加。搅拌均匀，顶部放一颗樱桃即可享用。

drinks.name: Black Velvet
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a tall champagne flute, halfway with chilled sparkling wine (champagne). Fill the other half with chilled stout beer on top of the wine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在细长香槟杯中倒入冰镇起泡酒（香槟）至半满。再在酒液上方倒入冰镇世涛啤酒至另一半满。

drinks.name: Black Widow
ingredients_en: 2 ounces black vodka or frozen raspberries
ingredients_zh: 2盎司黑伏特加或冷冻覆盆子
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the cranberry juice into a glass filled with ice. The taller the glass, the nicer will be the effect of the two liquids mixing together. Float the vodka on top by pouring it over the back of a bar spoon to disrupt the flow. Or you can slowly drizzle the vodka onto the cranberry juice for a swirling effect. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将蔓越莓汁倒入装有冰块的杯中。杯子越高，两种液体混合的效果越好看。将伏特加沿吧勺背面缓缓倒入以缓冲流速，使其浮在表面。或者，你也可以将伏特加慢慢淋在蔓越莓汁上，形成漩涡效果。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Blackberry Thyme Margarita
drinks.name_display: 黑莓百里香玛格丽特（Blackberry Thyme Margarita）
drinks.instructions_en: Run a lime wedge around the rim of glass and coat in flaky salt. Add blackberries, plums, thyme, lime juice, honey (if using), and orange zest in a cocktail shaker or glass jar. Muddle all of the ingredients together, squashing everything to release the juices from the fruit. Add the tequila. Fill with ice and shake until combined. Strain into your prepared glass. Top with sparkling water, if desired. Serve with fresh thyme. Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 用一块青柠角擦抹杯口，再蘸上一层片状盐。将黑莓、李子、百里香、青柠汁、蜂蜜（如使用）和橙皮放入摇酒壶或玻璃罐中。将所有材料一起捣压，充分压碎以释放水果的汁液。加入龙舌兰酒。加满冰并摇匀至混合。滤入备好的杯中。如喜欢，可用气泡水补满。配新鲜百里香上桌。干杯！

drinks.name: Blackthorn Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice, then strain into a glass filled with fresh ice, and garnish. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰搅拌，然后滤入装有新冰块的杯中，再加以装饰。享用！

drinks.name: Blood and Sand
ingredients_en: 3/4 fl oz Fresh blood orange juice
drinks.instructions_en: Add orange juice, cherry liqueur, vermouth, and scotch to a mixing tin. Add ice to mixing tin. Shake well. Double-strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange swath.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙汁、樱桃利口酒、味美思和苏格兰威士忌倒入摇酒壶中。向摇酒壶中加冰。充分摇匀。双重过滤后滤入冰镇的碟形香槟杯中。用一大片橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Blood Orange Champagne Mule
drinks.name_display: 血橙香槟骡子（Blood Orange Champagne Mule）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the blood orange juice, lime juice and vodka in a glass. Add the ginger beer and top with the champagne. Garnish with blood orange slices and fresh mint. Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将血橙汁、青柠汁和伏特加在杯中混合。加入姜汁啤酒，再用香槟补满。用血橙片和新鲜薄荷装饰。干杯！

drinks.name: Bloody Eyeball Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Create bloody eyeball garnish by placing a small amount of red jam into a lychee before adding a blueberry inside also. Add ice, coconut rum, peach schnapps and vodka to a shaking glass and combine until cold. Strain mix into shot glass and add a splash of red food coloring. Garnish with eyeball.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作血腥眼球装饰：先在荔枝中放入少量红色果酱，再塞入一颗蓝莓。在摇酒壶中加入冰块、椰子朗姆酒、桃子利口酒和伏特加，混合至冰凉。将混合液滤入子弹杯中，滴入少许红色食用色素。用眼球装饰。

drinks.name: Bloody Geisha
drinks.instructions_en: Pour some celery salt onto a small plate. Rub the juicy side of the lemon or lime wedge along the lip of a pint glass. Roll the outer edge of the glass in celery salt until fully coated. Fill with ice and set aside. Squeeze the lemon and lime wedges into a shaker and drop them in. Add the remaining ingredients and ice and shake gently. Strain into the prepared glass. Garnish with a parsley sprig, 2 speared green olives, and a lime wedge and a celery stalk (optional).
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个小碟上倒一些芹菜盐。用柠檬或青柠角的汁液一侧擦抹品脱杯的杯口。将杯子的外沿在芹菜盐中滚动，使其完全裹上。加满冰并放在一旁备用。将柠檬角和青柠角挤汁入摇酒壶并一起放入。加入其余材料和冰块，轻轻摇匀。滤入备好的杯中。用一小枝欧芹、2颗用签子串起的绿橄榄、一块青柠角和一根芹菜秆（可选）装饰。

drinks.name: Bloody Kirby
ingredients_en: 1 1⁄2 oz Grey Goose Le Citron vodka
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the vodka, cucumber, Tabasco, and vermouth in a shaker. Strain into a rocks glass filled with ice. Top with the tomato juice and garnish with a Kirby cucumber spear.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中捣压伏特加、黄瓜、塔巴斯科辣椒酱和味美思。滤入装有冰块的古典杯中。用番茄汁补满，再用一根柯比黄瓜条装饰。

drinks.name: Bloody Mary
drinks.instructions_en: Pour some celery salt onto a small plate. Rub the juicy side of the lemon or lime wedge along the lip of a pint glass. Roll the outer edge of the glass in celery salt until fully coated. Fill with ice and set aside. Squeeze the lemon and lime wedges into a shaker and drop them in. Add the remaining ingredients and ice and shake gently. Strain into the prepared glass. Garnish with a parsley sprig, 2 speared green olives, and a lime wedge and a celery stalk (optional).
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个小碟上倒一些芹菜盐。用柠檬或青柠角的汁液一侧擦抹品脱杯的杯口。将杯子的外沿在芹菜盐中滚动，使其完全裹上。加满冰并放在一旁备用。将柠檬角和青柠角挤汁入摇酒壶并一起放入。加入其余材料和冰块，轻轻摇匀。滤入备好的杯中。用一小枝欧芹、2颗用签子串起的绿橄榄、一块青柠角和一根芹菜秆（可选）装饰。

drinks.name: Blow Job Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Slowly pour the amaretto in a shot glass. Add Irish cream. Top it with the whipped cream without mixing.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将杏仁利口酒缓慢倒入子弹杯中。加入爱尔兰甜酒。顶部挤上打发的奶油，不要搅拌。

drinks.name: Blue Hawaiian Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 蓝色夏威夷鸡尾酒（Blue Hawaiian Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine rum, blue Curacao, pineapple juice, cream of coconut, and 1 cup crushed ice in blender. Blend on high until smooth. Pour into chilled highball glass. Garnish with a slice of pineapple and a maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、蓝色橙皮酒、菠萝汁、椰浆和1杯碎冰放入搅拌机中。高速搅打至顺滑。倒入冰镇的高球杯中。用一片菠萝和一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Blue Kamikaze Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add vodka, blue curaçao, and lime juice. Shake and strain into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰。加入伏特加、蓝橙皮酒和青柠汁。摇匀后滤入子弹杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Blue Lady
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients in a cocktail shaker. Add ice. Shake vigorously. Strain into chilled cocktail glasses.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入摇酒壶中。加冰。用力摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Blue Lagoon
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze the juice of half a lemon, add it to the shaker with the other ingredients and ice cubes. Strike and pour into the glass while filtering. To make it fresher and lighter, fill the glass with crushed ice beforehand.  Serve in a martini glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 挤出半个柠檬的汁，与其他材料和冰块一起加入摇酒壶中。摇匀并过滤后倒入杯中。想要更清爽轻盈，可事先在杯中装满碎冰。用马天尼杯上桌。

drinks.name: Blue Monday
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a shaker and shake with ice until chilled. Fine strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a flamed orange zest.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入摇酒壶中，加冰摇匀至冰镇。细滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用火烤过的橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Blue Oasis
drinks.instructions_en: Take a cocktail shaker and fill it half with crushed ice. Add gin along with blue curacao and soda, and shake well until frosted. Take a chilled cocktail glass and strain the liquid mixture into it. Serve in a martini glass. Garnish with a lemon wedge or slice, and serve immediately. (Note: You can even put salt on the rim of the glass for an exciting flavour.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个摇酒壶，装入一半碎冰。加入金酒、蓝橙皮酒和苏打水，充分摇匀至壶身起霜。取一个冰镇的鸡尾酒杯，将混合液滤入其中。用马天尼杯上桌。用一块柠檬角或一片柠檬装饰，立即上桌。（注：你甚至可以在杯口蘸盐，带来刺激的风味。

drinks.name: Blue Vodka Lemonade
drinks.name_display: 蓝伏特加柠檬水（Blue Vodka Lemonade）
ingredients_en: 3 oz Blue liquor, (UV Blue Vodka or Blue Curaçao)
ingredients_zh: 3盎司蓝色利口酒（UV Blue Vodka or Blue Curaçao）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together lemonade and blue liquor Add a drop or 2 of blue food coloring for deeper blue color Serve over ice. Garnish with lemon
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬水和蓝色利口酒混合。加入1-2滴蓝色食用色素，使颜色更深蓝。加冰上桌。用柠檬装饰。

drinks.name: Blueberry Banana Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 蓝莓香蕉冰沙（Blueberry Banana Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Optionally, add a tablespoon of flax seed oil, if desired. Pour into a glass and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中混合。如喜欢，可加1汤匙亚麻籽油。倒入杯中即可享用！

drinks.name: Boba Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the water and tea bags in a medium pot over high heat. Bring to a boil, then remove the pan from the heat and let the tea cool to room temperature. Bring a medium pot of water to boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, add the tapioca pearls and boil until softened, about 20 minutes. Drain the pearls through a strainer. Set the strainer with the pearls over a medium bowl. Add the brown sugar to the strainer and pour the hot water over. Stir to dissolve the brown sugar. Soak the pearls in brown sugar syrup for 30 minutes, then store the bubbles and syrup separately until ready to serve. Assemble the tea: Put the pearls and ice, then add the brown sugar syrup, tea Stir with a wide-opening straw, then serve. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在中号锅中加入水和茶包，用大火煮。煮沸后离火，让茶冷却至室温。另取一锅中号水用大火煮沸。水开后加入木薯珍珠，煮至变软，约20分钟。用滤网将珍珠沥干。将沥干的珍珠连同滤网架在中号碗上。将红糖加入滤网中，倒入热水。搅拌使红糖溶解。让珍珠在红糖糖浆中浸泡30分钟，然后将珍珠和糖浆分开存放至准备上桌。组合奶茶：放入珍珠和冰块，再加入红糖糖浆、茶，用粗吸管搅拌，然后上桌。享用！

drinks.name: Bobby Burns
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a shaker and shake with ice until chilled. Fine strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入摇酒壶中，加冰摇匀至冰镇。细滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用一片柠檬皮扭条装饰。

drinks.name: Bombeirinho
drinks.instructions_en: Put the ice in the cup. Add the cachaça first and then add the Red Gooseberry Liquor. Squeeze the lemon. Mix all the ingredients until they form one red color drink. Serve in a rounded cup of glass. (Optional) Add some lemon peel at the top of the drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中放入冰块。先加入卡莎萨，再加入红醋栗利口酒。挤入柠檬汁。将所有材料混合，直至成为红色的饮品。用圆形的玻璃杯上桌。（可选）在酒液上方放一些柠檬皮。

drinks.name: Boomerang
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a shaker and shake with ice until chilled. Fine strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a Maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入摇酒壶中，加冰摇匀至冰镇。细滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Boulevardier
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the spirits into a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled. Strain into a coup glass without ice. Garnish with an orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各种烈酒加冰倒入调酒杯中混合。搅拌至冰镇。滤入不加冰的碟形香槟杯中。用一片橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Bourbon Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients in a glass over ice. Garnish with lemon slice and maraschino cherry, if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加冰，将所有材料混合。如喜欢，可用柠檬片和马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Bourbon Mule
ingredients_en: 1/2 cup light ginger beer, such as Fever-Tree Naturally Light
ingredients_zh: 1/2杯淡味姜汁啤酒，如富树自然淡味
drinks.instructions_en: Combine bourbon and lime juice in a copper mug or highball glass. Fill cup with ice. Add ginger beer; stir gently to combine. Garnish with mint sprig and lime slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在铜杯或高球杯中加入波本威士忌和青柠汁。将杯中加满冰。加入姜汁啤酒，轻轻搅拌使其混合。用一小枝薄荷和一片青柠装饰。

drinks.name: Bourbon Old Fashioned
drinks.name_display: 波本古典鸡尾酒（Bourbon Old Fashioned）
drinks.instructions_en: Add the sugar, bitters and water into a rocks glass, and stir until sugar is nearly dissolved. Fill the glass with large ice cubes, add the bourbon, and gently stir to combine the flavors. Express the oil of an orange peel over the glass, then drop in.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖、苦精和水放入古典杯中，搅拌至糖几乎溶解。用大冰块将杯子装满，加入波本威士忌，轻轻搅拌使风味融合。在杯口上方挤压橙皮以喷出橙油，然后将橙皮投入杯中。

drinks.name: Boza
drinks.instructions_en: Transfer the coarse bulgur and rice you washed in plenty of water into a deep saucepan. Add the water and boil over medium heat until it becomes soft. After straining  the water of the mashed bulgur rice mixture, pass it through a fine-hole strainer. You can discard the pulp part. Leave the bulghur porridge that you filtered at the room temperature to cool completely. For the yeast mixture that will make boza sour; Mix warm milk, fresh yeast and powdered sugar in a separate bowl. Transfer the porridge mixture cooled at room temperature into a large pot. After mixing it with the yeast mixture you have prepared, keep it in the pot you have closed its lid in, in a sunless environment for 24 hours. Open the lid of the boza mixture that you have kept for fermentation from time to time and let it vent. After the boza wait enough, add the powdered sugar and then the water little by little to the boza and adjust its consistency. You can serve the boza cold for better taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将用大量清水洗净的粗粒小麦和米放入深锅中。加水，用中火煮至变软。将煮烂的小麦米混合物沥去水分后，用细孔滤网过滤。滤出的渣滓部分可以丢弃。将过滤得到的布尔格粥静置在室温下，使其完全冷却。制作让博扎变酸的酵母混合液：在另一个碗中将温牛奶、新鲜酵母和糖粉混合。将冷却至室温的粥状混合物倒入大锅中。与备好的酵母混合液混合后，盖上锅盖，置于无阳光处静置24小时。不时打开发酵中的博扎混合液的锅盖，让其排气。博扎充分发酵后，加入糖粉，再一点一点地加水，调整其浓稠度。博扎冷藏后上桌味道更佳。

drinks.name: Brain Damage
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the schnapps and Irish cream together in a shot glass - *do not stir* Gently tilt the glass to help the mixture curdle to the desired level. Add the dash of grenadine to the mix, swilling the glass more if desired for consistency.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在子弹杯中将桃味烈酒和爱尔兰甜酒混合——不要搅拌。轻轻倾斜杯子，帮助混合物凝结到理想程度。向混合液中滴入少许红石榴糖浆，如想要更浓稠可再晃动一下杯子。

drinks.name: Bramble
ingredients_en: Garnish – slice of lemon and a blackberry
ingredients_zh: 装饰用柠檬片和一颗黑莓
drinks.instructions_en: Shake the gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup in a cocktail shaker with a good handful of ice cubes. Then strain into a rocks glass full of crushed ice. Drizzle the crème de mure over the top so it ‘bleeds’ into the drink. Garnish with the lemon slice and blackberry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、柠檬汁和糖浆与一大把冰块一起放入摇酒壶中摇匀。然后滤入装满碎冰的古典杯中。将黑莓利口酒淋在表面，使其“渗入”酒中。用一片柠檬和黑莓装饰。

drinks.name: Brandy Alexander
drinks.instructions_en: Pour brandy, crème de cacao and cream into a cocktail shaker. Shake well and strain into a cup. Grate a little nutmeg on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将白兰地、可可利口酒和奶油倒入摇酒壶中。充分摇匀后滤入杯中。在表面磨入少许肉豆蔻。

drinks.name: Brandy Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Stir ingredients with ice. Strain into a highball glass with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰搅拌。滤入装有冰块的高球杯中。

drinks.name: Brandy Wine Punch
drinks.name_display: 白兰地葡萄酒宾治（Brandy Wine Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Slice the oranges and lemons. Cut the melons into 1/2 in chunks. Pour the brandy, wine and soda into a large punch bowl. Add the cut fruit and the sugar to the bowl. Stir the punch, pour into a glass and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙子和柠檬切片。将甜瓜切成1/2英寸的块。将白兰地、葡萄酒和苏打水倒入大潘趣盆中。将切好的水果和糖加入盆中。搅拌潘趣酒，倒入杯中享用！

drinks.name: Brass Monkey
drinks.instructions_en: Shake with ice. Strain into a highball glass with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀。滤入装有冰块的高球杯中。

drinks.name: Brazilian Coconut Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 巴西椰子鸡尾酒（Brazilian Coconut Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a pitcher with ice and set it aside. Put all ingredients in the blender and blend until creamy and frothy. Pour the drink in the pitcher and serve! If you want, you can sprinkle shredded coconut on top of it. Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在壶中加满冰并放在一旁备用。将所有材料放入搅拌机中，搅打至呈奶油状并起泡。将饮品倒入壶中即可上桌！如喜欢，可以在表面撒些椰丝。干杯！

drinks.name: Brazilian Limeade
drinks.instructions_en: Wash the limes thoroughly and cut them into quarters, removing any seeds. In a blender, combine the quartered limes, sweetened condensed milk, water, and sugar. Blend until the limes are completely pulverized and the mixture is smooth. Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any remaining pulp or seeds. Serve over ice and enjoy immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠彻底洗净，切成四瓣，去除籽。在搅拌机中放入切好的青柠、加糖炼乳、水和糖。搅打至青柠完全打碎、混合物顺滑。用细网筛过滤混合物，去除残留的果肉或籽。加冰上桌，立即享用。

drinks.name: Brazilian Strawberry Drink
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the starwberrys into small pieces. Mix the liquid ingredients in a blends. Add the strawberrys and the sugar and mix then with help of a spoon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将草莓切成小块。在搅拌机中混合各种液体材料。加入草莓和糖，然后用勺子搅拌。

drinks.name: Breakfast Club Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 早餐俱乐部鸡尾酒（Breakfast Club Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour cereal milk, demerara syrup and bourbon shaker. Shake over ice. Strain into glass and garnish with cereal pieces (suggestion: Lucky Charms Marshmallows)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将麦片牛奶、德梅拉拉糖浆和波本威士忌倒入摇酒壶中。加冰摇匀。滤入杯中，用麦片碎块装饰（建议：Lucky Charms 棉花糖）。

drinks.name: Breakfast Mai Tai
ingredients_en: 1 1/2 ounces overproof Jamaican rum (preferably Smith & Cross)
1/2 ounce banana liqueur (preferably Giffard Banane du Bresil)
ingredients_zh: 高度牙买加朗姆酒（preferably Smith & Cross）
1/2盎司香蕉利口酒（preferably Giffard Banane du Bresil）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the overproof rum, banana liqueur, orgeat, cinnamon syrup, and lime juice in a cocktail shaker. Add a few pellets of crushed or cracked ice and shake until they melt. Pour into a large rocks glass, add the black rum, and top with more crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig, a charred cinnamon stick, and edible flowers.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将高度朗姆酒、香蕉利口酒、杏仁糖浆、肉桂糖浆和青柠汁放入摇酒壶中混合。加入几块碎冰或裂冰，摇至冰块融化。倒入大的古典杯中，加入黑朗姆酒，再用更多碎冰补满。用一小枝薄荷、一根烤过的肉桂棒和可食用花朵装饰。

drinks.name: Breakfast Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Stir with ice. Strain into a martini glass. Garnish with a slice of a toast.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰搅拌。滤入马天尼杯中。用一片吐司装饰。

drinks.name: Bruce Wayne Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 布鲁斯韦恩鸡尾酒（Bruce Wayne Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare coffee with cold brew method of choice. Add Coffee, Bourbon and Maple Syrup into a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake until chilled and foamy and strain into your cocktail glass with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用你喜欢的方式以冷萃法制作咖啡。将咖啡、波本威士忌和枫糖浆加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。摇至冰凉并起泡，滤入装有冰块的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Brunswick Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients but wine and shake w/ ice. Strain into rocks glass over ice. Float wine over mixture.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除葡萄酒以外的所有材料混合，加冰摇匀。滤在古典杯中的冰上。将葡萄酒浮在混合液表面。

drinks.name: Buffalo Sweat
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice and ingredients to a shaker. Shake until it's completely cold. Serve in a whiskey glass or large shooter.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块和所有材料加入摇酒壶中。摇至完全冰凉。用威士忌杯或大子弹杯上桌。

drinks.name: Bullfisher
drinks.instructions_en: Shake apple juice and coconut rum with ice in a cocktail shaker. Strain into a highball glass full of ice and fill with ginger ale. Stir gently and garnish with apple slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中将苹果汁和椰子朗姆酒加冰摇匀。滤入装满冰块的高球杯中，用姜汁汽水补满。轻轻搅拌，用苹果片装饰。

drinks.name: Burnt Caramel Manhattan
drinks.instructions_en: Chill a cocktail glass with ice and water. Fill a shaker with ice and then add all liquid ingredients. Shake for about 30 seconds. Shaking creates ice flakes which are fun. Taste and then strain into the chilled cocktail glass, serving straight up. Note: You can vary this by increasing buttershot schnapps and vermouth to .5 oz.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用冰和水将鸡尾酒杯冰镇。在摇酒壶中加满冰，然后加入所有液体材料。摇约30秒。摇动会产生有趣的冰屑。尝味后滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中，纯饮上桌。注意：你可以将黄油糖味烈酒和味美思各增至0.5盎司来变换风味。

drinks.name: Butter Coffee
ingredients_en: 1–2 tablespoons of coconut or MCT oil
1–2 tablespoons of unsalted butter or ghee
ingredients_zh: 1至2汤匙椰子油或中链甘油三酯油
drinks.instructions_en: Freshly brew the coffee and add to blender. Add the coconut oil and butter. Blend for 20–30 seconds until it resembles a foamy latte. Optionally sprinkle some cinnamon on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 现煮咖啡并倒入搅拌机中。加入椰子油和黄油。搅打20-30秒，直至呈现出带泡沫的拿铁状。可选的，在表面撒些肉桂粉。

drinks.name: Buttermilk
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients except coriander leaves in a jar and mix it until all ingredients mixed properly. Pour in glasses. Garnish with coriander leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除香菜叶以外的所有材料放入罐中，搅拌至所有材料充分混合。倒入杯中。用香菜叶装饰。

drinks.name: Buttery Nipple
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the butterscotch schnapps into a shot glass. Slowly float the Irish cream on top by pouring over the back of a spoon. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黄油糖味烈酒倒入子弹杯中。将爱尔兰甜酒沿勺背缓缓倒入，使其浮在表面。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Cable Car
ingredients_en: 1/3 shot Sugar Syrup(2 sugar to 1 water rich syrup)
ingredients_zh: 1/3份糖浆（2 sugar to 1 water rich syrup）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all the ingredients with ice. Fine strain back into shaker. Fine Starin (ie without ice). Fine strain into chilled glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰摇匀。细滤回摇酒壶中。再次细滤（即滤去冰块）。细滤入冰镇的杯中。

drinks.name: Café Con Leche - Cuban Style
drinks.name_display: 古巴式牛奶咖啡（Café Con Leche - Cuban Style）
ingredients_en: 1-2 ounces espresso coffee - the Café Bustelo brand is common in Miami
1-3 teaspoons sugar, optional and to taste
ingredients_zh: 1至2盎司浓缩咖啡卡费布斯泰罗牌在迈阿密常见
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare espresso shot; Cubans commonly use a Moka stovetop pot. Add your sugar to bottom of drink cup. Heat milk, either by slowly warming on the stove, microwaving, or steaming. Pour piping hot espresso over sugar and stir until dissolved. Then pour hot milk into the cup and combine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作一杯浓缩咖啡，古巴人通常使用摩卡壶。将糖加入饮品杯底部。加热牛奶，可在炉上慢慢加热、用微波炉加热或打发蒸汽。将滚烫的浓缩咖啡倒在糖上，搅拌至糖溶解。然后将热牛奶倒入杯中混合。

drinks.name: Caferio Cookie Shake
drinks.name_display: 卡菲里奥曲奇奶昔（Caferio Cookie Shake）
ingredients_en: 3 teaspoons sugar, optional and to taste
drinks.instructions_en: Add sugar, coffee and chilled milk in the mixer and mix them. Pour the smoothie into glass. Top the smoothie with cookie-cream ice cream. garnish and serve with oreo cookies.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖、咖啡和冰镇牛奶加入搅拌机中混合。将奶昔倒入杯中。在奶昔顶部放上曲奇奶油冰淇淋。加以装饰，配奥利奥饼干上桌。

drinks.name: Capipink
drinks.instructions_en: Sugar Syrup: add 500ml of water and 500g of sugar into a medium hot pan and stir until the sugar is dissolved. Turn off the heat as soon as it starts to boil. Place the syrup into a bottle with lid. Place the lime, the red fruits and 15ml of syrup in the the glass. Muddle and add crushed ice before pouring Croft Pink to top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 糖浆：将500毫升水和500克糖加入中等热度的锅中，搅拌至糖溶解。一旦开始沸腾就关火。将糖浆装入带盖的瓶中。将青柠、红色水果和15毫升糖浆放入杯中。捣压后加入碎冰，再倒入 Croft Pink 补满。

drinks.name: Caipireja
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze the juice of one lemon, and chop the other into pieces. Place the lemon juice and chopped lemons in a cocktail shaker and mash the lemon. Add sugar and vodka then shake it. Transfer the mixture to a glass and slowly add beer.
drinks.instructions_zh: 挤出一个柠檬的汁，将另一个柠檬切块。将柠檬汁和切好的柠檬放入摇酒壶中，捣压柠檬。加入糖和伏特加，然后摇匀。将混合物倒入杯中，慢慢加入啤酒。

drinks.name: Caipirinha Black
drinks.instructions_en: Place lime and sugar into Old-Fashioned glass and muddle. Mash the two ingredients together using a muddler or a wooden spoon. Fill the glass with crushed ice and add the Black Vodka.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠和糖放入古典杯中捣压。用捣棒或木勺将这两种材料一起捣压。将杯子装满碎冰，加入黑伏特加。

drinks.name: Red fruit caipirinha
drinks.name_display: 红色水果卡琵莉亚（Red fruit caipirinha）
drinks.instructions_en: Add berries and sugar in a glass. Mash the fruit using a tamper to extract the juice. Add crushed ice, complete with cachaça, then stir gently and then serve. Decorate the glass with the red berries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加入浆果和糖。用捣棒将水果捣碎以榨出汁液。加入碎冰，倒入卡莎萨补满，然后轻轻搅拌后即可上桌。用红色浆果装饰杯子。

drinks.name: Caipirinha
drinks.instructions_en: Wash the lime and cut off both ends. Cut the lime into 8 or 9 pieces and remove the central white part responsible for the bitterness. Place the pieces in the glass and pour a good tablespoon of sugar. Crush firmly into the glass with the powdered sugar until the juice is extracted as completely as possible. Cover the lime-sugar mixture with a good layer of crushed ice or simple ice cubes (close to the rim), then level it to a finger from the rim. Serve in an old fashioned glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠洗净并切去两端。将青柠切成8或9块，去除带来苦味的中间白色部分。将切好的青柠放入杯中，倒入满满一汤匙糖。与糖一起用力捣压，尽可能完全地榨出汁液。在青柠糖混合物上覆盖一层厚厚的碎冰或普通冰块（接近杯口），然后将冰面整平至距杯口约一指的位置。用古典杯上桌。

drinks.name: Caipiroska
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with cracked ice Add the sugar and lime quarters in a mixing glass. Muddle to extract the juice without forcing the rind from the lime. Dump the ice from the glass into the mixing glass, add the vodka, and shake.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个杯中装入裂冰。将糖和青柠角放入调酒杯中。捣压以榨出汁液，但不要过度压出青柠皮的苦味。将杯中的冰倒入调酒杯中，加入伏特加，摇匀。

drinks.name: Calamansi Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Mix sugar, water and calamansi juice in a pitcher. Stir until well-blended. Add mixture and ice cubes to a glass. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在壶中将糖、水和金桔汁混合。搅拌至充分融合。将混合液和冰块加入杯中。享用！

drinks.name: Calamity Jane
drinks.instructions_en: Pour tequila in glass first, mix with basil leaf. Lightly top with orange liqueur and ancho reyes to keep a orange glow near the top of the drink. Slice strawberry and lime slice and place the slice on the rim of the glass for decoration. Drop the fresno chili through the center of the drink to lightly mix.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先在杯中倒入龙舌兰酒，与罗勒叶混合。轻轻在表面加入橙味利口酒和安乔雷耶斯辣椒利口酒，使饮品上部保留一抹橙色光泽。将草莓和青柠切片，放在杯口作装饰。将弗雷斯诺辣椒从饮品中心投下，使其轻轻混合。

drinks.name: Californication
drinks.instructions_en: Add vodka, gin, white rum and tequila into a large glass Add lemon juice, a good dose of freshly squeezed orange juice and lots of ice Add a lots of ice Decorate with a slice of fresh orange
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大杯中加入伏特加、金酒、白朗姆酒和龙舌兰酒。加入柠檬汁、适量鲜榨橙汁和大量冰块。加入大量冰块。用一片新鲜橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Canelazo
ingredients_en: 3 oz Aguardiente or puntas(alcoholic drink from Ecuador)
ingredients_zh: 3盎司阿瓜迪恩特酒或蓬塔斯酒（alcoholic drink from Ecuador）
drinks.instructions_en: Bring the water, sugar, lime juice and cinnamon sticks to a boil. Turn off the heat, then add the orange juice and aguardiente or puntas. Serve in an glass or a coffe mug. And say salud!!.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水、糖、青柠汁和肉桂棒煮沸。关火，然后加入橙汁和甘蔗烈酒（aguardiente 或 puntas）。用玻璃杯或咖啡杯上桌。并说声 salud（干杯）！！

drinks.name: Cantarito Tequila
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a tall glass with ice. Pour in tequila and all fruit juices. Top it off with grapefruit soda. Garnish with a lemon, lime, or orange wedge Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中加满冰。倒入龙舌兰酒和所有果汁。用西柚苏打水补满。用柠檬角、青柠角或橙子角装饰。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Cape Codder
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a highball glass with ice. Add vodka, cranberry juice, and squeeze of lime. Stir well. Garnish with lime wedge and/or a few cranberries, if available.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中加满冰。加入伏特加、蔓越莓汁，并挤入少许青柠汁。充分搅拌。如有，用一块青柠角和/或几颗蔓越莓装饰。

drinks.name: Capeta
drinks.instructions_en: Place ice, sweetened condensed milk, vodka, cinnamon, honey, guarana powder, and cocoa powder in a blender. Blend until smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块、加糖炼乳、伏特加、肉桂、蜂蜜、瓜拉纳粉和可可粉放入搅拌机中。搅打至顺滑。

drinks.name: Cappuccino
ingredients_en: 1 rounded tablespoon finely ground coffee, preferably an espresso blend
1 pinch cocoa powder or ground cinnamon, optional
ingredients_zh: 1满汤匙细磨咖啡，最好是意式浓缩拼配
drinks.instructions_en: Warm the espresso machine. Put the coffee in the filter basket of the portafilter, gently but firmly tamp it down with a tamper, and secure the portafilter in the brew head. Place a 5- or 6-ounce (148- or 177-ml) cup directly under the brew head. Brew just long enough to yield 1 to 1 1/2 ounces (30 to 44 ml) of espresso. Turn your machine off just as it finishes pouring the last of the pale-colored crema and before the espresso becomes watery, which you’ll learn with practice. The exact time will depend on your machine. Much will depend on your particular machine. Turn on the steamer and let it warm up. Pour the milk into a stainless steel pitcher. Submerge the tip of the steam wand at least half an inch below the milk surface and turn on the steam switch. As the foam rises, gradually lower the pitcher so the tip of the wand remains just below the milk surface. As the milk begins to heat up, tilt the pitcher slightly to swirl the milk and continue to steam until the side of the pitcher becomes almost too hot to hold. Turn off the steam while still holding the tip of the wand under the milk surface. For a smooth cappuccino in which both the warmed and foamed milk on top is evenly integrated throughout the beverage, gently pour the milk over the espresso in a thin, steady stream. For a cappuccino with a foamy head, hold back the foam with a spoon and gently pour the milk over the espresso. Spoon the foam over the top. Sprinkle with cocoa powder or cinnamon, if desired. Serve hot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 预热浓缩咖啡机。将咖啡粉放入手柄的滤篮中，用压粉器轻而紧实地压实，然后将手柄锁入冲煮头。将一个5或6盎司（148或177毫升）的杯子放在冲煮头正下方。萃取时间只需刚好得到1至1.5盎司（30至44毫升）浓缩咖啡。当最后一点浅色咖啡油脂流出后、在浓缩咖啡变稀之前立刻关闭机器，这一点需要多加练习来掌握。确切时间取决于你的机器。很大程度上取决于你使用的具体机器。打开蒸汽开关让它预热。将牛奶倒入不锈钢奶缸中。将蒸汽棒尖端没入牛奶表面下方至少半英寸，打开蒸汽开关。随着奶泡上升，逐渐放低奶缸，使蒸汽棒尖端始终保持在牛奶表面下方略低的位置。牛奶开始变热时，稍稍倾斜奶缸使牛奶旋转，继续打蒸汽，直到奶缸侧面热得几乎握不住。在仍将蒸汽棒尖端保持在牛奶表面下方的情况下关掉蒸汽。若想要一杯顺滑的卡布奇诺，使顶部加热和起泡的牛奶均与其下的饮品充分融合，就细而稳定地将牛奶缓缓倒入浓缩咖啡中。若想要一杯顶部有奶泡的卡布奇诺，则用勺子挡住奶泡，先将牛奶缓缓倒入浓缩咖啡中，再用勺子将奶泡舀在表面。如喜欢，撒上可可粉或肉桂粉。趁热上桌。

drinks.name: Carajillo
drinks.instructions_en: Use your favorite mix of coffee roasted beans to brew 2 oz of espresso. Let the espresso to stand and cold down a little bit. Get an Old Fashioned glass and put the 2 oz espresso. Carefully add the 2 oz of your favorite liquor (Whiskey, Ron or Brandy), this step is critical if you want a good looking cocktail. If done correctly you will get the liquor to fall to the bottom of the glass and you will see a beautiful transition between the two drinks. Tip: Traditionally, carajillo is served warm, but you can also serve it cold, add some ice cubes if you want. Tip: Use a liquior named "Licor 43", a spanish liquior made with a secret recipe of 43 ingredients (species, herbs, fruits), you will get a most refined taste. Tip: Brew your coffee with some herbs (cinnamon, clove, anís, and more) to improve the taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用你喜欢的混合烘焙咖啡豆煮2盎司浓缩咖啡。让浓缩咖啡静置并稍稍冷却。取一个古典杯，倒入2盎司浓缩咖啡。小心地加入2盎司你喜欢的烈酒（威士忌、朗姆酒或白兰地），若想要一杯好看的鸡尾酒，这一步很关键。如果操作正确，烈酒会沉到杯底，你就能看到两种饮品之间漂亮的过渡。小贴士：传统上，卡拉希略是温热上桌的，但你也可以冷饮，如喜欢可加些冰块。小贴士：使用名为“Licor 43”的利口酒，这是一款西班牙利口酒，采用43种原料（香料、香草、水果）的秘方酿制，能带来更精致的口感。小贴士：煮咖啡时加入一些香草（肉桂、丁香、八角等）以提升风味。

drinks.name: Caramel Apple Shot
drinks.name_display: 焦糖苹果子弹（Caramel Apple Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add caramel vodka, sour apple schnapps, and apple juice. Shake and strain into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰。加入焦糖伏特加、酸苹果味烈酒和苹果汁。摇匀后滤入子弹杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Caramel Frappuccino
drinks.instructions_en: To make Caramel Frappuccino simply add ice cubes, milk, caramel sauce, coffee powder (instant) and vanilla extract in a blender. Blend till ice breaks into very fine crystals. Remove and pour into a glass. On top pipe whipped cream and pour some caramel sauce over the whipped cream to garnish it. Serve it immediately. Cheers!! Tip: Use the blender at medium pace to get a perfect fluffed coffee.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作焦糖星冰乐，只需将冰块、牛奶、焦糖酱、速溶咖啡粉和香草精加入搅拌机中。搅打至冰块碎成极细的冰晶。取出倒入杯中。在顶部挤上打发的奶油，再在奶油上淋一些焦糖酱加以装饰。立即上桌。干杯！！小贴士：用中速搅打，才能得到完美蓬松的咖啡。

drinks.name: Caramel Snickerdoodle Martini
drinks.name_display: 焦糖肉桂曲奇马天尼（Caramel Snickerdoodle Martini）
drinks.instructions_en: Place caramel on a plate and cinnamon sugar on another. Dip rims of martini glasses in caramel, then in cinnamon sugar.  In a cocktail shaker, add heavy cream, Smirnoff Kissed Caramel, and cinnamon. Add ice and shake until cold. Pour into glasses and top each one with whipped cream and a cinnamon stick.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个碟上放焦糖，另一个碟上放肉桂糖。将马天尼杯的杯口先蘸焦糖，再蘸肉桂糖。在摇酒壶中加入淡奶油、斯米诺焦糖味伏特加和肉桂。加冰摇匀至冰凉。倒入杯中，每杯顶部挤上打发的奶油并放一根肉桂棒。

drinks.name: Carrulim
drinks.instructions_en: Use a mortar and pestle to extract the rue essence. Extract the juice from the limes. Mix the rue with the lime and caña/rum in a jar. (Optional) Add honey or other herbs to customize, according to your personal taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用研钵和研杵榨取芸香的精华。挤出青柠的汁液。将芸香与青柠以及甘蔗酒/朗姆酒在罐中混合。（可选）按个人口味加入蜂蜜或其他香草来定制风味。

drinks.name: Casino
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker. Shake until well chilled. Strain into a Nick and Nora glass. Garnish with a Maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加入摇酒壶中。摇匀至充分冰镇。滤入尼克与诺拉杯中。用一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Cement Mixer
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Irish cream into one shot glass and lime juice into another. Take the Irish cream first, then the lime juice. Swish briefly in your mouth (it will curdle) and swallow.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将爱尔兰甜酒倒入一个子弹杯中，将青柠汁倒入另一个子弹杯中。先喝爱尔兰甜酒，再喝青柠汁。在口中短暂漱一下（会凝结），然后吞下。

drinks.name: Es Cendol
ingredients_en: 200 gr Amanprana Gula Java Coconut blossom sugar
ingredients_zh: 200克阿曼普拉纳爪哇椰子花糖
drinks.instructions_en: Mix rice flour with sago flour and pour some water in the mixture. Boil the rest of the water, add green pandan leaves and a little salt. Put the flour mixture into the boiled water. Stir well and cook until it thickens (paste-like). Drain with a strain that has round holes, so when you press the cendol mixture it will go out of the strain as spaghetti. Put these cendol directly in a bowl with cold water and ice. Cendol will become solid then.> Drain the cendol and set aside. Put some cendol into a tall glass, pour Gula java sugar syrup and coconut milk (separate layers) into the glass. You can add shaved ice or just some ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将粘米粉与西米粉混合，向混合物中倒入一些水。将剩余的水煮沸，加入绿色香兰叶和少许盐。将面粉混合物放入沸水中。充分搅拌并煮至变稠（呈糊状）。用带圆孔的滤网沥出，这样当你挤压煎蕊混合物时，它会像意大利面一样从滤网中挤出。将这些煎蕊直接放入装有冷水和冰的碗中。煎蕊此时会凝固。捞出煎蕊备用。将一些煎蕊放入高杯中，把椰糖浆和椰奶（分成不同层次）倒入杯中。你可以加入刨冰或一些冰块。

drinks.name: Chai E Zanjafeel
ingredients_en: 1 tbs Walnuts, very finely chopped or ground
