drinks.instructions_en: Bring 3½ cups water to a boil in a pan, then add the tea and sugar. Continue boiling for about 2 minutes, then strain. Pour the tea back into the pan and add the ground ginger and walnuts. Boil again for about 2 minutes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在锅中将3½杯水煮沸，然后加入茶叶和糖。继续煮约2分钟，然后过滤。将茶倒回锅中，加入姜粉和核桃。再煮约2分钟。

drinks.name: Champagne Soup
drinks.instructions_en: Combine lime juice with the Cointreau and sugar in a very large bowl. Set aside in the fridge. Add the Champagne just before serving!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个很大的碗中将青柠汁与君度和糖混合。放入冰箱备用。上桌前再加入香槟！

drinks.name: Cheerwine
drinks.instructions_en: In a glass mix Vodka, Cheerwine, and Lime Juice. Stir and serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中混合伏特加、Cheerwine 樱桃汽水和青柠汁。搅拌后上桌！

drinks.name: Cherry Bourbon Smash
drinks.name_display: 樱桃波本斯玛什（Cherry Bourbon Smash）
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the cherries, basil, thyme, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker or glass jar, squashing everything to release the juices. Add the bourbon, Cointreau, and vinegar. Fill with ice and shake until combined. Strain and pour into prepared glasses. Top off with ginger beer. Finish with basil and a cherry on top. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶或玻璃罐中将樱桃、罗勒、百里香和柠檬汁捣压，充分压碎以释放汁液。加入波本威士忌、君度和醋。加满冰并摇匀至混合。过滤后倒入备好的杯中。用姜汁啤酒补满。最后用罗勒和一颗樱桃点缀。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Cherry Limeade
drinks.instructions_en: In a small saucepan combine sugar and 2 cups water. Heat to a boiling. Turn off and let cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, blend pitted cherries in a blender until pureed smooth. In a 2-qt pitcher combine syrup from step 1, lime juice, cherry puree, 3 cups of ice. Fill with water to the 2-quart line. Enjoy immediately or refrigerate until serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小锅中将糖和2杯水混合。加热至沸腾。关火，让其冷却至室温。与此同时，将去核樱桃放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑的果泥。在一个2夸脱的壶中，混合第一步的糖浆、青柠汁、樱桃果泥和3杯冰。加水至2夸脱刻度线。立即享用，或冷藏至上桌前。

drinks.name: Chikoo lassi
drinks.instructions_en: Place all the ingredients in a blender and blend well. Sieve the lassi to avoid lumps and make it smooth. Garnish with almond and more dry fruits. Serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中充分搅打。将拉西过滤以去除结块，使其顺滑。用杏仁和更多干果装饰。冷饮上桌。

drinks.name: Chocolate Cake Shot
drinks.name_display: 巧克力蛋糕子弹（Chocolate Cake Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Rim a lemon wedge in sugar and set aside. Fill a shaker with ice and add vodka and hazelnut liqueur. Shake and strain into a shot glass. Take the shot and bite the sugared lemon wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一块柠檬角蘸上糖，放在一旁备用。在摇酒壶中加满冰，加入伏特加和榛子利口酒。摇匀后滤入子弹杯中。饮下这杯酒，并咬一口蘸糖的柠檬角。

drinks.name: Chocolate Milk
drinks.instructions_en: Combine cocoa powder and water in a microwave-safe cup or mug. Microwave for 15 to 20 seconds until steaming, and stir until very smooth. Add 1/4 cup of the milk and the sugar, and microwave for an additional 15 to 30 seconds, until steaming. Stir until completely mixed. Stir in remaining milk and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将可可粉和水放入可微波的杯子或马克杯中混合。微波加热15至20秒至冒热气，搅拌至非常顺滑。加入1/4杯牛奶和糖，再微波加热15至30秒至冒热气。搅拌至完全混合。拌入剩余的牛奶即可享用。

drinks.name: Chocolate Monkey
drinks.instructions_en: Place the banana liqueur, crème de cacao, chocolate syrup, ice cream and milk in a blender. Process for a few seconds until smooth. Pour into long glasses. Top with whipped cream and a drizzle of more chocolate syrup.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将香蕉利口酒、可可利口酒、巧克力糖浆、冰淇淋和牛奶放入搅拌机中。搅打几秒至顺滑。倒入长杯中。顶部挤上打发的奶油，再淋上少许巧克力糖浆。

drinks.name: Chocoline Milk
drinks.instructions_en: Heat the milk until it boils Combine chocoline powder and Sugar in the cup or mug. Add the milk. Stir until completely mixed and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将牛奶加热至沸腾。在杯子或马克杯中将巧克力粉和糖混合。加入牛奶。搅拌至完全混合即可享用。

drinks.name: Christmas Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all the ingredients. Pour into into a cup. Add the lemon and the raisins.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料搅拌均匀。倒入杯中。加入柠檬和葡萄干。

drinks.name: Chuhai
ingredients_en: 1/4 cup Yuzu Juice or any fruit juice of choice
drinks.instructions_en: Add Shochu, Yuzu juice, Simple Syrup and ice to your cup. Stir the ingredients together. Top your glass with the club soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加入烧酒、柚子汁、单糖浆和冰块。将材料搅拌在一起。用苏打水补满杯中。

drinks.name: Churchill
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze the lemon into the glass. Poor the mineral water, be carefull with bubbles. Add salt. Additionally, you may add some ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬挤汁入杯。倒入矿泉水，注意气泡。加入盐。此外，你可以加一些冰。

drinks.name: Cinnamon Maple Whiskey Sour
drinks.name_display: 肉桂枫糖威士忌酸（Cinnamon Maple Whiskey Sour）
ingredients_en: 3 tablespoons Bulleit bourbon or your bourbon of choice
ingredients_zh: 3汤匙布雷特波本威士忌或自选波本威士忌
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker or mason jar about two-thirds full with ice.  Pour in the bourbon, lemon juice, maple syrup and a pinch of ground cinnamon.  Securely fasten the lid and shake well. Fill a cocktail shaker or mason jar about two-thirds full with ice.  Pour fresh ice into your cocktail glass and strain the cold whiskey sour mixture into the glass. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将摇酒壶或梅森罐装至约三分之二满的冰。倒入波本威士忌、柠檬汁、枫糖浆和一小撮肉桂粉。盖紧盖子充分摇匀。将摇酒壶或梅森罐装至约三分之二满的冰。将新鲜冰块放入鸡尾酒杯中，将冰镇的威士忌酸混合液滤入杯中。享用！

drinks.name: Citrus Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice cubes. Add all ingredients. Shake and strain into a cocktail glass. You can garnish with lemon zest.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰块。加入所有材料。摇匀后滤入鸡尾酒杯中。可以用柠檬皮装饰。

drinks.name: Clarito
drinks.instructions_en: Chill a cocktail glass. Cut a slice of lemon and rub the brim of the glass before serving. Place the cup upside down on a dish with sugar so that the sugar adheres to the moistened part. Add four or five ice rocks in a cocktail shaker. Pour the gin and the vermouth and shake for one minute. Serve, add the lemon twist and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将鸡尾酒杯冰镇。切一片柠檬，上桌前用它擦抹杯口。将杯子倒扣在盛有糖的碟上，使糖粘附在湿润的部分。在摇酒壶中加入四五块冰块。倒入金酒和味美思，摇一分钟。上桌，加入柠檬皮扭条即可享用。

drinks.name: Classic Whiskey Sour
drinks.name_display: 经典威士忌酸（Classic Whiskey Sour）
drinks.instructions_en: Build the cocktail. Place the bourbon, lemon juice, simple syrup, and egg white in a cocktail shaker. Do not add ice yet. Dry shake the cocktail. Seal the shaker and shake vigorously for 10 seconds. (This is referred to as a 'dry shake.' It's good for incorporating the egg white before adding ice to the shaker.) Shake again with ice. Add ice, seal again, and shake for 7 to 10 seconds more to chill. Strain the cocktail. Fit a Hawthorne strainer over the top of the shaker and pour the cocktail through a fine-mesh strainer into a coupe glass. This is referred to as a 'double strain' and this method is used to catch any ice shards or pulp from the fresh-squeezed lemon juice. Garnish and serve. Garnish with a speared maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 调制鸡尾酒。将波本威士忌、柠檬汁、单糖浆和蛋清放入摇酒壶中。此时先不要加冰。干摇鸡尾酒。盖紧摇酒壶，用力摇10秒。（这被称为“干摇”，有利于在向摇酒壶加冰之前先让蛋清融合。）再加冰摇一次。加冰，再次盖紧，再摇7至10秒使其冰镇。滤出鸡尾酒。将霍桑滤网扣在摇酒壶顶部，将鸡尾酒通过细网筛滤入碟形香槟杯中。这被称为“双重过滤”，这种方法用于滤除任何冰屑或鲜榨柠檬汁的果肉。装饰并上桌。用签子串起的马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Clavis Riga
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into a ice cooled mixing glass. Mix, then strain into a cocktail glass. Decorate with the orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入经冰镇过的调酒杯中。混合后滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Clericot
drinks.instructions_en: Cut two cups worth of fruits (oranges, kiwis, apples and pineapples are recommended) into medium pieces. Add them to a jar. Add orange juice, lemon soda, and wine to the jar. Add ice (as much as you want).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两杯量的水果（推荐橙子、猕猴桃、苹果和菠萝）切成中等大小的块。放入罐中。向罐中加入橙汁、柠檬汽水和葡萄酒。加冰（随意添加）。

drinks.name: Clover Club Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 三叶草俱乐部鸡尾酒（Clover Club Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients into a shaker with ice. Strain into chilled glass. Garnish with three speared rasberries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加冰放入摇酒壶中混合。滤入冰镇的杯中。用签子串起的3颗覆盆子装饰。

drinks.name: Coco Avocado
ingredients_en: 2 tablespoons Condensed milk, palm sugar, or honey for sweetener
ingredients_zh: 2汤匙炼乳、棕榈糖或蜂蜜作甜味剂
drinks.instructions_en: Put the whole cup of ice cube to a blender. Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit. Scoop out all the inside and add them on the blender. Add the sweetener of your preference. Blend them all until smooth. Open up a coconut and put away the coconut water. Scoop out the tender coconut inside and add it to the blender. Pour the drink into a serving glass. You can add more ice cubes or slushed ice to make it fresher!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将整杯冰块放入搅拌机中。将牛油果对半切开并去除果核。挖出全部果肉放入搅拌机中。加入你喜欢的甜味剂。将它们全部搅打至顺滑。打开一个椰子，倒出椰子水备用。挖出里面嫩滑的椰肉，加入搅拌机中。将饮品倒入上桌用的杯中。你可以加入更多冰块或冰沙，使其更清爽！

drinks.name: Coco Dream
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all ingredients together on a blender and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中搅拌均匀，即可享用。

drinks.name: Coco loco
drinks.instructions_en: Make the Coco Loco cocktail recipe in a blender or blender. Add white rum and coconut milk. Add the sugar and milk. Add ice cubes. Blend for a few seconds. Pour the mixture into a large tumbler glass. Add a few ice cubes to obtain a fresh cocktail.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中制作 Coco Loco 鸡尾酒。加入白朗姆酒和椰奶。加入糖和牛奶。加入冰块。搅拌几秒钟。将混合液倒入大号平底杯中。加入几块冰块，以获得清爽的鸡尾酒口感。

drinks.name: 1800 Coco Piñarita
ingredients_en: 8 oz Tres Agaves Organic Margarita Mix
1 slice Fresh Pinapple, Coconut or Lime (optional)
ingredients_zh: 8盎司特雷斯阿加韦有机玛格丽特混合液
drinks.instructions_en: Add two cups of ice in a 16 oz margarita glass. Add two ounces of the 1800 Coconut Tequila. After, add three ounces of Dole Pineapple Juice along with the eight ounces of Tres Agaves Organic Margarita Mix. Carefully stir with a drink stirrer and garnish your glass with a slice of pineapple or coconut. Sip and enjoy by the pool or on the go in your hydroflask!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在 16 盎司的玛格丽特杯中放入两杯冰。加入两盎司 1800 椰子龙舌兰。然后加入三盎司都乐菠萝汁以及八盎司 Tres Agaves 有机玛格丽特混合液。用调酒棒小心搅拌，并用一片菠萝或椰子装饰杯口。在泳池边小酌，或装入随身水杯中一路享用！

drinks.name: Coconut Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare one shot of espresso. If you can't get espresso, drip brewed coffee works fine but the taste won't be as robust. Mix the coconut milk, condensed milk, whipping cream, ice together in a blender. Put the coconut mixture into a glass cup, pour the espresso over. Garnish with the ice cream scoop or the coconut flesh. This drink tastes best on a hot day.
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备一份浓缩咖啡。如果买不到浓缩咖啡，用滴滤咖啡也可以，但口感不会那么醇厚。将椰奶、炼乳、淡奶油和冰块一起放入搅拌机中混合。将椰子混合物倒入玻璃杯中，淋上浓缩咖啡。用一勺冰淇淋或椰肉装饰。这款饮品在炎热的天气里饮用最佳。

drinks.name: Coconut Lime Cilantro Cooler
drinks.name_display: 椰子青柠香菜冰饮（Coconut Lime Cilantro Cooler）
ingredients_en: 1/3 cup sparkling water OR ginger ale OR club soda
ingredients_zh: 1/3杯苏打水或姜汁汽水或俱乐部苏打水
drinks.instructions_en: In a glass, stir all ingredients together except for the two garnishes. Garnish with the slice of lime and the 2 fresh cilantro leaves Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在玻璃杯中，将除两种装饰物以外的所有材料搅拌在一起。用一片青柠和 2 片新鲜香菜叶装饰，立即享用。

drinks.name: Coconut Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a blender with ice. Add the coconut cream, tequila, and triple sec. Blend at high speed until smooth. Scatter the coconut onto a plate. Wet the rims of four glasses. Dip the glass rims in the coconut. Serve the margaritas in the prepared glasses.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中装满冰。加入椰浆、龙舌兰和三秒酒。高速搅拌至顺滑。将椰蓉撒在盘子上。将四个杯子的杯口蘸湿。把杯口蘸上椰蓉。将玛格丽特倒入准备好的杯子中享用。

drinks.name: Coconut Mint Collins
drinks.name_display: 椰子薄荷柯林斯（Coconut Mint Collins）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a chilled glass. Add crushed ice, stir and fill with soda water. Top off with a wedge of lime and mint leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入冰镇的玻璃杯中。加入碎冰，搅拌，再倒入苏打水。最后放上一角青柠和薄荷叶。

drinks.name: Cold Brew Old Fashioned
drinks.name_display: 冷萃古典鸡尾酒（Cold Brew Old Fashioned）
drinks.instructions_en: Do not stir, simply build the drink in the glass. Add the cold black coffee. Add the rye and then the bitters. Served on the rocks, stir to combine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 不要搅拌，直接在杯中调制。加入冷黑咖啡。加入黑麦威士忌，然后加入苦精。加冰饮用，搅拌混合。

drinks.name: Cold Brew Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Coarsely grind coffee beans. Combine ground coffee and water in a 1 1/2 quart glass, jar or container by pouring water over the ground coffee. Stir gently with a long-handled wooden spoon to make sure the grounds are thoroughly saturated with water. Cover container with a lid and place in refrigerator to steep for 12 hours. Line a small strainer with cheesecloth or flour sack cloth and place over a large measuring cup or bowl. Pour the coffee through the strainer. Transfer the coffee to a small bottle or jar and store in the fridge for up to a week. Dilute the coffee with as much water or milk as you prefer. Serve over ice if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡豆粗磨。把研磨好的咖啡放入 1.5 夸脱的玻璃杯、罐子或容器中，将水浇在咖啡粉上。用长柄木勺轻轻搅拌，确保咖啡粉被水充分浸透。盖上盖子，放入冰箱冷泡 12 小时。在小滤网中铺上纱布或粗棉布，放在大量杯或碗上。将咖啡通过滤网过滤。把咖啡倒入小瓶或罐中，在冰箱中最多保存一周。根据个人喜好加水或牛奶稀释咖啡。如需冰饮，可加冰享用。

drinks.name: Cold Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Blend coffee powder and Sugar in a mixer jar with 2 teaspoons water until it turns light in colour. Pour milk and Hersheys Syrup in the jar. Blend the mixture until you get a good froth on the top. Put the ice-cream in a serving glass. Pour the coffee in the glass. Garnish with the cocoa powder and some Hersheys Syrup.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡粉和糖放入搅拌机杯中，加入 2 茶匙水搅拌至颜色变浅。向杯中倒入牛奶和好时糖浆。搅拌混合物，直到顶部形成丰富的泡沫。将冰淇淋放入饮用杯中。把咖啡倒入杯中。撒上可可粉并淋上一些好时糖浆装饰。

drinks.name: Cold Relief Tea
drinks.instructions_en: In a saucepan, heat up quarter cup of water. To this, add the tea leaves and sugar as per your taste call. After it comes to a gradual boil, add the milk and bring it to a boil. Now, add the lemongrass, grated ginger, cardamom, tulsi leaves, balck pepper powder, turmeric powder, cloves and cinnamon. At the end, add a teaspoon of honey or jaggery to it. Sit back and enjoy your relief tea!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在平底锅中加热四分之一杯水。向其中按口味加入茶叶和糖。逐渐煮沸后，加入牛奶并煮沸。然后加入香茅、姜末、小豆蔻、圣罗勒叶、黑胡椒粉、姜黄粉、丁香和肉桂。最后加入一茶匙蜂蜜或红糖。坐下来尽情享用你的舒缓茶吧！

drinks.name: Colombian michelada
drinks.name_display: 哥伦比亚米切拉达（Colombian michelada）
drinks.instructions_en: Rim the tip of the glass with lime. Dip the glass top into salt. Squeeze two lime halves into the glass. Pour the beer in.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用青柠擦拭杯口。将杯口蘸上盐。把两个半块的青柠汁挤入杯中。倒入啤酒。

drinks.name: Colorado Bulldog
drinks.instructions_en: Shake the booze and cream together with ice. Strain into a short glas with lots of ice and leave some space for cola. Top off with cola to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将酒和奶油与冰一起摇匀。滤入装有大量冰块的矮杯中，留出一些空间加可乐。按口味用可乐补满。

drinks.name: Comfort Collins
ingredients_zh: 加满玻璃杯的柠檬青柠汽水
drinks.instructions_en: Add Southern Comfort and lime juice to collins glass filled with ice. Top with lemon-lime soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将南方安逸威士忌和青柠汁加入装满冰块的柯林杯中。用柠檬青柠汽水补满。

drinks.name: Coquito
ingredients_en: 1 1/2 cups dark spiced rum (to give it good flavor) or white rum (adjust to taste, may be omitted)
ingredients_zh: 黑香料朗姆酒（to give it good flavor，adjust to taste, may be omitted）
drinks.instructions_en: (Optional) In a small pot, add water and anise. Gently boil for 2-3 minutes. Let it cool completely, remove the anise from the water. In a blender, add all of the ingredients. If you omit the rum, you might want to add a little water to cut some of the sweetness. (Depending on size of the blender, you may have to do this in batches.) Pour into old rum bottles or any liquor bottles or place in a sealed container and then refrigerate. Refrigerate for at least an hour or two before serving. Garnish with ground cinnamon and cinnamon sticks, if desired
drinks.instructions_zh: （可选）在小锅中加入水和八角。轻轻煮 2-3 分钟。待其完全冷却后，将八角从水中捞出。将所有材料放入搅拌机中。如果省略朗姆酒，可以加一点水来中和部分甜味。（根据搅拌机的大小，可能需要分批进行。）倒入旧的朗姆酒瓶或任何酒瓶中，或放入密封容器中，然后冷藏。食用前至少冷藏一两个小时。如需要，可撒上肉桂粉并用肉桂棒装饰。

drinks.name: Corn Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Boil sweet corn until cooked (set aside the boiled water and do not throw it away). Sweet corn stew using a knife. Blender sweet corn that has been smeared with sweet corn boiled water according to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将甜玉米煮至熟透（把煮玉米的水留下，不要倒掉）。用刀将甜玉米切下。将切下的甜玉米加入搅拌机，按口味加入煮玉米的水搅打。

drinks.name: CoronaRita
drinks.instructions_en: Slice the 2 limes in wedges for garnish. Run a cut lime around the rim of the glass. Dip glass rim into sea salt poured on a small plate. Test your bottles in your glasses, you can see the glasses I have used, are made with a well to fit the neck of the beer bottle. Pour margaritas from blender (see below for Frozen Margarita Recipe), carefully tip open Coronita (small 7 oz Corona beer) into the glass. That is it! Garnish with cut limes and colorful straws. You can serve CoronaRitas
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 2 个青柠切成角状备用。用切开的青柠擦拭杯口。将杯口蘸入倒在碟子上的海盐中。把酒瓶放入杯中试一下，可以看到我用的杯子带有凹槽，正好能卡住啤酒瓶的瓶颈。从搅拌机中倒入玛格丽特（见下方冰冻玛格丽特配方），小心地将打开的科罗娜（7 盎司小瓶装科罗娜啤酒）倾斜倒入杯中。这样就完成了！用切好的青柠和彩色吸管装饰。你可以享用 CoronaRita 了。

drinks.name: Corpse Reviver no.2
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all the ingredients with ice and fine strain into a chilled glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与冰一起摇匀，细滤入冰镇的玻璃杯中。

drinks.name: Cosmopolitan
ingredients_en: 0.5 oz triple sec (Curacao, Grand Marnier, Cointreau)
ingredients_zh: 白橙皮酒（Curacao, Grand Marnier, Cointreau）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients in a shaker and mix vigorously for 15 seconds. If you wish to respect the original recipe of the cosmo, take an orange peel and press it over the glass and in front of a match to ignite the orange essential oils on the surface of the peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入摇酒壶中，用力摇匀 15 秒。如果你想遵循大都会鸡尾酒的传统配方，取一片橙皮，在杯子上方挤压，并对着火柴点燃橙皮表面的橙油。

drinks.name: Cranberry Bourbon Sour
drinks.name_display: 蔓越莓波本酸（Cranberry Bourbon Sour）
drinks.instructions_en: To make the cranberry syrup: bring 1/2 cup water, the maple syrup, and cranberries in a medium pot and boil over high heat. Boil 5 minutes or until the cranberries begin to burst, then remove from the heat. Stir in the orange zest. Let cool. Combine 2-3 tablespoons cranberry syrup, the bourbon, lemon juice, cranberry juice, and orange bitters in a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake. Strain into a glass. You can ground the spices in a motor and pestle too. Boil milk in a heavy bottomed pan. Garnish with orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作蔓越莓糖浆：将 1/2 杯水、枫糖浆和蔓越莓放入中号锅中，大火煮沸。煮 5 分钟或直到蔓越莓开始爆裂，然后离火。拌入橙皮。放凉。在摇酒壶中将 2-3 汤匙蔓越莓糖浆、波本威士忌、柠檬汁、蔓越莓汁和橙味苦精混合。加入冰块摇匀。滤入杯中。你也可以用研钵和研杵将香料研磨。在厚底锅中煮沸牛奶。用橙片装饰。

drinks.name: Cranberry Mimosa
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 1/4 cup cranberry juice into each glass and top with champage.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在每个杯中倒入 1/4 杯蔓越莓汁，再用香槟补满。

drinks.name: Cranberry Orange Whiskey Cocktail
drinks.name_zh: 蔓越莓橙味威士忌鸡尾酒
drinks.name_display: 蔓越莓橙味威士忌鸡尾酒（Cranberry Orange Whiskey Cocktail）
ingredients_en: 3 oz orange juice (freshly squeezed is preferable)
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients except ginger beer to a cocktail shaker filled with ice.. Shake vigorously for 30 seconds and strain into chilled glass. Top off with ginger beer and garnish with orange peel and fresh thyme (optional).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除姜汁啤酒外的所有材料加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。用力摇匀 30 秒，滤入冰镇的玻璃杯中。用姜汁啤酒补满，并用橙皮和新鲜百里香装饰（可选）。

drinks.name: Cranberry Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Put the ingredients, except the soda, with a few ice cubes in a shaker. Shake and pour over ice in a long drink glass. Top off with the soda shake and add half a slice of lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除苏打水以外的材料与几块冰块放入摇酒壶中。摇匀后倒入装有冰块的长饮杯中。用苏打水补满，再加入半片青柠。

drinks.name: Creamy Indian Espresso
drinks.name_display: 奶油印度浓缩咖啡（Creamy Indian Espresso）
drinks.instructions_en: Put instant coffee powder and sugar in a coffee mug. Add 1 tsp. water and mix. Beat the mix vigorously with a spoon. You have to incorpotate as much air as you can. That will give you the whipped frothy coffee-sugar mix. The more you beat, the mix will become pale in colour. Make sure your mix is whipped and creamy enough. Heat a cup of milk and pour it over the whipped coffe-sugar paste. Stir. Sprinkle cocoa powder and serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将速溶咖啡粉和糖放入咖啡杯中。加入 1 茶匙水并搅拌。用勺子用力搅打。你需要尽可能多地搅入空气。这样就能得到打发泡状的咖啡糖混合物。搅打得越多，混合物颜色会变得越浅。确保混合物打发得足够蓬松绵密。加热一杯牛奶，倒在打发好的咖啡糖糊上。搅拌。撒上可可粉，立即享用。

drinks.name: Creamy Mango Lassi
drinks.name_display: 奶油芒果拉西（Creamy Mango Lassi）
drinks.instructions_en: Take a large bowl, add 250ml of fresh mango pulp. To the same bowl, now add yogurt. Now add cold milk. Also add the sugar and the cardamom powder. Blend everything until well combined. Pour the mango lassi into serving glasses and chill before serving. Garnish with crushed almonds,before serving!
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个大碗，加入 250 毫升新鲜芒果果肉。在同一碗中加入酸奶。再加入冷牛奶。同时加入糖和小豆蔻粉。将所有材料搅拌至充分混合。将芒果拉西倒入饮用杯中，食用前冷藏。食用前撒上碎杏仁装饰！

drinks.name: Creole Cream
drinks.instructions_en: Put rum, vermouth, grenadine and lemon juice into a cocktail shaker and stir with crushed ice. Pour into a martini glass. Add a dash of Angostura and one or two olives.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、味美思、红石榴糖浆和柠檬汁放入摇酒壶中，与碎冰一起搅拌。倒入马天尼杯中。加入一滴安高天娜苦精和一两颗橄榄。

drinks.name: Crock-Pot Butterbeer Rum
drinks.name_display: 慢炖锅黄油啤酒朗姆（Crock-Pot Butterbeer Rum）
drinks.instructions_en: In Crock-Pot, combine water, cream soda, sugar, butter, 1/4 cup butterscotch, cinnamon sticks, vanilla and salt. Cover and cook on low for 3 to 3 1/2 hours, until warm and butter is melted. Remove lid and stir in rum. Pour remaining butterscotch syrup onto a shallow plate. Dip rims of mugs in syrup before filling with butter beer. Top with whipped cream, sprinkle with sanding sugar, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在慢炖锅中，将水、奶油苏打、糖、黄油、1/4 杯奶油糖果、肉桂棒、香草和盐混合。盖上盖子，小火煮 3 到 3.5 小时，直到温热且黄油融化。揭开盖子，拌入朗姆酒。将剩余的奶油糖果糖浆倒在浅盘中。在倒入黄油啤酒之前，将马克杯的杯口蘸上糖浆。挤上打发的奶油，撒上装饰糖，即可享用。

drinks.name: Crusta
drinks.instructions_en: Rim a coupe glass with sugar and set aside. Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice and shake. Strain into the prepared glass. Garnish with a lemon twist. Freeze for five minutes, serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用糖装饰碟形香槟杯的杯口，备用。将所有材料放入装有冰块的摇酒壶中摇匀。滤入准备好的杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。冷冻五分钟，冷饮享用。

drinks.name: Cuba Libre
drinks.instructions_en: Add rum into a glass filled with ice and squeeze the lime wedges over the top. Give quick churn with a bar spoon and top up with ice. Fill to the brim with cola and add in the lime wedge as garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒倒入装满冰块的杯中，将青柠角挤汁淋在上面。用吧勺快速搅拌，再加满冰。倒入可乐至杯口，放入青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Cuban Zombie
drinks.instructions_en: Pour a shot of Havana 3 year old & a shot of Havana 7 year old into a glass. Add Orange, Pineapple & Lime Juice. Add lots of ice. Add ingredients into a cocktail shaker & Shake. Pour the mixture into a larger glass filled with ice. Squeeze some Passion. Pour the Grenadine & decorate with fresh Passion fruit.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一份哈瓦那 3 年陈和一份哈瓦那 7 年陈倒入杯中。加入橙汁、菠萝汁和青柠汁。加入大量冰块。将所有材料倒入摇酒壶中摇匀。将混合液倒入装有冰块的较大玻璃杯中。挤入一些百香果。倒入红石榴糖浆，并用新鲜百香果装饰。

drinks.name: Cucumber Gin
drinks.instructions_en: Place the ice cubes and cucumber slices in a large glass. Sprinkle with mint syrup and then add the gin and tonic water. Accompany the cocktail with a zest of lime. Add a slice of lemon and enjoy its delicious flavor.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块和黄瓜片放入大玻璃杯中。淋上薄荷糖浆，然后加入金酒和汤力水。配上一点青柠皮。加入一片柠檬，尽享其美味。

drinks.name: Cucumber Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Place the cucumber slices into a large pitcher. Pour the lemonade concentrate over the cucumber and let stand for 10 minutes. Pour in the lemon-lime soda and pour into glasses to serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黄瓜片放入大玻璃壶中。将浓缩柠檬水倒在黄瓜上，静置 10 分钟。倒入柠檬青柠汽水，然后倒入杯中享用。

drinks.name: Cucumber Lime Mint Agua Fresca
drinks.name_zh: 黄瓜青柠薄荷阿瓜弗雷斯卡
drinks.name_display: 黄瓜青柠薄荷阿瓜弗雷斯卡（Cucumber Lime Mint Agua Fresca）
ingredients_en: 2 cucumbers (ends trimmed, but peel still on, coarsely chopped)
0.5 cup lime juice from fresh limes
1.25 cup packed (spearmint) mint leaves, woody stems removed
ingredients_zh: 2根黄瓜（ends trimmed, but peel still on, coarsely chopped）
1.25杯压实的薄荷叶，去除木质茎（spearmint）
drinks.instructions_en: Put the ingredients in a blender and add enough water to fill 3/4 of the blender. Hold the lid on the blender and purée until smooth. Place a fine mesh sieve over a bowl and pour the purée through it, pressing against the sieve with a rubber spatula or the back of a spoon to extract as much liquid out as possible. Fill a large pitcher halfway with ice cubes. Add the juice. Serve with sprigs of mint and slices of lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料放入搅拌机中，加入足够的水至搅拌机的 3/4 处。按住搅拌机的盖子，搅打至顺滑。在碗上放一个细网滤筛，将果泥倒入滤筛中，用橡胶刮刀或勺背按压滤筛，尽可能多地挤出汁液。在大玻璃壶中装入一半冰块。加入果汁。配以薄荷枝和青柠片享用。

drinks.name: Cynar Spritz
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with ice. Add Prosecco, Cynar and soda. Stir gently to combine and garnish with the slice of lemon. Add one or two olives for garnish
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰。加入普罗塞克、奇纳和蘇打水。轻轻搅拌混合，用一片柠檬装饰。加入一两颗橄榄装饰。

drinks.name: Daddy don't go
ingredients_en: 1 part Fruit punch juice (Orange, pineapple and passion fruit)
ingredients_zh: 1份果汁潘趣（Orange, pineapple and passion fruit）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the Ron with the fruit Punch juice. Add Ice and Mint to the mix. Put it in the blender and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒与果汁潘趣混合。向混合液中加入冰块和薄荷。放入搅拌机中搅打，即可享用。

drinks.name: Daiquiri
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients in a shaker with ice and shake until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a lime twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与冰一起放入摇酒壶中，摇至充分冷却。滤入冰镇的碟形香槟杯。用青柠皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Dalgona Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Take a bowl and mix equal quantities of coffee powder, sugar and hot water. Beat coffee mixture using whisker or hand blender, until it is light, frothy and creamy. Pour cold milk in the glasses or coffee mugs and add the beaten and whipped coffee over it.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个碗，将等量的咖啡粉、糖和热水混合。用打蛋器或手持搅拌棒搅打咖啡混合物，直到变得轻盈、起泡且绵密。将冷牛奶倒入玻璃杯或咖啡杯中，把打发好的咖啡加在上面。

drinks.name: Danish Summer
ingredients_zh: 4厘升罗格斯托夫草莓大黄酒
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Råstoff Strawberry-Rhubarb over ice and top with Sprite. Then add freshly squeezed lime and decorate with a rosemary twig. Sweet and lovely like a warm summer’s day.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 Råstoff 草莓大黄倒在冰上，再用雪碧补满。然后加入现挤的青柠汁，并用一枝迷迭香装饰。甜美可人，如同温暖的夏日。

drinks.name: Dark and Stormy
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the Dark Rum, Ginger Beer and Lime juice in a glass full of ice cubes. Stir the ingredients. Garnish glass with lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装满冰块的杯中混合黑朗姆酒、姜汁啤酒和青柠汁。搅拌材料。用青柠角装饰杯口。

drinks.name: Dawet
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare ingredients, mix all ingredients until there are no lumps of flour. Turn on the low heat, stir until the mixture begins to thicken and weigh, turn off the heat, prepare ice cubes and give enough water in a rather large container, to print the cendol mixture with cendol mold. For the sugar sauce: boil all ingredients until the sugar dissolves stir and strain. For the coconut milk: boil all ingredients to boil and take the leaf leaves to wait for cold, prepare and arrange cendol along with sugar sauce and coconut milk according to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备材料，将所有材料混合至没有面粉颗粒。开小火，搅拌至混合物开始变稠并变重，然后关火，准备冰块并在一个较大的容器中加足量的水，用珍多模具印出珍多混合物。制作糖浆：将所有材料煮沸至糖溶解，搅拌并过滤。制作椰奶：将所有材料煮沸，取出叶片，待冷却后，根据口味搭配糖浆和椰奶准备并摆盘珍多。

drinks.name: Dayak Onion Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Peel and slice the Dayak onions into thin pieces. Boil 2 cups of water in a pot and add the sliced Dayak onions. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until the water turns reddish. Strain the tea into a cup and let it cool slightly. Add honey to taste, and serve warm.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将达雅洋葱去皮并切成薄片。在锅中煮沸 2 杯水，加入切好的达雅洋葱。小火煮 10-15 分钟，直到水变成淡红色。将茶水滤入杯中，稍微放凉。按口味加入蜂蜜，趁热享用。

drinks.name: Death in the Afternoon
drinks.name_display: 午后之死（Death in the Afternoon）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour one jigger absinthe into a Champagne glass. Add iced Champagne until it attains the proper opalescent milkiness. Drink three to five of these slowly.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一份苦艾酒倒入香槟杯中。加入冰镇香槟，直到呈现恰当的乳白色光泽。慢慢饮用三到五杯。

drinks.name: Death in the Gulf Stream
drinks.name_display: 湾流之死（Death in the Gulf Stream）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice. Fill glass with crushed ice. Strain into glass and garnish with sliced lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与冰一起摇匀。在杯中装满碎冰。滤入杯中，用青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Debonair
ingredients_zh: 75毫升单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled glass. Garnish with a lemon twist
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与冰一起搅拌。滤入冰镇的玻璃杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Desert Colada
drinks.instructions_en: Prickly Pear Syrup in the bottom of a hurricane glass. Combine next four ingredients in a blender carafe. Blend until smooth and pour over top of Prickly Pear Syrup. Swirl with spoon. Garnish with pineapple and cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将仙人掌果糖浆倒入飓风杯底部。将接下来四种材料放入搅拌机杯中混合。搅打至顺滑，倒在仙人掌果糖浆上面。用勺子搅出漩涡。用菠萝和樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Burhani/Borhani
drinks.instructions_en: Whisk the yogurt well. In a blender add mint leaves, coriander leaves, chopped green chili and minced ginger. Puree until smooth. Then add roasted coriander powder, cumin powder, mustard seeds powder, white pepper powder, sugar and black salt. Blend again by adding whisked yogurt and water. Whizz until frothy. Keep it refrigerator and let it become cold. Serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将酸奶充分搅打均匀。在搅拌机中加入薄荷叶、香菜叶、切碎的青辣椒和姜末。搅打成顺滑的泥状。然后加入烤香菜粉、孜然粉、芥菜籽粉、白胡椒粉、糖和黑盐。加入打发好的酸奶和水再次搅拌。搅打至起泡。放入冰箱冷藏至冰凉。冷饮享用。

drinks.name: Detox Green Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Wash and chop ingredients Blend to a smooth puree Garnish with mint leaves and serve
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料洗净切碎，搅打成顺滑的泥状，用薄荷叶装饰后享用。

drinks.name: Detox Green Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Heat a cup of water in a pan. As water starts boiling off the flame, and put green tea leaves and dried basil. Cover it for 1 min and sevie it. Cool it down. Meanwhile add mint leaves, lemon slice and honey in a jar. Now add this cooled tea. Add remaining water in jar, and mix well. Green tea detox water is ready, consume this after 4- 5 hour or overnight.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在锅中加热一杯水。当水开始沸腾时离火，放入绿茶茶叶和干罗勒。盖上盖子焖 1 分钟，然后滤出。将其放凉。同时，在罐子中加入薄荷叶、柠檬片和蜂蜜。现在倒入放凉的茶。在罐中加入剩余的水，充分混合。绿茶排毒水就做好了，4-5 小时后或隔夜后饮用。

drinks.name: Devil's Ice Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all the alcohol in a large Collins glass or a tumbler. Top with the sour mix (lemon & lime juice and 1 sugar cube) and cola. Gently stir. Add crushed ice. Garnish with a lemon and a lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有酒精饮品在大号柯林杯或平底杯中摇匀。加入酸甜混合液（柠檬汁、青柠汁和 1 块方糖）和可乐。轻轻搅拌。加入碎冰。用一片柠檬和青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Devil's Own
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice. Stir well and strain into a Coupe glass. Garnish with a lemon twist
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入装有冰块的调酒杯中。充分搅拌，滤入碟形香槟杯。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Diana's lips
ingredients_en: 4.5 cl Mezcal infused with cocoa beans and pink berries
ingredients_zh: 4.5厘升浸泡可可豆和粉红胡椒的梅斯卡尔
厘升舒味思木槿汤力水
drinks.instructions_en: Soak part of a tumbler glass in hibiscus powder. Pour the mezcal infused with cocoa beans and pink berries. Add the lime juice. Complete with Schweppes Tonic Hibiscus. Decorate your glass with slices of lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将平底杯的一部分杯身蘸上木槿花粉。倒入浸泡过可可豆和粉红胡椒的梅斯卡尔酒。加入青柠汁。用怡泉木槿花汤力水补满。用青柠片装饰杯子。

drinks.name: Dirty Snowmen
drinks.instructions_en: Pour melted chocolate and chocolate shavings into separate shallow dishes. Dip rims of two mugs in melted chocolate then immediately dip in chocolate shavings. Using a medium cookie scoop, add a few scoops of ice cream into each mug. Pour hot chocolate and Baileys on top. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with any extra chocolate shavings.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将融化的巧克力和巧克力碎分别倒入两个浅盘中。将两个马克杯的杯口蘸上融化的巧克力，然后立即蘸上巧克力碎。用中号冰淇淋勺，在每个马克杯中加入几勺冰淇淋。倒入热巧克力和百利甜酒。挤上打发的奶油，撒上剩余的巧克力碎。

drinks.name: Dolce Vita
drinks.instructions_en: Place the ice in a large glass. Add gancia and sparkling gancia. Add the drops of aromatic bitter. Decorate with orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大玻璃杯中放入冰块。加入甘恰和起泡甘恰。加入几滴芳香苦精。用橙片装饰。

drinks.name: Dole Whip Lemonade
drinks.name_display: 多尔雪葩柠檬水（Dole Whip Lemonade）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend frozen pineapple, lemonade, and coconut milk in a blender. Pour into glasses and garnish each with a pineapple wedge and a maraschino cherry. That's all and very easy to make! Enjoy the cold refreshing dessert!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冷冻菠萝、柠檬水和椰奶放入搅拌机中搅打。倒入杯中，每杯用一角菠萝和一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。就这么简单，非常容易制作！享用这款冰爽的甜品吧！

drinks.name: Dom Pedro
drinks.instructions_en: Add your ice-cream, coconut cream, and amarula cream into a blender. Add a few cubes of ice (optional). Blend it all up & pour into glass. Drizzle Frangelico on top. Garnish with cinnamon and chocolate.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰淇淋、椰浆和奶油利口酒（Amarula）放入搅拌机中。加入几块冰块（可选）。全部搅打均匀后倒入杯中。淋上榛子利口酒（Frangelico）。撒上肉桂和巧克力装饰。

drinks.name: Doodh Cola
drinks.instructions_en: Take a large glass and add milk and ice cube. Shake for 4 to 5 time. Then add chilled Cola and again shake another few times. Serve chilled Doodh Cola.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个大玻璃杯，加入牛奶和冰块。摇晃 4 到 5 次。然后加入冰镇可乐，再摇晃几次。冷饮享用牛奶可乐（Doodh Cola）。

drinks.name: Dorflinger
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Stir well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Add an extra dash (or two) of orange bitters to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分搅拌。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。按口味额外加入一滴（或两滴）橙味苦精。

drinks.name: Dr. Disaronno
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to taste (5 cubes recommended) Pour 2 oz of Disaronno Pour half a can of Dr. Pepper (6 oz) Mix well
drinks.instructions_zh: 按口味加入冰块（建议 5 块）。倒入 2 盎司 Disaronno 杏仁利口酒。倒入半罐 Dr. Pepper 博士胡椒汽水（6 盎司）。充分混合。

drinks.name: Dragon Fruit Smoothie
ingredients_en: 1 cup cubed and frozen dragon fruit
drinks.instructions_en: Add frozen fruits, milk, lime juice and protein powder to the blender, and blend until very smooth Add almond milk as needed to thin out the desired texture
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冷冻水果、牛奶、青柠汁和蛋白粉放入搅拌机中，搅打至非常顺滑。根据需要加入杏仁奶稀释，以达到理想的质地。

drinks.name: Dragon's Breath Mojito
ingredients_en: 1 small red chili (sliced thinly, seeds removed for less spice)
ingredients_zh: 1个小朝天椒（sliced thinly, seeds removed for less spice）
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the mint leaves and chili slices in the bottom of a glass with the lime juice and simple syrup. Add ice cubes and pour in the white rum. Top with club soda and stir gently to combine. Garnish with a sprig of mint and a thin slice of chili. Serve immediately and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在玻璃杯底部将薄荷叶和辣椒片与青柠汁、糖浆一起捣压。加入冰块，倒入白朗姆酒。加入苏打水补满，轻轻搅拌混合。用一枝薄荷和一片薄辣椒装饰。立即享用！

drinks.name: Drunken Monkey Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add the juice, coconut rum, spiced rum, and 4-5 shakes of bitters. Shake for 30 seconds. Pour into 2 iced tumblers or one tall glass. Then pour in 1-2 teaspoons of cherry juice and let it settle at the bottom of the glass. Garnish with a lime slice, pineapple wedge, and a cherry. Zest fresh nutmeg over the top and serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装满冰，加入果汁、椰子朗姆酒、香料朗姆酒和 4-5 抖苦精。摇匀 30 秒。倒入 2 个加冰的平底杯中，或一个大玻璃杯中。然后倒入 1-2 茶匙樱桃汁，让它沉在杯底。用青柠片、一角菠萝和一颗樱桃装饰。在顶部刨上新鲜肉豆蔻，即可享用！

drinks.name: Drunken Peanut Butter Cups
drinks.name_display: 醉花生酱杯（Drunken Peanut Butter Cups）
ingredients_en: 1/4 cup Peanut Butter (optional, for garnishing the rim of the glass)
1/2 cup Crushed Reese's Pieces (optional, for garnishing the rim of the glass)
ingredients_zh: 1/4杯花生酱（optional, for garnishing the rim of the glass）
1/2杯碎花生酱巧克力豆（optional, for garnishing the rim of the glass）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine vodka and Reese's Pieces in a sealable container (for example a mason jar). Cover with a tight-fitting lid and shake. Refridgerate overnight, then strain. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice, then pour over strained vodka, milk, and chocolate liqueur. Shake until chilled. Put peanut butter on one small plate and crushed Reese's Pieces on another. Dunk tops of two cocktail glasses in peanut butter then roll in crushed Reese's Pieces. Drizzle about a tablespoon of chocolate syrup into each glass. Divide cocktail mixture between glasses and garnish each with a peanut butter cup.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和 Reese's Pieces 巧克力豆放入密封容器中（例如梅森罐）。盖紧盖子并摇晃。冷藏过夜，然后过滤。在摇酒壶中装满冰，倒入过滤后的伏特加、牛奶和巧克力利口酒。摇至冰凉。在一个小碟中放花生酱，另一个碟中放碾碎的 Reese's Pieces 巧克力豆。将两个鸡尾酒杯的杯口蘸入花生酱，然后在碾碎的 Reese's Pieces 中滚一圈。在每个杯中淋入约一汤匙巧克力糖浆。将鸡尾酒混合液分入各杯中，每杯用一块花生酱巧克力杯装饰。

drinks.name: Dubliner
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients with ice cubes. Strain into a cocktail glass. Decorate with cherries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料与冰块混合。滤入鸡尾酒杯中。用樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Dutchman’s Daiquiri
ingredients_en: 1/4 Red chile pepper, seeded and sliced
1⁄2 oz Rich sugar syrup (2 parts sugar, 1 part water)
ingredients_zh: 1/2盎司浓糖浆（2 parts sugar, 1 part water）
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the chile in a shaker. Add the remaining ingredients and fill with ice. Shake, and double-strain into a Martini glass. Garnish with a red chile pepper.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中将辣椒捣碎。加入其余材料并加满冰。摇匀，双重过滤倒入马天尼杯中。用一根红辣椒装饰。

drinks.name: Earl Grey Gin Tea
drinks.name_display: 伯爵金酒茶（Earl Grey Gin Tea）
ingredients_en: 1 tbsp honey or sweetener of choice
1 splash milk or cream of choice (optional)
drinks.instructions_en: Steep earl grey tea in boiled water for 4 minutes. Remove tea and stir in honey or sweetener of choice until dissolved. Throw in ice cubes and mix until cooled. Add more if needed. Add a shot of your favorite gin. Fill with cold water, leaving room for milk or cream if desired. Top with milk or cream of choice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伯爵茶放入沸水中浸泡 4 分钟。取出茶叶，拌入蜂蜜或你选择的甜味剂直至溶解。放入冰块并搅拌至冷却。如有需要可再加冰块。加入一份你最喜欢的金酒。加入冷水补满，如需可留出加入牛奶或奶油的空间。最后加入你选择的牛奶或奶油。

drinks.name: Easy sangria
drinks.instructions_en: Put the chopped fruit in a bowl and sprinkle over the sugar and cinnamon, then stir to coat.  Cover and leave to macerate in the fridge for at least 1 hr, or ideally overnight. Fill a large jug with ice. Stir the macerated fruit mixture to ensure the sugar is dissolved, then tip into the jug with the wine and brandy. Stir, then top up with the sparkling water and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将切好的水果放入碗中，撒上糖和肉桂，然后搅拌使其裹匀。盖上盖子，放入冰箱浸泡至少 1 小时，最好浸泡过夜。在大壶中装入冰块。搅拌浸泡好的水果混合物，确保糖已溶解，然后连同葡萄酒和白兰地一起倒入壶中。搅拌，再加入气泡水补满，即可享用。

drinks.name: Egg Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the egg yolks, 20 ml of condensed milk, sugar and the vanilla extract in a bowl, then whisk until frothy and fluffy. Pour in the rest of condensed milk after brewing the coffee and stir gently Pour the egg on top of the coffee. Garnish with the cocoa powder on top. Serve the cup of coffee inside a bowl of hot water to keep the it warm.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在碗中混合蛋黄、20 毫升炼乳、糖和香草精，然后搅打至起泡蓬松。冲泡好咖啡后倒入剩余的炼乳，轻轻搅拌。将蛋液倒在咖啡上面。在表面撒上可可粉装饰。将咖啡杯放在一碗热水中，以保持其温热。

drinks.name: Eggnog
drinks.instructions_en: In a large saucepan, whisk together the eggs, honey and salt. Gradually add 2 cups (500 mL) of milk. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture coats the back of the spoon, 12 to 15 minutes. (Avoid boiling). Pour into a large fireproof bowl: stir in the rest of the milk and the vanilla. Place bowl over ice water and stir frequently until mixture is cold, about 15 minutes. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大平底锅中，将鸡蛋、蜂蜜和盐搅打均匀。逐渐加入 2 杯（500 毫升）牛奶。用中小火加热，不断搅拌，直到混合物能挂住勺背，约需 12 至 15 分钟。（避免煮沸。）倒入一个大的耐热碗中，拌入剩余的牛奶和香草精。将碗放在冰水上，经常搅拌至混合物变冷，约需 15 分钟。盖上盖子，冷藏至少 3 小时。

drinks.name: Egyptian Fakhfakhina Drink
drinks.name_display: 埃及法赫法希纳饮（Egyptian Fakhfakhina Drink）
ingredients_en: As you like Honey, to taste (optional)
As you like Crushed nuts, to taste (optional)
drinks.instructions_en: Chop the fruits into small pieces. Mix the fruit pieces in a bowl. In a separate bowl, mix the pineapple juice and the orange juice. In each serving cup, mix one-fourth of the fruit and one-fourth of the juice. Spread the cream evenly over each cup, as well as honey and nuts.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水果切成小块。在碗中混合水果块。在另一个碗中，混合菠萝汁和橙汁。在每个饮用杯中，加入四分之一的水果和四分之一的果汁混合。在每个杯子上均匀地铺上奶油，以及蜂蜜和坚果。

drinks.name: Egyptian Sobia Drink
drinks.name_display: 埃及索比亚饮（Egyptian Sobia Drink）
ingredients_en: 1/4 cup sugar (more or less depending on your liking)
ingredients_zh: 1/4杯糖（more or less depending on your liking）
drinks.instructions_en: Grind the rice to fine powder. Combine water and rice powder in a bowl and let it set for at least six hours in the fridge. Add the rice water and the rest of the ingredients in a blender. Blend very well – might take you 3-4 minutes until well combined. Strain with cheese cloth, coffee filter or tea strainer. Chill and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将米研磨成细粉。在碗中将水和米粉混合，放入冰箱静置至少六个小时。将米水和其余材料加入搅拌机中。充分搅拌——可能需要 3-4 分钟才能完全混合。用纱布、咖啡滤纸或滤茶网过滤。冷藏后享用。

drinks.name: El Diablo
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the tequila, cassis, and lime juice into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Strain into a Collins glass filled with ice. Top with ginger beer.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将龙舌兰、黑加仑利口酒和青柠汁倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。滤入装有冰块的柯林杯中。用姜汁啤酒补满。

drinks.name: El Presidente
ingredients_en: 1 oz Orange Curaçao (or Triple Sec, Cointreau)
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the rum, vermouth, orange curaçao and dash of grandine into a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Granish with orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、味美思、橙皮利口酒和一滴红石榴糖浆倒入摇酒壶中。加入冰块充分摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Elderflower Cooler
ingredients_en: 1.9 units of alcohol per tall glass
ingredients_zh: 20毫升博特格林接骨木花糖浆
drinks.instructions_en: Half fill a glass with cubed ice and pour over 50ml Gin. Add a slice or two of cool cucumber and some mint leaves. Splash over 20ml Bottlegreen® elderflower cordial, fill with more ice and top up with chilled soda. Stir and finish off with a couple of extra slices of cucumber and a final sprig of mint.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装入一半冰块，倒入 50 毫升金酒。加入一两片清爽的黄瓜和一些薄荷叶。淋入 20 毫升 Bottlegreen® 接骨木花糖浆，再加入更多冰块，用冰镇苏打水补满。搅拌，最后用几片额外的黄瓜和一小枝薄荷点缀。

drinks.name: Elderflower French 75
drinks.name_display: 接骨木花法式七五（Elderflower French 75）
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice, gin, elderflower liqueur and lemon juice to mixing glass and shake until combined and chilled. Strain mix into base of champagne flute or martini glass and top with champagne. Garnish with a lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰、金酒、接骨木花利口酒和柠檬汁加入调酒杯中，摇至混合并冰冷。将混合液滤入香槟笛形杯或马天尼杯的底部，再用香槟补满。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Elderflower-tini
drinks.instructions_en: Chill serving glass in freezer. Pour ingredients into mixing glass with ice in order listed and shake. Strain into chilled serving glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将饮用杯放入冷冻室冷却。按所列顺序将材料倒入装有冰块的调酒杯中并摇匀。滤入冰镇的饮用杯中。

drinks.name: Embuscade
ingredients_zh: 4厘升卡尔瓦多斯苹果白兰地
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the blackcurrant syrup and the lemon juice in a glass Stir well with a spoon Add the white wine and the Calvados brandy Stir again Add the cold beer slowly
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黑加仑糖浆和柠檬汁倒入杯中，用勺子充分搅拌。加入白葡萄酒和卡尔瓦多斯苹果白兰地，再次搅拌。慢慢加入冰镇啤酒。

drinks.name: English Garden Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 英式花园鸡尾酒（English Garden Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Add gin, lime juice, elderflower juice, and apple juice to a shaker with crushed ice and shake it Add to a glass with a slice of cucumber and mint leaves
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、青柠汁、接骨木花汁和苹果汁加入装有碎冰的摇酒壶中摇匀。倒入放有一片黄瓜和薄荷叶的玻璃杯中。

drinks.name: Es Jeruk
drinks.instructions_en: Choose the raw mangoes which are tart. You can keep the skin on before boiling the mangoes. It gives a very distinct flavour to the Panna. Peeling the skin before boiling makes the process very easy. If the Panna is not very tangy, you can add some lemon juice to it. Boil Mango with mild heat in 1 cup of water. You can also roast mango before boiling if needed for crispy taste. The subtly smoky flavour in this drink will take it to the next level. Strain into the prepared glass. Garnish with a parsley sprig, 2 speared green olives and a lime wedge and a celery stalk (optional). Inside the glass Dissolve sugar with hot water. Then split 2 oranges and squeeze. Pour in a glass of sugar and stir well. Add ice cubes. And serve it.
drinks.instructions_zh: 选择酸味的生芒果。煮芒果之前可以保留果皮。这会给 Panna 带来非常独特的风味。煮之前去皮会让过程变得非常简单。如果 Panna 不够酸，可以加一些柠檬汁。将芒果用文火在 1 杯水中煮。如需要口感更脆，也可以在煮之前先烤一下芒果。这款饮品中微妙的烟熏风味会让它更上一层楼。滤入准备好的杯中。用一枝欧芹、2 颗串起的绿橄榄、一角青柠和一根芹菜梗装饰（可选）。在杯中用热水将糖溶解。然后将 2 个橙子切开并挤汁。倒入一杯糖并充分搅拌。加入冰块。即可享用。

drinks.name: Es Sarang Burung
ingredients_en: 1/2 fruit Melon, pick up the fruit with a baller
1 tablespoons Basil seeds, soak in a little warm water
ingredients_zh: 1汤匙罗勒籽，用少量温水浸泡
drinks.instructions_en: In a saucepan, mix all ingredients. Stir well and boil until boiling. Remove and pour into a square pan. Let it harden. Grate the jelly lengthwise with a cheese grater. Set aside.  In a large bowl, mix melon, nata, kiwi, grated agar, syrup, water and ice cubes. Stir well. Add basil seeds.  Ready to serve in small glasses.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在平底锅中混合所有材料。充分搅拌并煮沸。离火后倒入方形盘中。让它凝固变硬。用奶酪刨丝器将果冻纵向刨成丝。备用。在一个大碗中，混合甜瓜、椰果、猕猴桃、刨好的琼脂、糖浆、水和冰块。充分搅拌。加入罗勒籽。即可盛入小杯中享用。

drinks.name: Espanhola
ingredients_zh: 红葡萄酒或干白葡萄酒
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the pineapple in pieces. Put all the ingredients, without the ice, in a blender and mix all together. Add the ice and mix a bit again. Serve in large glasses, and use the pineapple peel as garnish
drinks.instructions_zh: 将菠萝切成块。将所有材料（不含冰）放入搅拌机中混合。加入冰块再稍微搅拌。倒入大玻璃杯中享用，并用菠萝皮装饰。

drinks.name: Espresso Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Put the sugar in a small pan over medium heat and pour in 50ml water to make the syrup. Stir the sugar and bring it to a boil. Turn off the heat and allow the syrup to cool. Chill two martini glasses in the fridge. Pour 1 tbsp into a cocktail shaker along with a some ice, vodka, espresso, and coffee liqueur. Shake until the outside of the cocktail shaker feels icy cold. Strain into the chilled glasses. For decoration, you can put full coffee beans on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖放入小锅中，用中火加热，倒入 50 毫升水制成糖浆。搅拌糖并煮沸。关火，让糖浆冷却。将两个马天尼杯放入冰箱冷藏。将 1 汤匙糖浆连同一些冰、伏特加、浓缩咖啡和咖啡利口酒倒入摇酒壶中。摇至摇酒壶外壁感觉冰冷。滤入冰镇的杯中。装饰方面，可以在上面放整颗咖啡豆。

drinks.name: Fall Old-Fashioned
drinks.instructions_en: Place bourbon and spices in a glass jar with a lid. Allow to infuse for 24 hours, shaking occasionally. Strain the bourbon into a clean jar. This makes enough for 8 cocktails. Make the cocktail: Add the maple syrup, water, and bitters to the bottom of an old-fashioned glass. Add the ice and the bourbon, and stir for about 30 seconds. Garnish with orange peel: Rub a piece of orange peel around the rim of the glass and drop it in.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将波本威士忌和香料放入带盖的玻璃罐中。浸泡 24 小时，期间偶尔摇晃。将波本威士忌滤入干净的罐中。这足够制作 8 杯鸡尾酒。制作鸡尾酒：将枫糖浆、水和苦精加入古典杯底部。加入冰块和波本威士忌，搅拌约 30 秒。用橙皮装饰：用一片橙皮擦拭杯口，然后将其放入杯中。

drinks.name: Fast Food Classic
drinks.instructions_en: Make your fast food order a meal so it comes with a drink Create the perfect blend of sodas at the neverage station. Don't be afraid to stray from the recipe and try new things Drink at least 1/3 of it at the beverage station and fill it back up Enjoy! Optionally, head back for a refill or try a new blend!
drinks.instructions_zh: 把你的快餐订单升级为套餐，这样就会附带一杯饮料。在饮料区调配出完美的汽水混合。不要害怕偏离配方，尝试新花样。在饮料区至少喝掉 1/3，然后再把它加满。享用吧！你还可以回去续杯或尝试新的混合搭配！

drinks.name: Fernet with coke
drinks.instructions_en: Put the ice in a 500ml glass. Serve the Fernet (Branca is the best). Slowly serve the Coca Cola till the glass is full.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块放入 500 毫升的杯中。倒入菲奈特苦精（Branca 最佳）。慢慢倒入可口可乐直至杯中加满。

drinks.name: Fig Bourbon Cider Smash
drinks.name_zh: 无花果波本苹果酒斯玛什
drinks.name_display: 无花果波本苹果酒斯玛什（Fig Bourbon Cider Smash）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the apple cider, orange zest, orange juice, fig preserves, bourbon, and balsamic vinegar (optional) in a cocktail shaker. Shake to combine. Strain into a glass filled with ice. Top off with sparkling water and garnish with a fresh fig. Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苹果酒、橙皮、橙汁、无花果果酱、波本威士忌和香醋（可选）放入摇酒壶中。摇匀混合。滤入装有冰块的杯中。用气泡水补满，并用一颗新鲜无花果装饰。干杯！

drinks.name: The Marriage of Figaro Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 费加罗的婚礼鸡尾酒（The Marriage of Figaro Cocktail）
ingredients_zh: 1盎司无花果浸泡波本威士忌
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the two bourbons, Cardamaro, and allspice dram in a mixing glass filled with ice. Stir well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种波本威士忌、Cardamaro 和五香朗姆酒倒入装有冰块的调酒杯中。充分搅拌。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。享用吧！

drinks.name: Fireball Hot Toddies
drinks.instructions_en: Bring water to a boil and dip glasses in caramel. Add honey to each glass and squeeze lemon juice. Pour over Fireball and boiling water and stir until honey is dissolved. Top with cinnamon stick and star anise.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水煮沸，并将酒杯口蘸上焦糖。在每个杯中加入蜂蜜并挤入柠檬汁。倒入 Fireball 肉桂威士忌和沸水，搅拌至蜂蜜溶解。放入肉桂棒和八角装饰。

drinks.name: Fireball Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Chill the cinnamon whiskey if desired. Pour into a shot glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 如需要可将肉桂威士忌冷藏。倒入小酒杯中享用。

drinks.name: Firetruck: Emergency Response
drinks.name_display: 消防车紧急响应（Firetruck: Emergency Response）
drinks.instructions_en: Put ice in glass, add Jäger and vodka, finally top up with red soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中放入冰块，加入野格和伏特加，最后用红色汽水补满。

drinks.name: Firetruck
drinks.instructions_en: Put ice in glass, add Jäger, finally top up with red soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中放入冰块，加入野格，最后用红色汽水补满。

drinks.name: Flaming Engineer
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the molson canadian into a nice big mug (~20 oz mug should do) Add the amaretto and the whisky Float the orange juice on the top Serve and drink
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 Molson Canadian 啤酒倒入一个漂亮的大马克杯中（约 20 盎司的马克杯即可）。加入杏仁利口酒和威士忌。将橙汁漂浮在最上层。上桌饮用。

drinks.name: Flaming Moe
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients except rum in a highball glass. Stir. Float the rum on the top. Ignite with a match and extinguish before drinking.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除朗姆酒外的所有材料倒入高球杯中。搅拌。将朗姆酒漂浮在最上层。用火柴点燃，饮用前熄灭。

drinks.name: Four Horsemen Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all spirits into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有烈酒倒入小酒杯中。立即享用。

drinks.name: French 75
drinks.instructions_en: Combine gin, syrup and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake vigorously and strain into a chilled Champagne glass. Top up with Champagne and stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、糖浆和柠檬汁放入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。用力摇匀，滤入冰镇的香槟杯中。用香槟补满，轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: French Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Build ingredients in a Boston glass. Top with cubed ice and shake. Fine strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a raspberry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料在波士顿杯中调制。加入冰块摇匀。细滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。用一颗覆盆子装饰。

drinks.name: French Pearl
drinks.instructions_en: Add gin, simple syrup, and lime juice into a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake well untill cocktail is cool. Pour cocktail into a coupe glass, add a dash of absinthe. Clap the mint leaf and float it on top of the cocktail.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、糖浆和青柠汁加入摇酒壶中。加入冰块摇匀，直到鸡尾酒变冷。将鸡尾酒倒入碟形香槟杯中，加入一滴苦艾酒。拍打薄荷叶，让它漂浮在鸡尾酒表面。

drinks.name: French Sangria
ingredients_en: 1 / Peach / nectarine / other seasonal fruits thinly sliced
ingredients_zh: 桃子、油桃或其他时令水果切片
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the orange and lemon into thin slices. Combine all ingredients in a container except soda; leave aside a few slices of fruit for garnish Strain to serve in a Punch Bowl or large glass pitcher. Add ice & remaining fruit as garnish, top with the soda. Garnish: Fruit from mix or freshly sliced, on and/or in each glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙子和柠檬切成薄片。将除苏打水外的所有材料放入容器中混合；留出几片水果备用作装饰。过滤后盛入潘趣盆或大玻璃壶中享用。加入冰块和剩余水果作装饰，用苏打水补满。装饰：将混合中的水果或新鲜切片的水果，放在每个杯子上和/或杯内。

drinks.name: Frosé
drinks.instructions_en: Open the rosé and pour 2/3 cup into a glass measuring cup; set aside for when serving. Remove the tops of the strawberries and cut them in half. In a blender, blend the remaining rose, strawberries, and honey until smooth and fully combined. Then pour the mixture through a strainer and into a covered baking dish. Transfer the baking dish to the freezer and freeze at least 6 hours, or overnight. (The alcohol in the mixture will keep it a slushy texture instead of freezing solid.) Blend the mixture again until it comes to a fluffy texture. To serve, place the blended mixture into a glass. Then pour a splash of rose into each glass (this step is important: it gives the final texture and brings in the character of the rose). If desired, garnish with strawberries and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 打开桃红葡萄酒，将 2/3 杯倒入玻璃量杯中；留待上桌时使用。去掉草莓的蒂，切成两半。在搅拌机中，将剩余的桃红葡萄酒、草莓和蜂蜜搅打至顺滑且完全混合。然后将混合液通过滤网倒入带盖的烤盘中。将烤盘放入冷冻室冷冻至少 6 小时，或冷冻过夜。（混合物中的酒精会使其保持冰沙质地，而不会完全冻硬。）再次搅打混合物，直到呈蓬松的质地。上桌时，将搅打好的混合物放入杯中。然后在每个杯中倒入少许桃红葡萄酒（这一步很重要：它能带来最终的口感和桃红葡萄酒的特色）。如需要，可用草莓装饰后享用。

drinks.name: Frosted Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the lemon juice and the sugar together until the sugar is fully dissolved. Add water to dilute and let it chill. In a blender, add the lemonade and ice cream. Blend until it's smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬汁和糖混合，直到糖完全溶解。加水稀释并放凉。在搅拌机中加入柠檬水和冰淇淋。搅打至顺滑。

drinks.name: Frozen Cantaloupe Margarita
drinks.name_display: 冰镇哈密瓜玛格丽特（Frozen Cantaloupe Margarita）
ingredients_en: 1-2 tablespoons agave or honey to taste
ingredients_zh: 1至2汤匙龙舌兰糖浆或蜂蜜适量
drinks.instructions_en: Slice a thin piece of rind off both ends of cantaloupe so that it can stand upright. Cut in half horizontally and remove seeds. Scoop out flesh and set aside, save cantaloupe halves. Combine the cantaloupe, coconut milk, tequila, lime juice, Cointreau, and agave in a blender and pulse until smooth. If needed, add ice to get a slushy consistency. Divide between cantaloupe bowls (halves). Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将哈密瓜两端的薄皮切掉，使其能立起来。横向切成两半并去除籽。挖出果肉备用，保留哈密瓜的两半外壳。将哈密瓜果肉、椰奶、龙舌兰、青柠汁、君度和龙舌兰糖浆放入搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑。如需要，加入冰块以获得冰沙般的质地。分装入哈密瓜碗（两半外壳）中。干杯！

drinks.name: Fuzzy Navel
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to a glass. Add Orange Juice and Peach Schnapps. (Optional) Add an orange slice to garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 杯中加冰。加入橙汁和蜜桃利口酒。（可选）加入一片橙子作装饰。

drinks.name: Galack Colada
drinks.instructions_en: Blend Galack, pineapple juice, rum, coconut milk, and Malibu in a blender until smooth. Pour into a glass along with 500ml  condensed milk on the edge Serve with a cherry and pineapple triangle on the edge, and a white chocolate bar in the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将Galack、菠萝汁、朗姆酒、椰奶和Malibu放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。倒入杯中，并沿杯壁加入500毫升炼乳。杯沿配以一颗樱桃和一块三角形菠萝，杯中放一条白巧克力。

drinks.name: Galaxie Cocktail
ingredients_en: 2 oz Crushed lemon and magic ice
drinks.instructions_en: Rub lime around the edge of the glass and salt the rim. Half fill the glass with crushed lemon ice. Pour the lemon lime juice, simple syrup and triple sec. Stir to mix. Using the back of a spoon, layer the butterfly pea infused tequila. Top with color changing magic ice. Serve with a slice of lemon and lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用青柠擦拭杯口并沾上盐边。杯中装入半杯柠檬碎冰。倒入柠檬青柠汁、糖浆和橙皮利口酒。搅拌混合。用勺背将蝶豆花浸渍龙舌兰分层倒入。顶部放上会变色的魔法冰。配上一片柠檬和青柠即可享用。

drinks.name: Gazpacho
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the tomatoes and the pepper. Triturate all with the mixer. Cool the gazpacho in the fridge for an hour and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将番茄和甜椒切块。全部用搅拌机打碎。将西班牙冷汤放入冰箱冷藏一小时即可享用。

drinks.name: Gibson
drinks.instructions_en: Pour gin and vermouth into a shaker. Stir well with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with pickled onion and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒和味美思倒入摇酒壶。加冰充分搅拌。过滤到冰镇的马天尼杯中。用腌洋葱装饰即可享用。

drinks.name: Gimlet
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a mixing glass with ice, then add the gin, simple syrup and lime juice. Stir the ice and the ingredients with a bar spoon for a few minutes. Strain the cocktail into a chilled martini or cocktail glass. Garnish with the lime wedge/wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在调酒杯中装满冰，然后加入金酒、糖浆和青柠汁。用吧勺搅拌冰和原料几分钟。将鸡尾酒过滤到冰镇的马天尼杯或鸡尾酒杯中。用青柠角或青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Gin Coke
drinks.instructions_en: Pour gin into a glass. Add ice and pour in lime juice. Squeeze fresh lime juice to top and stir - serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒倒入杯中。加冰并倒入青柠汁。挤入新鲜青柠汁至满，搅拌，即可上桌享用！

drinks.name: Gin Elderflower Fizz
drinks.name_display: 金酒接骨木花菲士（Gin Elderflower Fizz）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail glass with ice to chill while you prepare the cocktail. In a cocktail shaker, add the gin, elderflower liqueur, lime juice, and simple syrup. Add ice to the shaker. Shake vigorously for about 15 seconds to thoroughly mix all the ingredients and chill them. Strain the mixture into the chilled cocktail glass. Top the glass with club soda to achieve the desired fizziness. Garnish the cocktail with a twist of lime zest. Serve immediately and enjoy this refreshing Gin Elderflower Fizz!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在准备鸡尾酒时，先在鸡尾酒杯中装满冰以冰镇。在摇酒壶中加入金酒、接骨木花利口酒、青柠汁和糖浆。向摇酒壶中加冰。用力摇晃约15秒，使所有原料充分混合并冷却。将混合物过滤到冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。向杯中加满苏打水，以达至理想的气泡感。用一卷青柠皮装饰鸡尾酒。立即上桌，享用这款清爽的金酒接骨木花菲士！

drinks.name: Gin Fizz with Pomegranate
drinks.name_display: 石榴金酒菲士（Gin Fizz with Pomegranate）
drinks.instructions_en: Before prepare your drink put the club soda on refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Mix the sugar with the lemon juice in a glass of wine. Add the pomegranate and gin. Fill the glass with ice and complete with Club Soda. Add the fresh rosemary - and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在准备饮品前，将苏打水放入冰箱冷藏至少30分钟。在葡萄酒杯中把糖与柠檬汁混合。加入石榴和金酒。在杯中加满冰，并用苏打水补满。加入新鲜迷迭香，即可享用！

drinks.name: Gin fizz
drinks.instructions_en: Add the first four ingredients to a shaker and dry-shake (without ice) for about 10 seconds. Add 3 or 4 ice cubes and shake very well. Double-strain into a chilled fizz glass and top with club soda. Blend with ice. Serve immediately while still cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将前四种原料加入摇酒壶，不加冰干摇约10秒。加入3或4块冰，充分摇匀。双重过滤到冰镇的菲士杯中，并加满苏打水。与冰混合。趁冷立即上桌。

drinks.name: Gin Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Chill glass with ice and soda water. Add the gin, simple syrup, lemon juice, and egg white to a mixing tin and dry shake for 10 seconds. Add ice to the mixing tin and shake for another 10 seconds. Fill glass with ice and strain drink into a glass. Squeeze some lemon zest over the drink and add a lemon twist into the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用冰和苏打水冰镇杯子。将金酒、糖浆、柠檬汁和蛋清加入摇酒壶，干摇10秒。向摇酒壶中加冰，再摇10秒。在杯中装满冰，将饮品过滤到杯中。在饮品上方挤些柠檬皮油，并在杯中放入一片柠檬皮卷。

drinks.name: Gin & Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Pour gin into a glass. Top with lemon wedges and cucumber to your taste. Add ice and pour in tonic water. Squeeze fresh lemon juice to top and stir - serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒倒入杯中。按个人口味放入柠檬角和黄瓜。加冰并倒入汤力水。挤入新鲜柠檬汁至满，搅拌，即可上桌享用！

drinks.name: Gin Tonica
drinks.instructions_en: Add gin and tonic to a balloon glass. Squeeze lime into glass. Fill glass most of the way with clear ice. Garnish drink with grapefruit, juniper berries, steawberry, and rosemary. Serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒和汤力水加入球形杯中。向杯中挤入青柠。将杯子大部分装满透明冰块。用西柚、杜松子、草莓和迷迭香装饰饮品。冷饮上桌。

drinks.name: Ginger Infused Water
drinks.instructions_en: Soak all ingredients overnight. Drink the infused water 600ml a day.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料浸泡过夜。每天饮用600毫升浸泡水。

drinks.name: Ginger Lemon Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare the fresh ginger by slicing it thinly to maximize the surface area. This will help you make a very flavorful tea. Add the water and ginger in a pot and bring to a boil for at least 10 minutes. For a stronger and tangier tea, allow to boil for 20 minutes or more, and use more ginger slices. Remove it from the heat, strain, and add the lime juice and honey to taste. Enjoy your ginger lemon tea.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将新鲜生姜切成薄片，以最大程度增大接触面积。这有助于你煮出非常香浓的茶。将水和姜放入锅中，煮沸至少10分钟。若想得到更浓郁、更开胃的茶，可煮沸20分钟或更久，并多放些姜片。离火，过滤，按口味加入青柠汁和蜂蜜。享用你的姜汁柠檬茶。

drinks.name: Ginger Lime Whiskey Sour
drinks.name_display: 姜青柠威士忌酸（Ginger Lime Whiskey Sour）
drinks.instructions_en: Make your ginger simple syrup by heating the Water (120 mL) and Granulated Sugar (150 g) over medium heat. Stir until combined. Once combined, remove from heat and add Fresh Ginger (1 piece). Let cool. Mix your drink by combining Whiskey (60 mL), Lime Juice (1), Egg White (1), and 1 part ginger syrup in a tumbler. Shake for 20 seconds. Strain into a coupe glass and garnish with Lemons (to taste). Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作姜味糖浆：用中火加热水（120毫升）和白砂糖（150克）。搅拌至融合。融合后离火，加入新鲜生姜（1块）。放凉。在调酒杯中混合威士忌（60毫升）、青柠汁（1份）、蛋清（1份）和1份姜味糖浆来调制饮品。摇晃20秒。过滤到碟形杯中，按口味用柠檬装饰。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Ginger Milk Tea
ingredients_en: 50 gr fresh ginger, peeled and bruised
drinks.instructions_en: Boil all ginger syrup ingredients on a stovetop. Reduce heat and simmer for 5-10 minutes until all the sugar has dissolved. Strain to get a clear syrup. Steep the teabag in the hot water according to the manufacturer instruction. Pour the milk and the ginger syrup. Stir to combine. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在炉灶上煮所有姜味糖浆原料。转小火炖5-10分钟，直至糖全部溶解。过滤得到清澈的糖浆。按厂商说明将茶包浸泡在热水中。倒入牛奶和姜味糖浆。搅拌混合。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Ginger Mint Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Finely slice the ginger into thin rounds/strips Strip the stems of the fresh mint In a saucepan or a water boiler, bring 1 cup of water to boil Pour the water into a cup, steep in the finely sliced ginger and sprigs of mint for 3-5 minutes
drinks.instructions_zh: 将生姜切成细薄的圆片或细丝。摘下新鲜薄荷的叶子。在奶锅或烧水壶中将1杯水煮沸。将水倒入杯中，放入切好的姜片和薄荷枝浸泡3-5分钟。

drinks.name: Gingerbread Eggnog
drinks.instructions_en: Wet rims of four cocktail glasses and dip in cinnamon sugar. In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, add eggnog, vodka, Kahlúa, molasses, and ginger and shake to combine. Pour into rimmed glasses. Top with whipped cream and drizzle with molasses before serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将四个鸡尾酒杯的杯口沾湿，再蘸上肉桂糖。在装满冰的摇酒壶中加入蛋奶酒、伏特加、甘露咖啡利口酒、糖蜜和姜，摇晃混合。倒入已做糖边的杯中。上桌前挤上打发的奶油并淋上糖蜜。

drinks.name: Gingerbread latte
ingredients_en: 1½ teaspoon ground ginger, plus extra to serve
¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg plus extra to serve
whipped cream and mini gingerbread men, to serve
ingredients_zh: 1又1/2茶匙姜粉另备少许供上桌
打发奶油和迷你姜饼人，供食用
drinks.instructions_en: In a bowl, mix together the spices, sugar and vanilla extract. Heat 100ml of the milk in a pan with the spice and sugar mix, whisking until the sugar has dissolved. Whisk in the remaining milk in additions until incorporated, then heat through  until steaming. Put a shot of espresso in each glass (if using) and top up with the spiced milk. Top with whipped cream, extra spices and a mini gingerbread man.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在碗中将香料、糖和香草精混合在一起。在锅中加热100毫升牛奶与香料糖混合物，搅拌至糖溶解。分次搅入剩余的牛奶至完全融合，然后加热至冒热气。每个杯中放一份浓缩咖啡（如使用），再用香料牛奶补满。顶部加上打发的奶油、额外的香料和一个迷你姜饼人。

drinks.name: Glögg
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients in a pot. Heat until the wine barely reaches a simmer: avoid boiling off the alcohol. Reduce the heat and let the wine simmer for 5-30 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain the mixture. Serve in heat proof glasses and garnish to your taste!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料放入锅中混合。加热至葡萄酒刚微微沸腾：避免酒精挥发。转小火，让葡萄酒慢炖5-30分钟。离火并过滤混合物。倒入耐热杯中，按个人口味装饰即可享用！

drinks.name: Glühwein
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan and heat until the wine reaches a simmer. Avoid boiling off the alcohol. Reduce the heat and let the wine simmer for 5-30 minutes. Remove from  heat and strain the mixture. Pour into glass mugs, serve, and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料放入奶锅中混合，加热至葡萄酒微微沸腾。避免酒精挥发。转小火，让葡萄酒慢炖5-30分钟。离火并过滤混合物。倒入玻璃马克杯中，上桌享用！

drinks.name: Godchild
drinks.instructions_en: Pour both ingredients directly into Old-Fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种原料直接倒入装满冰块的老式杯中。

drinks.name: Godfather
drinks.instructions_en: Pour both ingredients directly into Old-Fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种原料直接倒入装满冰块的老式杯中。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Golden Brown
drinks.instructions_en: Freeze the cup before starting your cocktail. Pour all the ingredients except for the orange peel into a shaker and shake well. Do a double strain and a foam should appear on the top of the drink. Place the orange peel above the foam. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 调制鸡尾酒前先将杯子冷冻。将除橙皮外的所有原料倒入摇酒壶，充分摇匀。进行双重过滤，饮品表面应出现一层泡沫。将橙皮放在泡沫上方。享用吧！

drinks.name: Golden Glow Water
ingredients_en: sparkling water or kombucha for topping
Optinal: Citrus slice and fresh mint for garnishing
ingredients_zh: 用于加满的气泡水或康普茶
可选：柑橘片和新鲜薄荷用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Combine water, ginger, turmeric, cayenne, honey, molasses, and lemon juice in a glass jar. Shake well to combine. Chill until ready to drink. Shake before serving. Add ice to two glasses, pour over the water and top with sparkling water. Garnish with citrus slices and fresh mint. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在玻璃罐中混合水、姜、姜黄、辣椒粉、蜂蜜、糖蜜和柠檬汁。充分摇晃混合。冷藏至准备饮用。上桌前摇匀。在两个杯中加冰，倒入该水并用气泡水补满。用柑橘片和新鲜薄荷装饰。享用吧！

drinks.name: Golden Slipper
drinks.instructions_en: Make sure all ingredients are chilled Pour the Danziger Goldwasser first Pour the chartreuse yellow second Separate the chilled egg yolk from the white, then without breaking it drop gently into the wine glass Add the lemon juice
drinks.instructions_zh: 确保所有原料都已冰镇。先倒入Danziger Goldwasser。其次倒入黄色荨麻酒。将冰镇的蛋黄与蛋清分离，然后在不弄破蛋黄的情况下轻轻放入葡萄酒杯中。加入柠檬汁。

drinks.name: Good Vibrations
ingredients_en: 1 Orange Soda (to fill rest of glass)
ingredients_zh: 1份橙子汽水（to fill rest of glass）
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to a glass. Add Tequila. Fill remainder of glass with Orange Soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 杯中加冰。加入龙舌兰。用橙味汽水补满杯中剩余部分。

drinks.name: Grandma's Apple Pie 'Ala Mode' Moonshine
drinks.name_zh: 奶奶的苹果派配冰淇淋私酒
drinks.name_display: 奶奶的苹果派配冰淇淋私酒（Grandma's Apple Pie 'Ala Mode' Moonshine）
ingredients_en: 3 cups 190 proof grain alcohol (such as Everclear®)
ingredients_zh: 3杯190标准酒度谷物酒精（such as Everclear®）
drinks.instructions_en: Bring the apple cider, apple juice, cinnamon sticks, whole clove, white sugar, and brown sugar to a boil in a large pot; reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and cool completely. Stir the grain alcohol and vanilla vodka into the cooled mixture. Pour into bottles and refrigerate.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大的锅中将苹果酒、苹果汁、肉桂棒、整颗丁香、白糖和红糖煮沸；转中低火炖20分钟。离火并完全放凉。将谷物酒精和香草伏特加搅入放凉的混合物中。倒入瓶中并冷藏。

drinks.name: Grass Jelly Drink
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the grass jelly into thin strips or chop into small pieces. Put in a glass and add water and ice. Sweeten the drink with a simple syrup made from sugar and water. Note: Soybean milk can be substituted for water.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将仙草切成细条或切碎成小块。放入杯中，加入水和冰。用由糖和水制成的糖浆为饮品增添甜味。注意：可用豆浆代替水。

drinks.name: Grasshopper
drinks.instructions_en: Combine Creme de Menthe, White Creme de Cacao, heavy cream, and ice in a blender Blend until smooth
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷利口酒、白色可可利口酒、淡奶油和冰放入搅拌机中。搅打至顺滑。

drinks.name: Green Beast
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the ingredients into a whiskey glass and stir. Add 2 ice cubes. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将原料倒入威士忌杯中搅拌。加入2块冰。上桌。

drinks.name: Green Lagoon
drinks.instructions_en: Add pineapple juice to the shaker with the other ingredients and ice cubes. Strike and pour into the glass while filtering. To make it fresher and lighter, fill the glass with crushed ice beforehand.  Serve in a martini glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将菠萝汁与其他原料及冰块一起加入摇酒壶。摇匀并在过滤的同时倒入杯中。若想更清爽轻盈，可事先在杯中装满碎冰。用马天尼杯盛装上桌。

drinks.name: Kancha Aamer Sharbat/Green Mango Sharbat
drinks.name_display: 青芒果雪葩（Kancha Aamer Sharbat/Green Mango Sharbat）
drinks.instructions_en: Boil, peel and cut the mango to give the blender an easier time to puree it. In a small vessel boil sugar, ginger and 2 cups of water until sugar is dissolve. Remove from flame and let them cool. In a blender pour remaining water, mango, salt, mint leaves, and sugar water. Blend them well until all mint leaves blended. Pour into a jug and mix lemon juice. Adjust salt and sugar.Repeat until you get the desired sweet-tangy balance Strain and transfer to serving glasses. Drop ice cubes into flour glasses and serve with mint.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将芒果煮过、去皮并切块，以便搅拌机更易打成泥。在小锅中将糖、姜和2杯水煮沸，直至糖溶解。离火，放凉。在搅拌机中倒入剩余的水、芒果、盐、薄荷叶和糖水。充分搅打，直至所有薄荷叶都被打碎。倒入壶中并拌入柠檬汁。调整盐和糖的用量。重复调整，直至达到理想的酸甜平衡。过滤后盛入杯中。向杯中丢入冰块，配薄荷上桌。

drinks.name: Greyhound
drinks.instructions_en: Combine vodka and grapefruit juice in a highball glass. Add ice and stir well.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在海波杯中混合伏特加和西柚汁。加冰并充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Grilled Grapefruit Paloma Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 烤西柚帕洛玛鸡尾酒（Grilled Grapefruit Paloma Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. Cut limes in half widthwise. Cut 1 half into 3 wheels. Pour sugar into a shallow bowl. Dip lime halves, 2 of the lime wheels, and grapefruit into sugar to coat thoroughly. Place limes and grapefruit cut-side down on the hot grill. Cook, turning lime wheels occasionally, until browned and grill marks form, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet to cool. Rub remaining lime wheel over the rim of 2 highball glasses. Dip rims in kosher salt. Fill glasses with ice. Juice grilled lime halves and grapefruit into a small pitcher. Pour in any juices that accumulated on the baking sheet. Stir in tequila or mezcal and simple syrup. Divide mixture between glasses and top off with club soda. Garnish with grilled lime wheels.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将户外烤架预热至中高火，并在烤网上轻轻刷油。将青柠横向切成两半。将其中半个切成3片。将糖倒入浅碗中。将青柠半块、2片青柠片和西柚蘸上糖，使其充分裹匀。将青柠和西柚切面朝下放在热烤架上。烤制5至10分钟，其间不时翻动青柠片，直至上色并出现烤痕。转移到有边的烤盘上冷却。用剩余的青柠片在2个海波杯的杯口摩擦。将杯口蘸上犹太盐。在杯中装满冰。将烤过的青柠半块和西柚挤汁到小壶中。倒入烤盘上积累的汁液。搅入龙舌兰或梅斯卡尔酒以及糖浆。将混合物分装入杯中，并用苏打水补满。用烤青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Grinch Drink
drinks.instructions_en: You can make this in individual glasses (4) or make a pitcher. Add all the ingredients together, stir, and add garnish. Add more lemon-lime pop if the drink is too strong.
drinks.instructions_zh: 你可以分装在单独的杯中（4杯）或调成一壶。将所有原料放在一起，搅拌，并加上装饰。如果饮品味道太浓，可多加些柠檬青柠汽水。

drinks.name: Grog
drinks.instructions_en: Fill the rum into a heat-resistant glass or cup. Add the hot water as well as the lime juice. Stir in the brown sugar. Garnish with cinnamon and orange. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒倒入耐热玻璃杯或杯中。加入热水以及青柠汁。搅入红糖。用肉桂和橙子装饰。享用吧！

drinks.name: Guarapita
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all the ingredients with lots of ice cubesIn a punch bowl. Serve in glasses with fresh ice cubes and garnish with mint leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在潘趣盆中将所有原料与大量冰块混合。盛入加了新鲜冰块的杯中，并用薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Guayacolita
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the two drinks, which must be very cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种饮品混合，两者都必须非常冰凉。

drinks.name: Hanky Panky
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with organge zest
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料倒入装有冰块的调酒杯中。充分搅拌。过滤到冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Happy Soda
drinks.instructions_en: Stir together soda water, sweet condensed milk, and coco pandan syrup in a glass. Serve immediately with crushed/shaved ice or ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中将苏打水、甜炼乳和椰香斑斓糖浆搅拌在一起。立即配上碎冰或冰块上桌。

drinks.name: Hard Apple Cider
ingredients_en: 1 Gallon Trader Joe's Spice Apple Cider or your friendly neighborhood apple cider brand
drinks.instructions_en: Grab a pot and turn the stove temperature to high. Pour apple cider juice into pot. Continuously stir until apple cider juice boils. Pour Fireball Whiskey into pot. Turn stove to low Add apple slice to garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 拿一个锅，把炉温调至高温。将苹果汁倒入锅中。不断搅拌，直至苹果汁沸腾。将Fireball威士忌倒入锅中。将炉火调至小火。加入苹果片作装饰。

drinks.name: Harry Potter Butterbeer
drinks.name_display: 哈利波特黄油啤酒（Harry Potter Butterbeer）
drinks.instructions_en: Whip heavy cream in large mixing bowl until it forms stiff peaks. Add butterscotch topping and powdered sugar. Mix the caramel and butter extracts with the cream soda and then pour the mixture into clear cups or mugs. Top with butterscotch cream topping and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大搅拌碗中将淡奶油打发至硬性发泡。加入奶油糖顶料和糖粉。将焦糖和黄油香精与奶油苏打水混合，然后将混合物倒入透明杯或马克杯中。顶部加上奶油糖奶油顶料即可享用！

drinks.name: Hi-Fi
drinks.instructions_en: Fill an Old Fashioned glass with ice. Pour in vodka. Top up with orange soda. Garnish with half orange wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在老式杯中装满冰。倒入伏特加。用橙味汽水补满。用半片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Hibiscus Cherry Vodka Spritz
drinks.name_zh: 洛神樱桃伏特加斯普利茨
drinks.name_display: 洛神樱桃伏特加斯普利茨（Hibiscus Cherry Vodka Spritz）
drinks.instructions_en: Add the cherries to a medium size pot. Mash the cherries up useing a muddler or a fork until they are almost pulp-like. Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from the heat, add the hibiscus flowers. Cover and let steep for 10 minutes. Strain into a pitcher, pressing out any juice from the cherries with a fork, discard the hibiscus flowers and cherries. Add the honey, lemon juice, pineapple juice, and vodka. Chill until ready to serve. To serve, pour over ice and top with sparkling water. Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将樱桃放入中等大小的锅中。用捣棒或叉子将樱桃捣碎，直至近乎成果泥状。加入1杯水，用大火煮沸。离火，加入洛神花。盖上盖子浸泡10分钟。过滤到壶中，用叉子挤出樱桃中的汁液，弃去洛神花和樱桃。加入蜂蜜、柠檬汁、菠萝汁和伏特加。冷藏至准备上桌。上桌时，倒在冰上并用气泡水补满。干杯！

drinks.name: Hibiscus Mint Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a stovetop kettle with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat; add mint leaves, hibiscus petals, and lemon juice. Stir once or twice and cover. Steep for 3 to 5 minutes before serving either hot or iced.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在炉灶水壶中装满水并煮沸。离火；加入薄荷叶、洛神花瓣和柠檬汁。搅拌一两次并盖上盖子。浸泡3至5分钟后，可热饮或冰镇上桌。

drinks.name: Hiroshima
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 0.75 oz of sambuca into a shot glass Use a bar spoon to layer on 0.35 oz of Irish cream liqueur and 0.75 oz of absinthe Carefully pour in 5 drops of grenadine syrup using a drinking straw
drinks.instructions_zh: 将0.75盎司萨姆布卡酒倒入子弹杯中。用吧勺依次分层加入0.35盎司爱尔兰奶油利口酒和0.75盎司苦艾酒。用吸管小心地滴入5滴石榴糖浆。

drinks.name: Hocus Pocus
drinks.instructions_en: Drop dry ice into base of glass and pour over vodka, sweet and sour and pineapple juice. Add melon liqueur and blue curaçao.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将干冰放入杯底，并倒入伏特加、酸甜汁和菠萝汁。加入蜜瓜利口酒和蓝橙利口酒。

drinks.name: Homemade Blackberry Lemonade
drinks.name_display: 自制黑莓柠檬水（Homemade Blackberry Lemonade）
drinks.instructions_en: Heat 3/4 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until sugar has dissolved, about 2 minutes. Let cool. Place blackberries and remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar in a blender. Blend until smooth. Combine simple syrup, blended blackberries, remaining 4 cups of water, and lemon juice. Place a fine-mesh sieve over a pitcher and pour lemonade into the pitcher. Discard solids. Serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小奶锅中用中火加热3/4杯糖和1/2杯水。煮并搅拌约2分钟，直至糖溶解。放凉。将黑莓和剩余的2汤匙糖放入搅拌机中。搅打至顺滑。混合糖浆、打好的黑莓、剩余的4杯水和柠檬汁。在壶上放一个细网筛，将柠檬水倒入壶中。弃去固体残渣。加冰上桌。

drinks.name: The Homemade Whiteclaw
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into a cup. Stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将原料倒入杯中。搅拌。

drinks.name: Honey Bee Mine
ingredients_en: 2 shot Bacardi Carta Blanca Superior White Rum
ingredients_zh: 2份百加得卡塔布兰卡优质白朗姆酒
drinks.instructions_en: Stir honey with rum in base of shaker to dissolve honey Add vanilla essence Shake with ice and fine strain into chilled glass Top with champagne Garnish with lemon zest twist (discarded) and honeycomb on rim
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶底部将蜂蜜与朗姆酒搅拌，使蜂蜜溶解。加入香草精。加冰摇晃，细过滤到冰镇的杯中。用香槟补满。用柠檬皮卷（丢弃）和蜂巢装饰，蜂巢置于杯沿。

drinks.name: Honey Carrot Juice
drinks.name_display: 蜂蜜胡萝卜汁（Honey Carrot Juice）
drinks.instructions_en: Wash carrots thoroughly. Slice according to taste so it is easy when blended. Add 2 tablespoons of honey or according to taste. Give a little sugar 1 teaspoon or according to taste. Add 1 small glass of water or use a cup. Last but not least, blend until deemed quite smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将胡萝卜彻底洗净。按个人喜好切片，以便搅打时更容易。加入2汤匙蜂蜜或按口味调整。加入少许糖，1茶匙或按口味调整。加入1小杯水或1杯水。最后但同样重要的是，搅打至相当顺滑。

drinks.name: Honey Egg Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Place all the ingredients in a beverage shaker. Shake well and pour it into a glass. Voilà!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料放入调酒器中。充分摇匀并倒入杯中。完成！

drinks.name: Honey Spearmint Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Pour boiling water into a teapot, then add a tea bag. After a few minutes, pour tea into a cup. Add 1-2 teaspoons of honey to the cup. Stir, making the honey somewhat dissolve. Enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将沸水倒入茶壶中，然后放入一个茶包。几分钟后，将茶倒入杯中。向杯中加入1-2茶匙蜂蜜。搅拌，使蜂蜜稍稍溶解。享用吧。

drinks.name: Horchata
drinks.instructions_en: Add 2 cups of raw tiger nuts into a large bowl and fill with water, about 1 inch above the tiger nuts and soak them for 24 hours. After 24 hours drain the tiger nuts, rinse them under cold water and add half of them to a blender, also add 1/2 of the cold water (2 1/4 cups) and blend until well combined, then add the remainder of the tiger nuts, the remainder of the cold water (2 1/4 cups), a 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon powder and some fresh lemon zest, blend until well . Run the mixture through a sieve and into a large bowl, using a wooden spoon push down on the mixture to release all the liquid into the bowl, once done discard what is in the sieve. Transfer the liquid into a pitcher, add 2 tablespoons of white sugar and mix together, add the pitcher into the fridge for at least 4 hours to let all the flavors develop. After 4 hours your horchata de chufas is ready to be served, give the horchata a quick mix and transfer into tall glasses, add a straw to drink, remember to always serve this horchata very cold. You can add Gin.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将2杯生油莎豆放入大碗中，加水至高出油莎豆约1英寸，浸泡24小时。24小时后沥干油莎豆，用冷水冲洗，取一半放入搅拌机，并加入一半的冷水（2又1/4杯），搅打至充分混合，然后加入剩余的油莎豆、剩余的冷水（2又1/4杯）、1/4茶匙肉桂粉和一些新鲜柠檬皮屑，搅打至顺滑。将混合物过筛倒入大碗中，用木勺向下按压，使所有液体释放到碗中，完成后弃去筛中的残渣。将液体转移到壶中，加入2汤匙白糖并搅拌均匀，将壶放入冰箱至少4小时，让所有风味充分释放。4小时后，你的油莎豆欧洽塔就可以上桌了，将欧洽塔快速搅拌一下并倒入高杯中，插入吸管饮用，记得始终将这款欧洽塔冰镇上桌。你可以加入金酒。

drinks.name: Horchata Water
ingredients_en: 1 cup white rice, uncooked and washed
drinks.instructions_en: Put half a liter of water to heat in a pot. When it starts to boil, remove from the heat and add the rice. Let the rice soak for at least one hour. Put the rice in the blender together with the water in which it was soaked and blend until everything is finely ground. Transfer the mixture to a large pitcher. Add the condensed milk, the evaporated milk, the liter and a half of water, the sugar, the vanilla extract and the cinnamon. Stir until well incorporated. Serve over ice. If desired, sprinkle cinnamon powder.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将半升水放入锅中加热。水开始沸腾时，离火并加入大米。让大米浸泡至少一小时。将大米连同浸泡它的水一起放入搅拌机，搅打至全部磨细。将混合物转移到大壶中。加入炼乳、淡奶、1.5升水、糖、香草精和肉桂。搅拌至充分融合。加冰上桌。如需要，可撒上肉桂粉。

drinks.name: Hot Buttered Rum
drinks.instructions_en: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Blend in brown sugar and confectioners sugar and simmer for 1 min. Remove from heat. Whisk in ice cream, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Pour mixture into a plastic container, seal, and freeze (can be safely frozen for a few months). Measure ~1 tablespoon of the Hot Buttered Rum batter in a mug then fill cup with boiling water. Add rum to taste (or similarly leave out the rum). Stir and sprinkle with nutmeg. Serve hot
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大的锅中用中火融化黄油。拌入红糖和糖粉，炖1分钟。离火。搅入冰淇淋、肉桂和肉豆蔻。将混合物倒入塑料容器，密封并冷冻（可安全冷冻数月）。在一个马克杯中量取约1汤匙热黄油朗姆酒糊，然后用沸水注满。按口味加入朗姆酒（或同样地省略朗姆酒）。搅拌并撒上肉豆蔻。热饮上桌。

drinks.name: Hot Espresso
drinks.instructions_en: Tools that you need are AeroPress or similar, tablespoon and grinder Stack your AeroPress. Place a filter inside the drain cap—if you can use more than one to slow the flow of water when pressing. Lightly rinse the filter and place the drain cap and filter inside the compartment of the press. Place the press on a stable cup or mug. Prepare about 2 tablespoons of coffee by grinding the beans to a fine, table salt-like consistency. Drop them into the filter. Note that adding more coffee than normal during these makeshift brewing sessions might work in your favor — it will create a more reliably concentrated shot. Add approximately 3.5 fluid ounces of water, heated to about 200 degrees. Stir with the coffee. Then, press down on the plunger—hard. Remember, espresso depends on the pressure! Transfer your espresso (or coffee shot) into a demitasse and enjoy it!
drinks.instructions_zh: 你需要的工具是爱乐压或类似的器具、汤匙和磨豆机。组装好你的爱乐压。在滤盖内放一张滤纸，如果可以的话，使用不止一张来减缓按压时水流的速度。将滤纸稍微冲洗一下，然后把滤盖和滤纸放入压滤器筒身内。将压滤器放在稳固的杯子或马克杯上。通过将咖啡豆磨成细如食盐的粗细，准备约2汤匙咖啡。将它们倒入滤器中。注意，在这种临时冲泡过程中加入比平时更多的咖啡可能对你有利，它会萃取出更稳定、更浓缩的一份。加入约3.5液盎司的水，加热到约200度。与咖啡一起搅拌。然后用力压下压杆，用力。记住，浓缩咖啡取决于压力！将你的浓缩咖啡（或咖啡液）转移到小咖啡杯中享用！

drinks.name: Hot Toddy
drinks.instructions_en: Bring water to simmer in a teapot or a small saucepan. Combine bourbon, honey, and lemon juice in a mug. Pour over hot water and stir to combine. Garnish with cinnamon stick and lemon slice. For a apple cider variation, Swap apple cider for the water and caramel for the honey.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在茶壶或小奶锅中将水煮至微沸。在马克杯中混合波本威士忌、蜂蜜和柠檬汁。倒入热水并搅拌混合。用肉桂棒和柠檬片装饰。若想做苹果酒版本，将水换成苹果酒，将蜂蜜换成焦糖。

drinks.name: Hot Water
