drinks.instructions_en: Take your water and put it in the kettle (as much or as little as you want). Wait for the water to boil or reach your preferred temperature (90°C to 100°C should suffice). Pour the hot water out from the kettle into a cup.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取水倒入水壶中（量随意）。等待水沸腾或达到你偏好的温度（90°C至100°C即可）。将热水从水壶倒入杯中。

drinks.name: Hugo
drinks.instructions_en: Lightly press the mint leaves and add them to a glass. Pour in the elderflower syrup, Prosecco, and soda water. Garnish with a lime slice and add ice cubes. Gently stir and enjoy your refreshing Hugo cocktail.
drinks.instructions_zh: 轻轻压一下薄荷叶并放入杯中。倒入接骨木花糖浆、普罗塞克和苏打水。用一片青柠装饰并加入冰块。轻轻搅拌，享用你清爽的雨果鸡尾酒。

drinks.name: Hurricane
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Add all ingredients (liquids). Strain the content in a tall glass. Add the cherry and slice of pineapple for decoration.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装满冰。加入所有原料（液体）。将内容物过滤到高杯中。加入樱桃和一片菠萝作装饰。

drinks.name: Ice Cold Water
drinks.instructions_en: Start off with an empty glass. Add an ice block. Add your water into the glass. Serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先准备一个空杯。加入一块冰砖。将水倒入杯中。冷饮上桌。

drinks.name: Iced Coffee Frappe
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare the espresso then chill it until completely cooled down. Combine the espresso, milk, sugar and ice in a blender. Blend on low speed, slowly increasing the speed to high, and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve right away.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作浓缩咖啡，然后冷藏至完全冷却。将浓缩咖啡、牛奶、糖和冰放入搅拌机中。以低速搅打，慢慢加快到高速，搅打至顺滑。倒入杯中并立即上桌。

drinks.name: Iced Matcha Latte
ingredients_en: 2 teaspoon Syrup or Sugar or Honey
2 tablespoon Heavy Cream or Coffee Creamer
drinks.instructions_en: Place Matcha Powder in small bowl Add Hot Water and whisk until smooth with no lumps remaining Place Ice in your glass Pour Matcha and Water mixture into glass Add Syrup to taste Whisk Heavy Cream until frothy and desired thickness Place whisked Heavy Cream on top Enjoy with whisked Heavy Cream mixed into drink or sitting on top
drinks.instructions_zh: 将抹茶粉放入小碗中。加入热水并搅打至顺滑、无结块。在杯中加入冰。将抹茶和水的混合物倒入杯中。按口味加入糖浆。将淡奶油搅打至起泡并达到理想的浓稠度。将打好的淡奶油放在顶部。可将打好的淡奶油拌入饮品中享用，或让它留在顶部。

drinks.name: Immune Boosting Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 增强免疫力冰沙（Immune Boosting Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Wash and cut the apple, banana and spinach. Then mix them in a blender. Squeeze the lemon and add the juice, together with the ginger into the blender. Pour into a glass and top with a pinch of cinnamon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将苹果、香蕉和菠菜洗净切好。然后将它们放入搅拌机中混合。挤出柠檬汁，连汁和姜一起加入搅拌机。倒入杯中，撒上一小撮肉桂。

drinks.name: Income Tax
drinks.instructions_en: Add gin, dry vermouth, sweet vermouth, orange juice, bitters, and ice in a shaker. Shake until chilled. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with orange peel if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加入金酒、干味美思、甜味美思、橙汁、苦精和冰。摇至冰凉。过滤到鸡尾酒杯中。如需要，用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Indian Summer
drinks.instructions_en: Add the vodka, fresh mangoes, mint leaves, ginger, lime juice, sweet and sour along with a few ice cubes in a blender. Blend until well combined. Pour it in a margarita glass and serve frozen garnished with a mint sprig.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中加入伏特加、新鲜芒果、薄荷叶、姜、青柠汁、酸甜汁以及几块冰。搅打至充分混合。倒入玛格丽特杯中，以冰沙形式上桌，并用一枝薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Indonesian Avocado Milkshake
drinks.name_display: 印尼牛油果奶昔（Indonesian Avocado Milkshake）
drinks.instructions_en: Add the avocado flesh, the milk, the agave and the lime juice in a blender and blend until smooth and creamy. Squirt the chocolate syrup into the sides of the glasses. Pour the shake into the glasses and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将牛油果果肉、牛奶、龙舌兰糖浆和青柠汁放入搅拌机，搅打至顺滑浓稠。将巧克力糖浆挤到玻璃杯的内壁。将奶昔倒入杯中即可上桌。

drinks.name: Irish Blues
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients with ice in a cocktail shaker. Strain into a rocks glass full of ice. Garnish with a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加冰摇晃所有原料。过滤到装满冰的古典杯中。用一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Irish Breakfast Shot
drinks.name_display: 爱尔兰早餐子弹（Irish Breakfast Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 2oz of Jameson into a small highball glass. Add 1oz of orange juice and stir. You're done!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将2盎司尊美醇倒入小海波杯中。加入1盎司橙汁并搅拌。大功告成！

drinks.name: Irish Car Bomb
drinks.name_display: 爱尔兰汽车炸弹（Irish Car Bomb）
ingredients_zh: 1/2盎司百利爱尔兰奶油利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Add the Baileys and whiskey into a shot glass, pouring slowly to create a layered effect. Drop the shot into a pint glass filled half to three-quarters with the Guinness. Drink immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将百利甜和威士忌加入子弹杯中，慢慢倒入以形成分层效果。将子弹杯投入装有二分之一至四分之三健力士的品脱杯中。立即饮用。

drinks.name: Irish Coffee
drinks.instructions_en: Whip the cream until thick, but not stiff. Combine the whiskey, sugar syrup and coffee In a pre-warmed toddy mug, irish coffee glass or sturdy wine glass (for more richness of flavor without added sweetness, try making the simple syrup using brown sugar or demerara sugar). Stir to mix and gently spoon between 1/2 - 1 inch of cream atop the coffee mixture.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将奶油打发至浓稠，但不要打发至硬挺。在预热过的托迪马克杯、爱尔兰咖啡杯或结实的葡萄酒杯中混合威士忌、糖浆和咖啡（若想获得更浓郁的风味而不额外增加甜味，可尝试用红糖或德梅拉拉糖制作糖浆）。搅拌混合，用勺子轻轻在咖啡混合物顶部舀上1/2至1英寸厚的奶油。

drinks.name: Irish Winter Spiked Coffee
drinks.name_display: 爱尔兰冬日烈酒咖啡（Irish Winter Spiked Coffee）
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. Pour the Irish whiskey, coffee liqueur, and Irish cream in a warm mug or Irish coffee glass. Fill with hot coffee. Stir to combine Top with whipped cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好所有原料。将爱尔兰威士忌、咖啡利口酒和爱尔兰奶油倒入温热的马克杯或爱尔兰咖啡杯中。注入热咖啡。搅拌混合。顶部加上打发的奶油。

drinks.name: Italian Cream Soda
drinks.name_display: 意式奶油苏打（Italian Cream Soda）
ingredients_en: ¾ fluid ounce passion fruit flavored syrup
¾ fluid ounce watermelon flavored syrup
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a tall glass half full with ice. Fill to 2/3 with carbonated water. Pour in watermelon and passion fruit flavored syrups, then float the half-and-half cream on top. Stir when ready to drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中装入半杯冰。倒入气泡水至三分之二。倒入西瓜和百香果风味的糖浆，然后在顶部浮上half-and-half奶油。准备饮用时搅拌均匀。

drinks.name: Jack Frosties
drinks.instructions_en: In a blender, combine vodka, Prosecco, blue curaçao, lemonade, and ice. Blend until combined. Run a lemon wedge around the rim of each glass then dip in sanding sugar. Pour frosties into rimmed glasses and serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中混合伏特加、普罗塞克、蓝橙利口酒、柠檬水和冰。搅打至混合。用柠檬角在每个杯子的杯口擦一圈，然后蘸上粗糖。将冰沙倒入已做糖边的杯中并立即上桌。

drinks.name: Jacqueline
drinks.instructions_en: Place a few ice cubes in the bottom of a glass. Add 1cl of grenadine. Add 8cl of dry white wine And finally 2cl of lemonade. Stir a little before serving to ensure proper mixing.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯底放入几块冰。加入1厘升石榴糖浆。加入8厘升干白葡萄酒，最后加入2厘升柠檬水。上桌前稍加搅拌，以确保充分混合。

drinks.name: Jäger Ginger
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail glass halfway with ice cubes. Pour the Jägermeister, squeeze the lime and add the ginger beer. Mix and decorate with the cucumber.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒杯中装入半杯冰块。倒入野格，挤入青柠，并加入姜汁啤酒。搅拌并用黄瓜装饰。

drinks.name: Jägerbomb
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Red Bull in highball glass Gently put a shot of Jägerbomb in glass Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将红牛倒入海波杯中。轻轻将一杯野格炸弹放入杯中。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Jaljeera
drinks.instructions_en: Clean and wash the mint and coriander leaves. Then finely chop the leaves. Take a large glass bowl and add chopped mint leaves, chopped coriander leaves, seedless tamarind, roasted cumin seeds, chopped ginger in a blender jar along with asafoetida, salt, black salt, sugar, and lemon juice. Add four cups of water in the jar and blend the mixture until all the ingredients are completely blended together. When done, strain the mixture into a bowl and discard the roughage remaining of the mixture. Meanwhile, arrange the glasses on the clean and dry counters.Pour the mixture equally in the glasses and also pour the remaining water in the glasses, mix well. Also, put the 2-4 ice cubes in the glasses. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷和香菜叶清洗干净。然后将叶子切碎。取一个大玻璃碗，将切碎的薄荷叶、切碎的香菜叶、无籽罗望子、烤孜然籽、切碎的姜放入搅拌机的罐中，并加入阿魏、盐、黑盐、糖和柠檬汁。向罐中加入四杯水，搅打混合物，直至所有原料完全融合。完成后，将混合物过滤到碗中，弃去剩余的粗渣。同时，将杯子摆放在干净干燥的台面上。将混合物均匀倒入杯中，并把剩余的水也倒入杯中，充分搅拌均匀。另外，在杯中放入2-4块冰。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Jam Band
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients except club soda to shaker with ice. Shake well, strain into glass filled with ice. Top with club soda and garnish with mint.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除苏打水外的所有原料加入装有冰的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀，过滤到装有冰的杯中。用苏打水补满，并用薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Jamaican mule
drinks.instructions_en: Completely fill an Old Fashioned glass with ice cubes. Place six slices of ginger root in a centrifuge and extract the juice. Place four slices of cucumber in a shaker and crush with a pestle. Add one cl of lime juice, 1.5 cl of ginger juice and six cl of brown rum. Fill the shaker with ice cubes and shake. Chinese in the Old Fashioned glass Fill with ginger beer and mix gently. Decorate with a slice of ginger and cucumber slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将老式杯完全装满冰块。将六片姜根放入离心机中榨取姜汁。将四片黄瓜放入摇酒壶中，用捣棒压碎。加入1厘升青柠汁、1.5厘升姜汁和6厘升棕色朗姆酒。将摇酒壶装满冰块并摇晃。过滤到老式杯中。用姜汁啤酒补满并轻轻搅拌。用一片姜和黄瓜片装饰。

drinks.name: Jammy Dodger Shot
drinks.name_display: 果酱道奇子弹（Jammy Dodger Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill the shot glass 3 quarters full with Chambord Top up the shot with cream Sprinkle a little sugar on top, knock it back and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将子弹杯装至四分之三满的香波（Chambord）。用奶油补满子弹杯。在顶部撒一点糖，一饮而尽，尽情享用！

drinks.name: Jamun Panna
drinks.instructions_en: Mix jamun, black salt, crushed black peppercorns, cumin powder, powdered sugar, salt, and mint leaves in a steel container. Cover the container and shake it vigorously. Add a little water and mix and strain. Deseed the jamuns and transfer into a mixer jar and grind with strained water and 3 cups water. Pour the panna into tall glasses, garnish with mint leaves and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在不锈钢容器中混合印度黑莓、黑盐、碎黑胡椒粒、孜然粉、糖粉、盐和薄荷叶。盖上容器并用力摇晃。加入少许水，混合并过滤。给印度黑莓去籽，转移到搅拌机的罐中，连同过滤出的水和3杯水一起研磨。将panna倒入高杯中，用薄荷叶装饰并上桌。

drinks.name: Jamun Shots
drinks.instructions_en: Clean and de-seed the jamuns and take them in a blender. Add sugar, black salt and 1 cup of water in the blender and blend together. Pour it in a tall glass and add remaining water and lemon juice and mix well. Spread the salt in a plate. Rub the brim of shot glasses with a lemon wedge. Next place each shot glass upside down in the salt. Salt will stuck on the edge of the glass creating a ring of salt. Pour the drink in each glass and garnish with mint sprig. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将印度黑莓清洗干净并去籽，放入搅拌机中。向搅拌机中加入糖、黑盐和1杯水，一起搅打。倒入高杯中，加入剩余的水和柠檬汁，充分搅拌均匀。将盐铺在一个盘子上。用柠檬角擦拭子弹杯的杯口。接着将每个子弹杯倒扣在盐上。盐会粘在杯口边缘，形成一圈盐边。将饮品倒入每个杯中，并用一枝薄荷装饰。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Japanese Highball
drinks.instructions_en: Pour whiskey into a chilled highball glass filled with large ice cubes. Add club soda or ginger ale to fill. Garnish with citrus peel such as a lemon or tangerine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌倒入装有加大冰块、已冰镇的海波杯中。加入苏打水或姜汁汽水至满。用柑橘皮（如柠檬或橘子）装饰。

drinks.name: Japanese Ice Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Add vodka, gin, melon liquor, and sweet & sour mix into a glass filled with ice. Top with sprite or other lemon soda. (Optional) Garnish with a cherry, lime, lemon, or orange. Stir and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加、金酒、蜜瓜利口酒和酸甜汁加入装有冰的杯中。用雪碧或其他柠檬汽水补满。（可选）用樱桃、青柠、柠檬或橙子装饰。搅拌后享用。

drinks.name: Jasmine Milk Tea
ingredients_en: 2 tablespoons loose leaf jasmine tea leaves
drinks.instructions_en: Put the tea leaves into a tea infuser (or anything else that works) Bring water to a boil Steep the tea leaves for 8-10 minutes Remove the tea leaves (and infuser if used) Add the half-and-half Add the honey Pour the tea over the ice Enjoy
drinks.instructions_zh: 将茶叶放入茶滤器（或其他适用的器具）中。将水煮沸。浸泡茶叶8-10分钟。取出茶叶（如使用滤器则一并取出）。加入half-and-half奶油。加入蜂蜜。将茶倒在冰上。享用。

drinks.name: Jaune Lemon Ricard
drinks.name_display: 黄柠檬里卡尔（Jaune Lemon Ricard）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour four teaspoons each of Ricard and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Add two teaspoons of orgeat syrup to bring sweetness. Mix so that the flavours mix.  Generously fill the glass with fresh water and ice cubes.  Garnish with a slice of lemon and a fresh mint leaf. Add a biodegradable straw and serve the cocktail.
drinks.instructions_zh: 各倒入四茶匙里卡尔和新鲜挤出的柠檬汁。加入两茶匙杏仁糖浆以增添甜味。搅拌均匀使风味融合。在杯中大量加入新鲜水和冰块。用一片柠檬和一片新鲜薄荷叶装饰。插入一根可生物降解的吸管，即可上桌这款鸡尾酒。

drinks.name: Jello Shots
drinks.instructions_en: Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water, stirring until fully dissolved. Stir in vodka and cold water. Pour into small cups and refrigerate until set. Serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将明胶溶解在沸水中，搅拌至完全溶解。搅入伏特加和冷水。倒入小杯中并冷藏至凝固。冷食上桌。

drinks.name: Jungle Bird
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a mixing glass three-quarters with ice, and add all of the ingredients. Shake until chilled for about 30 seconds. Strain into a rocks glass over ice cubes or one large piece of ice, and add the garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将调酒杯装至四分之三满的冰，并加入所有原料。摇制约30秒至冰凉。过滤到古典杯中，杯中加入冰块或一大块冰，并加上装饰。

drinks.name: Kalimotxo
ingredients_en: 1/2 cup cheap red wine of your choice
Lime or Lemon wedge, depending on preference or available ingredients
ingredients_zh: 青柠角或柠檬角，视喜好或现有材料而定
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice. Pour 1/2 glass of red wine. Pour 1/2 glass of cola (roughly maintaining 1:1 ratio with the wine from previous step). Garnish with lime/lemon wedge. Optional: squeeze lime/lemon wedge juice into the drink. Stir and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 杯中加满冰。倒入半杯红葡萄酒。倒入半杯可乐（大致与上一步的葡萄酒保持1:1的比例）。用青柠角或柠檬角装饰。可选：将青柠角或柠檬角的汁液挤入饮品中。搅拌后享用！

drinks.name: Kamikaze Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add vodka, triple sec, and lime juice. Shake hard for 10–15 seconds. Strain into a chilled shot glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装满冰。加入伏特加、橙皮利口酒和青柠汁。用力摇10-15秒。过滤到冰镇的子弹杯中。

drinks.name: Kansas City Ice Water
drinks.name_display: 堪萨斯城冰水（Kansas City Ice Water）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the gin, vodka, lime juice, and triple sec in a shaker with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled pint glass filled with ice. Pour in 7up and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有冰的摇酒壶中混合金酒、伏特加、青柠汁和橙皮利口酒。摇晃并过滤到装有冰的冰镇品脱杯中。倒入七喜即可上桌。

drinks.name: Karkade (Sudanese Hibiscus Tea)
drinks.name_display: 苏丹洛神花茶（Karkade (Sudanese Hibiscus Tea)）
drinks.instructions_en: Rinse hibiscus petals in cold water to clean Boil 1 cup of water, then add hibiscus petals Let simmer for 10-15min until the water is a deep red Strain the petals out and stir in sugar while the tea is still warm Let it cool, then refrigerate and serve over ice
drinks.instructions_zh: 用冷水冲洗洛神花瓣以清洁。将1杯水煮沸，然后加入洛神花瓣。炖10-15分钟，直至水变成深红色。滤出花瓣，趁茶还温热时搅入糖。放凉，然后冷藏，加冰上桌。

drinks.name: Kenyan Dawa
ingredients_en: 1 tbsp tsp brown sugar 1 lime, quartered then cut into chunks, plus lime wheel garnish Ice
ingredients_zh: 1汤匙红糖、1个青柠，切四瓣再切块、另加青柠圆片装饰和冰块
drinks.instructions_en: Place lime chunks, honey, and sugar in a rocks glass . Muddle just enough to release the lime juice and mix with the honey, and sugar, but not so much as to mash the pith (that will release a bitter flavour). Add some crushed ice, then the vodka and stir to combine ingredients and bring up the lime from the bottom of the glass. Add more ice until the glass is full, then garnish with a lime wheel. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠块、蜂蜜和糖放入古典杯中。稍微捣压，刚好释放出青柠汁并与蜂蜜和糖混合，但不要压得太碎以免捣碎白瓤（那会释放出苦味）。加入一些碎冰，然后加入伏特加，搅拌使原料混合，并把杯底的青柠翻上来。继续加冰直到杯子装满，然后用一片青柠装饰。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Kerala Sunset Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 喀拉拉日落鸡尾酒（Kerala Sunset Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Grab a shaker and fill it with ice. Pour in the Bacardi coconut rum, Bombay Sapphire gin, and lime juice. Give it a good shake then pour it into your cold glass. Pour in the ginger beer then add the splash of midori followed by the splash of blue curacao and beet juice. Top with rose petals and add in a lime peel. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 拿一个摇酒壶并装满冰。倒入百加得椰子朗姆酒、孟买蓝宝石金酒和青柠汁。好好摇匀，然后倒入冰镇的杯中。倒入姜汁啤酒，接着加入少许蜜瓜利口酒，随后加入少许蓝橙利口酒和甜菜汁。顶部放上玫瑰花瓣并加入一片青柠皮。享用吧！

drinks.name: Khoshaf
ingredients_en: As you like Crushed nuts, to taste (optional)
drinks.instructions_en: Chop the fruits into small pieces. In a bowl, add all the dried fruits, then cover with hot water. Dissolve sugar if using and the orange blossom water. Chill in the fridge for 3-4 hours before serving. Add the nuts and mix everything well together. Scoop in glasses and serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水果切成小块。在碗中放入所有干果，然后倒入热水没过。加入糖（如使用）和橙花水搅拌溶解。上桌前放入冰箱冷藏3-4小时。加入坚果并将所有食材充分混合。盛入杯中冷食上桌。

drinks.name: Kiba - A german smoothie
drinks.name_display: 德式基巴冰沙（Kiba - A german smoothie）
ingredients_en: A large handful of cherries, pitted
drinks.instructions_en: Place one frozen banana, the sliced banana and 200ml almond milk in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into two glasses or glass bottles. Put the leftover frozen banana with the cherries and 200ml almond milk in the blender and blend until smooth. Carefully pour the liquid on top of the first layer, pouring it on the back of a spoon to prevent the two layers from mixing. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一根冷冻香蕉、切片的香蕉和200毫升杏仁奶放入搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑。倒入两个杯子或玻璃瓶中。将剩余的冷冻香蕉与樱桃和200毫升杏仁奶放入搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑。借助勺背，小心地将液体倒在第一层之上，以防两层混合。上桌。

drinks.name: Kids Hot Chocolate
drinks.name_display: 儿童热巧克力（Kids Hot Chocolate）
drinks.instructions_en: Put milk on stove with medium-low heat for 5-7 minutes While the milk is on the stove, pour the hot cocoa mix into a cup fit for kids Pour milk on top of the hot cocoa mix in the cup Pour the heavy whipping cream and powdered sugar into a bowl and mix until fluffy Scoop the whipped cream into the cup Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将牛奶放在炉子上用中小火加热5至7分钟。趁牛奶加热时，将热可可粉倒入适合儿童使用的杯中。将牛奶倒在杯中的热可可粉上。将浓奶油和糖粉倒入碗中，搅拌至蓬松。将打发的奶油舀入杯中。享用吧！

drinks.name: Killer Cocktail
ingredients_zh: 1.5份迪萨罗诺阿玛雷托杏仁利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all intgredients with ice Strain into glass filled with crushed ice Garnish with lemon zest twist (cut like a shark fin) and 3 drops of Cranberry Bitters, as a bloody shark attack (or use grenadine)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰摇匀。滤入装满碎冰的杯中。用柠檬皮卷（剪成鲨鱼鳍的形状）和3滴蔓越莓苦精装饰，营造血腥鲨鱼袭击的效果（也可用红石榴糖浆代替）。

drinks.name: Kir Royale
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Crème de cassis in the bottom of a Champagne glass. Top with chilled Champagne. Garnish with fresh berries. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黑醋栗利口酒倒入香槟杯底部。加满冰镇香槟。用新鲜浆果装饰。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Kiwi Caipisake
drinks.instructions_en: Peel the kiwi and cut it into quarters. Optional: cut off one small slice of the kiwi to decorate your cocktail once it’s done. Put the kiwi and sugar in the cocktail shaker. Muddle the kiwi and sugar until it has a paste-like texture. Add the ice and sake. Put the lid on the shaker and shake. Pour your drink into the glass. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将猕猴桃去皮，切成四瓣。可选：切下一小片猕猴桃，待鸡尾酒做好后用于装饰。将猕猴桃和糖放入摇酒壶中。将猕猴桃和糖捣碎至呈糊状。加入冰块和清酒。盖上摇酒壶的盖子，摇匀。将饮品倒入杯中。享用吧！

drinks.name: Kiwi Cucumber Cooler
drinks.name_display: 奇异果黄瓜酷乐（Kiwi Cucumber Cooler）
drinks.instructions_en: Soak the chia seeds in two tablespoons of water. Peel the cucumber and the kiwi, and cut them into small pieces. Ensure that the cucumber is not overripe and seeds are soft. Blend the cucumber in a mixer. When the cucumber is well-blended, add kiwi, mint leaves, lemon & sugar. White sugar can be replaced with 1 tablespoon honey. Pour the juice in a glass and add soaked chia seeds, ice and top it up with tonic water. Chop the second kiwi into small pieces and use for garnishing. For the cocktail, do not add chia seeds and add gin instead.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将奇亚籽浸泡在两汤匙水中。将黄瓜和猕猴桃去皮，切成小块。确保黄瓜不过熟且籽较软。将黄瓜放入搅拌机中搅打。待黄瓜搅打均匀后，加入猕猴桃、薄荷叶、柠檬和糖。白糖可用1汤匙蜂蜜代替。将果汁倒入杯中，加入泡好的奇亚籽、冰块，再加满汤力水。将第二个猕猴桃切成小块，用于装饰。若要制作鸡尾酒版本，则不加奇亚籽，改用金酒。

drinks.name: kokam sherbat
drinks.instructions_en: Firstly, in a large bowl soak 1½ cup kokum in 2 cups of hot water for 3 hours. Transfer to a blender and blend to coarse paste. Take the kokum paste to kadai. Add 2 cup sugar and ½ cup water. Mix well-dissolving sugar completely. Further, add boil for 10-15 minutes stirring occasionally. Boil until the mixture thickens and forms syrup consistency. Turn off the flame and add ½ tsp cumin powder, ¼ tsp crushed pepper and pinch of salt. Mix well and pass the mixture through a sieve. Make sure to squeeze of the pulp completely. Now kokum syrup is ready. refrigerate it and use as required. kokum syrup stays good for 2-3 months when refrigerated. To make kokum juice from kokum concentration, take few ice cubes in a glass. Pour 2 tbsp of prepared kokum syrup / kokum concentration. Pour 2 cups of cold water and mix well. Finally, serve kokum juice / kokum sharbat chilled garnished with mint leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 首先，在大碗中用2杯热水浸泡1½杯科库姆，静置3小时。转移到搅拌机中，搅打成粗糊状。将科库姆糊倒入卡代锅中。加入2杯糖和½杯水。充分搅拌，使糖完全溶解。继续煮沸10至15分钟，其间偶尔搅拌。煮至混合物变浓稠、呈糖浆状。关火，加入½茶匙孜然粉、¼茶匙碎胡椒和少许盐。充分拌匀，将混合物过筛。务必把果肉中的汁液完全挤出。此时科库姆糖浆就做好了。冷藏保存，按需取用。科库姆糖浆冷藏可保存2至3个月。用科库姆浓缩汁制作科库姆果汁时，在杯中放入几块冰块。倒入2汤匙做好的科库姆糖浆／科库姆浓缩汁。倒入2杯冷水，充分搅匀。最后，将科库姆果汁／科库姆雪葩冰镇后上桌，用薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Kokum Stings
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle ginger and in a shaker, add lightly torn curry leaves and muddled ginger. Then mix kokum syrup, lime juice, sugar, rum, add ice and shake altogether. Pour into a small rock glass and garnish with curry leaf on ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将生姜捣碎。在摇酒壶中加入轻轻撕碎的咖喱叶和捣碎的生姜。然后加入科库姆糖浆、青柠汁、糖、朗姆酒，加入冰块，一起摇匀。倒入小古典杯中，在冰块上用咖喱叶装饰。

drinks.name: Kombucha-Vodka Highball
drinks.name_display: 康普茶伏特加嗨棒（Kombucha-Vodka Highball）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine vodka, lime juice, and simple syrup in an ice-filled glass. Top with kombucha and garnish with a lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在加满冰块的杯中混合伏特加、青柠汁和糖浆。加满康普茶，用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Kopi
ingredients_en: 1 4/5 cup (‘cup’ refers to your cup, not US measuring cup) Kopi concentrate
ingredients_zh: 咖啡浓缩液（‘cup’ refers to your cup, not US measuring cup）
drinks.instructions_en: To an empty cup, add condensed milk and evaporated milk (feel free to tweak amount to taste) Add 4/5 cup of kopi concentrate Top up with hot water (95 to 98°C). Feel free to dilute your kopi to desired strength. Stir well to dissolve milk.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在空杯中加入炼乳和淡奶（用量可按口味自行调整）。加入4/5杯咖啡浓缩液。加满热水（95至98°C）。可随意将咖啡稀释至理想浓度。充分搅拌，使奶完全溶解。

drinks.name: La Vie en Rose
drinks.name_display: 玫瑰人生（La Vie en Rose）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the lime juice, Cointreau, and cranberry juice in a pitcher. Chill, covered, for at least 2 hours or overnight. Moisten the rim of a glass with water and dip it into a saucer of sugar to coat Pour the juice mixture into the glasses and add 1/2 cup Champagne to each. Stir once gently. Garnish
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠汁、君度和蔓越莓汁在大壶中混合。加盖冷藏至少2小时或过夜。用水润湿杯口，将杯子蘸入盛有糖的碟子中裹上糖。将果汁混合物倒入各杯中，每杯加入1/2杯香槟。轻轻搅拌一次。加装饰。

drinks.name: Lafayette
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a rocks glass with ice cubes. Add all ingredients. Garnish with a maraschino berry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中加满冰块。加入所有配料。用一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Latte
ingredients_en: 9 gram finely ground coffee -- preferably an espresso blend
ingredients_zh: 9克细磨咖啡，最好是浓缩咖啡拼配
drinks.instructions_en: Warm the espresso machine. Put the finely ground coffee in the portafilter, tamp it down with a tamper and secure it in the brew head of the machine. Brew around 35-40ml, until the espresso starts to get watery, losing the crema. Pour the cold milk in a preferably cold milk pitcher. Submerge the steam wand a couple centimeters below the surface of the milk and turn it all the way on, introducing air into the milk while swirling it in the pitcher to get a thin, so-called microfoam. After introducing some foam (the milk level should rise around an additional 1/3 with foam) submerge the steam wand deeper to stop the hissing sound and introducing air. Continue heating and swirling the milk until the bottom of the pitcher is too hot to touch. Turn the steam wand off and gently hit the bottom of the pitcher to pop any big bubbles in the foam. Pour the frothed milk over the espresso, tilting the cup slightly. You want to start pouring high and fast first, and then get lower and slower in a steady stream for a latte.
drinks.instructions_zh: 预热意式咖啡机。将细研磨的咖啡粉放入手柄粉碗中，用压粉器压实，再固定到咖啡机的冲煮头上。萃取约35至40毫升，直到浓缩咖啡开始变稀、失去油脂。将冷牛奶倒入（最好是冰镇的）拉花缸中。将蒸汽棒浸入牛奶液面下方约几厘米，完全打开蒸汽，一边在拉花缸中旋转牛奶一边向奶中打入空气，以形成细腻的所谓奶泡。打入一些奶泡后（奶量应因奶泡而上升约三分之一），将蒸汽棒浸得更深，以停止嘶嘶声和进气。继续加热并旋转牛奶，直到拉花缸底部烫得无法触碰。关闭蒸汽棒，轻轻敲击拉花缸底部，震破奶泡中的大气泡。将打发好的牛奶倒在浓缩咖啡上，同时稍微倾斜杯子。做拿铁时，先高一点、快一点倒入，然后放低、放慢，以稳定的细流倒入。

drinks.name: Lava Flow
drinks.instructions_en: Add the two rums and strawberries into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour the blended mixture into a pitcher or mixing glass and rinse the blender. Add the pineapple juice, coconut cream and banana into the blender with crushed ice and blend until smooth. Pour both blends into a tall glass from opposite sides, and watch the strawberry mixture rise to the top like lava. Garnish with a pineapple wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将两种朗姆酒和草莓放入搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑。将搅打好的混合物倒入大壶或调酒杯中，并冲洗搅拌机。将菠萝汁、椰浆和香蕉连同碎冰一起放入搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑。将两种混合物从相对的两侧倒入高杯，看草莓混合物像岩浆一样升到顶部。用菠萝角装饰。

drinks.name: Lavender Basil Lemonade
drinks.name_display: 薰衣草罗勒柠檬水（Lavender Basil Lemonade）
ingredients_en: 3/4 cup basil: roughly chopped and more for garnishing
1/3 - 1/2 cup honey or coconut or granulated sugar
ingredients_zh: 3/4杯罗勒：粗略切碎，另备一些用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Bring the lavender and two cups water to a boil in a small sauce pan. If you are using coconut or granulated sugar, add the sugar to the water as well. Once the water is boiling remove from the heat and add the basil, cover and steep for 10 minutes. Meanwhile squeeze the lemon juice into a tall glass pitcher. Stir in the honey (unless you already added sugar earlier). Stir in three cups water. Once the basil has steeped, strain the mixture into the pitcher with the lemon juice. Stir well and then taste. If the lemonade tastes sweet, add water, if it tastes too tart, add honey, 1 tablespoon at a time, until the lemonade is just right. 1/3 cup honey works great. Place in the fridge until well chilled. To serve, pour the lemonade over a glass of crushed ice. Garnish with lavender and basil. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薰衣草和2杯水放入小奶锅中煮沸。如果使用椰糖或砂糖，也将糖一起加入水中。水沸腾后离火，加入罗勒，加盖浸泡10分钟。同时将柠檬汁挤入高身玻璃大壶中。搅入蜂蜜（除非此前已加入糖）。搅入3杯水。罗勒浸泡好后，将混合物滤入装有柠檬汁的大壶中。充分搅拌后尝味。如果柠檬水偏甜，就加水；如果太酸，就加蜂蜜，每次1汤匙，直至柠檬水味道恰到好处。1/3杯蜂蜜效果很好。放入冰箱冷藏至充分冰镇。上桌时，将柠檬水倒在装有碎冰的杯中。用薰衣草和罗勒装饰。上桌享用吧！

drinks.name: Lavender Latte
ingredients_en: 1/8-1/4 cup dried lavender (can use lavender extract as well)
ingredients_zh: 1/8至1/4杯干薰衣草（can use lavender extract as well）
drinks.instructions_en: Bring water to a boil, add dried lavender (or extract) and sugar. Stir sugar, lavender, water and reduce heat until liquid becomes more of a syrup. Add 1-2 tablespoons of lavender syrup to strong coffee and add milk to enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水煮沸，加入干薰衣草（或薰衣草精）和糖。搅拌糖、薰衣草和水，转小火，煮至液体变得更像糖浆。在浓咖啡中加入1至2汤匙薰衣草糖浆，再加入牛奶，即可享用！

drinks.name: Lazy Sunday
ingredients_en: 1-2 cup International Delight French Vanilla flavored Coffee Creamer
ingredients_zh: 1至2杯国际之悦法式香草味咖啡奶精
drinks.instructions_en: Bring the water to boiling Add the black tea leaves, (thick grain) into the water, the tea leaves will release their flavor and the water will look dark like a brownish black color, let the tea leaves cook for a while for 3-4 minutes (Optional) Add some cinnamon, some sugar, some cardamom, etc. If you do go through with this step, make sure to go easy on the spices as it can over power the vanilla flavoring in the creamer! This will require experimentation to fully understand the balance to get it right. However, once the balance is figured out, this is a pretty straightforward drink you can make rather quickly without much effort. Add the Vanilla Creamer into the tea leaves + water mixture, and let it cook until the milk has come to a boil. Pour the mixture into a thermal insulated cup, and enjoy. (It's best served warm!)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水煮沸。将红茶茶叶（粗颗粒）加入水中，茶叶会释放香气，水会变成深褐色。让茶叶煮3至4分钟。可选：加入一些肉桂、糖、豆蔻等。如果确实进行这一步，务必少放香料，因为香料会盖过奶精中的香草味！这需要反复试验才能完全掌握平衡、恰到好处。不过，一旦掌握了平衡，这就是一款相当简单、无需费太多力气就能快速做好的饮品。将香草奶精加入茶叶和水的混合物中，煮至牛奶沸腾。将混合物倒入保温杯中，即可享用。（最好趁热饮用！）

drinks.name: Lemon Cointreau Fizz
drinks.name_display: 柠檬君度菲士（Lemon Cointreau Fizz）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all the ingredients. Enjoy refreshing drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合所有配料。享用这款清爽的饮品。

drinks.name: Lemon drop
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice cubes. Add all ingredients (liquids). Shake and strain into a chilled shot glass. Garnish with a lemon slice and a sugar rim.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰块。加入所有配料（液体）。摇匀后滤入冰镇的子弹杯中。用一片柠檬装饰，并在杯口裹上糖边。

drinks.name: Lemon Stylus
drinks.instructions_en: Add 1 part vodka to glass. Add 1 part Lemon-Lime Soda. Add 2 parts Lemonade. Stir and serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加入1份伏特加。加入1份柠檬青柠汽水。加入2份柠檬水。搅拌后上桌！

drinks.name: Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Simple syrup:  Place the sugar and water in a small saucepan and stir so that the sugar dissolves completely. Juice the lemons: Juice your lemons. Depending on the size two or three lemons would be needed. Combine lemon juice, simple syrup: Pour the juice and the simple syrup sugar water into a serving pitcher. Add more water if you would like it to be more diluted (though note that when you add ice, it will melt and naturally dilute the lemonade). Chill: Refrigerate 30 to 40 minutes and serve
drinks.instructions_zh: 糖浆：将糖和水放入小奶锅中，搅拌使糖完全溶解。榨柠檬汁：榨取柠檬汁。视柠檬大小，约需两到三个。混合柠檬汁与糖浆：将柠檬汁和糖浆（糖水）倒入饮用大壶中。若希望更稀释，可多加些水（不过要注意，加入冰块后冰块融化会自然稀释柠檬水）。冷藏：冷藏30至40分钟后上桌。

drinks.name: Libertine
ingredients_en: 1 bar spoon Rhubarb and Ginger Jam
drinks.instructions_en: Add the ingredients to shaker filled with ice and shake to combine. Double strain, then shake again without ice. Pour into Champagne flute, top with Ruby Port et voilà mon ami! Et une bonne dégustation!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料加入装满冰块的摇酒壶中，摇匀混合。双重过滤，然后不加冰再摇一次。倒入香槟笛形杯中，加满红宝石波特酒，我的朋友，大功告成！祝品饮愉快！

drinks.name: Lillet Buck
drinks.instructions_en: Add Lillet Blanc to a glass with ice cubes. Top up with Ginger Ale and a splash of lime juice. Serve with a slice of lime and garnish with mint leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将利莱白葡萄酒倒入加有冰块的杯中。加满姜汁汽水，再加少许青柠汁。上桌时配一片青柠，并用薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Lime Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Place mint leaves and 1 lime wedge into a glass. Crush the mint and lime using a muddler to release the mint oils and lime juice. Add two more lime wedges and the sugar, and muddle again to release the lime juice. Do not strain the mixture. Fill the glass almost to the top with ice Pour the rum over the ice and fill the glass with soda water Garnish with the remaining lime wedge
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷叶和1个青柠角放入杯中。用捣棒捣压薄荷和青柠，释放薄荷精油和青柠汁。再加入两个青柠角和糖，再次捣压以释放青柠汁。不要过滤混合物。用冰块将杯子填至接近满杯。将朗姆酒倒在冰块上，用苏打水加满杯子。用剩下的青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Limerol
drinks.instructions_en: Clean the lime with hot water, dry and cut it into bits, then throw them into a long glass. Add sugar and mix well with the lemon juice. Remove the watermelon pulp and cut it into cubes. Pour it into a blender with the Aperol and mix. Fill the glass with 1/3 picked ice. Add the watermelon mix and stir well. Add the cava and serve with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用热水洗净青柠，擦干后切成小块，放入长饮杯中。加入糖，并用柠檬汁充分拌匀。取出西瓜果肉，切成方块。将西瓜与阿佩罗一起倒入搅拌机中搅打。杯中装入约三分之一冰块，加入西瓜混合物，充分搅拌。加入卡瓦起泡酒，配上吸管上桌。

drinks.name: Limoncello Spritz
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a wine glass with ice. Add limoncello and prosecco. Top with soda water and stir gently. Garnish with a lemon slice (and mint if you like).
drinks.instructions_zh: 在酒杯中加满冰块。加入柠檬利口酒和普罗塞克起泡酒。加满苏打水，轻轻搅拌。用一片柠檬装饰（如喜欢也可加薄荷）。

drinks.name: London Fog
drinks.instructions_en: Steep the tea in the water for five minutes and dispose of bag once done. Mix in the vanilla and honey. Pour in the steamed milk. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将茶包放入水中浸泡五分钟，泡好后取出茶包丢弃。搅入香草和蜂蜜。倒入蒸热的牛奶。享用吧！

drinks.name: Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.name_display: 长岛冰茶（Long Island Iced Tea）
ingredients_en: 1 fluid ounce sweet and sour mix
1 fluid ounce cola, or to taste
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Pour vodka, rum, gin, tequila, triple sec, and sour mix over ice; cover and shake. Pour cocktail into a Collins or hurricane glass; top with splash of cola for color. Garnish with a lemon slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒摇酒壶中装满冰块。将伏特加、朗姆酒、金酒、龙舌兰、白橙皮酒和酸味混合料倒在冰块上；盖上盖子摇匀。将鸡尾酒倒入柯林杯或飓风杯中；加入少许可乐调色。用一片柠檬装饰。

drinks.name: Lust For Life
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a shaker and shake with ice until chilled. Strain into a rocks glass on ice cubes. Garnish with grated nutmeg.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料放入摇酒壶中，加冰摇匀至冰镇。滤入装有冰块的古典杯中。撒上磨碎的肉豆蔻装饰。

drinks.name: Lynchburg Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Shake first 3 ingredients with ice. Strain into a ice-filled glass. Top with lemonade. Add more ice and stir. Garnish with lemon slices and cherries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将前3种配料加冰摇匀。滤入装满冰块的杯中。加满柠檬水。再加入冰块并搅拌。用柠檬片和樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Macunaíma
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with plenty of ice. Strain twice before putting in a glass cup of your choice
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入鸡尾酒摇酒壶中，加入大量冰块混合。过滤两次后倒入你喜欢的玻璃杯中。

drinks.name: Madeleine
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients and shake well. Strain into martini or shot glass
drinks.instructions_zh: 混合所有配料并充分摇匀。滤入马天尼杯或子弹杯中。

drinks.name: Madras
drinks.instructions_en: Gather and pour the ingredients into a highball glass. Stir the ingredients well. Garnish with a lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料收集并倒入海波杯中。充分搅拌。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Magic Eye Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Peel the oranges and sweet potato, cut into pieces. Wash, scrub and chop the carrots and lemon. Process all ingreedients through your juicer. Optional - strain through a sieve (if you don't like pulp). Drink immediately and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙子和红薯去皮，切成块。将胡萝卜和柠檬洗净、刷净并切碎。将所有配料用榨汁机榨汁。可选：用滤网过滤（如果不喜欢果肉）。立即饮用，尽情享用！

drinks.name: Mai Tai
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients except the dark rum into a shaker with ice and shake well. Strain into tall glass. Add the dark rum, pouring gently to 'float' it on top of the drink. Garnish with a slice of pineapple.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除黑朗姆酒外的所有配料放入加冰的摇酒壶中，充分摇匀。滤入高杯中。加入黑朗姆酒，轻轻倒入使其“漂浮”在酒液表面。用一片菠萝装饰。

drinks.name: Malibu Island Cosmo
drinks.name_display: 马利宝岛屿大都会（Malibu Island Cosmo）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into an ice-filled shaker. Shake until cold and double strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Top off with a wedge of lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入装满冰块的摇酒壶中。摇至冰冷，双重过滤后滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。加上一块青柠角。

drinks.name: Malibu Sunset
ingredients_en: 1 to 2 pineapple and/or slices of orange, for garnishing
ingredients_zh: 1至2颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃，用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to glass. Add juice, Malibu, and stir. Drizzle in grenadine. Garnish with cherries, pineapple, and/or slices of orange. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加入冰块。加入果汁、马利宝椰子朗姆酒，搅拌。淋入红石榴糖浆。用樱桃、菠萝和／或橙片装饰。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Mangalorean Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Heat a small broad non-stick pan and dry roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds and fenugreek seeds on a medium flame for 2 to 3 minutes, while stirring it continuously Cool slightly and blend in mixer to a coarse powder. Keep aside. Heat 1 cup of water in a saucepan and add 1½ tbsp of prepared spice powder and misri, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 3 minute, while stirring occasionally. Add the milk and cook on a medium flame for 1 minute, while stirring occasionally. Strain the mixture through a strainer. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一只小的宽底不粘锅加热，用中火干炒香菜籽、孜然籽、茴香籽和葫芦巴籽2至3分钟，其间不断搅拌。稍微放凉后放入搅拌机中打成粗粉。放置一旁备用。在奶锅中加热1杯水，加入1½汤匙做好的香料粉和蜜晶糖（misri），充分拌匀，用中火煮3分钟，其间偶尔搅拌。加入牛奶，用中火煮1分钟，其间偶尔搅拌。将混合物用滤网过滤。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Mango Daiquiri
drinks.instructions_en: Add a small scoop of ice to the blender. Add remaining ingredients. Blend for approximately 30 seconds. Pour into a cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 往搅拌机中加入一小勺冰块。加入剩余配料。搅打约30秒。倒入鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Mango Iced Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Peel and chop the mangoes. Puree them in a blender and refrigerate. Heat water on a stove top or in the microwave. Remove the pan of hot water. Add the black tea and stir. Cover and let the tea steep in the hot water for 5-7 mins. Strain and keep the tea in the fridge. Once the tea is cooled, remove from the fridge. Pour the tea in a blender. Add the mango puree, lemon juice and sugar to the tea. Blend everything till smooth. Serve the mango iced tea in tall glasses with some ice cubes garnished with mint leaves or mango or lemon slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将芒果去皮切块。放入搅拌机中打成泥，冷藏。在炉上或用微波炉加热水。将热水从火上移开。加入红茶并搅拌。加盖，让茶在热水中浸泡5至7分钟。过滤后把茶放入冰箱。茶冷却后从冰箱取出。将茶倒入搅拌机中。将芒果泥、柠檬汁和糖加入茶中。将所有材料搅打至顺滑。将芒果冰茶倒入高杯，加些冰块，用薄荷叶或芒果片、柠檬片装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Mango Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Wash mango thoroughly and chill. Peel the skin. Cut the mango into cubes and add them to a blender and pour the coconut water or orange juice. Put in the other ingredients if using like ginger and mint. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将芒果彻底洗净并冷藏。去皮。将芒果切成方块放入搅拌机中，倒入椰子水或橙汁。如使用生姜和薄荷等其他配料，也一并放入。搅打至顺滑。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Mango Lassi
ingredients_en: 1/4 cup Fresh or canned Mango pulp
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Add sugar to taste. Garnish with a pinch of ground cardamom seeds. A few extra ice cubes may be added when serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑。按口味加糖。撒上一小撮磨碎的豆蔻籽装饰。上桌时可多加几块冰块。

drinks.name: Mango Mastani
drinks.instructions_en: Blend the chopped mangoes. Keep a few pieces aside for topping the mastani. Add a tablespoon of sugar and a cup of full cream milk. Blend to a smooth thick milkshake. Pour this thick mango milkshake in a glass, leaving enough space at the top for ice cream scoops. Place one or two vanilla or mango ice cream scoops. Top with the dry fruits and chopped mangoes. Garnish with the glazed cherries. Serve mango mastani immediately with a spoon as well as a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将切好的芒果搅打。留出几块备用，用于给 mastani 点缀。加入1汤匙糖和1杯全脂牛奶。搅打成顺滑浓稠的奶昔。将这款浓稠的芒果奶昔倒入杯中，顶部留出足够空间放冰淇淋球。放入一到两个香草或芒果冰淇淋球。撒上干果和切好的芒果。用糖渍樱桃装饰。芒果 mastani 立即上桌，同时配上勺子和吸管。

drinks.name: Mango Mocktail
drinks.name_display: 芒果无酒精鸡尾酒（Mango Mocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine pineapple juice, mango, ginger, limes and syrup in blender container.  Add 2-1/2 cups ice. Cover; blend until smooth. Pour into chilled martini glasses rimmed with equal parts superfine bar sugar and dried ginger.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将菠萝汁、芒果、生姜、青柠和糖浆放入搅拌机容器中。加入2½杯冰块。盖上盖子；搅打至顺滑。倒入冰镇的马天尼杯中，杯口裹上用等量细砂糖和干姜粉混合的糖边。

drinks.name: Mango Nojito Mocktail
drinks.name_display: 芒果无酒精莫吉托（Mango Nojito Mocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour mango syrup, lime juice, and apple juice into a highball glass Add mint leaves and ice as desired Stir and fill with sparkling water Decorate with a slice of mango and mint leaves
drinks.instructions_zh: 将芒果糖浆、青柠汁和苹果汁倒入海波杯中。按需加入薄荷叶和冰块。搅拌后加满气泡水。用一片芒果和薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Mango Peach Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 芒果桃子冰沙（Mango Peach Smoothie）
ingredients_en: 0.5 cup fresh or frozen strawberries or raspberries
2 cups unsweetened non-dairy milk such as almond or soy milk
ingredients_zh: 新鲜或冷冻草莓或覆盆子
2杯无糖植物奶如杏仁奶或豆奶
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Pour into a glass and enjoy! This recipe was adapted from this excellent version here:  https://www.bestofthislife.com/2014/01/mango-hurricane-smoothie.html
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中混合。倒入杯中，尽情享用！本配方改编自以下这个出色的版本：https://www.bestofthislife.com/2014/01/mango-hurricane-smoothie.html

drinks.name: Mango Shake
ingredients_en: 2 medium sized ripe and sweet mangoes
drinks.instructions_en: Rinse and pat dry the ripe and sweet mangoes. Peel and chop the mangoes. Discard the stones. Add the chopped mangoes in a blender jar. Add milk in the jar. Add ice cubes in the jar. Blend till smooth. Pour mango shake in glasses and server immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将成熟香甜的芒果冲洗干净并拍干。去皮切块。去掉果核。将切好的芒果放入搅拌机杯中。往杯中加入牛奶。往杯中加入冰块。搅打至顺滑。将芒果奶昔倒入杯中，立即上桌。

drinks.name: Mango Juice with Yakult
drinks.name_display: 芒果养乐多汁（Mango Juice with Yakult）
drinks.instructions_en: Peel mango skin troughly. Cut the mango into cubes and add them to a blender and pour a bottle of Yakult, a sachet of Tropicana and 100 ml of water. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将芒果皮彻底剥净。将芒果切成方块放入搅拌机中，倒入一瓶养乐多、一小袋纯果乐和100毫升水。搅打至顺滑。立即上桌。享用吧！

drinks.name: Manhattan
drinks.instructions_en: Chill a cocktail glass with ice and soda. Fill a mixing glass with ice and then add all ingredients. Using a bar spoon, stir the drink for approximately 20 seconds. When stirring, always ensure the glass is topped up with ice. Taste and then strain into the chilled cocktail glass, serving straight up. Zest the drink and glass with the orange peel and then twist and place in glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用冰块和苏打水冰镇鸡尾酒杯。在调酒杯中装入冰块，然后加入所有配料。用吧勺搅拌约20秒。搅拌时始终确保杯中冰块是满的。尝味，然后滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中，净饮上桌。用橙皮在酒液和杯子上挤香，然后扭转橙皮放入杯中。

drinks.name: Maple Bourbon Smash
drinks.name_display: 枫糖波本碎冰酒（Maple Bourbon Smash）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the bourbon, maple syrup, and lemon juice into a shaker filled with ice. Stir until the drink is thoroughly chlled, about 20 seconds. Strain into a double old-fashioned glass with a large cube of ice. Garnish with lemon twist
drinks.instructions_zh: 将波本威士忌、枫糖浆和柠檬汁倒入装满冰块的摇酒壶中。搅拌至酒液彻底冰冷，约20秒。滤入放有一大块冰的加大古典杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Fill blender with crushed ice. Pour in limeade concentrate, tequila and triple sec. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将搅拌机装满碎冰。倒入浓缩青柠汁、龙舌兰和白橙皮酒。搅打至顺滑。倒入杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Marpha
ingredients_en: 1/2 cup Khesung(source of molds, bacteria and yeast)
ingredients_zh: 1/2杯凯松（source of molds, bacteria and yeast）
drinks.instructions_en: First you collect fresh apples, primarily from Mustang. You then ferment the apples on a large container. You ferment the drinks for around 3 months Add Khesung Now pour the drink into a jar and let is rest and cool. The drink is now ready to be served.
drinks.instructions_zh: 首先收集新鲜苹果，主要来自木斯塘。然后将苹果放入大容器中发酵。发酵约3个月。加入 Khesung。接着将酒液倒入罐中，静置冷却。此时饮品即可上桌。

drinks.name: Marquisette
ingredients_en: 7 l white wine (like Picpoul de Pinet)
drinks.instructions_en: Marinate 24 hours in advance the wine, lemon juice and sugar. Just before serving add the lime cut into small pieces and the champagne.
drinks.instructions_zh: 提前24小时将葡萄酒、柠檬汁和糖腌制浸泡。上桌前再加入切成小块的青柠和香槟。

drinks.name: Martini Royale
drinks.instructions_en: Fill the glass with ice cubes. Pour the Martini, then add the Prosecco. Use a spoon to turn the ice softly from bottom to top (2x only to preserve the bubbles). Squeeze the lime in the glass and drop the wedge in the glass. Take some mint and put it in one corner of the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰块。倒入马天尼，然后加入普罗塞克起泡酒。用勺子轻轻地将冰块从下往上翻动（只翻2次，以保留气泡）。在杯中挤入青柠汁，并将青柠角丢入杯中。取一些薄荷放入杯中的一角。

drinks.name: Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Add the Gin, Vodka and Lillet Blanc. Shake well and strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with lemon twist.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒摇酒壶中装满冰块。加入金酒、伏特加和利莱白葡萄酒。充分摇匀，滤入冰镇的马天尼杯中。用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Masala Chaas (Spiced Butter Milk)
drinks.name_display: 印度香料酪乳（Masala Chaas (Spiced Butter Milk)）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients to a blender, then Blend till combined, and Pour into serving glasses Garnish with fresh cilantro or mint and serve. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中，搅打至混合均匀，然后倒入饮用杯中。用新鲜的香菜或薄荷装饰后上桌。享用吧！

drinks.name: Masala Chai
drinks.instructions_en: Take 1/2 inch cinnamon, 2 to 3 green cardamoms, 2 cloves and 1 inch ginger in a mortar pestle, crush coarsely and keep aside. Heat 2 cups of water (250 ml) in a saucepan. Let the water come to a boil and then add the crushed spices. Boil the spices along with the water for 2-3 minutes. Add sugar as per taste. Add 2 teaspoons of Darjeeling tea and boil for a minute. Add milk and boil for 2-3 more minutes. Pour the tea through a strainer into the cups. Serve masala chai hot with some Indian snacks or cookies.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取1/2英寸肉桂、2至3颗绿豆蔻、2粒丁香和1英寸生姜放入研钵中，粗略捣碎后放置一旁备用。在奶锅中加热2杯水（250毫升）。待水煮沸后加入捣碎的香料。将香料与水一起煮2至3分钟。按口味加糖。加入2茶匙大吉岭红茶，煮一分钟。加入牛奶，再煮2至3分钟。将茶用滤网过滤后倒入杯中。印度香料茶趁热上桌，配些印度小食或饼干。

drinks.name: Masala Coke
drinks.instructions_en: Pour some salt onto a small plate. Rub the juicy side of the lemon or lime wedge along the lip of a pint glass. Roll the outer edge of the glass in celery salt until fully coated. Fill with ice and set aside. Squeeze the lemon and lime wedges into a shaker and drop them in. Add the remaining ingredients and ice and shake gently. Strain into the prepared glass. Garnish with a slice of lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一些盐倒在小碟子上。用柠檬或青柠角带汁的一侧涂抹品脱杯的杯口。将杯子的外沿在芹菜盐中滚动，直到完全裹上。装入冰块，放置一旁备用。将柠檬角和青柠角挤汁挤入摇酒壶中，并把果角丢入壶中。加入剩余配料和冰块，轻轻摇匀。滤入准备好的杯中。用一片青柠装饰。

drinks.name: Matcha Green Russian
drinks.name_display: 抹茶绿俄罗斯（Matcha Green Russian）
drinks.instructions_en: Create a matcha green tea liqueur. Add 2 cups of whole milk, 2 cups of sugar, the vanilla bean (seeds and pod), and 3 tablespoons of Numi Citrus Matcha to a small pot. Warm the mixture over a medium low heat and whisk until the sugar is completely dissolved and all ingredients are combined (except the vanilla bean pod). Remove from heat and remove the pod. Let the mixture cool for about 30 minutes. Transfer the green tea mixture to a pitcher and add in 2 cups of vodka. Mix well. Overfill an old fashioned glass with ice. Add 2 parts matcha green tea liqueur and then float about 1 part fresh cream over the top. Dust with some of the matcha powder. Makes about 6 cocktails.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作抹茶绿茶利口酒。将2杯全脂牛奶、2杯糖、香草荚（籽和荚）和3汤匙 Numi 柑橘抹茶放入小锅中。用中小火加热混合物，搅打至糖完全溶解、所有配料混合均匀（香草荚除外）。离火，取出香草荚。让混合物冷却约30分钟。将绿茶混合物倒入大壶中，加入2杯伏特加。充分混合。在古典杯中装满冰块（略多一些）。加入2份抹茶绿茶利口酒，然后在表面漂浮约1份新鲜奶油。撒上一些抹茶粉。约可制作6杯鸡尾酒。

drinks.name: Matcha Green Tea Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 抹茶绿茶冰沙（Matcha Green Tea Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Add the coconut milk to your blender jug, followed by the matcha green tea powder and spinach. Blend. Add the mango and frozen bananas and blend until creamy and smooth.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将椰奶倒入搅拌机杯中，接着加入抹茶绿茶粉和菠菜。搅打。加入芒果和冷冻香蕉，搅打至细腻顺滑。

drinks.name: Matcha Latte
ingredients_en: 1 teaspoon of Agave Negtar or Sugar
drinks.instructions_en: Sift Matcha powder into your cup. Add hot water and continue whisking until Matcha dissolves. Add in Agave Nectar Pour in hot milk (don't boil)
drinks.instructions_zh: 将抹茶粉筛入杯中。加入热水，持续搅打至抹茶溶解。加入龙舌兰蜜。倒入热牛奶（不要煮沸）。

drinks.name: Medicine Ball Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Warm the water to near boil. Steep both the mint tea and green tea in the hot water. Squeeze lemon into the tea. Add honey to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水加热至接近沸腾。将薄荷茶和绿茶一起在热水中浸泡。将柠檬挤汁挤入茶中。按口味加蜂蜜。

drinks.name: Meia de Seda (literally, Silk Socks)
drinks.name_display: 丝绸袜（Meia de Seda (literally, Silk Socks)）
ingredients_en: 2 oz Brandy (stick to the original), Vodka or Gin
ingredients_zh: 2盎司白兰地、伏特加或金酒（stick to the original）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all ingredients in a blender. Decorate with nutmeg or chocolate.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中搅打。用肉豆蔻或巧克力装饰。

drinks.name: Mexican Candy Shot
drinks.name_display: 墨西哥糖果子弹（Mexican Candy Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add tequila, watermelon liqueur, and lime juice. Shake and strain into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装满冰块。加入龙舌兰、西瓜利口酒和青柠汁。摇匀后滤入子弹杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Mexican Lágrimas de la Virgen
drinks.name_display: 墨西哥圣母之泪（Mexican Lágrimas de la Virgen）
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the beetroot into small pieces. Chopp the apple and the bananas. Cut into small slices the oranges. Cut the lettuce into small slices. Add the beetroot into a blender, add some water ( only the right amount) and add sugar at one's liking. Pour out the beetroot's liquid into a bigger jar and add the remaining water and mix it. Add all of the fruit and the lettuce and mix it. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将甜菜根切成小块。将苹果和香蕉切碎。将橙子切成小片。将生菜切成小片。将甜菜根放入搅拌机中，加入适量水（只需适量），并按个人喜好加糖。将甜菜根的汁液倒入较大的罐中，加入剩余的水并混合。加入全部水果和生菜并混合。享用吧！

drinks.name: Mexican Mule
drinks.instructions_en: Pour Tequila, fresh lime juice, bitters and Ginger beer over ice in glass or copper mug. Stir and garnish with lime wedges. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯或铜杯中加冰，倒入龙舌兰、新鲜青柠汁、苦精和姜汁啤酒。搅拌，用青柠角装饰。享用吧！

drinks.name: Mexican Michelada
drinks.instructions_en: Create a powder mix with salt and chili powder. Rim the tip of the glass with lime juice. Dip the glass top into the new powder mix. Squeeze one lime into the glass. Add sauce of your preferente into the glass. Poor a very cold beer into the glass. Mix the drink slightly with a spoon. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将盐和辣椒粉混合成调味粉。用青柠汁润湿杯口。将杯口蘸入调味粉中。将一个青柠挤汁挤入杯中。按喜好往杯中加入酱汁。将非常冰的啤酒倒入杯中。用勺子将饮品稍加搅拌。享用吧！

drinks.name: Mexican Strawberry Water
drinks.name_display: 墨西哥草莓水（Mexican Strawberry Water）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together sliced strawberries, sugar, and 1 cup of water in a medium bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for four hours. Remove the strawberry mixture from the refrigerator and pour into a blender. Blend on high until smooth. Pour the blended berry mixture through a wire mesh strainer set over a large mixing bowl; discard the pulp and seeds. Add the remaining seven cups cold water to the pureed strawberries and mix well. Place the Aqua de Fresa in the refrigerator to chill for several hours or pour over ice and serve immediately. Garnish with lime slices or mint leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将切好的草莓、糖和1杯水在中号碗中混合。用保鲜膜盖住碗，放入冰箱冷藏四小时。将草莓混合物从冰箱取出，倒入搅拌机中。高速搅打至顺滑。将搅打好的浆果混合物通过架在大号搅拌碗上的金属滤网过滤；弃去果肉和籽。将剩余的7杯冷水加入打好的草莓泥中，充分混合。将这款草莓水（Aqua de Fresa）放入冰箱冷藏数小时，或直接倒在冰块上立即上桌。用青柠片或薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Mezcal with grapefruit and jalapeno pepper
drinks.name_display: 梅斯卡尔葡萄柚辣椒（Mezcal with grapefruit and jalapeno pepper）
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker put some ice with the mezcal, syrup, jalapeno slices, grapefruit juice and coriander and shake it. Serve in glasses and add some ice and tonic water.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中放入一些冰块，加入梅斯卡尔、糖浆、墨西哥辣椒片、西柚汁和香菜，摇匀。倒入杯中，加些冰块和汤力水后上桌。

drinks.name: Miami Vice
drinks.instructions_en: In a blender, add strawberries, lime juice, simple syrup, half the rum (1 oz) and half the ice (1 cup). Blend until smooth and pour into glass. Clean the blender or get a second blender. In the blender add cream of coconut, pineapple juice, the remaining rum (1 oz) and the remaining ice (1 cup). Blend until smooth and pour into glass with the first blend. (Optional) Add a cherry and / or pineapple slice to garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中加入草莓、青柠汁、糖浆、一半的朗姆酒（1盎司）和一半的冰块（1杯）。搅打至顺滑后倒入杯中。清洗搅拌机，或另取一台搅拌机。在搅拌机中加入椰浆、菠萝汁、剩余的朗姆酒（1盎司）和剩余的冰块（1杯）。搅打至顺滑后倒入装有第一份混合物的杯中。（可选）加入一颗樱桃和／或一片菠萝装饰。

drinks.name: Michelada Zero Proof
drinks.name_display: 无酒精米切拉达（Michelada Zero Proof）
drinks.instructions_en: Choose a highball glass, tall and slender, like a lemonade glass. Frost your glass with chili powder on the rim. Pour in the lemon juice and condiments. Add tomato juice and non-alcoholic beer. Stir with a bar spoon and check the seasoning. Decorate with a lime wedge
drinks.instructions_zh: 选一只高身细长的海波杯，类似柠檬水杯。在杯口裹上辣椒粉。倒入柠檬汁和调味料。加入番茄汁和无酒精啤酒。用吧勺搅拌并检查调味。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Midnight in Paris
drinks.instructions_en: In a cocktail glass, add the fresh raspberries and sugar syrup. Gently crush the raspberries with a pestle to release their flavours. Add the cognac, blackcurrant liquor and fresh lemon juice to the glass. Fill the glass with crushed ice. Stir gently with a mixing spoon to combine the ingredients and chill the cocktail. Garnish the cocktail with a slice of lemon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒杯中加入新鲜覆盆子和糖浆。用杵轻轻压碎覆盆子，释放其风味。向杯中加入干邑、黑加仑利口酒和新鲜柠檬汁。用碎冰填满杯子。用搅拌勺轻轻搅拌，使配料混合并使鸡尾酒冰镇。用一片柠檬装饰鸡尾酒。

drinks.name: Milk Punch
drinks.instructions_en: In a cocktail shaker, add: Bourbon, Heavy Cream, Simple Syrup, Vanilla Extract Shake until combined, then pour into a glass. Sprinkle or grate a little nutmeg on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒摇酒壶中加入：波本威士忌、浓奶油、糖浆、香草精。摇匀混合后倒入杯中。在表面撒上或刨上少许肉豆蔻。

drinks.name: Milk Tea
ingredients_en: 1 Table Spoon Tea powder(chai ki patti)
drinks.instructions_en: In a non-stick saucepan put tea powder(chai ia patti). Add sugar. Add water. Add milk. Boil all ingredients together on a moderate flame. Boil the tea till the mixture rises to the brim. Once boiling starts, reduce the flame to low to prevent spilling out and continue to boil for 3 to 4 minutes, while stirring off to prevent the tea leaves from sticking on the sides of the pan. Strain immediately using a strainer and discard the tea powder mixture. Serve in a mug.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在不粘奶锅中放入茶叶（chai ia patti）。加糖。加水。加牛奶。将所有配料一起用中火煮沸。煮至混合物升到锅边。一旦开始沸腾，转小火以防溢出，继续煮3至4分钟，其间搅拌以防茶叶粘在锅壁上。立即用滤网过滤，弃去茶叶混合物。倒入马克杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Milo Dinosaur
ingredients_en: 3 tbsp Nestle Milo powder to top it off
drinks.instructions_en: Stir Milo and condensed milk with hot water in a tall glass until dissolved. Add ice cubes and stir lightly. Add ample amount of Milo to provide a crunchy top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中用热水搅拌美禄和炼乳，直至溶解。加入冰块，轻轻搅拌。加入足量美禄，在顶部形成一层酥脆的口感。

drinks.name: Mimosa
drinks.instructions_en: Combine equal parts champagne and orange juice into a champagne flute.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将等量的香槟和橙汁混合倒入香槟笛形杯中。

drinks.name: Mind Eraser
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 1 ounce of Kahlúa in a rocks glass with ice. Float 2 ounces of vodka on top, pouring down the side of the glass so that it separates. Top with 2 ounces of club soda, poured down the side of the glass in the same way.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在加冰的古典杯中倒入1盎司甘露咖啡利口酒。将2盎司伏特加漂浮在其上，沿着杯壁倒入，使其分层。再加满2盎司苏打水，同样沿杯壁倒入。

drinks.name: Mint Chocolate Milkshake
drinks.name_display: 薄荷巧克力奶昔（Mint Chocolate Milkshake）
ingredients_en: 5 small scoops mint chocolate ice cream
drinks.instructions_en: Melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water. Dip the rim of a large sundae glass in the chocolate, then drizzle the rest around the inside of the rim, letting it trickle down inside the glass. Chill in the fridge to set. Blend the mint chocolate ice cream with the milk. Pour into the glass and top with a few mint leaves and a sprinkling of dark chocolate shavings.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黑巧克力放在隔水加热的耐热碗中融化。将大号圣代杯的杯口蘸入巧克力中，然后将剩余的巧克力淋在杯口内侧一圈，让其沿杯内壁流下。放入冰箱冷藏使其凝固。将薄荷巧克力冰淇淋与牛奶一起搅打。倒入杯中，顶部放几片薄荷叶并撒上一些黑巧克力碎。

drinks.name: Mint Citrus Water
drinks.instructions_en: Pour water into a pitcher. Mix lemon slices, lime slices, mint leaves, and cucumber together in a bowl; add to water and stir. Refrigerate water mixture, stirring 1 time per day, until flavors have infused, 2 to 3 days.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水倒入大壶中。将柠檬片、青柠片、薄荷叶和黄瓜在碗中混合；加入水中并搅拌。将水混合物冷藏，每天搅拌1次，直至味道充分浸出，约2至3天。

drinks.name: Mint Julep
drinks.instructions_en: Place mint leaves and Mint Simple Syrup in a chilled julep cup. Gently press leaves against cup with back of spoon to release flavors.  Pack cup tightly with crushed ice; pour bourbon over ice. Place mint sprig directly next to straw, and serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷叶和薄荷糖浆放入冰镇的朱莉普杯中。用勺背将薄荷叶轻轻压在杯壁上以释放风味。用碎冰将杯子填满压实；将波本威士忌倒在冰上。将薄荷枝直接放在吸管旁边，立即上桌。

drinks.name: Mix Berry Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Wash strawberries and blackberries. Put strawberries and blackberries into the blender. Add sweetened condensed milk, sugar, ice cubes, and enough water. Blend until the juice is evenly mixed.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将草莓和黑莓洗净。将草莓和黑莓放入搅拌机中。加入甜炼乳、糖、冰块和适量水。搅打至果汁混合均匀。

drinks.name: Mocha
drinks.instructions_en: Warm up milk in a small pot. Shut off heat just before it boils. Stir in the cocoa powder and sugar, ensuring that there are no clumps and the sugar is dissolved. Pour your espresso and milk into your cup of choice. Optional: garnish with whipped cream and extra cocoa powder. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小锅中加热牛奶。在即将沸腾前关火。搅入可可粉和糖，确保没有结块且糖已溶解。将浓缩咖啡和牛奶倒入你选用的杯中。可选：用打发的奶油和额外的可可粉装饰。享用吧！

drinks.name: Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Place ice, rum, eight broken up mint sprigs, lime juice, and sugar in a beverage shaker . Shake well and serve over ice in a high ball glass. Top off each glass with a splash of club soda. Garnish each with a slice of lime and a sprig of mint.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块、朗姆酒、8枝掰碎的薄荷、青柠汁和糖放入摇酒壶中。充分摇匀，加冰倒入海波杯中上桌。每杯加少许苏打水。每杯用一片青柠和一小枝薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Monaco
drinks.instructions_en: Mix everything together starting with the syrup. And drink!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料混合在一起，先从糖浆开始。然后饮用！

drinks.name: Monkey Gland
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ingredients into a cocktail shaker and fill with ice Shake well for 10 seconds Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料倒入鸡尾酒摇酒壶中，装满冰块。充分摇匀10秒。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Montreal Mule
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze lime juice into a Moscow Mule mug (or a Collins glass) and drop in the spent shell. Add 2 or 3 ice cubes, then pour in the gin and fill with cold ginger beer. Add fresh mint sprig. Serve with a stirring rod.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠汁挤入莫斯科骡子杯（或柯林杯）中，并把挤过的青柠壳丢入杯中。加入2至3块冰块，然后倒入金酒，加满冰镇姜汁啤酒。加入新鲜薄荷枝。配一根搅拌棒上桌。

drinks.name: Moscato Mules
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice. Add moscato, ginger beer, vodka, and lime juice. Stir to combine. Garnish with lime and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰块。加入莫斯卡托、姜汁啤酒、伏特加和青柠汁。搅拌混合。用青柠装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Moscow Breeze
drinks.instructions_en: Add requila, vodka, gin. Drop the honey. Pour the shake into the glasses and serve with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入龙舌兰、伏特加、金酒。滴入蜂蜜。将摇好的酒倒入杯中，加冰上桌。

drinks.name: Simple Moscow Mule
drinks.name_display: 简易莫斯科骡子（Simple Moscow Mule）
ingredients_en: 6 oz Ginger Ale - fill to taste
drinks.instructions_en: Start with several ice cubes in a Moscow Mule mug. Add lime and lemon juice. Add Vodka. Fill with Ginger Ale. Serve with a fresh mint leaf.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先在莫斯科骡子杯中放入几块冰块。加入青柠汁和柠檬汁。加入伏特加。加满姜汁汽水。配一片新鲜薄荷叶上桌。

drinks.name: Moscow Mule
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze lime juice into a Moscow Mule mug (or a Collins glass) and drop in the spent shell. Add 2 or 3 ice cubes, then pour in the vodka and fill with cold ginger beer. Serve with a stirring rod
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠汁挤入莫斯科骡子杯（或柯林杯）中，并把挤过的青柠壳丢入杯中。加入2至3块冰块，然后倒入伏特加，加满冰镇姜汁啤酒。配一根搅拌棒上桌。

drinks.name: Mr. Peanut Shake
drinks.name_display: 花生先生奶昔（Mr. Peanut Shake）
ingredients_en: as much as you want some peanut candy, can be cream, paçoquita or crushed peanuts
ingredients_zh: 花生糖适量，可以是花生糖浆、帕索基塔或碎花生
drinks.instructions_en: Put all the condensed milk, peanuts (your preference), ice cubes and vodka in a blender. Shake everything until it has a more liquid creamy consistency. Drink it. When in doubt, add more peanuts or vodka. If too strong, add more ice and beat again. Decorete the glass with shelled peanuts.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将全部炼乳、花生（按个人喜好）、冰块和伏特加放入搅拌机中。将所有材料搅打至较为流动的奶油质地。饮用。若有疑虑，可多加些花生或伏特加。如果太烈，就多加些冰块再打一次。用去壳花生装饰杯子。

drinks.name: Mudslide
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice and shake until well chilled Strain into a chilled Fizz glass Optional: Garnish with chocolate shavings
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入加冰的摇酒壶中，摇匀至充分冰镇。滤入冰镇的发泡酒杯中。可选：用巧克力碎装饰。

drinks.name: Mulled Apple Crumble Cider
drinks.name_display: 热苹果酥皮苹果酒（Mulled Apple Crumble Cider）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a slow cooker or pot with Zeffer’s Apple Crumble Cider. Add sugar, sliced orange rounds, cinnamon sticks and star anise. Cover the pot or slow cooker and heat until the flavours meld. If using the slow cooker leave for 2-3 hours on low or warm. Serve in a glass or mug garnished with additional orange slices and cinnamon stick. Note: A slow cooker does the double duty of both mulling the cider and keeping it warm for hours, making it a good option for winter entertaining.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将 Zeffer 苹果酥饼风味苹果酒倒入慢炖锅或锅中。加入糖、切片橙子、肉桂棒和八角。盖上慢炖锅或锅盖加热，直到各种味道融合。若使用慢炖锅，用低档或保温档炖2至3小时。倒入杯中或马克杯中上桌，再用额外的橙片和肉桂棒装饰。注：慢炖锅既能煮热苹果酒，又能将其保温数小时，是冬季聚会的好选择。

drinks.name: Mulled Wine
ingredients_en: 1 bottle red wine, such as burgundy
1/4 cup sugar, honey or maple syrup
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in large pot over medium heat. Stir until all sugar (or sweetner of your choice) is dissolved. Bring to a low boil and reduce heat immediately to simmer for 20 minutes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入大锅中，用中火加热。搅拌至所有糖（或你选择的甜味剂）溶解。煮至微沸，立即转小火煨20分钟。

drinks.name: Muskmelon Panaka
drinks.instructions_en: In a blender add half of  the chopped muskmelon and the powdered jaggery Blend the mixture until it's completely mashed Add cold water, lime juice and cardamom powder Blend the mixture again till everything gets mixed Water and jaggery can be adjusted based on personal preference Strain the blended mixture into a jar and add the remaining half of chopped muskmelon Serve chilled
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中加入一半切好的甜瓜和椰糖粉。搅打混合物直到完全捣碎。加入冷水、青柠汁和豆蔻粉。再次搅打混合物，直到所有材料混合均匀。水和椰糖可根据个人喜好调整。将搅打好的混合物过滤到罐中，加入剩余一半切好的甜瓜。冰镇后上桌。

drinks.name: Nam Thom
ingredients_zh: 1.5至2升软饮料，如百事可乐、可口可乐
drinks.instructions_en: Bring the water to a boil and bring the prepared kratom leaves to wash thoroughly. When the kratom leaves are clean and crushed, put them into boiling water. Boil for a period of approximately 30 minutes. When the time is up, then filter out the water. Then pour the sparkling water into it and stir to combine. When everything is mixed well, set it aside to cool and fill a bottle. It can be stored in the refrigerator for 1 week. Drinking volume 250 ml / time (should not drink more than 2 times a day).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水煮沸，并将准备好的卡痛叶彻底洗净。待卡痛叶洗净并揉碎后，放入沸水中。煮约30分钟。时间到后，将水滤出。然后倒入气泡水，搅拌混合。待所有材料充分混合后，放置冷却并装入瓶中。可在冰箱中保存1周。每次饮用量250毫升（每天不宜超过2次）。

drinks.name: Nannari Sarabath
drinks.instructions_en: Heat up the syrup and let it boil until it reaches a fine string of single thread consistency. Let it cool down completely and add lemon juice Transfer to a clean container and refrigerate it take a serving glass add 120ml of water Add ice cubes Give a quick stir and serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加热糖浆并煮沸，直到达到能拉出细丝的单线浓度。让其完全冷却，加入柠檬汁。转移到干净的容器中并冷藏。取一只饮用杯，加入120毫升水。加入冰块。快速搅拌，冰镇后上桌。

drinks.name: Negroni sbagliato
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all in a glass with ice cubes, mix with a bar spoon. Garnish with an orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料倒入加有冰块的杯中，用吧勺搅拌。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Negroni
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the spirits into a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled. Strain into a rocks glass filled with large ice cubes. Garnish with an orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各种烈酒放入加冰的调酒杯中混合。搅拌至冰镇。滤入装有大冰块的古典杯中。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Negroski
drinks.instructions_en: Chill a rock medium or old fashioned glass. Fill the glass with large ice cubes. Pour the spirits and give a good stir. Garnish with an orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将中号古典杯冰镇。在杯中装入大冰块。倒入烈酒并充分搅拌。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Negrumi
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the spirits into a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled. Strain into a rocks glass filled with large ice cubes. Garnish with a slice of pink grapefruit.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将各种烈酒放入加冰的调酒杯中混合。搅拌至冰镇。滤入装有大冰块的古典杯中。用一片粉红西柚装饰。

drinks.name: Nevada (Snowy Cocktail)
drinks.instructions_en: In a blender put the crushed ice, squeeze the lemon, add the condensed milk and vodka Stir well until it looks like snow. Serve it. Don't get drunk too fast.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将碎冰放入搅拌机，挤入柠檬汁，加入炼乳和伏特加，充分搅拌至呈雪状。即可享用。别喝得太快。

drinks.name: New York Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Put ice and all of the ingredients except the wine into a shaker and shake hard for about 20 seconds to chill the liquid. Strain the mix into a glass filled with ice and garnish with the cherry and orange slice. Pour the wine on top of the drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块和除葡萄酒外的所有材料放入摇酒壶，用力摇约20秒使酒液冷却。将混合液滤入装有冰块的杯中，用樱桃和橙片装饰。将葡萄酒倒在饮品表面。

drinks.name: Newfoundland Christmas Slush
drinks.name_display: 纽芬兰圣诞冰沙（Newfoundland Christmas Slush）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the water and sugar into a large pot and bring to a boil. Let the mixture boil for 3-5 minutes Once the mixture is cool, add your orange juice and lemonade, mix well until dissolved Add the can of Pinapple juice and vodka to the mix and stir Transfer the mixture to a large, freezer safe container place in freezer, stir periodically until mixture is frozen Add two scoops of slush to a cup and fill with 7Up
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水和糖倒入大锅中煮沸。让混合液沸腾3至5分钟。待混合液冷却后，加入橙汁和柠檬水，充分搅拌至溶解。将罐装菠萝汁和伏特加加入混合液中并搅拌。将混合液转入一个大的、可冷冻的容器中，放入冰箱冷冻，期间不时搅拌直至冻实。舀两勺冰沙到杯中，加满七喜汽水。

drinks.name: Nice Holiday
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients (except the garnish) to a cocktail shaker. Fill with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with whipped cream, chocolate mints, and a fresh mint leaf.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（装饰除外）放入摇酒壶。加冰至满。摇匀后滤入冰镇过的马天尼杯。用打发的鲜奶油、巧克力薄荷糖和一片新鲜薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Nigerian Chapman
drinks.instructions_en: Put the icecubes in your mixing jar. Add half a cup of the Grenadine Syrup Add 2 tablespoons of Angostura Bitters. Add a squeeze of orange and lemon each. Add the Fanta Orange and the Sprite.  Add your sliced garnishings: cucumber, apples, orange and lemons. Top off with Ribena blackcurrant and stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块放入调酒杯中。加入半杯红石榴糖浆。加入2汤匙安高天娜苦精。各挤入少许橙汁和柠檬汁。加入芬达橙味汽水和雪碧。加入切片装饰：黄瓜、苹果、橙子和柠檬。最后倒入利宾纳黑加仑汁并搅拌。

drinks.name: Nimbu Pani
drinks.instructions_en: Pour water in a vessel. Slice the lemon and squeeze the juice with the squeezer or your hand into water. Discard the seed. Add sugar, cumin powder, chat masala, mint leaves and ice cubes. Mix all until sugar dissolves. Pour into tall glasses and add lemon slices if using. Serve nimbu pani chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水倒入容器中。将柠檬切片，用榨汁器或手把汁挤入水中。去掉柠檬籽。加入糖、孜然粉、印度酸辣粉（chat masala）、薄荷叶和冰块。搅拌至糖溶解。倒入高杯中，如有需要可加入柠檬片。冰镇后享用柠檬水。

drinks.name: Noche Caliente
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients in a shaker and shake. Add some leaf of mint and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入摇酒壶中摇匀。加入几片薄荷叶后即可享用。

drinks.name: Noon Chai
drinks.instructions_en: Boil 1 cup water and brew tea leaves until frothy. Add the baking soda and whisk vigorously for about 10 seconds. Add remaining water and ginger. Add milk and whisk it vigorously over medium heat to achieve a slight froth. The colour of the tea should now be a lovely dark pink. Adjust milk to colour of your choice. Add the salt and stir well. Pour into a cup and serve the Kashmiri Noon Chai hot.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将1杯水煮沸，冲泡茶叶至起泡。加入小苏打，用力搅打约10秒。加入剩余的水和姜。加入牛奶，用中火用力搅打至略微起泡。此时茶的颜色应呈漂亮的深粉色。按自己喜欢的颜色调整牛奶用量。加入盐并充分搅拌。倒入杯中，趁热享用克什米尔午茶（Kashmiri Noon Chai）。

drinks.name: The North Pole
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the orange zest, cranberries and 2 dashes of bitter orangeIin a shaker. Add ice cream, vanilla syrup, gin and orange juice soup. Shake well and add a little club soda. Decorate according to your inspiration.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙皮屑、蔓越莓和2抖振苦橙利口酒放入摇酒壶中混合。加入冰淇淋、香草糖浆、金酒和橙汁。充分摇匀后加入少许苏打水。按自己的灵感进行装饰。

drinks.name: Norwegian Glogg (norwegian mulled wine)
drinks.name_display: 挪威热红酒（Norwegian Glogg (norwegian mulled wine)）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine wines in a large saucepan. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the zest of citrus fruits. Squeeze fruits and add juice to wine. Tie up lemon peel, orange peel and spices in cheesecloth and add to wine. Add raisins, almonds and sugar. Bring wine mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and gently simmer for 15 minutes, or until flavors are well blended and almonds are soft. Skim wine from time to time to remove any foam. Taste glogg and add sugar as necessary. Just before serving, add bitters and aquavit or vodka. Ladle glogg into mugs or cups and provide each guest a spoon for eating the raisins and almonds.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将葡萄酒倒入大锅中混合。用削皮刀削下柑橘类水果的皮屑。将水果挤汁，把果汁加入葡萄酒中。将柠檬皮、橙皮和香料用纱布包好，放入葡萄酒中。加入葡萄干、杏仁和糖。将葡萄酒混合液煮沸。转小火慢炖15分钟，或直至风味充分融合、杏仁变软。期间不时撇去浮沫。品尝热红酒（glogg），按需加糖。上桌前加入苦精和达拉木酒（aquavit）或伏特加。将热红酒舀入杯中，并给每位客人配一把勺子，用来吃葡萄干和杏仁。

drinks.name: Ultimate Nutella Milkshake
drinks.name_display: 至尊能多益奶昔（Ultimate Nutella Milkshake）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the Nutella and the vanilla icecream. Blend the mixture to an almost-liquid consistency. Transfer the blend into a cup or a glass. Add the hazelnut icecream on top. Design with chocolate paste. Add the sprinkles on top. Freeze in the refrigerator for a while. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将能多益（Nutella）和香草冰淇淋混合。将混合液搅打至接近液体的浓稠度。将混合物倒入杯中或玻璃杯。在上面加入榛子冰淇淋。用巧克力酱装饰。撒上彩色糖粒。放入冰箱冷冻一会儿。即可享用！

drinks.name: Brown Sugar Oatmilk Shaken Espresso
drinks.name_display: 红糖燕麦奶摇摇浓缩（Brown Sugar Oatmilk Shaken Espresso）
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare espresso and pour into a glass. Stir light brown sugar into the hot espresso to dissolve. Adjust to your desired level of sweetness. Take a cocktail shaker or mason jar, adding the espresso, oatmilk and ice and shake for 20 seconds. Pour into tall glass and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作浓缩咖啡并倒入玻璃杯中。将浅棕糖搅拌进热浓缩咖啡中至溶解。调整至你喜欢的甜度。取一个摇酒壶或梅森罐，加入浓缩咖啡、燕麦奶和冰块，摇20秒。倒入高杯中享用。

drinks.name: Old Cuban
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the mint leaves with simple syrup and lime juice in a shaker. Add the rum, bitters and ice, and shake until well-chilled. Double-strain into a coupe glass. Top with champagne.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中将薄荷叶与单糖浆和青柠汁捣压。加入朗姆酒、苦精和冰块，摇匀至充分冷却。双重过滤倒入碟形香槟杯。用香槟补满。

drinks.name: Old Fashioned
drinks.instructions_en: Place one large ice cube in a low-ball glass. Add 1/4oz of simple syrup and 4-6 Dashes of bitters of your choice. Add 2-4oz of whiskey.  For a true-to-history Old Fashioned; use Rye Whiskey. For a less traditional version use Bourbon. Once all in the glass gently stir until combined.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在古典杯中放入一块大冰块。加入1/4盎司单糖浆和4至6抖振你选择的苦精。加入2至4盎司威士忌。想要正统的古典鸡尾酒，请使用黑麦威士忌；想要不那么传统的版本，请使用波本威士忌。全部放入杯中后，轻轻搅拌至融合。

drinks.name: Orange Carrot Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 橙子胡萝卜冰沙（Orange Carrot Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Puree the carrots and orange in a blender. Optionally, add water or fruit juice if desired. Pour into a glass and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将胡萝卜和橙子放入搅拌机中打成泥。如有需要，可自行加入水或果汁。倒入杯中享用！

drinks.name: Orange Earl Grey Iced Tea
drinks.name_display: 橙子伯爵冰茶（Orange Earl Grey Iced Tea）
drinks.instructions_en: Steep loose tea (or tea bags) and orange peel in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes. Strain the tea (or remove tea bags and orange peel) and pour into a large pitcher. Stir in orange juice and sugar until the sugar is dissolved. Add cold water. Refrigerate until chilled, about 2 hours. Serve over ice with orange wedges, if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将散装茶叶（或茶包）和橙皮放入沸水中浸泡3至5分钟。将茶滤出（或取出茶包和橙皮），倒入大壶中。搅入橙汁和糖，直至糖溶解。加入凉水。放入冰箱冷藏至冰凉，约2小时。如需要，可加冰块并配橙瓣享用。

drinks.name: Orange Glorious
ingredients_en: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
drinks.instructions_en: Combine milk, water, orange juice concentrate, ice cubes, vanilla, and sugar in a blender.  Blend until smooth. Pour into three 12 oz glasses and enjoy with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将牛奶、水、浓缩橙汁、冰块、香草和糖放入搅拌机中混合。搅打至顺滑。倒入三个12盎司的杯中，用吸管享用。

drinks.name: Cocktail Orange Ouzo
drinks.name_display: 橙味乌佐鸡尾酒（Cocktail Orange Ouzo）
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the lemons and grapefruit in half. Grate some of the zest of the half grapefruit. Squeeze the remaining grapefruit and lemon halves. Remove the leaves from half of the mint sprigs. Put the mint leaves, sugar, 6 oz grapefruit juice and 1 oz lemon juice in a graduated container. Crush the mint leaves with the back of a spoon. Stir well until the sugar is dissolved. Mix the remaining grapefruit and lemon juice with the orange juice. Put a few ice cubes and 1 oz of ouzo in each glass. Add 2 oz of fruit juice mixture, then fill with sparkling water to the rim. Decorate the cocktail with a few sprigs of mint, a slice of lemon and grapefruit zest.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬和西柚切成两半。刨下半个西柚的部分皮屑。将剩余的西柚和柠檬挤汁。从一半薄荷枝上摘下叶子。将薄荷叶、糖、6盎司西柚汁和1盎司柠檬汁放入带刻度的容器中。用勺背压碎薄荷叶。充分搅拌至糖溶解。将剩余的西柚汁和柠檬汁与橙汁混合。每个杯中放入几块冰块和1盎司乌佐酒（ouzo）。加入2盎司果汁混合物，然后用气泡水填至杯口。用几枝薄荷、一片柠檬和西柚皮屑装饰这款鸡尾酒。

drinks.name: Orange Pineapple Moscow Mule
drinks.name_display: 橙子菠萝莫斯科骡子（Orange Pineapple Moscow Mule）
ingredients_en: Optional: pineapple wedges, and fresh mint, for serving
ingredients_zh: 可选：菠萝角和新鲜薄荷供食用
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail glass with ice. Add the vodka, lime juice, orange juice, and pineapple juice. Stir to combine. Top off with ginger beer. Garnish with pineapple wedges and fresh mint. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在鸡尾酒杯中加满冰块。加入伏特加、青柠汁、橙汁和菠萝汁。搅拌混合。用姜汁啤酒补满。用菠萝块和新鲜薄荷装饰。享用！

drinks.name: Orangeade
drinks.instructions_en: Bring 2 cups water and sugar to a boil in a small saucepan. Cook at a boil for 3 minutes, stirring to dissolve sugar, and creating a simple syrup. Combine simple syrup, 6 cups water, orange juice, and lemon juice in a large pitcher; refrigerate until cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小锅中将2杯水和糖煮沸。沸腾3分钟，搅拌使糖溶解，制成单糖浆。将单糖浆、6杯水、橙汁和柠檬汁在大壶中混合；冷藏至冰凉。

drinks.name: Oreo Frappe
drinks.instructions_en: Add all the above ingredients except the whipping cream in a blender. Blend for 20 to 25 seconds or until all of it forms a thick paste. Pour into a glass and top it up with some whipping cream using a piping bag. Add some crushed Oreos and chocolate sauce on top. Serve immediately!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除打发的鲜奶油外的所有上述材料放入搅拌机中。搅打20至25秒，或直至全部形成浓稠糊状。倒入杯中，用裱花袋挤上一些打发的鲜奶油。在上面撒些碎奥利奥和巧克力酱。立即享用！

drinks.name: Oreo Milkshake
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ice cream, milk, and 4 Oreo cookies in a blender. Blend until pourable and pour into a glass. Crush one more Oreo cookie in your hand. Add the pieces to the the top of your shake,add a straw, and enjoy! NOTE:Use 1/2 cup milk for a thicker shake, 3/4 for a thinner one.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰淇淋、牛奶和4块奥利奥饼干放入搅拌机中混合。搅打至可倒出的浓稠度，倒入杯中。用手再捏碎一块奥利奥饼干。将碎块放到奶昔表面，插入吸管，享用！注意：想要更浓稠的奶昔用1/2杯牛奶，想要更稀的用3/4杯。

drinks.name: Orgasm
drinks.instructions_en: Build all ingredients over ice in an old fashioned glass Give it a good stir Garnish with a cherry and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料在古典杯中加冰依次倒入。好好搅拌一下。用樱桃装饰后即可享用。

drinks.name: Ozark Speedball
drinks.instructions_en: Stir chilled coffee, coffee liqueur, and white whiskey in an ice-filled shaker. Strain into a chilled old-fashioned glass. Top with heavy cream and a dash of Angostura bitters; garnish with 4 drops orange oil.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰镇咖啡、咖啡利口酒和白威士忌放入装有冰块的摇酒壶中搅拌。滤入冰镇过的古典杯。表面覆上重奶油和一抖振安高天娜苦精；用4滴橙油装饰。

drinks.name: P2
ingredients_zh: 柠檬青柠汽水，例如七喜
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice cubes and lime wedges to a tall glass Add Sourz and Vodka Top up the glass with your preferred lemon & lime soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块和青柠角放入高杯。加入Sourz利口酒和伏特加。用你喜欢的柠檬青柠苏打水补满杯中。

drinks.name: Paan Shot
ingredients_en: 4 tablespoon gulkand (sweet preserve of rose petals)
ingredients_zh: 4汤匙古尔康德玫瑰花瓣酱（sweet preserve of rose petals）
drinks.instructions_en: Tear apart the paan leaves using your hand and add to a mixer. Add all the other ingredients in the same mixer jar and blend until smooth. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Pour equal quantities of the paan shot into 12 shot glasses and serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用手将蒌叶（paan）撕碎，放入搅拌机中。将其他所有材料加入同一搅拌机中，搅打至顺滑。冷藏至少1小时。将蒌叶小酒（paan shot）平均倒入12个子弹杯中，冰镇后享用。

drinks.name: Pain Killer
drinks.instructions_en: Add the rum, pineapple juice, orange juice and cream of coconut to a shaker with ice and shake vigorously but briefly to combine. Strain into a hurricane glass or snifter over crushed ice. Garnish with freshly grated nutmeg and a pineapple wedge. Serve with a straw.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将朗姆酒、菠萝汁、橙汁和椰子奶油放入加冰的摇酒壶中，用力但快速地摇匀混合。滤入飓风杯或郁金香杯中，加碎冰。用现刨肉豆蔻和菠萝块装饰。配吸管享用。

drinks.name: Palembang Red Bean Ice
drinks.name_display: 巨港红豆冰（Palembang Red Bean Ice）
drinks.instructions_en: Boil red beans or presto dried beans that have been soaked overnight with brown sugar, granulated sugar, salt, pandan leaves and vanilla. Wait until tender after the beans are soft, turn off the heat, and wait for it to cool Prepare a bowl or glass of berries with enough red beans at the bottom. Cover with shaved ice cubes and then flush with coco pandan syrup, 4 tablespoons skm chocolate, and 4 tablespoons coconut milk. Then give the avocado slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将红豆或浸泡过夜后沥干的红豆，与棕榈糖、白砂糖、盐、香兰叶和香草一起煮。待豆子变软后，转小火煮至软糯后关火，等待冷却。准备一个碗或玻璃杯，底部放入足量红豆。盖上刨冰，然后淋上椰香香兰糖浆、4汤匙巧克力味加糖炼乳和4汤匙椰奶。最后放上牛油果片。

drinks.name: Palm Sugar Sharbat
drinks.instructions_en: Add Palm Sugar in a blender and blend it.  Then add cumin seed in the blender and blend it  After this add cocunut water and water in the blender and blend it. At last add the basil seend into the drink Now wait for the drink to get cold Your Drink is ready, Enjoy this yummy drink!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将棕榈糖放入搅拌机中搅打。然后加入孜然籽到搅拌机中搅打。之后加入椰汁和水到搅拌机中搅打。最后将罗勒籽加入饮品中。接下来等待饮品变凉。你的饮品就做好了，享用这杯美味的饮料吧！

drinks.name: Paloma
ingredients_en: 2 or 3 oz tequila (I prefer a silver or blanco, but use what you like)
Grapefruite soda (like Fresca, Squirt, or Jarritos)
(optional) Tajin - a seasoning mix of lime, chilies, and salt
ingredients_zh: 2或3盎司龙舌兰（I prefer a silver or blanco, but use what you like）
西柚汽水（like Fresca, Squirt, or Jarritos）
塔欣调味料，由青柠、辣椒和盐混合而成（optional）
drinks.instructions_en: Rim your glass with a wedge of lime and the Tajin (if using) or salt. Squeeze the other lime into the glass. Add a pinch of salt to the glass. Add ice and tequila. Fill with the grapefruit soda and stir. Garnish with a wedge of lime and enjoy!. Photo credit: Sarah Stierch (CC BY 4.0)
drinks.instructions_zh: 用青柠角和塔欣辣椒盐（如使用）或盐给杯口挂边。将另一个青柠挤汁入杯。在杯中加入一小撮盐。加入冰块和龙舌兰酒。用西柚汽水补满并搅拌。用青柠角装饰即可享用！照片来源：Sarah Stierch（CC BY 4.0）。

drinks.name: Panty Ripper
ingredients_en: Orange or pineapple slice for garnish
ingredients_zh: 橙子片或菠萝片用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all the ingredients in a cup of ice and enjoy with a straw. Panty Rippers are great to enjoy in hot sunny days and if you’re either poolside or on the beach – that would be perfection.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有这些材料加入一杯冰块中混合，用吸管享用。Panty Ripper非常适合在炎热的晴天享用，如果你在泳池边或海滩上——那就完美了。

drinks.name: Papaya Gin Sling
drinks.name_display: 木瓜金酒司令（Papaya Gin Sling）
drinks.instructions_en: Shake gin,bitters,lime juice and papaya juice in a cocktail shaker with ice. Strain into a collins glass filled with ice cubes. Fill the rest of the way with soda water, stir and garnish with a pineapple stick or canned pineapple tidbits.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、苦精、青柠汁和木瓜汁放入加冰的摇酒壶中摇匀。滤入装有冰块的柯林杯中。用苏打水补满剩余部分，搅拌，用菠萝棒或罐装菠萝小块装饰。

drinks.name: Papaya Milk
ingredients_en: 1/2 table spoon Sweetened condensed milk or honey (optional)
drinks.instructions_en: Blend papaya cubes along with milk. Add sweetened condensed milk and/or honey to the papaya milk and blend it again if it's not sweet enough. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将木瓜块与牛奶一起搅打。向木瓜奶中加入加糖炼乳和/或蜂蜜，如果不够甜就再搅打一次。享用！

drinks.name: Paper Plane
drinks.instructions_en: Add bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino, and lemon juice to a shaker with ice. Shake until well chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe glass. Garnish with a lemon twist if you like.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将波本威士忌、阿佩罗（Aperol）、诺尼诺苦味酒（Amaro Nonino）和柠檬汁放入加冰的摇酒壶中。摇至充分冷却。滤入冰镇过的碟形杯。如喜欢，可用柠檬皮卷装饰。

drinks.name: Passion Star Martini
drinks.name_display: 百香果之星马天尼（Passion Star Martini）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients except sparkling wine into a shaker with ice and shake vigorously until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe glass. Garnish with a passion fruit half. Serve with a sparkling wine sidecar (on the side). Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除起泡酒外的所有材料放入加冰的摇酒壶中，用力摇匀至充分冷却。滤入冰镇过的碟形杯。用半个百香果装饰。旁边配一小杯起泡酒（作为佐酒）。享用！

drinks.name: Peach Bellini
ingredients_en: 1 splash Red wine or Prosecco on top of each cup
ingredients_zh: 1点红葡萄酒或普罗塞克，浮于每杯顶部
drinks.instructions_en: Add the frozen & sliced peaches with peach vodka or Schnapps and ice to the blender. Blend well until the mix is uniform but creamy in the blender. Depending on taste and if needed add more ice or peaches to get it consistent, or more vodka to make it more liquid. Pour it on your favorite drink glass and add the splash of Red Wine or Prosecco on top of it to give it a lovely and tasty look.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冷冻切片桃子、桃子伏特加或桃子利口酒和冰块放入搅拌机。充分搅打至混合液均匀但呈奶油状。根据口味需要，可加入更多冰块或桃子使其浓稠一致，或加入更多伏特加使其更稀。将其倒入你喜欢的酒杯中，在表面淋上少许红酒或普罗塞克，使其外观可爱美味。

drinks.name: Peach Fizz
