drinks.instructions_en: Rim a highball glass with sugar. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Pour in everything exept the soda. Shake until chilled. Pour the mixture into a sugar-rimmed highball glass. Top the rest of the way with soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用糖给高球杯杯口挂边。在摇酒壶中加满冰块。倒入除苏打水外的所有材料。摇至冰凉。将混合液倒入挂糖边的高球杯。用苏打水补满剩余部分。

drinks.name: Peach Green Tea Lemonade
drinks.name_display: 桃子绿茶柠檬水（Peach Green Tea Lemonade）
drinks.instructions_en: Steep 4 bags green tea in 4 cups of boiled water for 3 minutes. Add 4 cups of lemonade when cooled. Fill cup with ice cubes, add 4 tablespoons of peach syrup. Add more syrup if desired, and enjoy! Serves 4.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将4个绿茶茶包放入4杯沸水中浸泡3分钟。冷却后加入4杯柠檬水。在杯中加满冰块，加入4汤匙桃子糖浆。如需要可加更多糖浆，尽情享用！可供4人饮用。

drinks.name: Peach Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Place the peach schnapps, vodka, orange juice, triple sec, and lime juice in a cocktail shaker. Add 2 handfuls of ice and shake until cold. Strain the drink into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a peach slice if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将桃子利口酒、伏特加、橙汁、三重橙酒和青柠汁放入摇酒壶。加入2把冰块，摇至冰凉。将饮品滤入鸡尾酒杯。如喜欢，可用桃子片装饰。

drinks.name: Peach Ring Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add peach schnapps, vodka, and sour mix. Shake and strain into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰块。加入桃子利口酒、伏特加和酸味混合料。摇匀后滤入子弹杯。立即享用。

drinks.name: Peach and Thyme Whiskey Smash
drinks.name_zh: 桃子百里香威士忌碎冰酒
drinks.name_display: 桃子百里香威士忌碎冰酒（Peach and Thyme Whiskey Smash）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine peach slices, thyme, mint and honey in a cocktail shaker. Gently muddle. Add ice, lemon juice, and bourbon and shake. Strain into a glass with ice. Garnish with peach slices and a thyme spring.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将桃子片、百里香、薄荷和蜂蜜放入摇酒壶中混合。轻轻捣压。加入冰块、柠檬汁和波本威士忌摇匀。滤入加冰的杯中。用桃子片和一枝百里香装饰。

drinks.name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 花生酱香蕉冰沙（Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Cut bananas into chunks. Place bananas, milk, peanut butter, honey and ice cubs in a blender. Blend until smooth (about 30 seconds).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将香蕉切成块。将香蕉、牛奶、花生酱、蜂蜜和冰块放入搅拌机。搅打至顺滑（约30秒）。

drinks.name: Pear Manhattan Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 梨子曼哈顿鸡尾酒（Pear Manhattan Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour whiskey, vodka, sweet vermouth, and ice into a cocktail shaker. Cover and shake until chilled. Strain into a chilled martini glass and garnish with maraschino cherry and pear slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌、伏特加、甜味美思和冰块倒入摇酒壶。盖上盖子摇至冰凉。滤入冰镇过的马天尼杯，用马拉斯奇诺樱桃和梨片装饰。

drinks.name: Penicillin
ingredients_en: 1/4 oz Islay single malt Scotch whisky
ingredients_zh: 1/4盎司艾雷岛单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌
drinks.instructions_en: Add the fresh ginger slices to a shaker and muddle gently to release the oils. Add the blended Scotch whisky, lemon juice, honey syrup, and ginger liqueur to the shaker. Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously for 10-15 seconds. Double strain the mixture into a rocks glass filled with ice. Float the Islay single malt Scotch on top by pouring it slowly over the back of a bar spoon. Garnish with a slice of fresh ginger and serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将新鲜姜片放入摇酒壶中轻轻捣压，释放其精油。将调和苏格兰威士忌、柠檬汁、蜂蜜糖浆和姜味利口酒加入摇酒壶。在摇酒壶中加满冰块，用力摇10至15秒。将混合液双重过滤倒入装有冰块的古典杯。将艾雷岛单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌沿吧勺背缓慢倒入，使其浮在表面。用一片新鲜生姜装饰，立即享用。

drinks.name: Peppermint Bark Mimosa
drinks.name_display: 薄荷树皮含羞草（Peppermint Bark Mimosa）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour melted chocolate onto a small plate. Pour crushed candy canes onto a separate plate. Dip rims of champagne flutes first in chocolate, then in crushed candy canes to coat. Add an ounce of peppermint schnapps to each glass, then top with champagne or prosecco. Garnish with full candy canes before serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将融化的巧克力倒在小盘上。将碎拐杖糖倒在另一个盘上。将香槟杯杯口先蘸巧克力，再蘸碎拐杖糖使其裹上。每个杯中加入1盎司薄荷利口酒，然后用香槟或普罗塞克补满。上桌前用整根拐杖糖装饰。

drinks.name: Peppermint Shake
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice cream, milk, crushed cane pieces and peppermint extract to a blender. Mix until well combined. Pour into glass and top with whipped cream and candy cane pieces.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰淇淋、牛奶、碎糖棒和薄荷提取物放入搅拌机。搅拌至充分混合。倒入杯中，表面覆上打发的鲜奶油和拐杖糖碎块。

drinks.name: Pick a Daisy
drinks.instructions_en: Place the Pick a Daisy cocktail ingredients in a shaker. Add ice (optional). Shave vigorously. Pour into a coupe and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将Pick a Daisy鸡尾酒的所有材料放入摇酒壶。加入冰块（可选）。用力摇匀。倒入碟形杯享用。

drinks.name: Pickleback Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Pour whiskey into one shot glass. Pour pickle juice into a second shot glass. Shoot the whiskey, then chase with the pickle juice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌倒入一个子弹杯。将腌黄瓜汁倒入第二个子弹杯。先一口喝下威士忌，再以腌黄瓜汁作为续饮。

drinks.name: Pimms
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to glass. Pour Pimms and Lemonade. Stir well. Add cucumber, Orange, and Strawberry. Enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加入冰块。倒入皮姆酒（Pimm's）和柠檬水。充分搅拌。加入黄瓜、橙子和草莓。享用。

drinks.name: Piña Colada
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the ingredients with 5 or 6 ice cubes in a blender and mix everything. Decorate with a piece of pineapple and a candied cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将材料与5到6块冰块放入搅拌机中混合搅打。用一块菠萝和一颗糖渍樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Pineapple Juice
ingredients_en: Granulated sugar to taste, or can be replaced with coco pandan syrup.
ingredients_zh: 砂糖适量，可用椰子香兰糖浆代替
drinks.instructions_en: Peel Pineapple Skin. Cut pineapple to make the blender easier, then put it in a blender glass with water and sugar. Blend for about 2 minutes until smooth. Last but not least, it's ready to be served with sweetener according to taste.
drinks.instructions_zh: 削去菠萝皮。将菠萝切开以便搅拌机更好处理，然后与水和糖一起放入搅拌机杯中。搅打约2分钟至顺滑。最后但同样重要的是，可根据口味加入甜味剂后上桌。

drinks.name: Pineapple Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: To make the simple syrup, combine sugar and 1 cup water in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring until the sugar has dissolved; let cool.  In a large pitcher, whisk together simple syrup, lemon juice, pineapple juice, lime juice Transfer to a clean container and refrigerate it Add ice cubes Give a quick stir and serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作单糖浆：将糖和1杯水放入中等锅中，中火加热，搅拌至糖溶解；放凉。在大壶中，将单糖浆、柠檬汁、菠萝汁、青柠汁搅拌混合。转入干净的容器并冷藏。加入冰块。快速搅拌一下，冰镇后享用。

drinks.name: Pineapple Lime Beer Margarita
drinks.name_zh: 菠萝青柠啤酒玛格丽特
drinks.name_display: 菠萝青柠啤酒玛格丽特（Pineapple Lime Beer Margarita）
ingredients_en: Optional: Pineapple slice and lime wedges for garnish
ingredients_zh: 可选：菠萝片和青柠角用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Salt the rim of the glass. Combine the tequila, pineapple juice, lime juice and agave nectar in a cocktail shaker and fill with ice. Shake until combined and then strain into prepared glass. Top off with beer. Optional: Garnish with pineapple and lime wedges. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 用盐给杯口挂边。将龙舌兰酒、菠萝汁、青柠汁和龙舌兰糖浆放入摇酒壶中并加满冰块。摇匀后滤入准备好的杯中。用啤酒补满。可选：用菠萝块和青柠角装饰。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Pineapple Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add vodka and pineapple juice. Shake briefly and strain into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰块。加入伏特加和菠萝汁。快速摇匀后滤入子弹杯。立即享用。

drinks.name: Pineapple Upside Down Shot
drinks.name_display: 菠萝翻转蛋糕子弹（Pineapple Upside Down Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add vanilla vodka and pineapple juice and shake briefly. Strain into a shot glass. Slowly add a dash of grenadine so it sinks to the bottom.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰块。加入香草伏特加和菠萝汁，快速摇匀。滤入子弹杯。缓慢加入一抖振红石榴糖浆，使其沉到底部。

drinks.name: Pink Gin
drinks.instructions_en: Add gin and bitters to a cocktail shaker. Add ice and stir untill gin is chilled. Pour cocktail into a martini glass and garnish as desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒和苦精加入摇酒壶。加入冰块搅拌至金酒冰凉。将鸡尾酒倒入马天尼杯，按喜好装饰。

drinks.name: Pink Grapefruit Margarita
drinks.name_display: 粉红西柚玛格丽特（Pink Grapefruit Margarita）
ingredients_en: Sea salt, to rim the glass
drinks.instructions_en: Wet the rim of a glass with a cut piece of the grapefruit or lime. Pour the sea salt on a plate and dip the wet rim into the salt. Fill the glass with ice. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice then add the tequila, pink grapefruit juice, lime juice, and agave. Shake until cold then strain into the prepared glass. Garnish with a slice of grapefruit.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用切开的西柚或青柠把杯口弄湿。将海盐倒在盘子上，把湿润的杯口蘸上盐。在杯中加满冰块。在摇酒壶中加满冰块，然后加入龙舌兰酒、粉红西柚汁、青柠汁和龙舌兰糖浆。摇至冰凉后滤入准备好的杯中。用一片西柚装饰。

drinks.name: Pink Lady
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into a shaker Add ice into the shaker. Shake vigorously. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加入摇酒壶。加入冰块。用力摇匀。滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯。用樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Pink cocktail with Ouzo
drinks.name_display: 乌佐粉红鸡尾酒（Pink cocktail with Ouzo）
drinks.instructions_en: Rinse the mint, wash the lemon and cut it into slices. Make a cut towards the centre of each slice so that it can be held straddling the edge of the glass. Pour the Ouzo, grenadine, water in a shaker and shake. Pour into 4 large glasses with ice cubes and decorate with lemon slices and mint leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 冲洗薄荷，洗净柠檬并切成片。每片切一道口子到中心，使其能跨挂在杯沿上。将乌佐酒、红石榴糖浆、水放入摇酒壶中摇匀。倒入4个大杯中，加冰块，用柠檬片和薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Pisco Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Combine the egg white, Pisco, simple syrup and lemon/lime juice. Cover and shake vigorously for 15 seconds. Strain the contents into a 6-ounce cocktail glass. Top with a few drops of bitters.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中加满冰块。将蛋白、皮斯科酒（Pisco）、单糖浆和柠檬/青柠汁混合。盖上盖子用力摇15秒。将内容物滤入6盎司鸡尾酒杯。表面滴上几滴苦精。

drinks.name: Planters Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Pour into highball with ice. Top up with soda water. Stir gently and add a dash of Angostura Bitters. Garnish with orange slices.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入加满冰块的摇酒壶。充分摇匀。倒入加冰的高球杯。用苏打水补满。轻轻搅拌并加入一抖振安高天娜苦精。用橙片装饰。

drinks.name: Pok Shot
drinks.instructions_en: Prepare a small glass on a strong table. Pour vodka, soda, and lime juice by step. Put salt around the rim of the glass. Hand cover the glass mouth and then slam on table and drink quickly.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在结实的桌上准备一个小杯。依次倒入伏特加、苏打水和青柠汁。在杯口周围放盐。用手盖住杯口，然后猛砸桌面并快速饮下。

drinks.name: Danish Polar Bear
ingredients_en: Ice cubes or crushed ice cubes
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice. Pour in vodka and soda. Gently pour in the curaçao.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入冰块。倒入伏特加和苏打水。轻轻倒入蓝橙酒。

drinks.name: Polar Bear
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with all the listed ingredients. Shake and serve in a shot glass. Add a mint leaf as garnish (optional).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有列出的材料放入摇酒壶。摇匀后倒入子弹杯。用一片薄荷叶作装饰（可选）。

drinks.name: Pomegranate Lemon Mint Refresher
drinks.name_display: 石榴柠檬薄荷清凉饮（Pomegranate Lemon Mint Refresher）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour ice cubes into a large glass pitcher. Slice the pomegranate in half. Squeeze the juice from both halves over the ice cubes. Slice the lemon in half. Squeeze the lemon juice into the pitcher. Pour the sparkling water into the pitcher. Put the nicest leaves into the pitcher. Pour into a tall glass and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块倒入大玻璃壶中。将石榴切成两半。将两半的汁挤在冰块上。将柠檬切成两半，把柠檬汁挤入壶中。将气泡水倒入壶中。把最好看的薄荷叶放入壶中。倒入高杯中享用！

drinks.name: Pomegranate Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: In a pitcher, add pomegranate juice, lime juice, tequila, and Cointreau (or Triple Sec) and mix well until combined. Taste and adjust if needed (more juice, more lime, more tequila, etc. Divide among ice filled glasses, and garnish with pomegranate seeds and lime wedges. Serve at once.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在壶中加入石榴汁、青柠汁、龙舌兰酒和君度（或三重橙酒），充分搅拌混合。品尝并按需调整（更多果汁、更多青柠、更多龙舌兰酒等）。分装到加冰的杯中，用石榴籽和青柠角装饰。立即享用。

drinks.name: Pomegranate Martini
drinks.instructions_en: The first step is to take and fill a shaker with three-fourths of it filled with ice Second step is to then proceed to add pomegranate juice, vodka, triple sec, club soda, and the lemon juice all together Afterwards, cover the shaker and shake for 10-15 seconds, or until you see the condensation forms on the outside of the shaker Then, pour the strain into a chilled cocktail glass Finally, add the pomegranate seeds and the lemon zest strips(the lemon zest is optional)
drinks.instructions_zh: 第一步是取一个摇酒壶，将其四分之三装满冰块。第二步是加入石榴汁、伏特加、三重橙酒、苏打水和柠檬汁。之后盖上摇酒壶摇10至15秒，或直到看到摇酒壶外壁结霜。然后滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯。最后加入石榴籽和柠檬皮条（柠檬皮为可选）。

drinks.name: Pompous Mexican
drinks.instructions_en: Take a sip (or pour out) a small amount of the Corona, down to where the neck widens, creating room for the other ingredients. Carefully pour the Tanqueray & lemon juice into the bottle of Corona. Cap the bottle tightly with your thumb, invert until the ingredients mix fully. Drink and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先喝一小口（或倒出）少量科罗娜啤酒，喝到瓶颈变宽处，为其他材料腾出空间。小心地将添加利金酒和柠檬汁倒入科罗娜酒瓶中。用拇指紧紧盖住瓶口，倒置摇匀至材料完全混合。饮用享用。

drinks.name: Pornstar Martini
ingredients_en: 30 ml passion fruit purée (or passion fruit juice)
ingredients_zh: 30毫升百香果泥（or passion fruit juice）
30毫升普罗塞克（served on the side）
drinks.instructions_en: Chill a coupe or martini glass. Add vanilla vodka, Passoã, passion fruit purée, lime juice, and vanilla syrup to a shaker with ice. Shake hard until well chilled. Double strain into the chilled glass. Serve with a small shot of prosecco on the side and garnish with half a passion fruit (optional).
drinks.instructions_zh: 冰镇一个碟形杯或马天尼杯。将香草伏特加、百香果利口酒（Passoã）、百香果果泥、青柠汁和香草糖浆放入加冰的摇酒壶。用力摇至充分冷却。双重过滤倒入冰镇过的杯中。旁边配一小杯普罗塞克，并用半个百香果装饰（可选）。

drinks.name: Port & Tonic
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice, Port and Tonic to glass Mix well with spoon. Add peppermint leaf and  garnish with your choice of citrus wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加入冰块、波特酒和汤力水。用勺子充分搅拌。加入薄荷叶，并按喜好用柑橘角装饰。

drinks.name: Pudina Sherbet
ingredients_en: 3 cups Chilled Water or Ice Cubes
drinks.instructions_en: Remove the mint leaves from stems and wash it very well. Take all the ingredients in the blender with only ½ cup of water. Blend it into smooth puree. Add remaining water and swirl again 2-3 times or till just all get incorporated. Strain the juice using strainer. (Optional) If your water is not chilled then chill it in the refrigerator or serve with ice cubes. If juice is refrigerated then stir first and then pour into the serving glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷叶从茎上摘下并充分洗净。将所有材料与仅1/2杯水放入搅拌机。搅打成顺滑的果泥。加入剩余的水，再搅打2至3次，或直到刚好全部混合均匀。用滤网过滤出汁液。（可选）如果你的水没有冰镇，可放入冰箱冷藏，或加冰块享用。如果汁液已冷藏，先搅拌再倒入饮用杯中。

drinks.name: Puka Punch
ingredients_en: 2 parts Light rum or Aged rum
3/4 part Dark rum or Demerara rum or Spiced rum
3/4 part Passion fruit syrup or Passion fruit liqueur
1/4 part Falernum liqueur or Falernum syrup
1 dash Aromatic bitters or Orange bitters or Peach bitters
3/4 part Overproof aged rum or Overproof light rum
ingredients_zh: 3/4份黑朗姆酒或德梅拉拉朗姆酒或香料朗姆酒
3/4份百香果糖浆或百香果利口酒
1/4份法勒南利口酒或法勒南糖浆
芳香苦精或橙味苦精或桃子苦精
3/4份高度陈年朗姆酒或高度淡朗姆酒
drinks.instructions_en: Put everything (except the overproof Demerara rum) in a blender with about a cup and a half of ice.  Blend on high until liquidified, pour into a tall glass, and top with more ice. Top with the overproof rum by slowly pouring over the back of a spoon. Garnish with fruits, herbs, little paper umbrellas, etc. Serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料（除高浓度德梅拉拉朗姆酒外）与约一杯半冰块放入搅拌机。高速搅打至完全液化，倒入高杯中，再加些冰块。将高浓度朗姆酒沿吧勺背缓慢倒在表面。用水果、香草、小纸伞等装饰。上桌！

drinks.name: Pumpkin Juice
ingredients_en: 2 1/2  cups apple cider or apple juice
1 cup water or to taste. You can add more if you are looking for something less sweet
1 portion honey or maple syrup to taste (optional. I don't add it as I find the apple juice is sweet enough on its own)
ingredients_zh: 1份蜂蜜或枫糖浆，按口味（optional. I don't add it as I find the apple juice is sweet enough on its own）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a blender and pulse to combine. Simmer for 5 minutes to help enhance the flavor of the spices infuse into the mixture. Enjoy warm or cool and enjoy chilled. Store leftovers in an air-tight jar or container in fridge for 3-4 days. Shake or mix well before serving after storing as the pumpkin will settle.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入搅拌机中，点动搅打混合。小火煮5分钟，有助于香料的香味融入混合液中。趁热享用，或放凉冷藏后饮用。剩余的存放在冰箱中的密封罐或容器中，可保存3至4天。存放后上桌前摇匀或充分搅拌，因为南瓜会沉淀。

drinks.name: Pumpkin Spice Latte
drinks.name_display: 南瓜香料拿铁（Pumpkin Spice Latte）
drinks.instructions_en: Preheat oven to 325 degrees Bake pumpkin slices 30 minutes Peel off skin from pumpkin Blend the pumpkin using fork In a pot stir the water with sugar until sugar will be mixed with water Add the pumkin and spices Stir for 5-7 mins. Remove from heat and immediately strain through cheesecloth. Once the tea is cooled, remove from the fridge. Heat and froth milk Brew the coffee in an espresso machine Place Homemade Pumpkin Spice Syrup into a mug, followed by hot espresso.  Stir all together. Fill mug with heated frothed milk until ¾ full, then top with whipped cream. Sprinkle with pumpkin pie spice!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将烤箱预热至325华氏度。将南瓜片烤30分钟。削去南瓜皮。用叉子将南瓜压成泥。在锅中将水和糖搅拌至糖与水混合。加入南瓜和香料。搅拌5至7分钟。离火，立即用纱布过滤。待茶冷却后，从冰箱取出。加热牛奶并打出奶泡。用意式咖啡机冲泡咖啡。将自制南瓜香料糖浆倒入马克杯，随后加入热浓缩咖啡。一起搅拌均匀。用加热并打出奶泡的牛奶填至马克杯四分之三满，然后表面覆上打发的鲜奶油。撒上南瓜派香料！

drinks.name: The Pumpkintini
ingredients_en: Rim: Caramel Syrup, Graham Cracker Crumbs
ingredients_zh: 杯边：焦糖糖浆和全麦饼干碎
装饰用打发奶油和糖粒
drinks.instructions_en: Rim edge of a martini glass with caramel syrup and graham cracker crumbs. In a shaker with ice, combine ingredients and shake thoroughly. Strain mix into rimmed glass and top with whipped cream and sprinkles.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用焦糖糖浆和全麦饼干碎给马天尼杯杯口挂边。在加冰的摇酒壶中，混合所有材料并充分摇匀。将混合液滤入挂边的杯中，表面覆上打发的鲜奶油和糖粒。

drinks.name: Purple Basil Sherbet
drinks.instructions_en: Boil 5 liters of water. Add purple basil into the water when bubbles start rising. Boil for couple of minutes. Slice your lemons in half and squeeze them. Add the sugar and freshly squeezed lemon juice into the boiling purple basil. Mix gently and let it boil for couple more minutes. Turn off the heat and let it rest for couple of minutes. Gently remove the purple basil from your mix. Put your drink into a pitcher and to the fridge and let it cool. Ta-da! your drink is ready.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将5升水煮沸。水开始冒泡时加入紫罗勒。煮几分钟。将柠檬切成两半并挤汁。将糖和现挤的柠檬汁加入沸腾的紫罗勒水中。轻轻搅拌，再煮几分钟。关火，静置几分钟。轻轻将紫罗勒从混合液中取出。将饮品倒入壶中，放入冰箱冷却。瞧！你的饮品就做好了。

drinks.name: Purple Haze
drinks.instructions_en: Gather your ingredients. Pour the vodka and black raspberry liqueur into a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake well! Strain into an old-fashioned glass with fresh ice. Top with cranberry juice. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好材料。将伏特加和黑覆盆子利口酒倒入加冰的摇酒壶。充分摇匀！滤入装有新鲜冰块的古典杯。用蔓越莓汁补满。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Queimada
drinks.instructions_en: We place the aguardiente and sugar in a clay pot of our own to burn, in the proportion of 150 grams for each liter of brandy. We reserve 2 tablespoons of sugar to plant the fire, so we peel the lemons and the orange and throw them into the clay container Now comes the most important part. In a ladle we put the 2 tablespoons of sugar with a little brandy and we start a flame on the spoon, when the flame starts we bring it to the container of the queimada so that it begins to burn. We add a handfull of coffee beans, the ones that fit in one hand. In this way, the drink will have a toasted color, also thanks to the caramel that is going to be formed with the sugar. Wait for the fire to burn out and cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 我们将甘蔗酒（aguardiente）和糖放入我们自己的陶罐中点燃，比例为每升白兰地配150克糖。我们留下2汤匙糖用来点火，然后我们将柠檬和橙子削皮并扔进陶罐中。现在到了最重要的部分。我们在一个长柄勺中放入那2汤匙糖和少许白兰地，在勺上点燃火焰，当火焰燃起时，我们把它拿到queimada的陶罐处，使其开始燃烧。我们加入一把咖啡豆，一只手能抓的量。这样，饮品会有烘烤的颜色，这也得益于糖形成的焦糖。等待火焰燃尽，干杯！

drinks.name: Quick Demise
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze the citrus beforehand. Add the vodka, carrot juice, orange juice, lime juice, ginger cardamom syrup, and a splash of club soda/seltzer into the cocktail shaker with ice. Shake well. Pour over a rocks glass rimmed with the black sugar sprinkles. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 事先将柑橘挤汁。将伏特加、胡萝卜汁、橙汁、青柠汁、姜豆蔻糖浆和少许苏打水/气泡水加入加冰的摇酒壶。充分摇匀。倒入杯口沾有黑糖碎的古典杯。享用！

drinks.name: Quick Milk Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Make a cup of hot tea by boiling some water. Remove the tea bag and add a few teaspoons of condensed and sweetened milk. Put it into the fridge and let the tea cool down. Add some ice cubes Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 烧些水泡一杯热茶。取出茶包，加入几茶匙加糖炼乳。放入冰箱让茶冷却。加入一些冰块。享用！

drinks.name: Rabo de galo
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients in a shot glass. Decorate with lemon peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料倒入子弹杯。用柠檬皮装饰。

drinks.name: Ramos Gin Fizz
drinks.name_display: 拉莫斯金菲士（Ramos Gin Fizz）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 2.5 cl of quail egg white, 1.5 cl of lemon juice, 1.5 cl of lime juice, 5 cl of light crème fraîche, 3 cl of sugar syrup and 5 cl of gin into a shaker. Add 0.5 cl of orange blossom water. Dry shake (no ice). Fill the shaker with ice cubes and shake vigorously again. Filter in a cooled Collins glass. Complete with sparkling water and mix gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将2.5厘升鹌鹑蛋白、1.5厘升柠檬汁、1.5厘升青柠汁、5厘升淡法式鲜奶油、3厘升糖浆和5厘升金酒倒入摇酒壶。加入0.5厘升橙花水。干摇（不加冰）。在摇酒壶中加满冰块，再次用力摇匀。滤入冰镇过的柯林杯。用气泡水补满并轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Ranch Water
ingredients_en: 120 ml Topo Chico (or sparkling mineral water)
ingredients_zh: 120毫升托波奇科气泡水（or sparkling mineral water）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a highball glass with ice. Add tequila and lime juice. Top with chilled Topo Chico (or sparkling water). Stir gently and garnish with a lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中加满冰块。加入龙舌兰酒和青柠汁。用冰镇的Topo Chico（或气泡水）补满。轻轻搅拌，用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Raspberry Caipirinha
drinks.instructions_en: Wash the lime and cut the lime into 4 pieces. Place the pieces in the glass and pour a good tablespoon of sugar. Crush firmly into the glass until the juice is extracted as completely as possible. Place the raspberry and gently crush them. Cover the lime-sugar mixture with a good layer of crushed ice. Add the cachaça. Serve in an old fashioned glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠洗净并切成4块。将青柠块放入杯中，倒入满满一汤匙糖。在杯中用力捣压，尽可能将汁液完全挤出。放入覆盆子并轻轻压碎。用一层厚厚碎冰盖住青柠糖混合物。加入卡莎萨（cachaça）。用古典杯盛装。

drinks.name: Raspberry Drink
drinks.instructions_en: Place raspberries, lemon juice and sugar into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour mixture into a fine sieve and strain to remove the seeds. Add ice to serving glasses and fill each glass with raspberry syrup equally. Top each glass with sparkling water. Stir and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将覆盆子、柠檬汁和糖放入搅拌机搅打至顺滑。将混合液倒入细滤网中过滤以去除籽。在饮用杯中加冰，每杯平均倒入覆盆子糖浆。每杯用气泡水补满。搅拌后享用！

drinks.name: Rebujito
ingredients_en: 500 ml Lemon-lime soft drink (like Sprite, 7 up)
ingredients_zh: 500毫升柠檬青柠汽水（like Sprite, 7 up）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a jug with ice. Pour manzanilla wine over the ice. Add Sprite or 7Up and mix them together. Optionally, add a bit of spearmint for a fresh touch. Pro tip: wine quenatity can be flexible if you prefer a softer or stronger drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在壶中加满冰块。将曼萨尼亚（manzanilla）葡萄酒倒在冰块上。加入雪碧或七喜并混合均匀。可选：加入少许留兰香以增添清新感。小贴士：如果你喜欢更柔和或更浓烈的饮品，葡萄酒的量可以灵活调整。

drinks.name: Red Stag Dirty Shirley
drinks.name_display: 红鹿脏雪莉（Red Stag Dirty Shirley）
ingredients_en: 1 1/2 oz. Red Stag black cherry bourbon
ingredients_zh: 红鹿黑樱桃波本威士忌
少许马拉斯奇诺樱桃糖浆
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the grenadine, cherry bourbon, 7 Up, and maraschino cherry syrup into a glass filled with ice and stir. Garnish with a maraschino cherry and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将红石榴糖浆、樱桃波本威士忌、七喜和马拉斯奇诺樱桃糖浆倒入加冰的杯中搅拌。用一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Red Velvet Hot Chocolate
drinks.name_display: 红丝绒热巧克力（Red Velvet Hot Chocolate）
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. If you are using the cream cheese, combine it with a cup of milk in a blender and blend until smooth. (If you have a stick blender, you can just combine them in a medium saucepan and blend until no lumps of cream cheese remain.) Add the remaining hot chocolate ingredients, except for the food coloring, and combine everything in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Warm up the drink, whisking occasionally, until the white chocolate melts, the cocoa powder blends into the liquid, and the drink is creamy and smooth. Add a few drops of red food coloring and whisk them in. Continue to add coloring until you get a deep, rich red that you like.
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好材料。如果你使用奶油奶酪，将其与一杯牛奶放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。（如果你有手持搅拌棒，可以在中等锅中将它们混合并搅打至没有奶油奶酪结块。）将剩余的热巧克力材料（除食用色素外）加入，在中等锅中用中火混合所有材料。加热饮品，不时搅拌，直到白巧克力融化、可可粉融入液体，饮品呈奶油般顺滑。加入几滴红色食用色素并搅入。继续添加色素，直至达到你喜欢的浓郁深红色。

drinks.name: Red wine spritzer
ingredients_en: red wine, from a box is fine
drinks.instructions_en: Add one parts Sierra Mist to two parts wine. Shake well and serve cold.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一份Sierra Mist汽水加入两份葡萄酒中。充分摇匀后冷藏上桌。

drinks.name: Resentin
drinks.instructions_en: Drink and enjoy your cup of espresso coffee. Clean it by putting some grappa in your cup and shake it (to clean the remaining coffee and sugar) then drink. If your cup is not clean you can repeat the process until the cup is perfectly clean.
drinks.instructions_zh: 喝掉并享用你的那杯浓缩咖啡。在杯中倒入一些格拉帕酒（grappa）清洗杯子并晃动（以清洗残留的咖啡和糖），然后喝掉。如果杯子还不干净，可重复此过程直到杯子完全干净。

drinks.name: Rich Hot Cocoa
ingredients_en: 12 oz soymilk or dairy-free milk of choice
1 tbsp maple syrup or sweetener of choice
drinks.instructions_en: Bring soymilk or milk alternative to a simmer on the stove or use hot milk-frother. Stir cacao powder and maple syrup or sweetener of choice until fully combined. Add the mixture to the warmed soymilk and blend together. Pour into your favorite mug and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在炉上将豆奶或替代奶煮至微沸，或使用热奶打泡器。搅拌可可粉和枫糖浆或你选择的甜味剂，直至完全混合。将混合物加入温热的豆奶中并搅打混合。倒入你最喜欢的马克杯中享用！

drinks.name: Rob Roy
drinks.instructions_en: Add all the ingredients into a mixing glass over ice and stir. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with 2 speared brandied cherries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料加入装有冰块的调酒杯中搅拌。滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯。用2颗串起的白兰地樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Romulan Ale
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze the lime juice, then add the blue curaçao and Plantation 3 Star rum. Add one ice cube, then crack a second into the drink shaker. Shake and strain into the tall glass or flute.
drinks.instructions_zh: 挤入青柠汁，然后加入蓝橙酒和Plantation 3 Star朗姆酒。加入一块冰块，然后将第二块敲碎加入调酒壶中。摇匀后滤入高杯或笛形杯。

drinks.name: Rooh Afza Milkshake
drinks.name_display: 露阿夫扎奶昔（Rooh Afza Milkshake）
drinks.instructions_en: Add rooh afza syrup to the chilled milk. Add sugar. If sugar has big granules then grind into powder, so it dissolves quickly. Mix well and keep it refrigerated till serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将Rooh Afza糖浆加入冰镇牛奶中。加糖。如果糖颗粒较大，可研磨成粉，以便快速溶解。充分搅拌，冷藏备用至上桌前。

drinks.name: Rooibos Peach Tea
drinks.name_display: 路易波士蜜桃茶（Rooibos Peach Tea）
ingredients_en: 1 l Cooled Rooibos Tea (3 Tea Bags is usually enough)
ingredients_zh: 冰镇路易波士茶（3 Tea Bags is usually enough）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients in a large jug and stir well. Serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入大壶中充分搅拌。加冰块享用。

drinks.name: Rooibos Punch
ingredients_en: 500 ml Cooled Rooibos Tea (2 Tea Bags is usually enough)
ingredients_zh: 500毫升冷却的路易波士茶（2 Tea Bags is usually enough）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all the ingredients in a large jug and stir well. Strain and serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有材料放入大壶中充分搅拌。过滤后加冰块享用。

drinks.name: Rose Milk
drinks.instructions_en: Pour cold milk and rose syrup into a pitcher or jug. Stir the rose syrup thoroughly with a spoon until it completely blends with the milk. If you prefer it sweeter, you can add sugar, but it's entirely optional. Keep stirring until the sugar dissolves completely. In a serving glass, place a couple of ice cubes and then gently pour the rose-infused milk into the glass Finally, top it off with a touch of dried rose petals or some dry fruits, and savor this revitalizing rose milk.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冷牛奶和玫瑰糖浆倒入壶中。用勺子将玫瑰糖浆充分搅拌，直至与牛奶完全融合。如果你喜欢更甜，可以加糖，但完全是可选的。持续搅拌至糖完全溶解。在饮用杯中放入几块冰块，然后轻轻将玫瑰牛奶倒入杯中。最后，用少许干玫瑰花瓣或一些干果点缀，尽情享受这杯提神的玫瑰牛奶。

drinks.name: Rose Sangria
drinks.instructions_en: Slice the oranges and strawberries into a jar. Place the sugar and muddle all the ingredients. Fill the jar with ice. Place the soda and the wine inside the jar. Mix it all up, in circular motions, going in a upwards motion. Add some mint leaves as garnish and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙子和草莓切片放入罐中。放入糖并捣压所有材料。在罐中加满冰块。将苏打水和葡萄酒倒入罐中。以画圈并向上的动作将所有材料混合。加入一些薄荷叶作装饰，享用！

drinks.name: Rosemary Horse's Neck
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the ginger ale with the whiskey. Add ice. Garnish with a branch of fresh rosemary. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将姜汁汽水与威士忌混合。加入冰块。用一枝新鲜迷迭香装饰。享用！

drinks.name: Rosemarycano
ingredients_en: 4 cl Antica Formula (or another red vermouth of your choice)
ingredients_zh: 4厘升安提卡配方（or another red vermouth of your choice）
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the lemon in quarters and squeeze them directly into the glass, making sure that the essential oils from the zest hit the glass. Rub and twist the rosemary between your hands to release the aromatics and add to the glass along with ice cubes. Add Campari and Antica Formula and fill with Tonic Water. Stir vertically once with a long spoon. A rosemary sprig and a lemon twist go well as garnish. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬切成四块，直接挤汁入杯，确保果皮中的精油溅到杯中。将迷迭香在双手间揉搓扭转以释放香气，与冰块一起加入杯中。加入金巴利（Campari）和Antica Formula，用汤力水补满。用长勺垂直搅拌一次。一枝迷迭香和一条柠檬皮卷很适合作为装饰。享用！

drinks.name: Rossini
drinks.instructions_en: Crush the strawberry in a sieve. Muddlie with a spoon. Mix the sparkling candy and the strawberry in a bowl.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将草莓放入滤网中压碎。用勺子捣碎。将起泡糖和草莓放入碗中混合。

drinks.name: Rosy Gin-Kombucha Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 玫瑰金康普茶鸡尾酒（Rosy Gin-Kombucha Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Stir gin, Campari, lemon juice, and ginger in a pint glass or measuring cup. Stir in kombucha. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into an ice-filled Collins glass. Garnish with lemon wedges.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在品脱杯或量杯中搅拌金酒、金巴利、柠檬汁和姜。搅入康普茶。用细网筛过滤至加冰的柯林杯中。用柠檬角装饰。

drinks.name: Royal Milk Tea
drinks.instructions_en: Bring water to a boil over medium-high heat. Add your black tea leaves, reduce the heat and let leaves simmer for 1 and a half minute to 2 minutes. Add milk. When the tea is about the boil, remove from the heat and run it through a tea/ mesh strainer. Pour it into a fancy cup and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用中高火将水煮沸。加入红茶叶，调小火，让茶叶煨煮1分半至2分钟。加入牛奶。当茶将要沸腾时，离火并用茶滤/滤网过滤。倒入精致的杯子中享用。

drinks.name: Royal Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Plunder the ice. Crush the mint with a little sugar and rum. Squeeze the juice from the lime. In a tumbler-type glass: Fill it with crushed ice. Add the lime juice and the mint leaves. Add the rum. Complete with champagne.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取来冰块。将薄荷与少许糖和朗姆酒一起捣碎。挤出青柠的汁。在平底杯中：加满碎冰。加入青柠汁和薄荷叶。加入朗姆酒。用香槟补满。

drinks.name: Rum and Coke
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 1oz Rum into old-fashioned glass. Add 3oz Coke. Place lime wedge on edge of glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将1盎司朗姆酒倒入古典杯中。加入3盎司可乐。将青柠角放在杯沿上。

drinks.name: Rum Old Fashioned
drinks.name_display: 朗姆古典鸡尾酒（Rum Old Fashioned）
drinks.instructions_en: Place a large ice cube into an Old Fashioned glass. Add the rum, allspice dram, demerara syrup and both bitters, and stir until well-chilled. Garnish with an orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一大块冰块放入古典杯中。加入朗姆酒、多香果利口酒、德梅拉拉糖浆和两种苦精，搅拌至充分冷却。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Bajan Rum Punch
drinks.name_display: 巴巴多斯朗姆宾治（Bajan Rum Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients in a glass or shaker Add crushed ice Stir & add grated nutmeg on top Garnish with lemon or lime
drinks.instructions_zh: 将全部原料放入杯中或摇酒壶中。加入碎冰，搅拌，并在顶部撒上磨碎的肉豆蔻。用柠檬或青柠装饰。

drinks.name: Rumchata Bourbon
drinks.instructions_en: Add ingredients to a cocktail shaker filled with ice and shake until well chilled. Strain into a lowball glass over fresh ice. Optional: Garnish with a sprinkle of nutmeg.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将原料加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中，摇至充分冷却。过滤到装有新鲜冰块的矮杯中。可选：撒上少许肉豆蔻装饰。

drinks.name: Rumple Minze Shot
drinks.name_display: 朗普勒薄荷酒（Rumple Minze Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Chill the schnapps (or the bottle) well. Pour into a shot glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将施纳普斯（或整瓶）充分冷藏。倒入子弹杯中即可享用。

drinks.name: Rusty nail
drinks.instructions_en: Pour all ingredients directly into old-fashioned glass filled with ice. Stir gently. Garnish with a lemon twist. (optional) Serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料直接倒入装有冰块的古典杯中。轻轻搅拌。用柠檬皮卷装饰。（可选）即可享用！

drinks.name: Rye Tai
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the rye, orgeat and juices in a shaker and fill with ice. Shake until chilled.  Strain into a highball filled with crushed ice. Top with bitters and garnish. Serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将黑麦威士忌、杏仁糖浆和果汁倒入摇酒壶中，加满冰块。摇至冷却。过滤到装有碎冰的高球杯中。淋上苦精并装饰。即可享用！

drinks.name: Rysgaard's Corona Special
drinks.name_display: 里斯加德科罗娜特调（Rysgaard's Corona Special）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the whiskey, soda and Old Danish Observe the discusting color. Fix with the sauce coloring Stir the drink counterclockwise until you feel better inside If there is too much alcohol in the drink, you can always cry in it, to lower the percentage
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌、苏打水和老丹麦混合。观察那难看的颜色。用酱汁色素来补救。逆时针搅拌这款饮品，直到你内心感觉好些。如果饮品中酒精太多，你总可以对着它哭，以降低酒精度。

drinks.name: Safari Coke
ingredients_zh: 萨法里异国水果利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients to a shaker except Coca-cola / Coke. Shake well and serve in a tall drink glass. Add Coca-cola / Coke until glass is almost full. Decorate with a slice of lemon if you would like. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除可口可乐/可乐外的所有原料加入摇酒壶中。充分摇匀，倒入高杯中。加入可口可乐/可乐至杯子几乎满。如愿意可用一片柠檬装饰。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Salty Grapefruit Refresher
drinks.name_display: 咸西柚清凉饮（Salty Grapefruit Refresher）
ingredients_en: to top club soda club soda
drinks.instructions_en: Stir together the preserved lemon purée, grapefruit juice, and lime juice until well combined. Pour over ice and top with club soda. Garnish with a grapefruit wheel and a lime wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将腌柠檬泥、西柚汁和青柠汁搅拌至充分混合。倒在冰上，用苏打水补满。用西柚片和青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Sambharam
drinks.instructions_en: In a large bowl, add buttermilk and water, and whisk well until combined. Add grated ginger, finely chopped green chilies, curry leaves, and salt to the buttermilk mixture. Mix everything well and let it sit for about 10-15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Strain the mixture into a serving jug or glasses. Serve chilled, garnished with a sprig of curry leaf if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大碗中加入酪乳和水，充分搅打至混合。向酪乳混合物中加入磨碎的姜、切碎的小青辣椒、咖喱叶和盐。将所有材料充分混合，静置约10至15分钟，让风味融合。将混合物过滤到上桌用的壶或杯中。冷藏后享用，如愿可用一小枝咖喱叶装饰。

drinks.name: Portuguese Sangria
ingredients_en: 2 oranges (one whole and another for juice)
ingredients_zh: 2个橙子（one whole and another for juice）
drinks.instructions_en: Slice the fruit and mix with the brown sugar, Port Wine and the mint leaves in a big bowl. Pour the lemon and the orange juice on the mixture and let it rest for an hour. Put everything in a jug and then add the wine and the soda on top. Finally, add the cinnamon sticks and ice to your taste. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水果切片，与大碗中的红糖、波特酒和薄荷叶混合。将柠檬汁和橙汁淋在混合物上，静置一小时。将所有材料倒入壶中，然后在顶部加入葡萄酒和苏打水。最后，按口味加入肉桂棒和冰块。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Savage Banana Soup
drinks.instructions_en: Put spinach/kale in bottom of a smoothie maker. Add ginger, peanut butter, and flax/linseed. Bananas and blueberries go on top, followed by the milk. Blend. Enjoy! Go get 'em, tiger!'
drinks.instructions_zh: 将菠菜/羽衣甘蓝放在搅拌机底部。加入姜、花生酱和亚麻籽。香蕉和蓝莓放在上面，然后加入牛奶。搅打均匀。享用吧！加油，老虎！

drinks.name: Şayran
drinks.instructions_en: In a blender, combine yogurt, cold water and salt. Blend until combined. Pour the turnip juice and keep blending and you're good to go.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中，混合酸奶、冷水和盐。搅打至混合。倒入萝卜汁继续搅打，就可以享用了。

drinks.name: Sazerac
drinks.instructions_en: Place the sugar cube at the bottom and add bitters and splash of whiskey in a mixing glass; muddle until mixed. Add the remaining whiskey and ice then stir. Add Absinthe in a separate, chilled old-fashioned glassand turn glass to coat the inside; pour out any excess Strain stirred cocktail into the old-fashioned glass and garnish with lemon peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将方糖放在调酒杯底部，加入苦精和少量威士忌，捣拌至混合。加入剩余的威士忌和冰块，然后搅拌。在另一个冷藏过的古典杯中加入苦艾酒，转动杯子使内壁挂上一层，倒出多余的。将搅拌好的鸡尾酒过滤到古典杯中，用柠檬皮装饰。

drinks.name: Sbagliato
drinks.instructions_en: First combine the spirits into a glass. Add that amount in sparkling wine (prosecco works best). Add ice and stir briefly until chilled. Garnish with an orange or lemon peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 先将烈酒倒入杯中。加入等量的起泡酒（普罗塞克最佳）。加入冰块，简短搅拌至冷却。用橙皮或柠檬皮装饰。

drinks.name: Scivolo
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with ice and pour in vodka and schweppes. Mix. Garnish with a lime or lemon slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰块，倒入伏特加和怡泉汽水。混合。用青柠片或柠檬片装饰。

drinks.name: Scotch and Soda
drinks.name_display: 苏格兰威士忌苏打（Scotch and Soda）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 2 parts of soda and 1 part scotch into a tumbler. Add Ice (optional).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将2份苏打水和1份苏格兰威士忌倒入平底杯中。加入冰块（可选）。

drinks.name: Screamsicle
drinks.instructions_en: Rim edge of glass with black sugar and set aside. In an ice filled glass add whipped cream vodka, orange vodka and orange juice. Shake well. Strain mix over crushed ice into rimmed glass and add a splash of grenadine, cream and a marshmallow ghost garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用黑糖给杯口挂边，放在一旁备用。在装有冰块的杯中加入打发奶油伏特加、橙味伏特加和橙汁。充分摇匀。将混合物过滤到铺有碎冰的挂边杯中，加入少许红石榴糖浆、奶油，并以棉花糖幽灵装饰。

drinks.name: Screwdriver
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a long drink glass with ice cubes. Add all ingredients. garnish with orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中装满冰块。加入所有原料。用橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Sea Breeze
drinks.instructions_en: Fill high ball glass with ice. Stir together juices and vodka. Garnish with lime.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中装满冰块。将果汁和伏特加搅拌在一起。用青柠装饰。

drinks.name: Es Selendang Mayang
drinks.name_display: 塞伦当玛央冰（Es Selendang Mayang）
drinks.instructions_en: Mix together all the flour and water ingredients. Split evenly into three parts and add color paste. Cook the white color first until you clot and change color. Remove and then put in a row / mold The second one cooks again the green mixture and does the same thing as the first pan. Then put d over the first batter. Comb brown sugar, Cook all the sugar sauce ingredients until thickened. Then put d glass. Set aside. Place the ice cubes in a serving bowl. Cut the box stretching the mayang shawl and put it on ice cubes, then flush it with coconut milk and sugar broth. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有面粉和水的原料混合在一起。均匀分成三份，加入色素糊。先煮白色那份，直到凝结并变色。取出后摆成一排/放入模具。第二份再次煮绿色混合物，与第一锅做法相同。然后将其铺在第一个面糊上。混合棕糖，将所有糖浆原料煮至浓稠。然后倒入杯中。放在一旁。将冰块放入上桌用的碗中。将拉伸成盒状的 mayang 薄纱切开，放在冰块上，然后用椰奶和糖汤浇淋。上桌。

drinks.name: Sergeant Pepper
drinks.instructions_en: The Ingredients are for 2 servings of Sergeant Pepper. Toast cumin seeds on a Saucepan until they just begin to darken. Add water, sugar, and black pepper, regularly stir to dissolve sugar. Simmer for 15 minutes, strain, and let cool, This is the Cumin-Pepper Syrup. Add Pineapple Juice, Orgeat, Lime Juice, Cumin-Pepper Syrup, Gin and some extra pepper according to taste. Add Ice Cubes, Shake well. Strain and Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 以下原料为2份萨金特·佩珀的用量。在平底锅中烘烤孜然籽，直到刚开始变深色。加入水、糖和黑胡椒，不断搅拌使糖溶解。煨煮15分钟，过滤并放凉，这就是孜然胡椒糖浆。加入菠萝汁、杏仁糖浆、青柠汁、孜然胡椒糖浆、金酒，并按口味加入一些额外的胡椒。加入冰块，充分摇匀。过滤并立即享用。

drinks.name: Serviceberry Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Shake whiskey and serviceberry syrup with ice and pour into an old fashioned glass. Add serviceberries. Spoon over meringue foam. Garnish with lemon wedge or berries and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌和唐棣糖浆加冰摇匀，倒入古典杯中。加入唐棣果。用勺舀上蛋白霜泡沫覆盖。用柠檬角或浆果装饰后上桌。

drinks.name: Seven Devils
drinks.instructions_en: Place pitted maraschino cherries in the base of a heavy bottomed glass. Pour grenadine directly onto the cherries until exhausted. Pour 7-Up slowly into the direct center of the cherries until exhausted.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将去核的马拉斯奇诺樱桃放入厚底杯的底部。将红石榴糖浆直接倒在樱桃上，直至倒完。将七喜缓慢地直接倒入樱桃的正中央，直至倒完。

drinks.name: Sex in the Driveway
drinks.name_display: 车道诱惑（Sex in the Driveway）
drinks.instructions_en: Put crushed ice in a highball glass. Pour in the ingredients, in order, ending by topping it off with Sprite. Stir and serve with a straw. Garnish with a lemon wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将碎冰放入高球杯中。按顺序倒入原料，最后用雪碧补满。搅拌，配上吸管上桌。用柠檬片装饰。

drinks.name: Sex on the beach
drinks.name_display: 性感沙滩（Sex on the beach）
drinks.instructions_en: Make the recipe in a mixing glass. Pour the alcohols over ice cubes, mix and complete with the fruit juices. Serve in a tulip glass with a piece of pineapple and a candied cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在调酒杯中调制此配方。将酒类倒在冰块上，混合，用果汁补满。倒入郁金香杯中，配上一块菠萝和一颗糖渍樱桃。

drinks.name: Sgroppino
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the spirits in a champagne glass. Put the lemon sorbet scoop inside the glass. Put the glass in the freezer for 3-5 minutes. Drink and enjoy it.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将烈酒倒入香槟杯中。将一球柠檬雪酪放入杯中。将杯子放入冷冻室3至5分钟。饮用并享用。

drinks.name: Shandy
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the beer into a pint glass. Slowly add the lemonade. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将啤酒倒入品脱杯中。缓慢加入柠檬汽水。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Shembot
drinks.instructions_en: Get a pitcher filled with water(3/4 cups). Pour the Gin into the pitcher together with the melon juice and nescafe. Light the bottle using a match or a lighter and subside bottle in the pitcher. Serve it with ice ;)
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个装有水（3/4杯）的壶。将金酒连同甜瓜汁和雀巢咖啡倒入壶中。用火柴或打火机点燃瓶子，并将瓶子沉入壶中。配冰上桌；)

drinks.name: Shikanji
drinks.instructions_en: Roast cumin seeds, black peppercorns and coriander seeds until very slightly browned. Add them in a grinder along with chat masala, black salt and salt and grind to make a fine powder. Add lemon juice in 2 glasses. Add powdered sugar and mix until sugar dissolves in the lemon juice. Add the grounded powder, mint leaves and ice cubes in the glasses. Top the glasses with chilled water or soda.
drinks.instructions_zh: 烘烤孜然籽、黑胡椒粒和芫荽籽，直到微微变成棕色。将它们与印度酸辣香料粉、黑盐和盐一起放入研磨机，磨成细粉。在2个杯子中加入柠檬汁。加入糖粉并搅拌至糖在柠檬汁中溶解。将磨好的粉末、薄荷叶和冰块加入杯中。用冰水或苏打水将杯子补满。

drinks.name: Shirley Temple
drinks.instructions_en: Fill collins glass with ice cubes. Add ginger ale and lemonase, or just 4 oz ginger ale. Add a dash of grenadine. Stir well and garnish with a maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在柯林杯中装满冰块。加入姜汁汽水和柠檬汽水，或仅用4盎司姜汁汽水。加入少许红石榴糖浆。充分搅拌，用一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Sidecar
ingredients_zh: 装饰用柠檬皮卷或橙皮卷
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Wet rim of the glass and cover it with sugar, Pour drink into glass Garnish with a lemon twist. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将原料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。润湿杯口并裹上糖，将酒倒入杯中，用柠檬皮卷装饰。上桌。

drinks.name: Singapore Sling
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze half a lime over the ice cubes and discard it. Add the ingredients. Stir and complete with sparkling water. Serve in a tumbler type glass. Decorate with a slice of pineapple and a candied cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将半个青柠挤汁淋在冰块上，然后丢弃。加入原料。搅拌，用气泡水补满。倒入平底杯中上桌。用一片菠萝和一颗糖渍樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Skeleton Key Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 万能钥匙鸡尾酒（Skeleton Key Cocktail）
ingredients_zh: 3/4盎司圣日耳曼接骨木花利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a highball glass with ice (or clear ice). Pour in the bourbon, St Germain, and lemon juice. Top with the ginger beer. Shake in 6 to 8 dashes Angostura bitters. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高球杯中装满冰块（或透明冰）。倒入波本威士忌、圣杰曼接骨木花利口酒和柠檬汁。用姜汁啤酒补满。甩入6至8滴安高天娜苦精。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Slippery Nipple
drinks.instructions_en: Pour sambuca into a shot glass. Slowly float the Irish cream on top using the back of a spoon. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将萨姆布卡茴香酒倒入子弹杯中。用勺背将爱尔兰奶油缓慢漂浮在顶部。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Sloe Tom Collins
drinks.name_display: 黑刺李汤姆柯林斯（Sloe Tom Collins）
ingredients_en: 1/2 ounce simple syrup (optional to increase sweetness)
Optional: lemon slice as additional garnish
ingredients_zh: 可选：柠檬片作为额外装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker 1/2-2/3 with ice. Add lemon juice, both gins, and syrup (optional) into shaker. Shake thoroughly until cold. Pour contents of the shaker into collins glass with ice. Add rapsberries and garnish. Top with club soda Stir gently. Enjoy your creation!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装入1/2至2/3的冰块。向摇酒壶中加入柠檬汁、两种金酒和糖浆（可选）。充分摇至冰冷。将摇酒壶中的内容物倒入装有冰块的柯林杯中。加入覆盆子并装饰。用苏打水补满，轻轻搅拌。享用你的作品！

drinks.name: Smirnoff Black Russian
drinks.name_display: 斯米诺黑俄罗斯（Smirnoff Black Russian）
ingredients_en: 25 ml Baileys® Coffee Irish Cream Liqueur
ingredients_zh: 25毫升百利咖啡爱尔兰奶油利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with ice. Pour Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka and Baileys Coffee Irish Cream Liqueur into the glass. Enjoy your drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰块。将斯米诺21号伏特加和百利咖啡爱尔兰奶油利口酒倒入杯中。享用你的饮品。

drinks.name: Snake Bite
ingredients_en: 8 oz Your choice of Stout or Lager
ingredients_zh: 8盎司你选择的世涛或拉格啤酒
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the hard cider into a tall pint glass. Slowly add the stout or lager of choice. If done correctly, there should be a separation between the stout and cider. Add currant syrup and serve without a garnish. Enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将硬苹果酒倒入高品脱杯中。缓慢加入你选择的世涛或拉格啤酒。如果操作正确，世涛和苹果酒之间应当分出层次。加入黑加仑糖浆，不加装饰上桌。尽情享用。

drinks.name: Snowball
drinks.instructions_en: Pour lemonade and lime juice into an ice-filled tall glass. Add advocaat which will mostly sink through other ingredients. lightly stir to integrate while retaining the lemonade's carbonation. Fill up with ice and then add the rum. Enjoy
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬汽水和青柠汁倒入装有冰块的高杯中。加入蛋黄利口酒，它会大致沉入其他原料中。轻轻搅拌使其融合，同时保留柠檬汽水的气泡。用冰块补满，然后加入朗姆酒。尽情享用。

drinks.name: Yakult Soju
drinks.instructions_en: To a large glass, fill your cup to the top with ice. Open up 2 small containers of Yakult and add them to your glass of ice. Next, add in 80ml of Soju Top up the drink with Sprite to the top
drinks.instructions_zh: 取一个大杯子，将杯中装满冰块。打开2小瓶养乐多，倒入装有冰块的杯中。接着加入80毫升烧酒。用雪碧将饮品补满至杯口。

drinks.name: Solkadhi
ingredients_en: 0.5 tablespoon garlic and green chilly paste
drinks.instructions_en: Soak kokum in hot water for 30 minutes. Squeeze and strain. Take two cups of grated fresh coconut and blend by adding warm water. Strain it and remove the coconut milk. Keep it aside. Take the coconut milk and add the kokum water to it in a jar or a mixing bowl. Add the garlic and green chilly paste, and salt as required. Mix nicely and keep it in a refrigerator. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将印度藤黄果在热水中浸泡30分钟。挤出汁液并过滤。取两杯磨碎的新鲜椰子，加入温水搅打。过滤并取出椰奶。放置一旁备用。将椰奶与藤黄果汁水倒入罐子或搅拌碗中。加入大蒜青辣椒酱和适量盐。充分混合后放入冰箱冷藏。用切碎的芫荽叶装饰，冷藏后上桌。

drinks.name: Somaek
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the beer into a large beer cup (usually 490 ml) gently so that no foam is formed. Pour the soju into the shot glass. Drop the shot glass into the beer cup, i.e., shot glass with the soju.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将啤酒缓慢倒入大啤酒杯（通常490毫升）中，使其不产生泡沫。将烧酒倒入子弹杯中。将子弹杯（即装有烧酒的子弹杯）投入啤酒杯中。

drinks.name: Sonic Screwdriver
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a 12 oz glass halfway with ice. Mix soda and alcohol and pour over ice. Enjoy with your favorite companion.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在12盎司的杯子中装一半冰块。混合苏打水和酒，倒在冰上。与你最喜欢的伙伴一起享用。

drinks.name: Sour Apple Martini
drinks.name_display: 酸苹果马天尼（Sour Apple Martini）
ingredients_zh: 无糖柠檬青柠碳酸饮料
drinks.instructions_en: Place a cherry into each of two 4-ounce martini glasses; set aside. In a cocktail shaker, combine schnapps and vodka. Add ice cubes to fill shaker half full; shake until very cold. Strain vodka mixture into the prepared martini glasses. Fill glasses with lemon-lime carbonated beverage.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在两个4盎司的马天尼杯中各放入一颗樱桃；放置一旁备用。在摇酒壶中，混合施纳普斯和伏特加。加入冰块至摇酒壶的一半满；摇至非常冰冷。将伏特加混合物过滤到准备好的马天尼杯中。用柠檬青柠碳酸饮料将杯子补满。

drinks.name: South African Ginger Beer
drinks.name_display: 南非姜啤（South African Ginger Beer）
drinks.instructions_en: Heat the sugar and 1⁄2 cup water in a saucepan, stirring continually until the sugar has dissolved without coming to a boil.  Add ginger, tartaric acid and bring to a simmer.  Simmer for 7 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened. Mix the syrup with the remaining water and transfer to a 2 litre container or bottle Place in a warm place for two days, and open the bottle every 12 hours to allow some gas to escape. Once fermented, strain and chill drink. Serve with ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在平底锅中加热糖和1/2杯水，不断搅拌，直到糖溶解且未煮沸。加入姜和酒石酸，煮至微沸。煨煮7分钟，或直到混合物变浓稠。将糖浆与剩余的水混合，转移到2升的容器或瓶子中。放在温暖处两天，每12小时打开瓶盖一次，让一些气体逸出。发酵完成后，过滤并冷藏饮品。配冰上桌。

drinks.name: Southside
drinks.instructions_en: Place mint leaves inside a shaker, muddle them gently for about 30 seconds. Add ice to shaker, the larger the ice cube the better, this is going to create some of that classic daiquiri-like foam. Add gin, simple syrup, bitters, and lemon juice to the shaker, cover it all up and shake for a few seconds. Strain contents of the shaker into a coupe glass, garnish with a mint leaf.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷叶放入摇酒壶中，轻轻捣压约30秒。向摇酒壶中加入冰块，冰块越大越好，这样能产生那种经典代基里式的泡沫。向摇酒壶中加入金酒、糖浆、苦精和柠檬汁，盖好并摇几秒钟。将摇酒壶中的内容物过滤到碟形杯中，用一片薄荷叶装饰。

drinks.name: Spaghett
drinks.instructions_en: Pop open the bottle and take a couple gulps - you want to drink down part of the neck so you can add more to the bottle. Pour an ounce of Aperol into the bottle. Pour an ounce of lemon juice into the bottle. Mix as well as you can then enjoy in the bottle or pour out into your favorite cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 打开瓶盖，喝上几口——你要喝掉瓶颈处的一部分，以便能往瓶中加更多东西。向瓶中倒入1盎司阿佩罗。向瓶中倒入1盎司柠檬汁。尽可能混合均匀，然后在瓶中享用，或倒入你最喜欢的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: Sparkling Campari Orange
drinks.name_display: 气泡金巴利橙（Sparkling Campari Orange）
ingredients_en: As many as you want Ice cubes
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with ice. Pour campari, pour orange juice, pour sparkling water on top. Mix and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰块。倒入金巴利，倒入橙汁，在顶部倒入气泡水。混合并享用。

drinks.name: Sparkling Fall Sangria
drinks.name_display: 气泡秋日桑格利亚（Sparkling Fall Sangria）
ingredients_en: How many you want pcs Pears, Red Apples, Cinnamon Sticks, Star Anise
ingredients_zh: 随意数量的梨、红苹果、肉桂棒和八角
drinks.instructions_en: Drop fruits and cinnamon sticks into base of pitcher and pour over amaretto and cinnamon whiskey. Add apple cider, followed by champagne and sparkling drink. Stir well. Pour to serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将水果和肉桂棒放入壶底，倒入杏仁利口酒和肉桂威士忌。加入苹果酒，接着加入香槟和气泡饮料。充分搅拌。倒出上桌。

drinks.name: Sparkling Punch
drinks.instructions_en: Thinly slice the lemons and the oranges and place in a large punch bowl. Pour in the thawed lemonade. Gently stir in the club soda and the sparkling apple cider. Add sugar to taste. Add ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将柠檬和橙子切成薄片，放入大潘趣碗中。倒入解冻的柠檬汽水。轻轻搅入苏打水和气泡苹果酒。按口味加糖。加入冰块。

drinks.name: Spezi
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the cola and orange soda in a cup. Add lemon juice to taste. Stir gently.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中混合可乐和橙味汽水。按口味加入柠檬汁。轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Spiced Harvest Fall Sangria
drinks.name_zh: 香料丰收秋日桑格利亚
drinks.name_display: 香料丰收秋日桑格利亚（Spiced Harvest Fall Sangria）
drinks.instructions_en: Place the chopped fruit in the bottom of a large pitcher. Pour in the wine, spiced rum, cranberry juice, apple juice, pomegranate juice, and simple syrup. Stir and add in the nutmeg, rosemary, and cinnamon sticks.  Fill the bottom layer of the pitcher with cranberries. Sangria should be refrigerated for at least 30 minutes before serving, but is better if refrigerated for several hours or overnight. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将切碎的水果放入大壶底部。倒入葡萄酒、香料朗姆酒、蔓越莓汁、苹果汁、石榴汁和糖浆。搅拌，并加入肉豆蔻、迷迭香和肉桂棒。在壶的底层放入蔓越莓。桑格利亚在上桌前应至少冷藏30分钟，若冷藏数小时或过夜则更佳。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Spicy Grapefruit Margarita
drinks.name_display: 辛辣西柚玛格丽特（Spicy Grapefruit Margarita）
ingredients_en: 1-2 slices jalapeno: depending on spiciness of drink
slices of lime + grapefruit: for serving
ingredients_zh: 1至2片墨西哥辣椒视饮品辛辣度而定
青柠片和西柚片：供食用
drinks.instructions_en: , combine the chili power salt and sugar in a bowl. Mix well to combine. Use this mixture to rim your glasses. Combine all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and fill with ice. Shake until combined and then strain into your prepared glass. The longer you shake the drink, the spicier it will become. Add a grapefruit wedge and a slice of jalapeño if desired. Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在碗中混合辣椒粉、盐和糖。充分混合。用此混合物为杯口挂边。将所有原料放入摇酒壶中，加满冰块。摇至混合，然后过滤到准备好的杯中。摇的时间越长，饮品就越辣。如愿可加入一块西柚角和一片墨西哥辣椒。干杯！

drinks.name: Spicy Red Beer
ingredients_en: 12 Fluid Ounces Coors Banquet American Lager
ingredients_zh: 12液量盎司康胜宴会美式拉格啤酒
drinks.instructions_en: Add Tomato Sauce. Mix in hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and salt. Poor in cold beer and stir.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加入番茄酱。拌入辣酱、伍斯特酱和盐。倒入冰啤酒并搅拌。

drinks.name: Spicy Tamarind Margarita
drinks.name_display: 辛辣罗望子玛格丽特（Spicy Tamarind Margarita）
drinks.instructions_en: Run a lime slice along the rim of a glass and dip it into salt to coat the rim. In a shaker, combine tequila, tamarind paste, lime juice, simple syrup, chili powder, and ice. Shake well for 15-20 seconds until the mixture is chilled. Strain into the prepared glass filled with ice. Garnish with a lime slice and serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用一片青柠沿杯口擦拭，然后蘸盐给杯口挂边。在摇酒壶中，混合龙舌兰、罗望子酱、青柠汁、糖浆、辣椒粉和冰块。充分摇15至20秒，直到混合物冷却。过滤到装有冰块的准备好的杯中。用一片青柠装饰并立即上桌。

drinks.name: Spicy Orange Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all the ingredients thoroughly in a blender. Serve immediately and enjoy your spicy orange juice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料在搅拌机中充分搅打。立即上桌，享用你的辣味橙汁。

drinks.name: Springbokkie
drinks.instructions_en: The Crème de menthe is poured into the shot glass and the Amarula is carefully layered on top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷利口酒倒入子弹杯中，然后将阿玛茹拉小心地分层倒在上面。

drinks.name: Spritz Pomegranate
ingredients_en: Sliced orange or lemon for garnish
ingredients_zh: 橙子片或柠檬片用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a glass with ice. Add Prosecco, pomegranate and soda. Stir gently to combine and garnish with a slice of orange.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中装满冰块。加入普罗塞克、石榴和汽水。轻轻搅拌以混合，并用一片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Spritz
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the orange in slices. Add the ice cubes in the glass. Add 1/3 of Aperol and 1/3 of white wine. Finally sprinkle the soda in the glass. Garnish with one slice of orange and serve. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将橙子切成片。将冰块放入杯中。加入1/3的阿佩罗和1/3的白葡萄酒。最后在杯中倒入汽水。用一片橙子装饰后上桌。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Stinger
drinks.instructions_en: Pour liquid ingredients over ice. Stir. Garnish with fresh mint leaf (optional). You can use cognac in place of brandy
drinks.instructions_zh: 将液体原料倒在冰上。搅拌。用新鲜薄荷叶装饰（可选）。你可以用干邑代替白兰地。

drinks.name: Susu Telur Madu Jahe/STMJ (Milk Egg Honey Ginger)
drinks.name_display: 奶蛋蜜姜饮（Susu Telur Madu Jahe/STMJ (Milk Egg Honey Ginger)）
ingredients_en: 3 table of spoon Sweetened condensed milk
drinks.instructions_en: Peel and crush the ginger, then roast it until fragrant. Pour the fresh milk and sweetened condensed milk into a saucepan. Stir until well combined. Heat the milk mixture, then cut the roasted ginger in half and add it to the milk. Stir continuously to prevent it from boiling. Separate the egg yolks from the whites, and use only the yolks. Place the egg yolks into a glass and mix them with the honey. Strain the hot milk mixture into the glass with the egg yolks and honey while stirring quickly to combine everything evenly. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将姜去皮并压碎，然后烤至出香。将鲜奶和加糖炼乳倒入平底锅中。搅拌至充分混合。加热牛奶混合物，然后将烤好的姜切成两半，加入牛奶中。不断搅拌以防其沸腾。将蛋黄与蛋白分离，只用蛋黄。将蛋黄放入杯中，与蜂蜜混合。将热牛奶混合物过滤到装有蛋黄和蜂蜜的杯中，同时快速搅拌，使所有材料均匀混合。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Stone Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Add the bourbon, orange juice, lemon juice and simple syrup into a shaker with ice  Shake until well-chilled Strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice Garnish with a sherry and an orange half-wheel
drinks.instructions_zh: 将波本威士忌、橙汁、柠檬汁和糖浆加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。摇至充分冷却。过滤到装有新鲜冰块的岩石杯中。用雪莉酒和半片橙子装饰。

drinks.name: Stoned Gimlet
drinks.instructions_en: Pre-chill your ingredients in the snow Find a suitable vessel (a mug is ideal) Pour Mix with your finger, a stick, or even a spoon (fancy!) Enjoy! (repeat)
drinks.instructions_zh: 先在雪中预冷你的原料。找一个合适的容器（马克杯最理想）。倒入。用手指、一根棍子，甚至一把勺子搅拌（真讲究！）。尽情享用！（可重复）

drinks.name: Straight Tequila Shot
drinks.name_display: 纯龙舌兰一口饮（Straight Tequila Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour tequila into a shot glass. Serve neat (optional: with salt and a lime wedge on the side).
drinks.instructions_zh: 将龙舌兰倒入子弹杯中。纯饮上桌（可选：旁边配盐和一块青柠角）。

drinks.name: Straight Whiskey Shot
drinks.name_display: 纯威士忌一口饮（Straight Whiskey Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour whiskey into a shot glass. Serve neat.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌倒入子弹杯中。纯饮上桌。

drinks.name: Ice Strawberry Mix Banana
drinks.name_display: 冰草莓香蕉混合（Ice Strawberry Mix Banana）
drinks.instructions_en: Wash strawberries and banana thoroughly. Cut the banana and strawberries, then add yougurt and mineral water. Blend all the components and after that put in your glass. The juice ready to serve!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将草莓和香蕉彻底洗净。将香蕉和草莓切块，然后加入酸奶和矿泉水。将所有材料搅打均匀，之后倒入杯中。果汁就可以上桌了！

drinks.name: Strawberry Cheesecake Shot
drinks.name_display: 草莓芝士蛋糕一口饮（Strawberry Cheesecake Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a shaker with ice. Add vanilla vodka, strawberry liqueur, and Irish cream. Shake well and strain into a shot glass. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装满冰块。加入香草伏特加、草莓利口酒和爱尔兰奶油。充分摇匀，过滤到子弹杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Strawberry Daiquiri
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ice, sugar and strawberriesIn a blender. Pour in lime juice, lemon juice, rum and lemon-lime soda. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中混合冰块、糖和草莓。倒入青柠汁、柠檬汁、朗姆酒和柠檬青柠汽水。搅打至顺滑。倒入杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Strawberry Ginger Turmeric  Tea
drinks.name_display: 草莓姜黄茶（Strawberry Ginger Turmeric  Tea）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend coarsely of turmeric and ginger with 500 ml of mineral water and boil. Strain, cool and store in the refrigerator. Roughly blend the strawberries or dice them or crush them with a fork. store in the refrigerator After the ingredients are cool enough, you can immediately serve them: add about 1 tablespoon of honey or according to taste in a glass, add 2 tablespoons of crushed strawberries and pour the turmeric ginger water until the glass is full. Put one stalk of lemongrass geprek to add extra aroma. If you like, you can add more ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将姜黄和姜与500毫升矿泉水粗略搅打后煮沸。过滤、冷却并存入冰箱。将草莓粗略搅打，或切丁，或用叉子压碎。存入冰箱。待原料足够冷却后，你可以立即上桌：在杯中加入约1汤匙蜂蜜或按口味添加，加入2汤匙压碎的草莓，然后倒入姜黄姜水直至杯子装满。放入一根拍碎的香茅以增添额外的香气。如果喜欢，可以再加些冰块。

drinks.name: Strawberry Limeade
drinks.instructions_en: Use fresh lime juice and the sweetest strawberries you can find. To make the syrup, combine the sugar and water in a saucepan Cook over medium high heat for 5-10 minutes until the sugar is dissolved and the liquid is clear. In a large mason jar or a pitcher, combine the lime juice, simple syrup, strawberries, mint, and water.  Put it in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 使用新鲜的青柠汁和你所能找到的最甜的草莓。制作糖浆时，将糖和水放入平底锅中，用中高火煮5至10分钟，直到糖溶解且液体清澈。在一个大号梅森罐或壶中，混合青柠汁、糖浆、草莓、薄荷和水。放入冰箱2至3小时。上桌享用！

drinks.name: Strawberry Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a blender with strawberries, tequila, lime juice, triple sec, honey, and ice. Pulse the mixture until it is smooth. Taste and add extra tequila or sweetener if desired. Pour into glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中放入草莓、龙舌兰、青柠汁、橙皮甜酒、蜂蜜和冰块。脉冲搅打混合物至顺滑。品尝一下，如愿可加入额外的龙舌兰或甜味剂。倒入杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Strawberry Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Add mint leaves, half the lime slices and chopped strawberries to a tall glass. Mix it up, without breaking the mint leaves. Add the other half of lime slices and add the sirup/sugar. Mix it up gently, as before. Fill up with ice and then add the rum. Fill up with club soda and stir. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将薄荷叶、一半的青柠片和切碎的草莓加入高杯中。混合，但不要弄碎薄荷叶。加入另一半青柠片，并加入糖浆/糖。像之前一样轻轻混合。用冰块填满，然后加入朗姆酒。用苏打水补满并搅拌。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Strawberry Saquerinha
drinks.instructions_en: Add the sugar over the strawberries. Mash the ingredients. Fill the glass with ice and add the sake. Shake the drink in the shaker and serve in another glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖撒在草莓上。将原料捣碎。在杯中装满冰块并加入清酒。将饮品放入摇酒壶中摇匀，倒入另一个杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Strawberry Sunrise Smoothie
drinks.name_display: 草莓日出冰沙（Strawberry Sunrise Smoothie）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the strawberries and almond milk in a blender and blend until smooth. Scrape off and pour the contents in three separate glasses. Keep the glasses in the freezer for at least 20 minutes to help separate the next layer. Combine the mangoes and orange juice in the blender and blend until smooth. Pour the contents in the glasses. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将草莓和杏仁奶放入搅拌机，搅打至顺滑。刮下并将内容物倒入三个单独的杯中。将杯子放入冷冻室至少20分钟，以帮助分出下一层。将芒果和橙汁放入搅拌机，搅打至顺滑。将内容物倒入杯中。立即上桌。

drinks.name: Strawberry watermelon juice
ingredients_en: 1 ½ cups Watermelon cut into large cubes
drinks.instructions_en: Put all the ingredients into the blender. Blend it till it get smooth and runny. Pour the juice into individual serving glass and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有原料放入搅拌机。搅打至顺滑、流动的质地。将果汁倒入各个上桌用的杯中上桌。

drinks.name: Submarino
drinks.instructions_en: Pour your beer into a beer glass. Pour the tequila into a shot glass. Put the shot glass gently in the beer to finish your Submarino. Your Submarino is ready!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将啤酒倒入啤酒杯中。将龙舌兰倒入子弹杯中。将子弹杯轻轻放入啤酒中，完成你的 Submarino。你的 Submarino 做好了！

drinks.name: Sugarcane Juice
drinks.instructions_en: Peel off the hard sugarcane outer skin, then chop into small cubes.Transfer to a mixer along with ginger.I did this in batches as I used my small mixer jar. Add little water and grind it.Now drain the sugarcane extract in a strainer. Squeeze it with your hands or press using a spoon.Keep a bowl underneath to hold the juice.Repeat this again if you feel the extract is juicy then grind again and discard.Then proceed grinding with next batch. Collect the juice, and then finally strain again so that the small pieces of sugarcane is also strained.Now squeeze half lemon,add salt to the sugarcane juice.Mix well and serve. Serve chilled and immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 削去甘蔗坚硬的外皮，然后切成小块。连同姜一起放入搅拌机。由于我用的是小搅拌杯，我分批进行。加少许水研磨。然后将甘蔗渣倒入滤网沥干。用手挤压或用勺子压。下面放一个碗接住汁液。如果你觉得渣还有汁，就再磨一次然后丢弃。接着处理下一批继续研磨。收集果汁，最后再过滤一次，把小块的甘蔗也滤掉。然后挤入半个柠檬，向甘蔗汁中加盐。充分混合后上桌。冷藏并立即上桌。

drinks.name: Sunshine Cocktail
drinks.instructions_en: Shake ingredients well with cracked ice. Lightly strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将原料与碎冰充分摇匀。轻轻过滤到冷藏过的鸡尾酒杯中。

drinks.name: The Swan Song Cocktail
drinks.name_display: 天鹅之歌鸡尾酒（The Swan Song Cocktail）
drinks.instructions_en: Add all the ingredients (except garnish) to a cocktail shaker half filled with ice. Shake vigorously until the contents are well chilled (about 20 seconds). Strain into a cocktail glass, preferably one that has been chilled. Garnish, if you wish, and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除装饰外的所有原料加入装有一半冰块的摇酒壶中。用力摇至内容物充分冷却（约20秒）。过滤到鸡尾酒杯中，最好是冷藏过的。如愿可加以装饰，然后上桌。

drinks.name: Swedish Libre
drinks.instructions_en: Gently drop the ice cubes in a Highball glass. Grab the aged cork on top of the rum bottle and pull until you hear the classic pop. Use eye measurement to pour between 6-10 cl of rum over the ice cubes. Gently pour the Julmust into the glass so it does not foam over. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块轻轻放入高球杯中。抓住朗姆酒瓶顶部的陈年软木塞，拉出直到听到经典的爆响声。凭目测将6至10厘升的朗姆酒倒在冰块上。慢慢将 Julmust 倒入杯中，以免泡沫溢出。上桌。

drinks.name: Sweet Dreams
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice cubes. Add all the ingredients. Shake and strain into a cocktail glass. Decorate with a Maraschino cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装满冰块。加入所有原料。摇匀后过滤到鸡尾酒杯中。用一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Sweet Lassi
drinks.instructions_en: In a blender, blend the yogurt, ice, water, sugar and salt until mixture becomes frothy. Pour mixture over ice cubes in tall glasses. Now, relish it! :D
drinks.instructions_zh: 在搅拌机中，将酸奶、冰块、水、糖和盐搅打至混合物起泡。将混合物倒在装有冰块的高杯中。现在，好好享受吧！:D

drinks.name: Swinging Sultan
drinks.instructions_en: Combine vodka, pomegranate juice, Triple Sec and lime juice in a large shaker with ice. Shake vigorously for five to ten seconds. Pour into two martini glasses. Spray raki over surface of each drink, 1- 2 spritzes per glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一个装有冰块的大摇酒壶中混合伏特加、石榴汁、橙皮甜酒和青柠汁。用力摇五到十秒。倒入两个马天尼杯中。在每杯饮品表面喷洒拉克酒，每杯喷1至2下。

drinks.name: Targoviste Twist
drinks.name_display: 特尔戈维什特旋风（Targoviste Twist）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Add the rum, lime juice, simple syrup, and Tabasco sauce and shake well. Strain into a highball glass filled with ice. Top with soda water and garnish with a lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在摇酒壶中装满冰块。加入朗姆酒、青柠汁、糖浆和塔巴斯科辣酱，充分摇匀。过滤到装有冰块的高球杯中。用苏打水补满，并用一块青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Taro Fresh Milk
drinks.instructions_en: Dissolve taro powder with liquid sugar, add a little warm water then mix well. Prepare whole milk in a serving glass, put ice cubes, then pour the liquid sugar that has been mixed with taro powder. Serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用液体糖溶解香芋粉，加少许温水后充分混合。在上桌用的杯中备好全脂牛奶，放入冰块，然后倒入已与香芋粉混合的液体糖。上桌。

drinks.name: Taste The Rainbow
drinks.instructions_en: Pour some Grenadine into the base of a glass and slowly spoon in some ice cubes. Set aside. In a shaking glass with ice, combine peach schnapps and pineapple juice. Shake well. Slowly pour over grenadine, filling almost to the top. In a separate shaking glass with ice, combine vodka and blue curaçao. Shake well and carefully layer on top. Garnish with an orange slice and a cherry.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将一些红石榴糖浆倒入杯底，然后慢慢用勺加入一些冰块。放在一旁备用。在一个装有冰块的摇酒壶中，混合桃子施纳普斯和菠萝汁。充分摇匀。缓慢倒在红石榴糖浆上，几乎填满至杯口。在另一个装有冰块的摇酒壶中，混合伏特加和蓝橙利口酒。充分摇匀后小心地分层倒在顶部。用一片橙子和一颗樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: Tea Ais
drinks.instructions_en: Steep the tea bags covered in the hot water for 5-8 minutes. Mix in the milk and sugar. Prepare two containers, preferably with curved lips to ease pouring with minimal dripping. With a steady stream, pour the tea from one container to the other back and forth. Carefully increase the height as your pour. The higher the steam, the frothier it'll become. Be careful not to scald yourself. Tea will splatter. Repeat 4-6 times. Adds some ice cubes and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将茶包盖好浸泡在热水中5至8分钟。拌入牛奶和糖。准备两个容器，最好带弧形壶嘴，便于倾倒且不易滴漏。以稳定的水流，将茶从一个容器来回倒入另一个容器。倾倒时小心逐渐提高高度。倒得越高，泡沫就越多。注意不要烫伤自己。茶会溅出。重复4至6次。加入一些冰块即可上桌。

drinks.name: Teh C
drinks.instructions_en: Place tea bag into a cup and pour hot water until the cup is 3/4 full. Let the tea seep for 5 minutes Add in the evaporated milk and sugar. Stir well
drinks.instructions_zh: 将茶包放入杯中，倒入热水至杯子3/4满。让茶浸泡5分钟。加入淡奶和糖。充分搅拌。

drinks.name: Teh Tarik
ingredients_en: 4 tbs sweetened condensed milk (or replace half with evaporated milk)
ingredients_zh: 4汤匙加糖炼乳（or replace half with evaporated milk）
drinks.instructions_en: Steep the tea bags covered in the hot water for 5-8 minutes. Mix in the milk and sugar. Prepare two containers, preferably with curved lips to ease pouring with minimal dripping. With a steady stream, pour the tea from one container to the other back and forth. Carefully increase the height as you pour. The higher the stream, the frothier it’ll become. Be careful not to scald yourself. Tea will splatter. Repeat 4-6 times.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将茶包盖好浸泡在热水中5至8分钟。拌入牛奶和糖。准备两个容器，最好带弧形壶嘴，便于倾倒且不易滴漏。以稳定的水流，将茶从一个容器来回倒入另一个容器。倾倒时小心逐渐提高高度。水流越高，泡沫就越多。注意不要烫伤自己。茶会溅出。重复4至6次。

drinks.name: Tequila Honeysuckle
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice to shaker and combine ingredients. Strain mixture into a coupe glass. Garnish with lime wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 向摇酒壶中加入冰块并混合原料。将混合物过滤到碟形杯中。用青柠角装饰。

drinks.name: Tequila Mockingbird
drinks.instructions_en: Add very cold, or frozen watermelon cubes in a small glass. Add tequila and then lime juice to the glass. When serving, make a literary reference if at all possible. Other fruit can be substituted for watermelon if needed.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将非常冰的或冷冻的西瓜块放入小杯中。向杯中加入龙舌兰，然后加入青柠汁。上桌时，尽可能引用一句文学典故。如有需要，可用其他水果替代西瓜。

drinks.name: Tequila Pineapple
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a mixing cup half-full with ice cubes. Fill a drinking glass half-full with ice cubes. Add tequila and pineapple juice to the mixing cup and shake well. With the filter intact on the mixing cup, pour the mixture into the drinking glass. (Optional) add a marachino cherry or pineapple slice as a garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将调酒杯装至半满的冰块。将饮用杯装至半满的冰块。向调酒杯中加入龙舌兰和菠萝汁，充分摇匀。在调酒杯的滤网保持原位的情况下，将混合物倒入饮用杯中。（可选）加入一颗马拉斯奇诺樱桃或一片菠萝作为装饰。

drinks.name: Tequila Slammer
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a rocks drinking glass with ice cubes. Add all ingredients carefully to not release the CO2. Slam on the counter to make it fizz up and drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在岩石杯中装满冰块。小心加入所有原料，以免释放二氧化碳。在台面上猛磕一下使其冒泡，然后饮用。

drinks.name: Tequila Sunrise
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a long drink glass with ice cubes. Add tequila and then orange juice to the glass. Top the drink with grenadine.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在高杯中装满冰块。向杯中加入龙舌兰，然后加入橙汁。在饮品顶部淋上红石榴糖浆。

drinks.name: Terere
drinks.instructions_en: Put 1 liter of cold water in a thermos, the juice of the lemon juice packet, the juice of the 4 lemons, sugar and stir. Serve in the bowl with the herb.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将1升冷水倒入保温瓶中，加入柠檬粉包冲出的汁、4个柠檬的汁和糖，然后搅拌。连香草一起盛在碗中上桌。

drinks.name: Thai Tea with almond milk
drinks.name_display: 杏仁奶泰式茶（Thai Tea with almond milk）
drinks.instructions_en: 1. Take your tea sock and add thai tea. Put tea sock on boil water cup. To steep the tea. 2. Leave the tea sock for a couple minutes to extract the tea flavour. 3. Pour the tea to a cup. Mix all the the rest of ingredients except ice. 4. Bring the cup with the ice. Pour the tea to this cup.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将泰式茶叶放入茶袋（滤网）中，把茶袋放在盛有沸水的杯子上，浸泡茶叶。让茶袋静置几分钟，以萃取茶香。将茶倒入杯中，把除冰块外的其余所有配料混合。取来装有冰块的杯子，将茶倒入其中。

drinks.name: Thandai
drinks.instructions_en: Boil milk in a bowl and soak saffron strands in it. Allow it to sit for 15 - 20 minutes. Soaking saffron strands in hot milk releases its color and flavor. Stir it with a spoon and milk will have a beautiful pale yellow color. Set it aside. Let's assemble our thandai masala ingredients. Feel free to adjust spices according to taste. Add all the nuts and spices to a grinder. Grind spices to their powdered form. Set it aside. You can ground the spices in a motor and pestle too. Boil milk in a heavy bottomed pan. Stir in the nuts and spices one by one onceit  comes to a full boil. Whisk so that no lumps remain. Add sugar and keep stirring the liquid. Give it a good boil and take it off the flame. Allow it to cool completely. Stir in saffron flavored milk, rose spread and rose water. If no rose spread available add 2 tablespoons of rose water. Allow it to sit for a while (an hour or more) so that it can soak in all the flavors. Later sieve it through a strainer, add water and refrigerate this drink for at least 3-4 hours or until chilled. Thandai tastes best when served chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将牛奶煮沸并浸入藏红花，静置 15-20 分钟。用热牛奶浸泡藏红花可释放其色泽与香味。用勺子搅拌，牛奶便会呈现漂亮的淡黄色，放置一旁备用。开始准备印度香料奶茶（thandai masala）的配料，可根据口味自由调整香料用量。将所有坚果和香料放入研磨机，研磨成粉末状，放置一旁备用，你也可以用研钵和研杵把香料捣碎。在厚底锅中煮沸牛奶，待牛奶完全沸腾后，将坚果和香料逐样搅入，搅打至没有结块。加入糖并持续搅拌液体，充分煮沸后离火。让其完全冷却。搅入藏红花牛奶、玫瑰酱和玫瑰水，若没有玫瑰酱，可加 2 汤匙玫瑰水。静置一会儿（一小时或更久），使其充分吸收所有风味。之后用滤网过滤，加水，并将这款饮品冷藏至少 3-4 小时或至冰凉。印度香料奶茶冰镇后风味最佳。

drinks.name: The Bengal Tiger
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaker filled with ice pour the spirits, some sweet and sour mix Pour the juices and shake the mixture. In a tall glass filled with ice pour the drink. Garnish with a wedge of gondoraj lemon and twist a peel of the lemon over the drink. Rub the peel on the glass for the freshness and aroma. Serve with a smile!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装满冰块的摇酒壶中倒入烈酒和适量酸甜混合液，倒入果汁并摇匀。将饮品倒入加满冰块的直身杯中。用一角 gondoraj 柠檬装饰，并在饮品上方拧转一片柠檬皮。把柠檬皮在杯口抹一圈，以增添清新与香气。带着微笑端上桌！

drinks.name: The Diddy
drinks.instructions_en: Combine ingredients in a Highball glass filled with ice. Stir. Garnish with lemon wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料放入加满冰块的海波杯中混合。搅拌。用柠檬片装饰。

drinks.name: The Flaming Homer
drinks.instructions_en: In a shaking glass with ice, combine vodka, whiskey, creme de cassis, blueberry schnapps, and simple syrup. Shake well. Strain mix into a glass over ice and top with lemon lime soda. Layer on a splash of Bacardi 151 or any overproof rum and ignite.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在装有冰块的摇酒壶中，加入伏特加、威士忌、黑加仑利口酒、蓝莓利口酒和糖浆。充分摇匀。将混合液滤入加冰的玻璃杯中，注入柠檬青柠汽水。在表面轻轻淋上一层百加得 151 或任何高度数朗姆酒并点燃。

drinks.name: The Last Word
ingredients_zh: 22.5毫升马拉斯奇诺利口酒（e.g., Luxardo）
drinks.instructions_en: Add gin, green Chartreuse, maraschino liqueur, and lime juice to a shaker with ice. Shake hard until very cold. Strain into a chilled coupe glass. Garnish with a brandied cherry if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将金酒、绿查特酒、黑樱桃利口酒和青柠汁加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。用力摇至充分冰凉。滤入冰镇过的碟形香槟杯。如喜欢，可用酒渍樱桃装饰。

drinks.name: The Perfect Storm
ingredients_en: 1 part Dark Rum (Kraken if ye be a brave soul)
3 parts Ginger Beer (Crabbies be the pirate's favorite)
2 dashes Bitters (if ye be feelin' fancy)
Half Lime (for juice... and to prevent scurvy)
Ice (if ye be wantin' it cool)
ingredients_zh: 1份黑朗姆酒（Kraken if ye be a brave soul）
3份姜汁啤酒（Crabbies be the pirate's favorite）
半个青柠（for juice... and to prevent scurvy）
冰块（if ye be wantin' it cool）
drinks.instructions_en: Fill glass with ice. Add rum and lime juice into glass. Pour the ginger beer on top, and follow with the bitters. Garnish with lime wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中加满冰块。将朗姆酒和青柠汁倒入杯中。在表面倒入姜汁啤酒，随后加入苦精。用青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: The Salty Dog
drinks.instructions_en: Wet the rim of a highball glass. and dip it in coarse salt. Dip the rim in coarse salt. Fill the glass with ice. Then add the gin and grapefruit juice. Stir gently to combine. Garnish with a grapefruit slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将海波杯的杯口沾湿，再蘸上粗盐。将杯口蘸上粗盐。在杯中加满冰块。然后加入金酒和西柚汁。轻轻搅拌混合。用一片西柚装饰。

drinks.name: The Swedish Tart
drinks.instructions_en: Shake sugar and water in a jar until sugar dissolves. Stir in dill. Cover the jar and chill until flavors infuse for 24–48 hours. Strain dill syrup. Combine kombucha, aquavit, and half ounce dill syrup in a highball glass half-filled with crushed ice. Stir. Add more crushed ice, mounding above rim. Garnish with a dill sprig.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将糖和水放入罐中摇晃至糖溶解。搅入莳萝。盖上罐子冷藏，让风味浸出 24-48 小时。过滤出莳萝糖浆。在盛有半杯碎冰的海波杯中，将康普茶、阿夸维特酒和半盎司莳萝糖浆混合。搅拌。再加入更多碎冰，堆高至高出杯口。用一枝莳萝装饰。

drinks.name: Thyme to kill
drinks.instructions_en: Mix with ice cubes using a shaker, strain in a small bowl, perfume with 1/2 sprays of bergamot. Glassware: Cup. Thyme and candied apricot filling.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用摇酒壶加冰块摇匀，滤入小碗中，喷上 1/2 下佛手柑香气。杯具：杯。填入百里香和糖渍杏子。

drinks.name: Tinto de Verano
drinks.instructions_en: Uncork the wine and pour it into a large pitcher. Add the soda and stir well. Add the lemon and orange slices, as well as the vermouth if using. Stir to combine. Serve over ice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 开瓶后将葡萄酒倒入大壶中。加入汽水并充分搅拌。加入柠檬片和橙片，若使用的话也加入味美思。搅拌混合。加冰享用。

drinks.name: Toddy from Coconut Water
drinks.name_display: 椰子水托迪（Toddy from Coconut Water）
ingredients_en: 500 ml Coconut water or tender coconut water
drinks.instructions_en: Take 1/2 cup of lukewarm water add, 1/2 tsp yeast and 2 tbsp of sugar. Mix it well and keep this mixture aside covered for 10 minutes. Take a large clean dry jar. Add 500 ml of coconut water. Add yeast sugar mixture. Now cover the jar with a muslin cloth and leave it to ferment for about 24 hours.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取 1/2 杯温水，加入 1/2 茶匙酵母和 2 汤匙糖。充分混合，将混合物盖好静置 10 分钟。取一个干净干燥的大罐子。加入 500 毫升椰子水。加入酵母糖混合物。然后用细棉布盖住罐子，静置发酵约 24 小时。

drinks.name: Tom Collins
ingredients_en: Optional: maraschino cherry or lemon slice for garnish
ingredients_zh: 可选：马拉斯奇诺樱桃或柠檬片用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. Add ice cubes, gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup in a collins glass. Stir thoroughly. Top with club soda. Optional: Garnish with cherry or lemon slice Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好所有配料。在柯林杯中放入冰块、金酒、柠檬汁和糖浆。充分搅拌。注入苏打水。可选：用樱桃或柠檬片装饰。端上桌尽情享用！

drinks.name: Tom Yum
ingredients_en: 1.5 oz Patrón Silver infused with coriander and Kaffir lime
ingredients_zh: 1.5盎司培恩银樽龙舌兰，浸泡香菜与马蜂橙
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in a shaker with ice. Shake and pour into a whiskey glass rimmed with shrimp salt. Garnish with coriander and dried chili pepper. Optional shrimp salt: mix 150g of shrimp powder with 250g of salt.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入加冰的摇酒壶中。摇匀后倒入杯口蘸有虾盐的威士忌杯中。用香菜和干辣椒装饰。可选虾盐：将 150 克虾粉与 250 克盐混合。

drinks.name: Tomato Ricard
drinks.instructions_en: Pour 4 teaspoons of Ricard and a dash of grenadine. Complete with water. Add a few ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 倒入 4 茶匙里卡尔（Ricard）和少许红石榴糖浆。加水至满。加入几块冰块。

drinks.name: Tongba
ingredients_en: 1/2 cup Khesung(source of molds, bacteria and yeast)
ingredients_zh: 1/2杯凯松（source of molds, bacteria and yeast）
drinks.instructions_en: Cook the whole millet grains. Cool down the cooked millet grains. Put the cooled millet grains on a woven bamboo basket. Cover it with warm clothes or leaves, and leave it for 1-2 days according to temperature. The grains turn a little sweet, pack it tightly into earthenware pot or aluminium jar. After 7-15 days the fermentation is completed. Normally for good sweet taste, it is stored for six months. Put the fermented millet grains on a bamboo container known as 'Tongba' and pour hot water over it and leave it undisturbed for about 5 minutes . Your 'Tongba-The Drink' is now ready and drink it wholeheartedly .
drinks.instructions_zh: 将整粒小米煮熟。将煮熟的小米放凉。把放凉的小米放在编织的竹篮上。用保暖的衣物或叶子盖住，根据温度静置 1-2 天。待米粒略带甜味后，将其紧紧装入陶罐或铝罐中。7-15 天后发酵完成。通常为了获得良好的甜味，会储存六个月。将发酵好的小米放入称为童巴（Tongba）的竹制容器中，倒入热水，静置约 5 分钟不要搅动。你的童巴饮品就做好了，尽情畅饮吧。

drinks.name: Tornado Twist
ingredients_en: 1 can or bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
drinks.instructions_en: In a pitcher, mix cranberry-raspberry juice with lemon-lime soda. Pour over ice and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在壶中将蔓越莓-覆盆子汁与柠檬青柠汽水混合。倒在冰块上即可享用。

drinks.name: Traffic Light Shot
drinks.name_display: 红绿灯一口饮（Traffic Light Shot）
drinks.instructions_en: Pour grenadine into a shot glass. Slowly add orange juice over the back of a spoon to create the next layer. Float blue curaçao on top using the back of a spoon. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将红石榴糖浆倒入子弹杯中。借助勺背缓缓加入橙汁，形成下一层。用勺背将蓝橙利口酒漂浮在最上层。立即享用。

drinks.name: Trash Can
drinks.instructions_en: Fill large glass with ice. Add alcoholic ingredients. Open the Red Bull and place upside down in the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在大杯中加满冰块。加入含酒精的配料。打开红牛，倒扣放入杯中。

drinks.name: Tropical Sangria
drinks.instructions_en: Preferably the night before, but at least an hour before serving prepare the watermelon and grapes and put in freezer. Use a melon baller or small ice cream scoop to make balls of watermelon and place in a freezer container in a single layer and freeze. The watermelon balls and frozen grapes will keep the sangria at a nice temperature without diluting it. Don’t throw away the juice left in the watermelon! Reserve it in a jar to add to the plum/orange juice. Slice the plums in half and remove the pit over your blender to catch the juices. Whirr a few times to puree. Add the orange juice and give it a whirl to combine. You should have about 1 cup of juice. Strain through a fine strainer (or when you’re ready to make the sangria) to remove some of the pulp. If you own a juicer, you can juice the plums. And for the sangria, put 6-7 watermelon balls, pineapple triangles (or cubes), and sliced kiwi into a pitcher Add 1/2 cup of the strained plum/orange/watermelon juice and the entire bottle of rose. Stir gently and refrigerate for at least an hour to let the flavors mingle. Reserve the remaining juice for another batch. To serve, add grape “ice” to each glass (cocktail glasses, wine glasses, or goblets depending on the mood you’re going for). Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 最好在前一晚，但至少在享用前一小时，准备好西瓜和葡萄并放入冷冻室。用挖球器或小号冰淇淋勺将西瓜挖成球，单层摆放在冷冻容器中冷冻。西瓜球和冷冻葡萄能让桑格利亚保持适宜的温度又不会将其稀释。不要把西瓜里剩下的汁水倒掉！将其留存在罐中，用来加入李子/橙汁中。将李子对半切开，在搅拌机上方去核以接住汁水。搅打几次打成泥。加入橙汁再搅打混合。你应当得到约 1 杯汁。用细滤网过滤（或在准备调制桑格利亚时过滤）以去除部分果肉。如果你有榨汁机，也可以直接榨李子。调制桑格利亚时，将 6-7 个西瓜球、菠萝三角块（或方块）和切片猕猴桃放入壶中。加入 1/2 杯过滤后的李子/橙/西瓜汁以及整瓶桃红葡萄酒。轻轻搅拌，冷藏至少一小时让风味融合。剩余的汁留作下一批使用。上桌前，在每个杯子（鸡尾酒杯、葡萄酒杯或高脚杯，随你当时的心情选择）中加入葡萄冰。端上桌尽情享用！

drinks.name: Tropical Smoothie
ingredients_en: 1 cup fresh or frozen sliced strawberries
drinks.instructions_en: Whiz all ingredients together in a blender for 30 seconds. Pour into a glass and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中搅打 30 秒。倒入杯中享用！

drinks.name: Tschunk
drinks.instructions_en: Dice limes, put them together with the brown sugar into a high glass and crush both. Add crushed ice and pour the rum and the Club-Mate over it. Add a straw
drinks.instructions_zh: 将青柠切丁，与红糖一起放入高杯中压碎。加入碎冰，倒入朗姆酒和 Club-Mate 汽水。插入一根吸管。

drinks.name: Turkish Buttermilk (Ayran)
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in a blender. Mix for 10-20 seconds until ingredients are combined and drink is frothy. Serve chilled.
