drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机。搅打 10-20 秒，直至配料混合均匀、饮品起泡。冰镇后享用。

drinks.name: Turmeric Latte
ingredients_en: one eight teaspoon ground black pepper
ingredients_zh: 四分之一茶匙小豆蔻粉
八分之一茶匙黑胡椒粉
八分之一茶匙多香果粉
drinks.instructions_en: Whisk turmeric, cardamom, black pepper, ginger, cloves, and allspice together in a small bowl. Heat milk in a small saucepan over medium heat until heated through, 3 to 4 minutes; stir honey and vanilla extract into milk until completely dissolved. Whisk 1 teaspoon turmeric mixture into milk mixture; reduce heat to medium-low and cook until flavors blend, 2 to 3 minutes. Pour mixture through a strainer.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小碗中将姜黄、小豆蔻、黑胡椒、生姜、丁香和多香果搅拌均匀。在小锅中用中火加热牛奶 3-4 分钟至热透；将蜂蜜和香草精搅入牛奶中至完全溶解。将 1 茶匙姜黄混合物搅入牛奶混合物中；转中低火煮 2-3 分钟，让风味融合。将混合物通过滤网倒入。

drinks.name: Tuxedo
drinks.instructions_en: Stir all the ingredients with ice. Fine strain into a chilled coupe glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加冰搅拌。细滤入冰镇过的碟形香槟杯。

drinks.name: Two-One-Two
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all ingredients in a shaker and shake Double strain into chilled glass filled with ice. Optionally top with soda. Optionally add grapefruit or orange peel for garnish
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入摇酒壶中摇匀。双重过滤倒入加满冰块的冰镇杯中。可选：注入苏打水。可选：加入西柚皮或橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: umeshu sparkling
ingredients_en: 2 any kind of soda you like
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the CHOYA and soda in a highball glass. Serve over crushed ice and UME fruit. Enjoy it
drinks.instructions_zh: 在海波杯中将 CHOYA（蝶矢梅酒）与苏打水混合。加碎冰和梅子，冰镇享用，尽情享用它吧。

drinks.name: Urak
drinks.instructions_en: Take two-three tablespoons of cashew feni. Fill up half your glass with limca / lemon juice. Add a pinch of salt and some ice cubes. serve over a green chili.
drinks.instructions_zh: 取两三汤匙腰果芬尼酒（cashew feni）。用 Limca 汽水/柠檬汁将杯子装至半满。加入一撮盐和一些冰块。搭配一根青辣椒享用。

drinks.name: Vaca preta
ingredients_en: 2 ice cream ball any flavor (vanilla preferable)
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all ingredients in a blender or just pour Coke on ice cream.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中混合，或者直接把可乐倒在冰淇淋上。

drinks.name: Vampiro
ingredients_en: 2 ounces of Tequila (one ounce per glass)
2 slices of fresh pink grapefruit or grapefruit
drinks.instructions_en: Add the ice cubes and Don Julio tequila (one ounce) in each glass. Then add the sriracha sauce to the tomato juice and stir. This cocktail is prepared in layers, so start with the first layer by pouring a little of the tomato juice, then add the grapefruit or grapefruit juice and, finally, the orange juice. Garnish with a slice of pink grapefruit and a slice of natural orange. Drink this vampire cocktail slowly and enjoy while you drip with fresh Mexican sauce and corn chips before the strong meal.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在每个杯中加入冰块和一杯（1 盎司）唐胡里奥（Don Julio）龙舌兰。然后将是拉差辣椒酱加入番茄汁中搅匀。这款鸡尾酒是分层的，所以先倒入少量番茄汁作为第一层，接着加入西柚或西柚汁，最后加入橙汁。用一片粉红西柚和一片鲜橙装饰。慢慢品尝这款吸血鬼鸡尾酒，在享用丰盛正餐之前，搭配新鲜墨西哥酱汁和玉米片一起慢慢享用。

drinks.name: Vanilla Palm
drinks.instructions_en: Mix all the ingredients. Enjoy this light and refreshing drink.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料混合。享用这杯清爽怡人的饮品。

drinks.name: Vegan Iced Milk Tea
drinks.name_display: 纯素冰奶茶（Vegan Iced Milk Tea）
drinks.instructions_en: Steep black tea in boiled water for 4 minutes. Remove tea and stir in sweetener until fully dissolved. Mix with ice cubes until cool. Add more as needed. Fill with cold water, leaving room for milk alternative. Stir and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将红茶放入沸水中浸泡 4 分钟。取出茶叶，搅入甜味剂至完全溶解。加入冰块搅拌至冷却，可视需要再加冰块。加冷水至满，留出空间加入植物奶。搅拌后享用！

drinks.name: Vegas Bomb
drinks.instructions_en: Combine the whisky, peach schnapps, and coconut rum in a shot glass. Fill a separate glass with a small amount of energy drink. Drop the shot into the energy drink and drink immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将威士忌、桃子利口酒和椰子朗姆酒在子弹杯中混合。在另一个杯中倒入少量能量饮料。将子弹杯投入能量饮料中，立即饮用。

drinks.name: Velvet Elvis
ingredients_en: 1/2 part Shot Freshly squeezed lime juice
drinks.instructions_en: Place all the ingredients (except lemonade) into a Boston Shaker over ice. Strain into a chilled Old Fashioned tumbler glass. Top-up with lemonade.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将除柠檬汽水外的所有配料放入装有冰块的波士顿摇酒壶中。滤入冰镇过的古典杯。加柠檬汽水至满。

drinks.name: Venom
drinks.instructions_en: Add Southern Comfort and Triple Sec to a Pint glass. Fill glass with ice. Fill 3/4 of glass with orange juice. Mix then pour in the bottle of Blue WKD (Can also be placed into the glass). (Optional) Triple Sec can be replaced with Vodka. Enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将南方安逸（Southern Comfort）和橙皮甜酒倒入品脱杯中。在杯中加满冰块。用橙汁将杯子装至 3/4。搅拌后倒入一瓶 Blue WKD（也可以整瓶放入杯中）。（可选）橙皮甜酒可用伏特加代替。尽情享用！

drinks.name: Venus Flytrap
ingredients_en: 2 oz gin infused with kefir lime
1 oz Falernum (West Indies lime based sweetener)
ingredients_zh: 1盎司法勒南（West Indies lime based sweetener）
drinks.instructions_en: To make the gin infusion: blend the gin with keffir lime leaves. Combine 1 double kefir lime leaf per 2oz gin. Strain the result through a cheesecloth and retain infused gin. Combine infused gin, other liquid ingredients, and crushed ice with a blender. Serve in a fancy glass with lime slice, keffir leaf and dash of nutmeg as garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 制作金酒浸泡液：将金酒与泰国青柠叶一起搅打。每 2 盎司金酒配 1 片对折的泰国青柠叶。用纱布过滤，保留浸泡好的金酒。将浸泡金酒、其余液体配料和碎冰放入搅拌机中混合。倒入精致的玻璃杯中，用青柠片、泰国青柠叶和少许肉豆蔻粉装饰。

drinks.name: Vesper
drinks.instructions_en: Shake over ice until well chilled. Strain into a deep goblet. Add a thin slice of lemon peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 加冰摇匀至充分冰凉。滤入深口高脚杯中。加入一片薄柠檬皮。

drinks.name: Vietnamese Coffee (Cafe Sua Da)
drinks.name_display: 越南咖啡（Vietnamese Coffee (Cafe Sua Da)）
drinks.instructions_en: Boil water. Add coffee grounds to phin coffee filter (or pour over coffee filter) and stamp down. Pour hot water in phin coffee filter (or pour over coffee filter). Add in Sweetened condensed milk. Stir until well combined. Add ice and enjoy
drinks.instructions_zh: 烧开水。将咖啡粉放入越南滴滤壶（或手冲滤杯）中压平。将热水倒入越南滴滤壶（或手冲滤杯）。加入甜炼乳。搅拌至充分混合。加冰享用。

drinks.name: Vieux Carre
drinks.instructions_en: Combine liquid ingredients in an ice-filled shaker Shake for approximately 20 seconds. Add ice to an Old Fashioned glass. Larger ice cubes are better here. Strain into the Old Fashioned glass Zest the drink and glass with the lemon peel and then twist and place in glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将液体配料放入装有冰块的摇酒壶中，摇制约 20 秒。在古典杯中加入冰块，这里用较大的冰块更好。滤入古典杯中。用柠檬皮在饮品和杯口上挤香，然后拧转柠檬皮并放入杯中。

drinks.name: Vinho Quente
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the pear and apple into cubes and place all the ingredients in a pan. Bring to the fire and boil for 10 minutes. Turn off and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将梨和苹果切成块，把所有配料放入锅中。上火煮沸 10 分钟。关火即可享用。

drinks.name: Virgin Belgian Orange Blossom
drinks.name_display: 无酒精比利时橙花（Virgin Belgian Orange Blossom）
drinks.instructions_en: Lightly crush the orange slices in a tall glass using a tablespoon. Do not mash the oranges; just crush them enough to release a bit of juice. Add 1/3 cup ice to the cup, fill with the remaining ingredients, and then stir lightly, keeping the orange slices at the bottom of the glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 用汤匙在直身杯中轻轻压碎橙片。不要将橙子捣烂，只需压碎到释出少许汁水即可。向杯中加入 1/3 杯冰块，倒入其余配料至满，然后轻轻搅拌，让橙片保持在杯底。

drinks.name: Virgin Margarita
drinks.instructions_en: Optional: Rim a glass with salt. Add lime juice, orange juice, and agave syrup to a shaker with ice. Shake briefly and strain into a glass over fresh ice. Top with sparkling water if desired and garnish with a lime wheel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 可选：用盐沾杯口。将青柠汁、橙汁和龙舌兰糖浆加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。短暂摇匀后滤入加有新鲜冰块的杯中。如愿可注入气泡水，并用青柠片装饰。

drinks.name: Virgin Mary
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. Pour the tomato juice and lemon juice into a glass filled with ice cubes. Mix well. Add the Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, and hot sauce to taste. Garnish with the celery stalk or pickle spear if using. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好所有配料。将番茄汁和柠檬汁倒入装有冰块的杯中。充分混合。按口味加入伍斯特酱、盐、胡椒和辣酱。若使用的话，用芹菜杆或酸黄瓜条装饰。端上桌尽情享用！

drinks.name: Virgin Mojito
drinks.instructions_en: Crush and mix the mint leaves and lime juice in a glass. Add the raw sugar into the mix. Mix with the honey syrup. Add sparkling water. Garnish with some slices of lime and a spring of mint.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中压碎并混合薄荷叶和青柠汁。将粗糖加入混合物中。加入蜂蜜糖浆混合。加入气泡水。用几片青柠和一枝薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Virgin Strawberry Colada
drinks.name_display: 无酒精草莓可乐达（Virgin Strawberry Colada）
drinks.instructions_en: Blend all the ingredients in a blender at high speed. Pour into a tall glass and decorate with maraschino cherry and a pineapple slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中高速搅打。倒入直身杯中，用酒渍樱桃和一片菠萝装饰。

drinks.name: Vodka Irish Coffee
drinks.name_display: 伏特加爱尔兰咖啡（Vodka Irish Coffee）
drinks.instructions_en: Add cold brewed coffee, vodka, Irish cream, and a dash of bitters to an ice-filled cocktail shaker. Cover and shake until combined. Strain into a 6-oz. ice-filled glass. Sprinkle with ground nutmeg, if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冷萃咖啡、伏特加、爱尔兰奶油和少许苦精加入装有冰块的鸡尾酒摇酒壶中。盖上盖子摇匀至混合。滤入装有冰块的 6 盎司杯中。如愿可撒上肉豆蔻粉。

drinks.name: Vodka Lemonade Punch
drinks.name_display: 伏特加柠檬水潘趣（Vodka Lemonade Punch）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine all of the ingredients in a large pitcher filled with ice, adding the soda last.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入装有冰块的大壶中混合，最后加入汽水。

drinks.name: Vodka Martini
drinks.instructions_en: Combine vodka and dry vermouth in a cocktail mixing glass. Fill with ice and stir until chilled. Strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with three olives on a toothpick.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在调酒杯中加入伏特加和干味美思。加满冰块搅拌至冰凉。滤入冰镇过的马天尼杯。用牙签串三颗橄榄装饰。

drinks.name: Vodka Red Bull
drinks.instructions_en: Either mix, with or without ice, or drop a shot of vodka into the Red Bull in the style of Depth charge
drinks.instructions_zh: 可以加冰或不加冰直接混合，也可以像深水炸弹那样将一份伏特加投入红牛中。

drinks.name: Vodka Schweppes
ingredients_en: 1 1/2 cup Schweppes of your preferred taste, I like the Citrus found in Brazil but you can use other flavors
drinks.instructions_en: Mix the vodka and the soda in the cup, preferably adding the vodka first so it blends well and that's it! Your homemade Smirnoff Ice aka Vodka Schweppes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中混合伏特加和汽水，最好先加伏特加以便充分融合，就这样！你自制的斯米诺冰爽，也就是伏特加舒味思（Vodka Schweppes）就做好了。

drinks.name: Vodka Soda
ingredients_en: 2 Shot glass Vodka (Absolut OR Grey Goose)
drinks.instructions_en: Apply vodka in a glass followed by Soda water. Top off with a lime/lemon if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中倒入伏特加，随后加入苏打水。如愿可用青柠/柠檬收尾。

drinks.name: Warm Lemon Honey Tea
drinks.name_display: 暖柠檬蜂蜜茶（Warm Lemon Honey Tea）
drinks.instructions_en: Squeeze a lemon in a cup of warm water. Add the honey. stir and enjoy.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在一杯温水中挤入一个柠檬。加入蜂蜜。搅拌后享用。

drinks.name: Warm Water
drinks.instructions_en: Take your water and put it in the kettle (as much or as little as you want). Wait for the water to boil or reach your preferred temperature (90°C to 100°C should suffice). Pour the hot water out from the kettle into a cup. Add Dihydrogen Monoxide to cup (again, this is my preference; the more you add, the colder your water becomes).
drinks.instructions_zh: 取水放入水壶中（多少随你喜欢）。等待水烧开或达到你想要的温度（90°C 到 100°C 即可）。将热水从水壶倒入杯中。向杯中加入一氧化二氢（同样，这只是我的偏好；加得越多，水就越凉）。

drinks.name: Washington Apple
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice and ingredients to a shaker. Shake until it's completely cold. Serve in a martini or highball glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块和配料加入摇酒壶中。摇至完全冰凉。倒入马天尼杯或海波杯享用。

drinks.name: Water Chestnut Drink
drinks.instructions_en: Wash the water chestnuts. Scrub the water chestnuts with brush and wash thoroughly, sliced off the heads and bottoms and smash each water chestnut. Bring water to boil in a large pot. Add water chestnuts and winter melon and simmer for 45mins – 1 hr. Add rock sugar and stir. Turn off heat.
drinks.instructions_zh: 洗净荸荠。用刷子刷洗荸荠并彻底冲洗，切去头尾，并将每个荸荠拍碎。在大锅中将水烧开。加入荸荠和冬瓜，小火炖 45 分钟至 1 小时。加入冰糖搅拌。关火。

drinks.name: Watermelon Agua Fresca
ingredients_en: ½ cup white sugar, or to taste
drinks.instructions_en: Puree the watermelon and water in a blender until smooth. Add sugar to taste. Cut the lime slices in half. Place a half lime slice into each of 8 glasses along with 3 mint leaves. Crush with a cocktail muddler, then fill each glass with ice. Pour in the watermelon agua fresca, and stir before serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将西瓜和水放入搅拌机中打成顺滑的果泥。按口味加糖。将青柠片对半切开。在 8 个杯子中分别放入半片青柠和 3 片薄荷叶。用捣棒压碎，然后在每个杯子中加满冰块。倒入西瓜 Agua Fresca（西瓜清凉饮），上桌前搅拌均匀。

drinks.name: Watermelon Lemonade
drinks.instructions_en: Place the watermelon into a blender and mix until it's smooth. Boil the sugar and 1/2 cup of water on medium heat until sugar dissolves. Remove the mix from the heat and and stir 3 cups of cold water and lemon juice. Scoop 2-3 tablespoons of watermelon into a cup. Add the ice cubes and the lemonade. Gently stir before serving.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将西瓜放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。用中火将糖和 1/2 杯水煮沸至糖溶解。将混合物离火，搅入 3 杯冷水和柠檬汁。在杯中舀入 2-3 汤匙西瓜泥。加入冰块和柠檬水。上桌前轻轻搅拌。

drinks.name: Watermelon Mint Lemonade
drinks.name_display: 西瓜薄荷柠檬水（Watermelon Mint Lemonade）
ingredients_en: 10 cup seedless watermelon, cubed in 1-inch pieces
ingredients_zh: 10杯无籽西瓜切成一英寸方块
drinks.instructions_en: Make a simple syrup by combining 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water in a small pan over medium-high heat. Heat the liquid just until the sugar is complete dissolved, 5-6 minutes. Set the simple syrup aside to cool. Pulse the watermelon in a blender until smooth. (You may need to do this in 2 batches.) Strain the pureed watermelon through a fine mesh colander into a large bowl. Discard the pulp and rinse the blender container out with water. Return the watermelon liquid to the blender. Add the lemon juice and mint and blend until the mint is very finely chopped. Transfer the Watermelon Mint Lemonade to a juice pitcher. Slowly adjust for your desired sweetness by adding simple syrup to the lemonade. Chill until serving. Serve over ice, with lemon slices and fresh mint as a garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在小锅中用中高火将 1/2 杯糖和 1/2 杯水混合，制作糖浆。将液体加热 5-6 分钟，直到糖完全溶解即可。将糖浆放置一旁冷却。将西瓜放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。（你可能需要分两批进行。）将西瓜泥通过细网滤器过滤到大碗中。丢弃果渣，用水冲洗搅拌机容器。将西瓜汁倒回搅拌机中。加入柠檬汁和薄荷，搅打至薄荷被切得非常细碎。将西瓜薄荷柠檬水倒入果汁壶中。向柠檬水中慢慢加入糖浆，调整到你喜欢的甜度。冷藏至享用。加冰享用，用柠檬片和新鲜薄荷装饰。

drinks.name: Watermelon Moscow Mule
drinks.name_display: 西瓜莫斯科骡子（Watermelon Moscow Mule）
drinks.instructions_en: Slice watermelon, blend and strain. Add Watermelon, Vodka and ice into shaker and shake for 30 seconds. Pour over ice in mule mug and top it off with ginger beer. Add mint leaves and a slice of lime and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 将西瓜切片，搅打并过滤。将西瓜汁、伏特加和冰块加入摇酒壶中摇 30 秒。倒入加有冰块的铜杯中，注入姜汁啤酒至满。加入薄荷叶和一片青柠，尽情享用！

drinks.name: Watermelon Smoothie
drinks.instructions_en: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。立即享用。

drinks.name: Watermelon Vodka
drinks.instructions_en: Open the watermelon by cutting a hat on top. Scoop out the flesh with a spoon and blend the pieces to make a puree. Collect the juice from the watermelon by straining it through a sieve. Pierce the watermelon with an apple corer and install the cubicle tap. If necessary, roll up some cellophane to seal the watermelon. Put the vodka, brown sugar, lemon juice and watermelon juice inside and mix. Serve and add a few mint leaves and ice cubes.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在西瓜顶部切一个盖子将其打开。用勺子挖出果肉，将果肉搅打成泥。用滤网过滤收集西瓜汁。用苹果去核器在西瓜上打孔，装上龙头（出液阀）。如有必要，卷一些玻璃纸来密封西瓜。将伏特加、红糖、柠檬汁和西瓜汁倒入其中混合。上桌时加入几片薄荷叶和冰块。

drinks.name: Wedang Uwuh
drinks.instructions_en: Wash all ingredients, then boil water in a saucepan, put all the ingredients in the wedang uwuh. Bring the wedang uwuh to a boil until the boiling water is dark red. Turn off the heat and wait until the warm boiled water is strong. Move in a teapot and add the honey mixture until well blended. Serve warm.
drinks.instructions_zh: 洗净所有配料，然后在锅中烧水，将所有配料放入 wedang uwuh 中。将 wedang uwuh 煮沸，直到水变成深红色。关火，等待温热的煮水味道浓郁。倒入茶壶中，加入蜂蜜混合至充分融合。趁热享用。

drinks.name: Werther's Hot Toddies
drinks.name_display: 韦特斯热托迪（Werther's Hot Toddies）
ingredients_en: 2 cinnamon sticks, plus more for garnish
ingredients_zh: 2根肉桂棒另备更多用于装饰
drinks.instructions_en: Place crushed Werther's on a shallow plate, and caramel on a separate shallow plate. Dip rims first in caramel, and then in crushed Werther's. In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine water, whole Werther's, and cinnamon sticks. Stir constantly until candies are fully melted. Turn off heat and stir in lemon juice and whiskey.  Ladle into mugs and serve.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将压碎的怡口糖（Werther's）放在浅盘中，焦糖放在另一个浅盘中。先将杯口蘸焦糖，再蘸压碎的怡口糖。在小锅中用中火将水、整颗怡口糖和肉桂棒混合。不断搅拌至糖完全融化。关火，搅入柠檬汁和威士忌。舀入马克杯中享用。

drinks.name: Whiskey Boulevardier
drinks.instructions_en: Fill a mixing glass with ice. Add whiskey, vermouth, and aperol. Stir until chilled and strain into cocktail glass. Garnish with orange peel.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在调酒杯中加满冰块。加入威士忌、味美思和阿佩罗。搅拌至冰凉，滤入鸡尾酒杯。用橙皮装饰。

drinks.name: Whiskey Highball
drinks.instructions_en: Chill a highball glass and fill it with ice. Add whiskey and stir briefly to chill. Top with chilled soda water. Stir once or twice very gently to keep carbonation. Garnish with lemon if desired.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将海波杯冰镇后加满冰块。加入威士忌并短暂搅拌使其冰凉。注入冰镇苏打水至满。非常轻柔地搅拌一两次以保留气泡。如愿可用柠檬装饰。

drinks.name: Whiskey Smash
drinks.instructions_en: Add the ingredients to your cocktail shaker and fill with ice. Shake & double strain over fresh ice into a double old fashioned glass. Slap a mint sprig between your hands and use as garnish.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将配料加入鸡尾酒摇酒壶中并加满冰块。摇匀后双重过滤倒在新鲜冰块上，倒入大号古典杯中。在双手间拍打一枝薄荷，用作装饰。

drinks.name: Whiskey Sour [Vegas Style]
drinks.name_display: 维加斯风味威士忌酸（Whiskey Sour [Vegas Style]）
drinks.instructions_en: Add ice, Bourbon, and lemon juice in a metal mixer. Shake until condensation forms on the metal. Pour into glass and garnish with cherry and your choice of citrus wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在金属调酒器中加入冰块、波本威士忌和柠檬汁。摇至金属外壁凝结水珠。倒入杯中，用樱桃和你喜欢的柑橘角装饰。

drinks.name: Whisky Sour
drinks.instructions_en: Put ice and all of the ingredients into a shaker and shake hard for about 20 seconds to chill the liquid really well. Strain the mix into a glass filled with ice and garnish with the cherry and orange slice.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将冰块和所有配料放入摇酒壶中，用力摇制约 20 秒，使液体充分冰凉。将混合液滤入装有冰块的杯中，用樱桃和橙片装饰。

drinks.name: White Bear
drinks.instructions_en: Optional: Put some ice into champagne glass. Add Champagne and Vodka. Stir gently to release some bubbles. Garnish with a lemon wedge.
drinks.instructions_zh: 可选：在香槟杯中放入一些冰块。加入香槟和伏特加。轻轻搅拌释放一些气泡。用一角柠檬装饰。

drinks.name: White Christmas Margaritas
drinks.name_display: 白色圣诞玛格丽特（White Christmas Margaritas）
drinks.instructions_en: Combine coconut milk, tequila, triple sec, lime juice and ice in a blender. Blend until smooth. Rim glasses with lime wedge and dip in sanding sugar. Pour into glass and garnish with lime and cranberries.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将椰奶、龙舌兰、橙皮甜酒、青柠汁和冰块放入搅拌机中混合。搅打至顺滑。用青柠角抹湿杯口，再蘸上粗砂糖。倒入杯中，用青柠和蔓越莓装饰。

drinks.name: White Christmas Mojito
drinks.name_display: 白色圣诞莫吉托（White Christmas Mojito）
drinks.instructions_en: Muddle the lime juice, sugar and mint leaves in a glass until the leaves have broken down. Fill the glass half way with ice. Combine the white rum, coconut rum, and coconut milk in a blender and pulse until smooth. Pour over the ice and stir to combine. Top with sparkling water, mint and pomegranate. Cheers!
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯中捣压青柠汁、糖和薄荷叶，直到薄荷叶被捣碎。将杯子用冰块装至半满。将白朗姆酒、椰子朗姆酒和椰奶放入搅拌机中搅打至顺滑。倒在冰块上搅拌混合。注入气泡水，加入薄荷和石榴。干杯！

drinks.name: White Freezie
drinks.instructions_en: Optional: Add ice to a glass. Pour Liqueur into the glass. Fill remainder of glass with Sprite or 7-Up.
drinks.instructions_zh: 可选：在杯中加入冰块。将利口酒倒入杯中。用雪碧或七喜将杯子剩余部分装满。

drinks.name: White Lady
drinks.instructions_en: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice and shake. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料加入装有冰块的摇酒壶中摇匀。滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯。

drinks.name: White Russian
drinks.instructions_en: Pour coffee liqueur and vodka into an Old Fashioned glass filled with ice. Float fresh cream on top and stir slowly.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将咖啡利口酒和伏特加倒入装有冰块的古典杯中。在表面漂浮一层鲜奶油，缓慢搅拌。

drinks.name: White Wine Sangria
drinks.name_display: 白葡萄酒桑格利亚（White Wine Sangria）
drinks.instructions_en: In a medium bowl, combine strawberries, mango, peach, sugar, and Grand Marnier. Refrigerate for 1 hour. To a large pitcher, add refrigerated fruit and apple, orange, and lime slices. Pour in white wine and seltzer, and stir to combine. Serve well chilled.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在中号碗中，将草莓、芒果、桃子、糖和柑曼怡混合。冷藏 1 小时。将冷藏过的水果以及苹果片、橙片和青柠片放入大壶中。倒入白葡萄酒和苏打水，搅拌混合。充分冰镇后享用。

drinks.name: Witches Heart
ingredients_en: 1 oz Apple Brandy or Apple Vodka
ingredients_zh: 1盎司苹果白兰地或苹果伏特加
drinks.instructions_en: Add about 1/2 - 1 tsp of powdered dry ice to the bottom of the glass (optional). Place the apple brandy and purple shimmery liqueur in a shaker. Add 1 ice cube and shake for a few seconds to chill the drink. Strain the drink into a martini glass. Top up with more Blackberry liqueur if necessary.  Pour 1 tsp of grenadine syrup, about an inch from the surface of the drink - the grenadine should sink to the bottom, creating a bleeding effect. Add about 1/2 tsp of powdered dry ice on top and serve with a stirrer, so that your guests can stir the potion to create that shimmery, smoky effect.
drinks.instructions_zh: 在杯底加入约 1/2-1 茶匙干冰粉（可选）。将苹果白兰地和紫色闪光利口酒放入摇酒壶中。加入 1 块冰块，摇几秒使饮品冰凉。将饮品滤入马天尼杯中。如有需要，再加入更多黑莓利口酒至满。在距饮品表面约一英寸处倒入 1 茶匙红石榴糖浆，糖浆应沉到底部，形成流血效果。在表面加入约 1/2 茶匙干冰粉，并附上一根搅拌棒上桌，这样你的客人就能搅拌这杯魔药，营造出那种闪光、烟雾缭绕的效果。

drinks.name: Woo Woo
drinks.instructions_en: Gather the ingredients. Place the ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass or a highball filled with fresh ice. Garnish with a lime wedge. Serve and enjoy!
drinks.instructions_zh: 准备好所有配料。将配料放入装有冰块的鸡尾酒摇酒壶中。充分摇匀。滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯，或装有新鲜冰块的海波杯。用一角青柠装饰。端上桌尽情享用！

drinks.name: Yale Cocktail
ingredients_zh: 1/4茶匙马拉斯奇诺樱桃利口酒
drinks.instructions_en: Shake all ingredients well with ice in a cocktail shaker. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and serve
drinks.instructions_zh: 将所有配料与冰块放入鸡尾酒摇酒壶中充分摇匀。滤入冰镇过的鸡尾酒杯即可享用。

drinks.name: Yellow watermelon juice
drinks.instructions_en: Cut the watermelon. Put the watermelon in the blender & pour with water. Add sugar. Blend until the watermelon is smooth. If it's already smooth, put it in the glass.  Add ice cubes and the juice is ready to serve
drinks.instructions_zh: 切开西瓜。将西瓜放入搅拌机中并加水。加入糖。搅打至西瓜顺滑。如果已经顺滑，就将其倒入杯中。加入冰块，果汁即可上桌。

drinks.name: Yogurt Fruit Shake
drinks.name_display: 酸奶水果奶昔（Yogurt Fruit Shake）
ingredients_en: 1 1/2 cup milk (can substitute with almond/soy/cashew milk)
ingredients_zh: 牛奶（can substitute with almond/soy/cashew milk）
drinks.instructions_en: Add yogurt, orange juice, and milk to blender. Add frozen fruits (strawberries, blueberries, bananas). Blend on medium/high power until mushy, stopping occasionally to stir the mixture around (especially if frozen fruits don't look like they're blending). Once the mixture has been turned to a thick mush, add the honey for taste, and pulse on low for a few seconds. And you're done! Serve in a cup with a straw, or spoon.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将酸奶、橙汁和牛奶加入搅拌机中。加入冷冻水果（草莓、蓝莓、香蕉）。用中/高功率搅打至糊状，期间偶尔停下搅拌混合物（尤其是当冷冻水果看起来搅不动时）。待混合物变成浓稠的糊状后，按口味加入蜂蜜，用低速搅打几秒。这样就完成了！盛入杯中，配上一根吸管或勺子享用。

drinks.name: Yogurt-Lassi
drinks.instructions_en: Chill the curd or yogurt and water. Add curd to a large bowl. Whisk it well to break lumps and make it smooth. Pour curd, water, salt, sugar, mint powder and cumin powder to a blender. Blend lassi until frothy. Pour to serving glasses. Lassi is best served chilled garnished with mint leaves.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将凝乳（或酸奶）和水冷藏。将凝乳放入大碗中。充分搅打以打散结块并使其顺滑。将凝乳、水、盐、糖、薄荷粉和孜然粉倒入搅拌机中。搅打拉西至起泡。倒入饮用杯中。拉西冰镇后配薄荷叶装饰风味最佳。

drinks.name: Zanzibar Ricard
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the Ricard pastis, pineapple juice and coconut liqueur into a shaker. Add ice cubes and beat. Pour into a glass. Add the grenadine syrup and other ice cubes. Garnish with a slice of pineapple.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将里卡尔茴香酒（Ricard pastis）、菠萝汁和椰子利口酒倒入摇酒壶中。加入冰块摇匀。倒入杯中。加入红石榴糖浆和其余冰块。用一片菠萝装饰。

drinks.name: Zombie
drinks.instructions_en: Blend at high speed for no more than 5 seconds. Pour into glass. Add ice cubes to fill. Add garnish to top.
drinks.instructions_zh: 高速搅打不超过 5 秒。倒入杯中。加入冰块至满。在顶部加上装饰。

drinks.name: Zorbatini
drinks.instructions_en: Pour the vodka and ouzo into a martini glass. Decorate with a green olive.
drinks.instructions_zh: 将伏特加和乌佐酒倒入马天尼杯中。用一颗绿橄榄装饰。
